item.title: 本文提出将小波编码与傅里叶神经算子相结合，突破了传统算子学习假设唯一输入-输出映射的限制，实现了在单一模型中学习并预测弹性波方程的多个特征模态，从而确定超材料中声波传播的变形模式。
item.description:
基于小波编码傅里叶神经算子的超材料特征模态学习

Learning Metamaterial Eigenmodes with Wavelet-Encoded Fourier Neural Operators

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08102

本文提出将小波编码与傅里叶神经算子相结合，突破了传统算子学习假设唯一输入-输出映射的限制，实现了在单一模型中学习并预测弹性波方程的多个特征模态，从而确定超材料中声波传播的变形模式。

基于神经算子的机器学习代理模型在求解偏微分方程（PDE）正问题方面展现出广泛的适用性。然而，特征值问题——需要同时求解一个特征参数和多个有效特征模态中的一个——仍然极具挑战性，因为标准的算子学习框架假设输入-输出映射是唯一的。这项工作表明，傅里叶神经算子（FNOs）与基于小波的PDE输入编码相结合，能够学习和预测弹性波方程的多个特征模态，这些模态对应于声波在任意超材料几何结构中传播时的变形模式。我们为小波编码为何与FNO的双重空间-频谱结构高度契合提供了机理解释和实验证据，这一契合使得单一模型能够在连续值和二值几何结构上实现确定性的模态选择，并解释了预测精度为何随……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.08102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning surrogates based on neural operators have shown broad applicability in solving forward PDE problems. However, eigenvalue problems, in which an eigenparameter and one of several valid eigenmodes must be simultaneously solved, remain difficult because standard operator learning formulations assume a unique input-output map. This work demonstrates that Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs), combined with wavelet-based encodings of PDE inputs, can learn and predict multiple eigenmodes of the elastic wave equation, corresponding to deformation modes of acoustic waves propagating through arbitrary metamaterial geometries. item.title: PocketVE是一个以蛋白质口袋为条件的方差爆炸扩散框架，通过结合EDM式3D去噪、无分类器多性质引导和自适应蛋白质扰动正则化，在CrossDocked2020上显著提升了3D有效性（58.6→80.6）并大幅降低了应变能（457.4→127.9）。
item.description:
PocketVE：基于方差爆炸扩散的稳定且性质引导的结构药物设计

PocketVE: Stable and Property-Guided Structure-Based Drug Design with Variance-Exploding Diffusion

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08101

PocketVE是一个以蛋白质口袋为条件的方差爆炸扩散框架，通过结合EDM式3D去噪、无分类器多性质引导和自适应蛋白质扰动正则化，在CrossDocked2020上显著提升了3D有效性（58.6→80.6）并大幅降低了应变能（457.4→127.9）。

蛋白质条件化的3D分子生成是基于结构的药物设计中的核心挑战，需要在口袋兼容性、分子性质和物理几何之间取得平衡。我们提出了PocketVE，一个以蛋白质口袋为条件的方差爆炸（VE）扩散框架，它将稳定的坐标去噪与推理时的性质引导相结合。具体而言，PocketVE结合了用于3D去噪的EDM风格训练与采样设置、无需外部性质分类器即可实现多性质导向的无分类器引导，以及作为训练时口袋正则化器的自适应蛋白质扰动。在CrossDocked2020数据集上按照GenBench3D协议进行评估，PocketVE相对于其TAGMol架构基线，将Valid$_{3\text{D}}$从58.6提升到80.6，并将应变能从457.4降低到127.9，同时在适度引导下保持具有竞争力的对接得分和分子性质评分。一个引导尺度

arXiv:2609.08101v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Protein-conditioned 3D molecule generation is a central challenge in structure-based drug design, requiring a balance between pocket compatibility, molecular properties, and physical geometry. We propose \textbf{PocketVE}, a protein-pocket-conditioned variance-exploding (VE) diffusion framework that couples stable coordinate denoising with inference-time property guidance. Specifically, PocketVE combines an EDM-style training and sampling setup for 3D denoising, classifier-free guidance for multi-property steering without external property classifiers, and adaptive protein perturbation as a training-time pocket regularizer. Evaluated on CrossDocked2020 under the GenBench3D protocol, PocketVE improves Valid$_{3\text{D}}$ from 58.6 to 80.6 and reduces strain energy from 457.4 to 127.9 relative to its TAGMol architectural baseline, while retaining competitive docking and molecular-property scores under moderate guidance. item.title: 提出Marigold V2，通过将基于扩散Transformer的图像生成模型改造为单步推理的单目深度估计器，并借助语义特征对齐和两阶段微调两种策略消除训练伪影，在保持低成本的同时实现高质量、强泛化能力的深度估计。
item.description:
Marigold V2：重新审视用于单目深度估计的扩散Transformer

Marigold V2: Revisiting Diffusion Transformers for Monocular Depth Estimation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08084

提出Marigold V2，通过将基于扩散Transformer的图像生成模型改造为单步推理的单目深度估计器，并借助语义特征对齐和两阶段微调两种策略消除训练伪影，在保持低成本的同时实现高质量、强泛化能力的深度估计。

单目深度估计是一项普遍存在但高度不适定的计算机视觉任务，在场景重建、计算摄影和机器人等领域有着广泛的下游应用。尽管该领域已相当成熟，但近期的模型仍难以泛化到分布外的输入，也难以生成清晰、细致的深度图。在本文中，我们重新审视了Marigold——一套将基于扩散Transformer（DiT）架构的现代图像生成与编辑模型改造为最先进单目深度估计器的技术方案。我们的方法针对从预训练的多步流匹配模型进行单步推理，并在需要时进行量化，在保持模型能力的同时保持较低的运行成本。我们分析了朴素训练所产生的伪影问题，并找到了两种有效的补救措施：将模型的内部表征与从真实值中提取的语义特征对齐，以及采用两阶段微调策略。

arXiv:2609.08084v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Monocular depth estimation is a ubiquitous yet highly ill-posed computer vision task, with downstream applications in scene reconstruction, computational photography, and robotics, among others. Despite the field's maturity, recent models still struggle to generalize to out-of-distribution inputs and to produce sharp and detailed depth maps. In this paper, we revisit Marigold, a set of techniques for repurposing modern image generation and editing models, powered by the diffusion transformer (DiT) architecture, into state-of-the-art monocular depth estimators. Our recipes target single-step inference from pretrained multi-step flow-matching models, with quantization where needed, preserving model capacity while remaining cheap to run. item.title: 提出了一种基于情境预测的主动式安全约束生成框架，通过推断潜在环境情境并预测其未来演变来前瞻性地构建安全约束，使强化学习智能体能够在非平稳环境中主动规避不安全区域。
item.description:
面向非平稳强化学习的主动式情境预测安全约束

Proactive Context-Forecasted Safety Constraints for Nonstationary Reinforcement Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08080

提出了一种基于情境预测的主动式安全约束生成框架，通过推断潜在环境情境并预测其未来演变来前瞻性地构建安全约束，使强化学习智能体能够在非平稳环境中主动规避不安全区域。

在非平稳环境下确保强化学习的安全性，需要在风险导致不安全行为之前预先察觉这些变化。现有方法通常依赖于在设计阶段定义的安全约束，或在执行过程中被动更新的约束，并假设此类约束会随时间保持有效。然而，在具有演变情境和变化驾驶布局的非平稳环境中，这些假设可能失效。我们提出了一个基于情境预测的主动式安全约束生成框架。该方法从观测中推断潜在的环境情境，预测其未来演变，并构建适应预期条件的安全约束。这使智能体能够主动避免不安全区域，而不是仅在安全违规发生后才做出反应。我们在具有结构化情境变化的驾驶环境中对该方法进行评估，实验包括对非平稳性的参数扫描。

arXiv:2609.08080v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ensuring safety in reinforcement learning under nonstationarity requires anticipating changes in risk before they lead to unsafe behavior. Existing approaches typically rely on safety constraints defined at design time or updated reactively during execution, assuming that such constraints remain valid over time. However, in nonstationary environments with evolving contexts and changing driving layouts, these assumptions may fail. We propose a framework for proactive safety constraint generation based on context forecasting. The approach infers latent environmental context from observations, predicts its future evolution, and constructs safety constraints adapted to anticipated conditions. This enables the agent to proactively avoid unsafe regions instead of reacting only after safety violations occur. We evaluate the method in driving environments with structured context variation. item.title: 本文提出了一个整合餐厅运营需求、气象数据和时间事件指标的机器学习框架，利用四种回归模型预测餐厅每日食物浪费量，以支持可持续食物管理。
item.description:
一个用于预测餐厅食物浪费以支持可持续食物管理的机器学习框架

A Machine Learning Framework for Predicting Restaurant Food Waste to Support Sustainable Food Management

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08078

本文提出了一个整合餐厅运营需求、气象数据和时间事件指标的机器学习框架，利用四种回归模型预测餐厅每日食物浪费量，以支持可持续食物管理。

餐饮行业的食物浪费对环境可持续性和经济效率构成了重大挑战。本文提出了一个探索性的机器学习框架，用于根据运营和情境特征估计餐厅每日的食物浪费量。通过整合餐厅需求记录、气象数据和时间事件指标，构建了一个结构化数据集，包含77,980条记录和27个特征。由于大规模的真实食物浪费测量数据尚未公开，目标变量基于合理的运营假设推导得出，并公开了完整的构建公式和受控随机变异性，以确保完全可复现性。研究在遵循餐厅运营时间顺序的按时间顺序70-30训练-测试划分下，评估了四种监督回归模型，即线性回归、决策树、随机森林和梯度提升。

arXiv:2609.08078v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Food waste in the restaurant sector poses a substantial challenge to environmental sustainability and economic efficiency. This paper presents an exploratory machine learning framework for estimating daily restaurant food waste quantities from operational and contextual features. A structured dataset was constructed by integrating restaurant demand records, meteorological data and temporal event indicators, yielding 77,980 records across 27 features. Because large-scale ground-truth food waste measurements are not publicly available, the target variable was derived from operationally justified assumptions, with the complete construction formula and controlled stochastic variability disclosed for full reproducibility. A Gradient-based yet Spike-Timing-Dependent Solution to the Feedback Learning Problem in Neural Microcircuits

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08070

本文提出梯度隧穿算法，将时间信用分配重构为状态分离问题，从局部突触脉冲时序推导信用分配，实现了与生物脉冲时序一致的神经微回路在线反馈学习框架。

大脑利用离散脉冲进行动态计算，然而神经微回路如何利用局部脉冲时序来解决时间信用分配问题仍然是一个基本的开放性问题。主流的脉冲神经网络（SNN）方法通过代理梯度近似反向传播来规避这一问题，使学习与生物脉冲时序解耦。在此，我们将时间信用分配重新表述为一个状态分离问题：直接从当前神经状态中提取由历史扰动引起的任务所需成分。这使得通过梯度隧穿（GT）算法和超前-滞后展开技术，为神经微回路构建了在线反馈学习框架，该技术从局部突触脉冲时序中推导信用分配，同时保持与ANN-SNN混合架构的兼容性。实验表明，经GT训练的神经微回路在长时间尺度的证据整合和抗噪记忆保持方面表现出色，并且能够执行……

arXiv:2609.08070v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The brain uses discrete spikes for dynamic computation, yet, how neural microcircuits (NMCs) solve temporal credit assignment using local spike timing remains a fundamental open question. Dominant spiking neural network (SNN) approaches circumvent this by approximating backpropagation through surrogate gradients, decoupling learning from biological spike timing. Here, we reformulate temporal credit assignment as a state separation problem: extracting task-required components induced by historical perturbations directly from the current neural state. This enables an online feedback learning framework for NMCs through a gradient tunneling (GT) algorithm and the lead-lag expansion technique that derives credit assignment from local synaptic spike timing, while remaining compatible with ANN-SNN hybrid architectures. item.title: 提出风险条件化RLHF框架，通过训练单一策略提供连续可调的风险控制接口，使用户能够在推理时灵活选择不同的风险规避程度，而无需重新训练或部署多个特定风险的模型。
item.description:
大语言模型的风险条件化微调

Risk-Conditioned Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08064

提出风险条件化RLHF框架，通过训练单一策略提供连续可调的风险控制接口，使用户能够在推理时灵活选择不同的风险规避程度，而无需重新训练或部署多个特定风险的模型。

大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被部署在罕见但严重的有害生成内容可能造成重大后果的场景中。现有的风险规避RLHF通过优化条件风险价值（CVaR）来解决这一问题，但其针对固定的风险水平训练策略，因此无法在推理时调整所需的风险规避程度。在本文中，我们提出了风险条件化RLHF，这是一个训练单一策略的框架，该策略提供了连续的风险控制接口，使用户无需重新训练或部署多个针对特定风险的模型即可选择不同的风险规避程度。在多个基准测试上的实验表明，单一的风险条件化策略能够在推理时适应不同的风险水平，从而实现更灵活、更具风险感知能力的大语言模型部署。

arXiv:2609.08064v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings where rare but severe harmful generations can have significant consequences. Existing Risk-Averse RLHF addresses this issue by optimizing Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), but it trains policies for fixed risk levels and therefore cannot adjust the desired degree of risk aversion at inference time. In this paper, we propose risk-conditioned RLHF, a framework that trains a single policy that provides a continuous risk-control interface, enabling users to select different degrees of risk aversion without retraining or deploying multiple risk-specific models. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that a single risk-conditioned policy can adapt to different risk levels at inference time, enabling more flexible and risk-aware LLM deployment.

Bayesian Matrix-Valued Graphs for Context-Dependent Multivariate Relationships

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08055

本文提出贝叶斯矩阵值图（BMVG），用对称正定矩阵建模图的边，并借助AIRM测地距离与广义特征值来量化和定位多变量相互作用在不同情境间的变化幅度与方向，在精度矩阵恢复上优于或媲美现有基线方法。

许多科学领域的图网络在每一个节点上附加了多个变量，因此单一的标量边权重无法描述方向依赖的相互作用。我们用对称正定（SPD）矩阵对每条边进行建模，并推断矩阵值图几何结构上的后验分布，我们称之为贝叶斯矩阵值图（BMVG）。我们研究这些相互作用如何在不同情境间重新配置：变化有多大，以及哪些多元方向被加强或削弱。由仿射不变黎曼度量（AIRM）诱导的测地距离用于量化变形幅度，而广义特征值则解析其带符号的方向。与融合图套索（fused graphical lasso）、贝叶斯多重高斯图模型（Bayesian multiple-GGM）和公共主成分方法相比，BMVG在全局精度矩阵恢复方面具有竞争力，同时保留了可识别的矩阵值边结构，并能准确恢复边级别的变形方向。在受控的真值已知实验中，它能够解析结构……

arXiv:2609.08055v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many scientific graphs attach several variables to each node, so a single scalar edge weight cannot describe direction-dependent interactions. We model each edge by a symmetric positive-definite (SPD) matrix and infer a posterior over matrix-valued graph geometries, which we call the Bayesian matrix-valued graph (BMVG). We ask how these interactions reconfigure across contexts: how large the change is and which multivariate directions strengthen or weaken. A Quantitative Evaluation Framework for Temporal Explainability in Echocardiographic Video Segmentation

Using EchoNet-Dynamic, we compare a baseline 2D U-Net with ConvLSTM U-Net models trained across multiple temporal strides. While segmentation performance remained comparable across all models, intermediate ConvLSTM explanations exhibited substantially lower saliency consistency and greater centroid motion than final prediction explanations. item.title: 提出了MamMA，一种基于Mamba的行人轨迹预测算法，通过将占据地图按补丁划分提取障碍物特征，并结合行人感知状态和自我视角图像的细粒度行为信息，提升了人机共存环境中移动机器人的轨迹预测精度与导航安全性。
item.description:
MamMA：一种考虑占据地图和行人感知状态的基于Mamba的行人轨迹预测算法

MamMA: A Mamba-Based Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction Algorithm Considering Occupancy Map and Pedestrian Awareness States

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08041

提出了MamMA，一种基于Mamba的行人轨迹预测算法，通过将占据地图按补丁划分提取障碍物特征，并结合行人感知状态和自我视角图像的细粒度行为信息，提升了人机共存环境中移动机器人的轨迹预测精度与导航安全性。

许多行人轨迹预测算法被提出来改善在人机共存环境中工作的移动机器人的导航安全性。一些行人轨迹预测算法从俯视图图像中提取行人附近障碍物的信息，以提高轨迹预测的准确性。然而，移动机器人通常使用激光雷达（LiDAR）创建局部占据地图，而非俯视图图像。同时，机器人上搭载的视觉传感器提供以机器人为中心的自我视角图像，其中包含机器人附近行人的细粒度行为信息。为了更好地利用激光雷达和机载视觉传感器收集的信息，我们提出了MamMA，一种考虑占据地图和行人感知状态的基于Mamba的行人轨迹预测算法。MamMA将占据地图按补丁划分，并从每个补丁中提取障碍物特征以构建地图特征。

arXiv:2609.08041v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithms have been proposed to improve the safety of navigation for mobile robots working in human-robot coexistence environments. Some pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithms extract information about obstacles near pedestrians from top-down view images to improve the accuracy of trajectory prediction. However, mobile robots typically create local occupancy maps using LiDAR, rather than top-down view images. Meanwhile, the vision sensors on board robots provide egocentric view images, which contain fine-grained behavioral information about the pedestrians near the robot. To better use the information collected by LiDAR and on-board vision sensors, we propose MamMA, a Mamba-based pedestrian trajectory prediction algorithm considering occupancy maps and pedestrian awareness states. MamMA divides the occupancy map by patches and extracts obstacle features from each patch to create map features.

item.title: 该论文提出了VEX-Bench，这是首个专门用于评估大语言模型智能体判断软件供应链中已知漏洞对下游项目可利用性能力的基准测试，填补了以往基准仅针对零日漏洞场景的空白。
item.description:
VEX-Bench：用于评估大语言模型智能体判断软件供应链漏洞可利用性能力的基准测试

VEX-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Assessing Exploitability of Software Supply Chain Vulnerabilities

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08040

该论文提出了VEX-Bench，这是首个专门用于评估大语言模型智能体判断软件供应链中已知漏洞对下游项目可利用性能力的基准测试，填补了以往基准仅针对零日漏洞场景的空白。

摘要：软件供应链由于依赖复杂而脆弱的依赖关系，已成为日益暴露的攻击面。现有的防御措施（如 GitHub Dependabot）经常产生大量误报，因为其粗粒度匹配无法判断易受攻击的依赖是否真正可被利用。安全分析师通常需要花费大量时间逐一评估漏洞的可利用性。最近的大语言模型（LLM）智能体凭借其在编程和网络安全方面的先进能力，已成为完成这项任务的有前景的候选者，但目前尚无基准测试对此进行评估。以往的基准测试针对的是零日漏洞场景，即智能体检测并利用先前未知的漏洞。相比之下，软件供应链安全关注的是上游依赖中的已知漏洞如何影响下游项目，这要求智能体跨代码库进行推理，并判断上游漏洞是否能够影响下游项目。

arXiv:2609.08040v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The software supply chain has become an increasingly exposed attack surface because of its reliance on intricate yet fragile dependencies. Existing defenses such as GitHub Dependabot often raise many false alerts because their coarse-grained matching cannot determine whether a vulnerable dependency is actually exploitable. Security analysts typically spend substantial time assessing vulnerability exploitability case by case. Recent LLM agents have emerged as promising candidates for this task given their advanced capabilities in coding and cybersecurity, yet no existing benchmark evaluates them on it. Prior benchmarks target zero-day settings, where agents detect and exploit previously unknown vulnerabilities. In contrast, software supply chain security focuses on how known vulnerabilities in upstream dependencies affect downstream projects. item.title: 提出双尺度局部化PCA-Net，通过粗全局PCA基与局部残差PCA基相结合的表示方法，在将PCA拟合成本减半的同时，显著降低了PDE算子学习中的重建误差与块状伪影。
item.description:
双尺度局部化PCA-Net：用于伪影削减的PDE算子学习的粗全局与局部残差表示

Two-Scale Localized PCA-Net: Coarse-Global and Local-Residual Representations for Artifact-Reduced PDE Operator Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08034

提出双尺度局部化PCA-Net，通过粗全局PCA基与局部残差PCA基相结合的表示方法，在将PCA拟合成本减半的同时，显著降低了PDE算子学习中的重建误差与块状伪影。

局部化降维可以提升高维偏微分方程（PDE）算子学习的可扩展性，但独立解码的局部块可能引入块间偏移、界面失配以及虚假的高波数内容。我们提出了双尺度局部化PCA-Net（Two-Scale Localized PCA-Net），该方法将解分解为粗全局分量和局部残差修正。一个紧凑的全局PCA基用于捕获域尺度结构，而非重叠的局部PCA基表示剩余的细尺度残差。块平衡的潜在目标函数将两种表示耦合起来，可选的界面感知微调则通过重建损失和迹损失进一步促进连续性。在泊松方程基准测试中，相较于普通及基于重叠的局部化PCA-Net，双尺度表示显著降低了重建误差和可见的块状伪影，同时将PCA拟合成本大约减半。

arXiv:2609.08034v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Localized dimensionality reduction improves the scalability of operator learning for high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs), but independently decoded local patches can introduce block offsets, interface mismatches, and spurious high-wavenumber content. We introduce Two-Scale Localized PCA-Net, which decomposes the solution into a coarse-global component and local residual corrections. A compact global PCA basis captures domain-scale structure, while nonoverlapping local PCA bases represent the remaining fine-scale residual. A block-balanced latent objective couples the two representations, and optional interface-aware fine-tuning further promotes continuity through reconstruction and trace losses. item.description:
基于语言与风格参考的灵活动作生成

Flexible Motion Generation from Language and Style References

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08032

FlexMoGen是一个同时以自然语言描述和动作风格示例片段为条件的人体动作合成框架，能够生成既保留文本语义内容、又忠实再现目标风格细节的高质量动作。

我们提出了FlexMoGen，这是一个新颖的框架，能够同时以自然语言描述和动作风格参考为条件进行灵活的人体动作合成。文本提示在定义语义内容方面很有效，但在捕捉细粒度风格细节（如节奏时序、肢体关节表达和富有表现力的动态）方面往往存在局限。风格示例片段通过直接传达这些细微的动作特征来补充文本，使模型能够在保留高层意图的同时再现所需的风格特征。给定一个文本提示和一个风格示例片段，FlexMoGen可以生成高质量的动作，既保留语义内容，又忠实反映目标风格，为用户提供对动画生成过程更大的控制。与依赖离散风格标签且无法泛化到长序列或多风格生成的先前方法不同，FlexMoGen学习了一个变分风格编码器……

Given a text prompt and a style example clip, FlexMoGen generates high-quality motions that preserve semantic content while faithfully reflecting the target style, offering users greater control over the animation generation process. 部分线性模型的尖锐结构无关极小极大风险

Sharp Structure-Agnostic Minimax Risk for Partial Linear Models

For each nuisance \(q\in\{\mu,\pi\}\), we characterize the available learner by an approximation-error budget \(a_q\) and a stochastic-error budget \(s_q\), with the latter controlled through localized Rademacher complexity. item.title: HyCO提出了一种混合推理算法，先用强化学习求解器构造解的前缀，再自适应切换到条件扩散模型完成剩余决策，并通过统一的误差缩放理论框架证明了这种混合方式能结合两类求解器的优势、规避各自的失效模式。
item.description:
HyCO：一种用于组合优化的混合神经求解器

HyCO: A Hybrid Neural Solver for Combinatorial Optimization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07990

HyCO提出了一种混合推理算法，先用强化学习求解器构造解的前缀，再自适应切换到条件扩散模型完成剩余决策，并通过统一的误差缩放理论框架证明了这种混合方式能结合两类求解器的优势、规避各自的失效模式。

在优化遗憾的视角下，用于神经组合优化的序贯强化学习（RL）求解器与全局扩散模型（DM）求解器呈现出互补的失效模式。前者在构造早期阶段具有较小的边际遗憾，但会遭受逐步累积的复合误差，导致遗憾呈超线性增长；后者虽避免了时间步上的误差复合，但其遗憾会随剩余未求解子空间的维度呈线性或次线性增长。我们提出了组合优化混合神经求解器（HyCO），这是一种混合推理算法，它先使用RL求解器构造解的前缀，再自适应地切换到条件扩散模型以完成剩余的决策。为了刻画这种混合方法为何有效、何时触发切换以及如何在实践中实现，我们首先开发了一个统一的误差缩放理论框架，并证明在明确的误差缩放假设下……

arXiv:2609.07990v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Sequential reinforcement learning (RL) solvers and global diffusion model (DM) solvers for neural combinatorial optimization exhibit complementary failure modes under an optimization-regret view. The former enjoys small marginal regret in the early construction stage, but suffers from horizon-wise compounding errors with super-linear regret growth; the latter avoids horizon compounding but incurs linear or sublinear regret w.r.t. the dimension of the remaining unsolved subspace. We propose Hybrid Neural Solver for Combinatorial Optimization (HyCO), a hybrid inference algorithm that constructs a solution prefix with an RL solver and adaptively switches to a conditional DM to complete the remaining decisions. item.title: 该研究利用微调的LLaMA-3.1-70B大语言模型从28万余份胸部CT影像申请的自由文本中提取嵌入特征并构建自动协议选择系统，克服了传统关键词方法缺乏上下文理解的局限，实现了更一致、高效的CT协议推荐。

基于大语言模型从影像申请文本中提取文本嵌入的胸部CT检查协议自动选择

Automated Chest CT Protocol Selection via Large Language Model Derived Text Embeddings from Imaging Request Text

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07986

该研究利用微调的LLaMA-3.1-70B大语言模型从28万余份胸部CT影像申请的自由文本中提取嵌入特征并构建自动协议选择系统，克服了传统关键词方法缺乏上下文理解的局限，实现了更一致、高效的CT协议推荐。

目的：准确的CT协议选择对诊断质量和患者安全至关重要，然而目前该流程依赖人工操作，耗时且容易出现不一致。以往基于关键词或词袋模型的机器学习方法缺乏上下文理解能力，且在罕见协议上表现不佳。我们提出了一种利用大语言模型（LLM）特征的决策支持系统，从自由文本临床适应症中推荐协议，能够捕捉临床细微差别和措辞变化，实现更一致、更高效的协议选择。方法：在这项经研究伦理委员会批准的回顾性研究中，来自一家大型学术医疗中心（2017-2024年）的285,123份胸部CT影像申请被分为训练集（228,099份，80%）和留出测试集（57,024份，20%）。每份申请包含检查名称、临床适应症、HIS备注以及所选协议。临床文本使用微调后的大语言模型Meta的LLaMA-3.1-70B进行嵌入，所得特征输入逻辑回归模型（摘要原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.07986v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Purpose: Accurate CT protocol selection is critical for diagnostic quality and patient safety, yet the current process is manual, time-consuming, and prone to inconsistencies. Prior Machine Learning methods using keywords or bag-of-words lack contextual understanding and perform poorly on rare protocols. We propose a decision support system using large language model (LLM) features to recommend protocols from free-text clinical indications, capturing clinical nuance and phrasing variation for more consistent, efficient selection. Methods: In this REB-approved retrospective study, 285,123 chest CT imaging requests from a large academic medical center (2017-2024) were split into training (228,099, 80%) and held-out test (57,024, 20%) sets. Each request included procedure names, clinical indication, HIS comments, and the selected protocol. item.title: 本文对物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在地震学弹性波方程求解中的应用进行了稳健且批判性的评估，系统考察了其在不同震源、参数模型及不同复杂度问题上的性能表现。
item.description:
使用物理信息神经网络求解弹性波方程：稳健且批判性的评估

Solving the Elastic Wave Equation with Physics-Informed Neural Networks: A Robust and Critical Assessment

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07983

本文对物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在地震学弹性波方程求解中的应用进行了稳健且批判性的评估，系统考察了其在不同震源、参数模型及不同复杂度问题上的性能表现。

物理信息神经网络（PINNs）最近成为求解偏微分方程（PDEs）的一种有前景的方法，它提供了一种将物理原理融入学习过程的无网格替代方案。与传统离散化方法和纯数据驱动的机器学习技术相比，这代表了一种新的范式。尽管前景广阔，PINNs并非万能；它们继承了谱偏差和不稳定收敛等挑战。此外，它们在地震学中的潜力在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们对PINNs在地震学中求解弹性波方程进行了稳健且批判性的评估。我们研究了PINNs在各种震源和参数模型上、从恒定到高度异质设置等不同复杂度问题上的性能表现。我们工作的一个关键方面是研究是否直接嵌入物理原理（原文摘要被截断）……

arXiv:2609.07983v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have recently emerged as a promising approach for solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), offering a meshfree alternative that integrates physical principles into the learning process. This presents a new paradigm compared to traditional discretization methods and purely data-driven machine learning techniques. While promising, PINNs are not a panacea; they inherit challenges such as spectral bias and unstable convergence. Moreover, their potential in seismology remains largely unexplored. In this work, we provide a robust and critical assessment of PINNs for solving the elastic wave equation in seismology. We investigate the performance of PINNs on problems with varying degrees of complexity across various seismic sources and parameter models, from constant to highly heterogeneous settings. item.title: 该论文系统研究了空间偏倚采样导致半监督学习失效的问题，将边缘分布失配、空间自相关和空间非平稳性作为三种可独立调控的机制，分析了SSL性能退化规律并探索了失效诊断方法。
item.description:
空间偏倚采样下的半监督学习

Semi-Supervised Learning under Spatially Biased Sampling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07982

该论文系统研究了空间偏倚采样导致半监督学习失效的问题，将边缘分布失配、空间自相关和空间非平稳性作为三种可独立调控的机制，分析了SSL性能退化规律并探索了失效诊断方法。

标准半监督学习（SSL）通常依赖于有标签数据和无标签数据共享相同边缘分布这一假设。当标签是在空间偏倚或优先选址的条件下收集时，这一假设往往会被有偏的空间采样机制所违背。我们将这种边缘分布失配、空间自相关和空间非平稳性视为三种不同的机制，通过有标签采样集中度参数、空间长度尺度和非平稳性强度参数对其进行独立变化，并探讨失配如何降低SSL性能、聚类假设和流形假设是否能在这种失配下依然成立，以及如何诊断由此产生的失效。我们使用受控合成框架以及PovertyMap-WILDS、加州住房、社会经济和美国空气质量监测数据集，在考虑空间自相关和非平稳性的同时，系统地改变失配的程度。通过一系列……

arXiv:2609.07982v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Standard semi-supervised learning (SSL) typically relies on labelled and unlabelled data sharing a common marginal distribution. This assumption is often violated by biased spatial sampling mechanism, when labels are collected under spatially biased or preferential site selection. We treat this marginal mismatch, spatial autocorrelation, and spatial non-stationarity as three distinct mechanisms, varied independently via a labelled-sampling concentration parameter, a spatial length scale, and a non-stationarity strength parameter, and ask how mismatch degrades SSL, whether the cluster and manifold assumptions survive it, and how the resulting failure can be diagnosed. Using a controlled synthetic framework alongside PovertyMap-WILDS, California housing, socio-economic and US air quality monitoring datasets, we systematically vary the degree of mismatch while accounting for spatial autocorrelation and non-stationarity. item.title: 该论文通过前瞻性注册的编解码器压力实验揭示，在干净数据上表现近乎完美的音频溯源归因模型，在经过单阶段编解码器转码后性能损失可高达约70个Macro-F1点，且退化程度强烈依赖条件与编码器表示，证明干净数据准确率并不能保证溯源归因的鲁棒性。
item.description:
干净数据准确率并不能保证溯源鲁棒性：音频归因的前瞻性编解码器压力评估

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07981

该论文通过前瞻性注册的编解码器压力实验揭示，在干净数据上表现近乎完美的音频溯源归因模型，在经过单阶段编解码器转码后性能损失可高达约70个Macro-F1点，且退化程度强烈依赖条件与编码器表示，证明干净数据准确率并不能保证溯源归因的鲁棒性。

音频溯源归因——即识别哪个系统生成了合成语音——在干净基准测试中被报告具有接近上限的准确率，然而到达分析师手中的音频通常已经过转码处理。我们报告了一项前瞻性注册的测量研究，考察单阶段编解码器传输后的闭集归因性能，其中分析区域在任何归因模型训练之前即依据保真度元数据予以固定。在两个语料库上，在同时施加的组件级条件频带下，支持集内的性能损失分别达到 53.5 [43.5, 63.6] 和 70.3 [63.0, 77.5] 个 Macro-F1 点（WavLM-Base+），以及 61.0 [56.8, 65.1] 和 49.8 [41.6, 57.9] 个点（W2V2-BERT 2.0）。性能退化强烈依赖于具体条件和表示方式：在同一个支持集内测试网格中，WavLM 的损失从 -0.4 到 +53.5 个点不等，且两个编码器在十二个条件中的六个上超出了预设的 ±5 点误差范围。经过干净数据认证的 ECAPA-TDNN 和 Proxy-Anchor 头表现出相当的退化程度，因此该效应并非局限于……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.07981v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Audio provenance attribution - which system produced a synthetic utterance - is reported at near-ceiling accuracy on clean benchmarks, yet audio reaching an analyst has usually been transcoded. We report a prospectively registered measurement of closed-set attribution after single-stage codec transport, with the analysis region fixed from fidelity metadata before any attribution model was trained. On two corpora, in-support losses reach 53.5 [43.5, 63.6] and 70.3 [63.0, 77.5] Macro-F1 points for WavLM-Base+, and 61.0 [56.8, 65.1] and 49.8 [41.6, 57.9] for W2V2-BERT 2.0, under simultaneous component-level bands. Degradation is strongly condition- and representation-dependent: within one in-support grid WavLM losses run from -0.4 to +53.5 points, and the two encoders differ beyond a prespecified +/-5-point margin at six of twelve conditions. item.title: 该论文提出热场签名（HFS），将点云提升为多尺度平滑环境热场，从而直接从成对距离闭式计算捕捉内在维度、各向异性和尺度过渡等特性的全局与局部几何签名，并引入热维度谱（HDS）紧凑总结多尺度几何构成，为点云几何分析提供了直接接口。
item.description:
热场签名：从点云到平滑几何

Heat Field Signatures: From Point Clouds to Smooth Geometry

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07975

该论文提出热场签名（HFS），将点云提升为多尺度平滑环境热场，从而直接从成对距离闭式计算捕捉内在维度、各向异性和尺度过渡等特性的全局与局部几何签名，并引入热维度谱（HDS）紧凑总结多尺度几何构成，为点云几何分析提供了直接接口。

将多尺度几何分析直接应用于不规则点云仍然是一个难题：诸如局部维度、各向异性、密度变化和几何过渡等量通常需要通过显式的邻域、流形或图结构来估计，或者留给神经网络从坐标中自行推断。我们提出了热场签名，它将点云提升为一个多尺度的平滑环境热场族，为从离散样本到几何分析提供了直接的接口。基于该热场，HFS可以直接从成对距离出发，以闭式形式计算全局和局部签名，捕捉热量集中、内在维度、各向异性和尺度过渡等特性。我们进一步引入了热维度谱，这是一种对多尺度几何构成的紧凑总结。HFS可以用作闭式描述符、轻量级学习表示，或作为神经网络的几何特征通道。

arXiv:2609.07975v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bringing multiscale geometric analysis directly to irregular point clouds remains difficult: quantities such as local dimension, anisotropy, density variation, and geometric transitions are typically estimated through explicit neighborhood, manifold, or graph constructions, or left for neural networks to infer from coordinates. We introduce Heat Field Signatures (HFS), which lift a point cloud to a multiscale family of smooth ambient heat fields, providing a direct interface from discrete samples to geometric analysis. From this field, HFS computes closed-form global and local signatures directly from pairwise distances, capturing heat concentration, intrinsic dimension, anisotropy, and scale transitions. We further introduce the Heat Dimension Spectrum (HDS), a compact summary of multiscale geometric composition. item.title: 本文针对公平 $k$-均值聚类问题提出了首个次4倍近似算法，通过将线性规划松弛与几何变换相结合构造候选中心集合，实现了 $1+(3-1/\Gamma)\rho+O(\epsilon)$ 的近似比。

公平 $k$-均值聚类的次4倍近似算法

A Sub-4 Approximation for Fair $k$-Means

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07974

本文针对公平 $k$-均值聚类问题提出了首个次4倍近似算法，通过将线性规划松弛与几何变换相结合构造候选中心集合，实现了 $1+(3-1/\Gamma)\rho+O(\epsilon)$ 的近似比。

聚类中的公平性吸引了持续的研究关注，其动机在于需要确保受保护群体在机器学习应用中的公平代表性。我们研究欧几里得空间中的公平 $k$-均值聚类问题，其中每个受保护群体在每个簇中所占的比例必须位于指定的下界与上界之间。这些约束使得同时确定簇中心和点的分配变得极具挑战性。我们提出了一种近似算法，该算法将线性规划松弛与对输入数据的几何变换相结合来构造候选中心集合。给定一个加权 $k$-均值问题的 $\rho$-近似算法以及任意 $\epsilon>0$，我们的算法返回一个分数解，其成本至多为最优整数公平成本的 $1+(3-1/\Gamma)\rho+O(\epsilon)$ 倍，其中 $\Gamma\approx6.357$ 是标准欧几里得 $k$-均值线性规划整数间隙的上界。当使用 PTAS 作为……

We study fair $k$-means clustering in Euclidean space, where the proportion of each protected group in every cluster must lie within specified lower and upper bounds. These constraints make it challenging to determine both cluster centers and point assignments. We propose an approximation algorithm that combines a linear programming relaxation with geometric transformations of the input to construct candidate center sets. item.title: MetaKV是一个自适应KV缓存压缩框架，利用轻量级预测模型根据用户指定的延迟和峰值内存预算为每个输入提示动态选择最优压缩配置，在保证准确性的同时满足资源约束。
item.description:
MetaKV：面向受限LLM推理的自适应KV缓存压缩

MetaKV: Adaptive KV Cache Compression for Constrained LLM Inference

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07966

MetaKV是一个自适应KV缓存压缩框架，利用轻量级预测模型根据用户指定的延迟和峰值内存预算为每个输入提示动态选择最优压缩配置，在保证准确性的同时满足资源约束。

键值缓存压缩是降低大语言模型推理内存开销的有效方法，尤其适用于长上下文工作负载。然而，现有的压缩方法在准确性、推理延迟和峰值KV缓存内存利用率之间做出了不同的权衡，使得单一固定配置无法适用于不同的提示词和资源约束。我们提出了MetaKV，这是一个自适应框架，它根据用户指定的延迟和峰值内存预算，为每个输入提示词选择合适的KV缓存压缩配置。MetaKV使用轻量级预测模型来估计每个候选配置的端到端延迟、峰值内存和正确响应概率，并选择在保持准确性的同时最能满足延迟-内存约束的配置。我们在来自三种代表性KV缓存压缩方法的十种配置上对MetaKV进行了评估……

arXiv:2609.07966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Key--value (KV) cache compression is an effective way to reduce the memory overhead of large language model (LLM) inference, particularly for long-context workloads. However, existing compression methods make different trade-offs among accuracy, inference latency, and peak KV cache memory utilization, making a single fixed configuration unsuitable across different prompts and resource constraints. We introduce MetaKV, an adaptive framework that selects a KV cache compression configuration for each input prompt based on user-specified latency and peak memory budgets. MetaKV uses lightweight prediction models to estimate the end-to-end latency, peak memory, and probability of a correct response for each candidate configuration, and selects the configuration that best satisfies the latency-memory constraints while preserving accuracy. We evaluate MetaKV across ten configurations from three representative KV cache compression methods, KVQuan

item.title: 本文提出了一种基于注意力的归一化流方法α-Graph，通过可逆注意力机制实现对图数据的显式、可解释且可处理的建模，能够有效捕获复杂的图结构和输入间的相关性。
item.description:
α-Graph：一种注意力注入的可处理图建模归一化流方法

$\alpha$-Graph: Attention-Infused Normalizing Flow Approach to Tractable Graph Modeling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07961

本文提出了一种基于注意力的归一化流方法α-Graph，通过可逆注意力机制实现对图数据的显式、可解释且可处理的建模，能够有效捕获复杂的图结构和输入间的相关性。

图建模是表示图结构数据中复杂关系的一项关键任务，近年来已取得显著成功。然而，当前的图建模方法依赖于传统的图神经网络和预训练方法来隐式地学习图数据的潜在关系结构。因此，这些先前的方法无法捕获复杂的图结构和输入之间的相关性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于注意力的归一化流方法（ANFA 或 α），它提供了显式、可解释且易于处理的图建模（α-Graph）。特别是，我们提出了一种新的带可逆注意力机制的无条件图归一化流，用于捕获图数据的复杂关系结构。为了进一步增强模型的表达能力，我们引入了条件（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2609.07961v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph modeling, a crucial task for representing complex relationships in graph-structured data, has achieved significant success in recent years. However, current graph modeling methods rely on traditional Graph Neural Networks and pre-training approaches to implicitly learn the underlying relational structure of graph data. Thus, these prior methods cannot capture the complex graph structure and correlations among inputs. In this paper, we introduce a novel Attention-based Normalizing Flow-based Approach\footnote{Our implementation and models will be released publicly for research reproducibility.} (ANFA or $\alpha$) that provides an explicit, interpretable, and tractable Graph Modeling ($\alpha$-Graph). In particular, we propose a new Unconditional Graph Normalizing Flow with an Invertible Attention Mechanism to capture the complex relational structure of graph data. To further enhance the expressiveness of the model, we introduce Cond

item.title: 该论文超越了传统点估计方法，提出用频率学派和贝叶斯方法量化公平机器学习中的不确定性，从而对模型可能存在的偏见进行更严格的风险评估。
item.description:
不确定性在评估机器学习模型公平性中的作用

The Role of Uncertainty in Assessing the Fairness of Machine Learning Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07959

该论文超越了传统点估计方法，提出用频率学派和贝叶斯方法量化公平机器学习中的不确定性，从而对模型可能存在的偏见进行更严格的风险评估。

机器学习模型被广泛应用于临床医疗、社交媒体、执法部门和关键基础设施等领域。验证这些模型的输出是否对弱势群体或个人存在偏见，对于确保其公平性并允许其在此类场景中使用至关重要。对可能存在的公平性问题进行严格的风险评估，需要量化与模型选择和估计相关的不确定性。然而，现有文献很少做到这一点，它们大多集中于寻找一个在预测准确性和公平性之间达到合适权衡的单一模型。在本文中，我们超越了点估计的范畴，探讨了公平机器学习中不确定性量化的频率学派和贝叶斯方法，并结合模拟数据和真实数据的实际示例与应用影响加以说明。

arXiv:2609.07959v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning models are widely used in clinical applications, social media, law enforcement and critical infrastructure. Verifying whether their outputs are biased against disadvantaged groups or individuals is crucial to ensuring they are fair and allowing their use in such settings. A rigorous risk assessment of possible fairness violations requires quantifying the uncertainty associated with selecting and estimating such models. Yet, this is rarely done in the literature, which focuses on identifying a single model with a suitable trade-off between predictive accuracy and fairness. In this paper, we move beyond point estimation and discuss frequentist and Bayesian approaches to uncertainty quantification for fair machine learning, with practical examples and implications for simulated and real data.

item.title: HINT 提出了一种边缘-云协同的分层推理框架，通过滑动窗口上的图近似最近邻记忆在本地进行预测与不确定性估计，仅将不确定的样本连同检索上下文卸载到云端表格基础模型，从而在预测性能与通信成本之间实现有效平衡。
item.description:
基于表格基础模型的流式分层推理

Streaming Hierarchical Inference with Tabular Foundation Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07956

HINT 提出了一种边缘-云协同的分层推理框架，通过滑动窗口上的图近似最近邻记忆在本地进行预测与不确定性估计，仅将不确定的样本连同检索上下文卸载到云端表格基础模型，从而在预测性能与通信成本之间实现有效平衡。

表格基础模型（TFMs）近期通过上下文学习展现出了强大的预测性能，但由于通信开销和延迟问题，其在高吞吐量数据流中的部署仍然充满挑战。我们提出了 HINT，一种将基于边缘的检索与基于云的 TFM 推理相结合的分层推理框架。该框架在滑动窗口上维护一个基于图的近似最近邻记忆，提供本地预测和不确定性估计，使高置信度样本能够在本地处理，而不确定的实例则连同其检索到的上下文被选择性地卸载至云端托管的 TFM。该框架提供了一个卸载阈值和一个邻域检索策略，可通过调节二者来平衡预测性能与通信成本。实验表明，HINT 能够持续找到有利的权衡点。

arXiv:2609.07956v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) have recently demonstrated strong predictive performance through in-context learning, but their deployment in high-throughput data streams remains challenging due to communication overhead and latency. We propose \textit{HINT}, a hierarchical inference framework that combines edge-based retrieval with cloud-based TFM inference. A graph-based approximate nearest neighbor memory maintained over a sliding window provides local predictions and uncertainty estimates, allowing confident samples to be processed locally while uncertain instances are selectively offloaded, together with their retrieved context, to a cloud-hosted TFM. The framework exposes an offloading threshold and a neighborhood retrieval policy that can be varied to balance predictive performance and communication cost. Experiments show \textit{HINT} consistently identifies favorable trade-offs.

item.title: 本文发展了一套固定支撑演算来分析Sinkhorn层中的梯度传播机制，并证明了传输多面体的每个可行面具有成对两跳列重叠是支撑图与边际保证梯度均匀一步收缩的充要条件。
item.description:
Sinkhorn层中的支撑拓扑与梯度混合

Support Topology and Gradient Mixing in Sinkhorn Layers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07954

本文发展了一套固定支撑演算来分析Sinkhorn层中的梯度传播机制，并证明了传输多面体的每个可行面具有成对两跳列重叠是支撑图与边际保证梯度均匀一步收缩的充要条件。

稀疏Sinkhorn层使用固定的支撑图来限制token之间的传输。该图如何控制缩放迭代中的梯度传播？我们发展了一套固定支撑演算，证明在模常数意义下，每个行-列循环会对列势扰动诱导出一个行随机算子。其转置用于传播零质量的反向模式余切。有限循环算子使用两个不同的半步传输计划；在平衡不动点处，它退化为由单一计划确定的两步游走。我们推导了相应的得分项和边际源项，并利用Dobrushin收缩与minorization方法来界定齐次和源驱动的尾部余切。我们的主要结果刻画了支撑和边际在有限得分上一致保证一步收缩的条件：传输多面体的每个可行面必须具有成对的两跳列重叠。否则，某些合适的得分方向（原文此处截断）……

arXiv:2609.07954v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sparse Sinkhorn layers use a fixed support graph to restrict transport between tokens. How does this graph control gradient propagation through the scaling iterations. We develop a fixed-support calculus showing that each row-column cycle induces a row-stochastic operator on column-potential perturbations modulo constants. Its transpose propagates zero-mass reverse-mode cotangents. The finite-cycle operator uses two distinct half-step transport plans; at a balanced fixed point it reduces to a two-step walk determined by a single plan. We derive the accompanying score and marginal source terms and use Dobrushin contraction and minorization to bound homogeneous and source-driven tail cotangents. item.title: 该研究发现经典机器学习代理模型在逼近粘性Burgers方程时，其单步残差在极值附近呈现结构化分支，且误差与局部曲率（二阶空间导数）的关联远强于与梯度（一阶导数）的关联，并提出了一个物理一致的基于曲率的残差模型来解释这一现象。
item.description:
粘性Burgers方程经典代理模型中的结构化极值误差：一种物理一致的解释

Structured Extrema Errors in Classical Surrogates for Viscous Burgers: A Physics-Consistent Interpretation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07952

该研究发现经典机器学习代理模型在逼近粘性Burgers方程时，其单步残差在极值附近呈现结构化分支，且误差与局部曲率（二阶空间导数）的关联远强于与梯度（一阶导数）的关联，并提出了一个物理一致的基于曲率的残差模型来解释这一现象。

摘要（arXiv:2609.07952v1）：我们研究了经典机器学习代理模型在逼近一维粘性Burgers方程时间演化时的局部误差。四种模型在同一预测任务上直接使用空间网格值进行比较：径向基函数（RBF）核岭回归（KRR）、线性岭回归、ExtraTrees和随机森林。在所有四种模型中，单步残差（定义为每个网格点上真实值减去预测值）在预测的极大值和极小值附近形成清晰的弯曲分支。对KRR的更详细分析表明，这些误差与衡量局部曲率的二阶空间导数的关联远强于与一阶空间导数的关联。在光滑极值附近，预测值和曲率形成局部双分支折叠结构。在我们基于局部曲率的残差模型下，这种折叠结构预测了预测值之间的领先阶近抛物线关系。

arXiv:2609.07952v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the local errors of classical machine-learning surrogate models, which approximate the time evolution of the one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation. Four models are compared on the same prediction task, using the spatial grid values directly: radial basis function (RBF) kernel ridge regression (KRR), linear Ridge, ExtraTrees, and Random Forests. Across all four models, the one-step residual, defined here as the true value minus the predicted value at each grid point, forms clear curved branches near predicted maxima and minima. A more detailed analysis of KRR shows that these errors are much more strongly related to the second spatial derivative, which measures local curvature, than to the first spatial derivative. Near a smooth extremum, predicted value and curvature form a local two-branch fold. item.title: 本文提出一种实证方法，检验“信念”这一潜在变量能否用于描述大语言模型的行为，发现高性能模型可以被有效地描述为持有信念，这为理解和对齐LLM行为提供了新途径。
item.description:
语言模型中的信念与行为

Beliefs and Behavior in Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07943

本文提出一种实证方法，检验“信念”这一潜在变量能否用于描述大语言模型的行为，发现高性能模型可以被有效地描述为持有信念，这为理解和对齐LLM行为提供了新途径。

关于信念或欲望等抽象概念是否能有效描述大语言模型（LLM）的行为，目前存在很大的不确定性。除了这个问题本身的科学意义之外，这些潜在变量常被用来向用户解释LLM的行为，或用于定义和评估与意图相关的有害行为。然而，我们目前缺乏一种系统性方法来检验“信念”等概念是否适用于LLM，以及它们是否可能成为使模型与人类利益对齐工作中有价值的要素。我们提出了一种实证研究此类问题的方法，探讨从LLM输出中推断出的单一潜在变量——被解释为信念程度——是否能让观察者对LLM将如何响应新提示做出可解释的预测。我们发现，高性能模型可以被有效地描述为持有信念……

arXiv:2609.07943v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: There is significant uncertainty about whether abstractions like beliefs or desires usefully describe the behavior of large language models (LLMs). In addition to the inherent scientific interest of this question, these latent quantities are often invoked to explain the behavior of LLMs to users or to define and evaluate harmful behaviors which are relative to intent. Nevertheless, we currently lack a means to systematically test whether concepts like "belief" are well-applied to LLMs, and hence whether they are likely to be fruitful ingredients of attempts to align models with human interests. We propose an approach for empirically studying such questions, asking whether a single latent variable inferred from the LLMs' outputs -- interpreted as a degree of belief -- allows an observer to make interpretable predictions of how the LLMs' will respond to new prompts. We find that highly capable models are usefully described as holding belie

item.title: 该论文创新性地将捷径学习重新定义为校准问题，并提出两种与编码器无关的患病率均衡校准方法（处理中正则化和事后重校准）来有效缓解捷径依赖，且可应用于冻结基础模型编码器。
item.description:
患病率校准作为捷径学习缓解方法

Prevalence calibration as shortcut mitigation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07922

该论文创新性地将捷径学习重新定义为校准问题，并提出两种与编码器无关的患病率均衡校准方法（处理中正则化和事后重校准）来有效缓解捷径依赖，且可应用于冻结基础模型编码器。

捷径学习是指分类器利用虚假相关性而非诊断性特征的普遍现象。现有的缓解策略大多旨在学习捷径不变表示；但它们的实证效果有限，且无法应用于使用冻结基础模型编码器的分类器。我们提出将捷径学习重新构建为一个本质上属于校准问题的框架：无约束的学习会隐式地将每个捷径组的校准对齐到其训练集中的疾病患病率，使得所得的分类器必然在一组中过度自信而在另一组中自信不足。基于这一见解，我们通过两种与编码器无关的方法实现捷径组之间的患病率均衡校准：一种是处理过程中的正则化器，另一种是事后患病率均衡重校准步骤。在CheXpert和SIIM-ACR数据集的胸腔引流-气胸基准测试中，涵盖微调的CNN和冻结的基础模型编码器

arXiv:2609.07922v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Shortcut learning denotes the widespread situation in which a classifier exploits spurious correlations rather than diagnostic features. Existing mitigation strategies mostly aim to learn shortcut-invariant representations; their empirical success is limited and they cannot be applied to classifiers using frozen foundation model encoders. We propose to reframe shortcut learning as fundamentally a calibration problem: unconstrained learning implicitly calibrates each shortcut group to its training set disease prevalence, rendering the resulting classifier necessarily over-confident in one group and under-confident in the other. Building on this insight, we prevalence-equalize calibration between shortcut groups through two encoder-agnostic methods, an in-processing regularizer and a post-hoc prevalence-equalized recalibration step. Across chest-drain-pneumothorax benchmarks on CheXpert and SIIM-ACR, spanning fine-tuned CNNs and frozen fou

item.title: 提出AVCG框架，将反事实生成从依赖单一确定性预测器推广为对任意合理预测假设分布进行变分优化，有效解决了模型重训练或更新后解释失效的脆弱性问题。
item.description:
AVCG：假设分布下反事实生成的广义变分框架

AVCG: A Generalized Variational Framework for Counterfactual Generation under Hypothesis Distributions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07917

提出AVCG框架，将反事实生成从依赖单一确定性预测器推广为对任意合理预测假设分布进行变分优化，有效解决了模型重训练或更新后解释失效的脆弱性问题。

反事实解释通过识别对输入实例的修改来形式化“如果……会怎样”的场景，从而获得期望的替代预测。传统上，无论是通过实例特定优化还是摊销式单次前向模型生成，这些方法都依赖于单一的、确定性的点估计预测器。然而，这忽略了预测的不确定性和假设的可变性，导致解释变得脆弱——当底层模型被重新训练或更新时，这些解释经常会失效。为了解决这种脆弱性，我们提出了摊销式变分反事实生成器（AVCG），这是一个广义的优化框架，它将反事实生成表述为对合理预测假设的任意分布进行优化，而非针对单一的确定性预测器进行优化。这一表述自然地兼容了贝叶斯后验、Rashomon受限假设空间以及其他不确定性表示。

arXiv:2609.07917v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Counterfactual explanations formalize "what-if" scenarios by identifying modifications to an input instance that obtain a desired alternative prediction. Traditionally, whether generated via instance-specific optimization or amortized single pass models, these approaches rely on a single, deterministic point-estimate predictor. However, this ignores predictive uncertainty and hypothesis variability, leading to brittle explanations that frequently become invalid if the underlying model is retrained or updated. To address this fragility, we propose the Amortized Variational Counterfactual Generator (AVCG), a generalized optimization framework that formulates counterfactual generation as optimization over an arbitrary distribution of plausible predictive hypotheses rather than a single deterministic predictor. This formulation naturally accommodates Bayesian posteriors, Rashomon-restricted hypothesis spaces, and other uncertainty represen

item.title: JEDI提出了一种两阶段蒸馏框架，通过跨架构投影对齐与任务训练全程持续的特征蒸馏，将大型I-JEPA教师模型的知识迁移到轻量级SegFormer学生模型，仅用4.04M参数即可实现68.0 mIoU的高效卫星影像农田分割。
item.description:
JEDI：面向边缘高效的卫星影像农田分割的JEPA到边缘蒸馏方法

JEDI: JEPA-to-Edge Distillation for Efficient Cropland Segmentation from Satellite Imagery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07915

JEDI提出了一种两阶段蒸馏框架，通过跨架构投影对齐与任务训练全程持续的特征蒸馏，将大型I-JEPA教师模型的知识迁移到轻量级SegFormer学生模型，仅用4.04M参数即可实现68.0 mIoU的高效卫星影像农田分割。

大型视觉模型为遥感分割提供了有用的表征，但对于在卫星端或田间边缘部署而言往往成本过高。现有的特征级蒸馏方法通常假设教师与学生架构相似，并且往往在任务训练开始时就停止特征对齐。我们提出了JEDI（JEPA到边缘蒸馏），这是一个两阶段框架，将表征从大型I-JEPA Vision Transformer教师模型迁移到紧凑的SegFormer学生模型。首先，JEDI使用跨架构投影和空间对齐，将学生的终端表征与教师的token空间对齐。随后，在整个任务适应过程中，它联合优化监督分割、温度缩放的响应蒸馏以及持续的特征对齐。在CalCROP21数据集上，JEDI-B0以仅4.04M参数实现了68.0的平均交并比（mIoU），比独立的学生模型提升了16.0个百分点。

arXiv:2609.07915v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large vision models provide useful representations for remote-sensing segmentation but are often too expensive for deployment at the satellite or field edge. Existing feature-level distillation methods also tend to assume similar teacher and student architectures and often stop feature alignment when task training begins. We introduce JEDI (JEPA-to-Edge Distillation), a two-stage framework that transfers representations from a large I-JEPA Vision Transformer teacher to a compact SegFormer student. First, JEDI aligns the student's terminal representation with the teacher's token space using cross-architecture projection and spatial alignment. It then jointly optimizes supervised segmentation, temperature-scaled response distillation, and persistent feature alignment throughout task adaptation. item.title: 本研究实证诊断了多标签酶委员会预测中默认决策阈值（t=0.50）在严重类别不平衡下的失效，揭示出高准确率（77.16%）掩盖下的预测崩溃：多数类过度预测、少数类召回率骤降，且EC6的决策边界完全失效。
item.description:
准确率悖论：多标签酶委员会（EC）预测中默认决策阈值的实证诊断[附代码]

The Accuracy Paradox: Empirical Diagnostic of Default Decision Thresholds in Multi-Label Enzyme Commission Prediction [With Code]

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07897

本研究实证诊断了多标签酶委员会预测中默认决策阈值（t=0.50）在严重类别不平衡下的失效，揭示出高准确率（77.16%）掩盖下的预测崩溃：多数类过度预测、少数类召回率骤降，且EC6的决策边界完全失效。

酶委员会（EC）编号的自动预测在功能注释和计算药物发现中发挥着核心作用。然而，标准的多标签机器学习流程通常依赖默认决策阈值（t=0.50），并假设各目标头的先验分布是平衡的。在本研究中，我们对在严重类别不平衡条件下运行的未校准固定决策边界进行了系统的实证诊断，研究对象为N = 14,096个已注释化合物，这些化合物被划分为六个主要EC类别（EC1-EC6）。我们的结果凸显了一个明显的准确率悖论：尽管该多标签系统达到了看似很高的77.16%平均准确率，但宏平均F1分数（0.3976）和宏平均召回率（0.3872）揭示了严重的预测失效。多数目标类别遭受超敏感性和过度预测的问题，而少数类别则表现出急剧的召回率衰减，最终导致EC6的决策边界完全崩溃。

arXiv:2609.07897v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automated prediction of Enzyme Commission (EC) numbers plays a central role in functional annotation and computational drug discovery. However, standard multi-label machine learning pipelines frequently rely on default decision thresholds (t=0.50), assuming balanced prior distributions across target heads. In this study, we present a systematic empirical diagnostic of uncalibrated fixed decision boundaries operating under severe class imbalance across N = 14,096 annotated compounds categorized into six primary EC classes (EC1-EC6). Our results highlight a pronounced Accuracy Paradox: while the multi-label system achieves a deceivingly high mean accuracy of 77.16%, the macro F1-score (0.3976) and macro recall (0.3872) reveal severe predictive breakdown. Majority target classes suffer from hyper-sensitivity and over-prediction, whereas minority classes exhibit sharp recall decay, culminating in a total decision boundary collapse for EC6

item.title: 本文提出一种基于多模态时序注意力的可解释深度学习模型，利用焊接图像和声音数据实时检测熔化极气体保护焊角焊缝中的内部缺陷，F1分数达到0.99，并通过可解释AI提升了焊接检测的可信度和可靠性。
item.description:
基于多模态数据的实时熔化极气体保护焊角焊缝可解释时序注意力缺陷检测

Explainable Temporal Attention-based Defect Detection For Fillet Joints in Real-Time Gas Metal Arc Welding Based on Multi-modal Data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07893

本文提出一种基于多模态时序注意力的可解释深度学习模型，利用焊接图像和声音数据实时检测熔化极气体保护焊角焊缝中的内部缺陷，F1分数达到0.99，并通过可解释AI提升了焊接检测的可信度和可靠性。

深度学习是监测实时焊接过程的高效技术，能够减少焊后修补和生产延误。本文利用这种监测能力，提出了一种基于多模态时序注意力的深度学习缺陷检测模型，用于检测熔化极气体保护焊角焊缝过程中难以检测的内部缺陷，包括气孔、未熔透和未熔合、咬边以及冷隔。该模型使用工业协作焊接机器人采集的焊接图像和声音数据进行训练。结果表明，注意力模块可将F1分数提高至0.99。我们使用可解释人工智能来解释所提出模型的行为和数据集分布，确定图像和声音频谱图中潜在的重要区域以及检测每种缺陷的首选模态。这提高了人工智能驱动焊接检测的信任度和可靠性。

arXiv:2609.07893v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep learning is an efficient technique to monitor the real time welding process, reducing post-welding repairs and production delays. This paper leverages the monitoring capability by proposing a multi modal temporal attention based deep learning defect detection model for internal defects that are challenging to detect, including porosity, lack of penetration and fusion, undercut, and cold lap during Gas Metal Arc Welding in fillet joints. The model is trained on collected welding images and sound data from an industrial collaborative welding robot. The results show that the attention module can improve the F1 Score to 0.99. We use explainable Artificial Intelligence to interpret the proposed models behavior and dataset distribution, determining potential important areas in image and sound spectrograms and preferred modality to detect each defect. This improves trust and reliability in Artificial Intelligence driven welding inspection.

item.title: 该研究发现了大语言模型中的“Transformer层间修正机制”（TLCM）：相邻层会系统性地相互抵消并修正对方的输出，这一机制普遍存在于主流开源模型中，在预训练期间涌现，并能根据上下文依赖程度自适应地校准修正强度。
item.description:
大语言模型层间的即时相互修正

LLM Layers Immediately Correct Each Other

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07876

该研究发现了大语言模型中的“Transformer层间修正机制”（TLCM）：相邻层会系统性地相互抵消并修正对方的输出，这一机制普遍存在于主流开源模型中，在预训练期间涌现，并能根据上下文依赖程度自适应地校准修正强度。

近期语言模型可解释性研究采用稀疏自编码器等技术，将残差流的贡献分解为线性且具有语义意义的特征。这类方法通常被解读为识别出持续存在于残差流中、并被后续层所构建之上的特征。我们通过识别出Transformer层间修正机制（TLCM）来挑战这一观点：相邻的Transformer层会系统性地抵消彼此贡献中的部分内容。TLCM出现在7个主要开源模型家族中的5个，并在多样化文本中几乎对所有token激活。我们证明TLCM在预训练过程中自然涌现，在依赖上下文的token上作用最强，并能根据前一层的输出自适应地校准其修正强度。利用层雅可比矩阵，我们进一步证明TLCM会选择性地修正特定子空间，同时强化其他子空间，而我们……

arXiv:2609.07876v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent methods in language model interpretability employ techniques such as sparse autoencoders to decompose residual stream contributions into linear, semantically meaningful features. Such methods are commonly interpreted as identifying features that persist in the residual stream and that subsequent layers build upon. We challenge this view by identifying the Transformer Layer Correction Mechanism (TLCM), wherein adjacent transformer layers systematically counteract portions of each other's contributions. TLCM appears in 5 out of 7 major open-source model families and activates across nearly all tokens in diverse texts. We show that TLCM emerges during pretraining, operates most strongly on contextually dependent tokens, and adaptively calibrates its correction strength based on the preceding layer's output. item.title: 提出 InfluenceField——一种插入视觉编码器与语言解码器之间的干预感知可微潜场，通过共享转移算子多步传播有向影响来预测局部视觉干预的下游效应，并从理论上证明了干预监督下因果结构（有向依赖图）的可辨识性。
item.description:
InfluenceField：一种具有干预可辨识因果结构的可微影响场，用于多模态世界建模

InfluenceField: A Differentiable Field with Interventionally Identifiable Causal Structure for Multimodal World Modeling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07874

提出 InfluenceField——一种插入视觉编码器与语言解码器之间的干预感知可微潜场，通过共享转移算子多步传播有向影响来预测局部视觉干预的下游效应，并从理论上证明了干预监督下因果结构（有向依赖图）的可辨识性。

多模态大语言模型通常能够捕捉视觉与语言之间的相关性，但难以预测局部视觉干预如何传播并影响下游的回答。我们提出了 InfluenceField，一种插入在视觉编码器与语言解码器之间的干预感知潜场。它将图像块特征提升为连续的空间表示，通过多个步骤传播有向影响，并借助共享的转移算子预测局部干预效应。训练过程联合优化语言建模、跨环境不变性、反事实展开监督以及结构正则化。针对一个非线性有限基种群模型，我们证明了与目标对齐的干预监督，结合对转移的一步分离条件，能够将可容许的表示限制为位置内的重参数化，从而使完整转移的有向依赖图得以恢复。

arXiv:2609.07874v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal large language models often capture visual-linguistic correlations but struggle to predict how local visual interventions propagate and affect downstream answers. We introduce InfluenceField, an intervention-aware latent field inserted between the visual encoder and language decoder. It lifts patch features into a continuous spatial representation, propagates directed influence over multiple steps, and predicts local intervention effects through a shared transition operator. Training jointly optimizes language modeling, cross-environment invariance, counterfactual rollout supervision, and structural regularization. item.title: 该论文证明了多类别逻辑回归在高维高斯混合模型上的学习按类别频率从高到低序贯进行，交叉熵风险随训练时间呈幂律衰减，且在固定计算预算下容量项与优化项之间存在精确可刻画的幂律权衡。
item.description:
多类别逻辑回归中的SGD：序贯学习与标度律

SGD in Multiclass Logistic Regression: Sequential Learning and Scaling Laws

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07868

该论文证明了多类别逻辑回归在高维高斯混合模型上的学习按类别频率从高到低序贯进行，交叉熵风险随训练时间呈幂律衰减，且在固定计算预算下容量项与优化项之间存在精确可刻画的幂律权衡。

我们研究了在具有大量类别的高维高斯混合模型上，多类别逻辑回归的训练动态，并建立了基于梯度优化下交叉熵风险的精确标度律。我们证明学习是按类别从最频繁到最不频繁依次序贯进行的。当类别先验服从幂律分布时，风险动态分解为三个阶段：在学习到第一个类别之前的初始平台期、发生序贯学习的幂律衰减阶段，以及最终的收敛阶段。随后，我们分析了在固定计算预算下模型容量与优化之间的相互作用。当通过投影到前几个主成分来限制有效维度时，风险分解为容量项（关于保留维度的幂律）和优化项（关于训练时间的幂律）。优化这一权衡产生了一个……

arXiv:2609.07868v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the training dynamics of multiclass logistic regression on high-dimensional Gaussian mixture models with a large number of classes and establish precise scaling laws governing the cross-entropy risk under gradient-based optimization. We show that learning proceeds sequentially across classes, from most to least frequent. When the class priors follow a power law distribution, the risk dynamics decompose into three phases: an initial plateau until the first class is learned, a power-law decay regime during which sequential learning occurs, and a final convergence regime. We then analyze how model capacity interacts with optimization under a fixed compute budget. When the effective dimension is restricted via projection onto leading principal components, the risk decomposes into a capacity term (a power law in the retained dimension) and an optimization term (a power law in training time). item.title: 该论文提出FMSGOC框架，利用视觉-语言基础模型先验选择并传输稀疏语义锚点，结合微调的扩散模型在接收端重建图像，有效解决了语义通信在低码率下泛化能力差的问题。
item.description:
面向可泛化语义与目标导向通信的基础模型

Foundation Models for Generalizable Semantic and Goal-Oriented Communication

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07853

该论文提出FMSGOC框架，利用视觉-语言基础模型先验选择并传输稀疏语义锚点，结合微调的扩散模型在接收端重建图像，有效解决了语义通信在低码率下泛化能力差的问题。

语义与目标导向通信在6G领域的研究日益增多，但在严格码率预算下超越已见数据的泛化能力仍然是一个关键弱点。许多现有系统对训练数据过拟合，并在极低码率下性能急剧下降，因为它们试图压缩整个信号。我们提出了基础模型引导的语义与目标导向通信（FMSGOC），这是一个利用广泛的视觉-语言基础模型先验来缓解过拟合的框架。该框架通过将比特集中在稀疏的、与目标对齐的锚点上，并依靠生成式基础模型先验来重建被掩蔽的区域，进一步提高了码率效率。通过解耦“发送什么”与“如何重建”，视觉-语言基础模型选择并传输一组稀疏的语义锚点，而在接收端，一个针对掩蔽补全任务微调过的预训练扩散模型负责重建图像。在我们的实验中，FMSGOC达到了0……（原文截断）

arXiv:2609.07853v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Semantic and goal-oriented communication is increasingly studied for 6G, but generalization beyond seen data remains a key weakness under tight rate budgets. Many existing systems overfit their training data and degrade sharply at very low bit rates because they attempt to compress the entire signal. We introduce Foundation Model-Guided Semantic and Goal-Oriented Communication (FMSGOC), a framework that uses broad visual-linguistic Foundation Model priors to mitigate overfitting. It further improves rate efficiency by concentrating bits on sparse, goal-aligned anchors and relying on generative foundation-model priors to reconstruct the masked regions. By decoupling what to send from how to reconstruct, a vision-language foundation model selects and transmits a sparse set of semantic anchors, while a pretrained diffusion model, fine-tuned for masked completion, reconstructs the image at the receiver. item.title: OCUDU dApp 平台首次提供了开放运行时和 E3 接口，使经过签名的 AI-RAN 应用能够在生产 5G 分布式单元内部，按照三种时序契约（GPU 接收链驻留、100 微秒调度截止时间、非阻塞观察者）实时运行，填补了机器学习在 10 毫秒以下超低时延区间的开放平台空白。
item.description:
OCUDU dApp 平台：面向实时 AI-RAN 的开放运行时与 E3 接口

The OCUDU dApp Platform: An Open Runtime and E3 Interface for Real-Time AI-RAN

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07843

OCUDU dApp 平台首次提供了开放运行时和 E3 接口，使经过签名的 AI-RAN 应用能够在生产 5G 分布式单元内部，按照三种时序契约（GPU 接收链驻留、100 微秒调度截止时间、非阻塞观察者）实时运行，填补了机器学习在 10 毫秒以下超低时延区间的开放平台空白。

机器学习在 3GPP 新空口（NR）5G 分布式单元（DU）内 10 毫秒以下的时延区间展现出最大收益，应用场景包括链路自适应、逐时隙调度、信道估计以及接收机本身。然而此前没有任何开放平台允许独立开发的软件在该区间内运行，先前的 dApp 框架只能作为导出流的外部观察者进入这一领域。本文是对 OCUDU dApp 平台的导引性介绍，该平台是一个开放运行时与 E3 接口，经过签名的 AI-RAN 应用可在生产 DU 内部按照三种时序契约执行：驻留在 GPU 接收链上（A 类）、在调度器 100 微秒的准入截止时间内运行（B 类），或作为永不阻塞的观察者、其结果由调度器消费（C 类）。传统处理路径始终不会被取代，且每项权限都经过类型化、验证并受运营商约束。论文还阐述了运行时、嵌入式 E3 代理以及三个公开代码库之间的协作方式。

arXiv:2609.07843v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning has shown its largest gains in the band below 10 ms inside a 3GPP new radio (NR) 5G distributed unit (DU): link adaptation, per-slot scheduling, channel estimation, and the receiver itself. No open platform has let independently built software run there. Prior dApp frameworks reached the band only as external observers of an export stream. This paper is a guided introduction to the OCUDU dApp platform, an open runtime and E3 interface under which signed AI-RAN applications execute inside a production DU under three timing contracts: resident on the GPU receive chain (Class A), inside the scheduler's 100 us admitted deadline (Class B), or as never-blocking observers whose results the scheduler consumes (Class C). The conventional path is never displaced, and every authority is typed, validated, and operator-bounded. The paper explains how the runtime, the embedded E3 agent, and the three public repositories fit together

item.title: A*-Thought-V2将思维链建模为隐藏状态轨迹，在大语言模型的三维PCA几何空间中测量各推理步骤与全局解答方向的对齐角度，把偏离方向的步骤压缩为连续潜在token、对齐步骤保留为显式文本，从而在保留关键中间信息的同时大幅降低思维链推理的计算与上下文开销。
item.description:
A*-Thought-V2：基于大语言模型几何动力学的高效潜在推理

A*-Thought-V2: Efficient Latent Reasoning via Geometric Dynamics of LLM

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07821

A*-Thought-V2将思维链建模为隐藏状态轨迹，在大语言模型的三维PCA几何空间中测量各推理步骤与全局解答方向的对齐角度，把偏离方向的步骤压缩为连续潜在token、对齐步骤保留为显式文本，从而在保留关键中间信息的同时大幅降低思维链推理的计算与上下文开销。

思维链提升了大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但会带来大量的计算和上下文开销。现有方法要么通过硬剪枝丢失中间信息，要么缺乏一个有原则依据的连续压缩准则。我们提出了A*-Thought-V2，一个由LLM几何动力学引导的框架，它将思维链建模为隐藏状态轨迹，并用显式-隐式交错的潜在架构取代硬性删除。在将问题、步骤和解答的表示投影到三维PCA空间后，该框架测量每个局部状态转移与全局“问题到解答”方向之间的对齐程度。对齐的步骤保留为显式文本，而偏离的步骤则被压缩为连续的潜在token。方向角度同时捕捉局部语义和推理动态：小角度表示直接执行和答案形成，而大角度更频繁地涉及检查、纠正（原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.07821v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) improves the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) but incurs substantial computation and context costs. Existing methods either lose intermediate information through hard pruning or lack a principled criterion for continuous compression. We present A*-Thought-V2, a geometric dynamics of LLM guided framework that models CoT as a hidden-state trajectory and replaces hard deletion with an explicit-implicit interleaved latent architecture. After projecting question, step, and solution representations into a 3D PCA space, it measures alignment between each local transition and global question-to-solution direction. Aligned steps remain explicit text, whereas deviating steps are compressed into continuous latent tokens. item.title: 该论文提出卡尔曼增量网络（KDNs），将循环联想记忆重新表述为线性-高斯状态空间模型，利用卡尔曼滤波同时传播记忆状态及其不确定性，使每次记忆写入的强度能够根据积累的证据进行自适应调节。
item.description:
卡尔曼增量网络：不确定性感知的联想记忆

Kalman Delta Networks: Uncertainty-aware Associative Memory

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07816

该论文提出卡尔曼增量网络（KDNs），将循环联想记忆重新表述为线性-高斯状态空间模型，利用卡尔曼滤波同时传播记忆状态及其不确定性，使每次记忆写入的强度能够根据积累的证据进行自适应调节。

线性注意力因其在高效长上下文推理和恒定内存解码方面的优势，越来越多地应用于前沿语言模型中。然而，其固定大小的循环记忆需要在每个token处做出在线决策：在尚不知道未来查询需要哪些信息的情况下，决定写入什么内容以及以多强的力度覆盖现有关联。增量规则（Delta-rule）模型从当前token嵌入中学习这一写入强度，但不追踪记忆估计的置信度，导致每次写入无法根据积累的证据进行自适应调整。为了显式地表示这种不确定性，我们将循环联想记忆重新表述为线性-高斯状态空间模型（卡尔曼滤波器是其最优递归估计器），并由此引入了一类新的模型族——卡尔曼增量网络。在KDN中，状态转移同时传播记忆状态及其不确定性，使得卡尔曼增益能够根据积累的证据对每次残差写入进行加权。

arXiv:2609.07816v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Linear attention is increasingly used in frontier language models for efficient long-context inference and constant-memory decoding. Its fixed-size recurrent memory, however, requires an online decision at each token: what to write and how strongly to overwrite existing associations before knowing which information future queries will require. Delta-rule models learn this strength from the current token embedding but do not track confidence in the memory estimate, preventing each write from adapting to accumulated evidence. To represent this uncertainty explicitly, we reformulate recurrent associative memory as a linear--Gaussian state-space model, for which the Kalman filter is the optimal recursive estimator, and introduce a new family of models, Kalman Delta Networks (KDNs). item.description:
Latent-MoE：面向多物理区域PDE的域感知混合专家模型

Latent-MoE: Domain-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for PDEs with Multi-Regime Physics

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07814

提出Latent-MoE架构，通过在共享骨干网络中嵌入具有紧支撑路由器的域感知混合专家模块，使NTK呈指数衰减的带状结构以实现学习的局部化，从而解决PINNs在求解域内物理特性多变化的PDE时的远程耦合与梯度冲突问题。

物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在处理控制物理随域内空间位置变化的偏微分方程（PDE）时表现不佳。我们将这一问题归因于标准坐标网络的一个结构特性：其神经正切核（NTK）具有平移变异性，使得坐标幅值较大的训练点会不成比例地影响其他位置的预测，从而在训练过程中产生远程耦合和梯度冲突。我们从理论和实验上证明，采用中心化、紧支撑路由器的混合专家（MoE）架构能够产生均匀带状的NTK，其核回归权重随距离呈指数衰减，从而实现学习的局部化。基于这一发现，我们提出了Latent-MoE，它在共享骨干网络中交错嵌入域感知的MoE模块。与FB-PINNs或X-PINNs将域和参数进行刚性划分、使得不同子域上的参数只能独立更新不同，Latent-MoE的设计

arXiv:2609.07814v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) struggle on PDEs whose governing physics varies across the domain. We trace this to a structural property of standard coordinate networks: their neural tangent kernel (NTK) is translation-variant and lets training points of large coordinate magnitude disproportionately influence predictions elsewhere, producing long-range coupling and gradient conflict during training. We show analytically and empirically that mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures with centered, compact-support routers yield a uniformly banded NTK whose kernel-regression weights decay exponentially with distance, localizing the learning. Building on this, we propose \emph{Latent-MoE}, which interleaves domain-aware MoE blocks within a shared backbone. item.title: 本文首次量化了DPO微调的大语言模型在情感控制上的系统性强度不足现象——实际情感增益仅为请求值的0.13-0.26（理想值为1），并将其根源归结为偏好学习训练数据以中性情感为主、采样候选很少触及极端情感这一流程性缺陷。
item.description:
你无法偏好从未采样到的情感：DPO微调大语言模型中的情感强度不足现象

You Can't Prefer Emotions You Don't Sample: Intensity Undershoot in DPO-Tuned LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07808

本文首次量化了DPO微调的大语言模型在情感控制上的系统性强度不足现象——实际情感增益仅为请求值的0.13-0.26（理想值为1），并将其根源归结为偏好学习训练数据以中性情感为主、采样候选很少触及极端情感这一流程性缺陷。

当你要求一个语言模型“非常兴奋地”回答时，其输出通常只是略微更有活力一些。我们对这一效应进行了量化。我们将一个经过指令微调的大语言模型（LLM）条件化于连续的效价-唤醒度（VA）目标——其中效价衡量一种状态的愉悦程度，唤醒度衡量其激活程度——使用冻结的回归器测量实际达到的情感效果，并将请求的目标从-1扫描至+1。实际响应远低于所要求的：增益（实际情感相对于请求情感的斜率）在Llama-3.1-8B上，效价仅为0.26，唤醒度仅为0.13，而一个忠实的控制器应得分为1。模型系统性地无法达到所请求的情感强度，这为Fazzi等人（2025）的定性观察提供了具体数字。我们的实验将这一现象追溯到偏好学习流程本身：来自EmoBank等自然语料库的训练目标以中性情感为主，且采样的候选响应本身很少达到极端情感，因此DPO（直接偏好优化）训练……

arXiv:2609.07808v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ask a language model to respond "very excitedly," and its output is typically only mildly more energetic. We quantify this effect. We condition an instruction-tuned LLM on a continuous Valence-Arousal (VA) target, where valence measures how pleasant a state is and arousal how activated it is, measure the achieved affect with a frozen regressor, and sweep the requested target from -1 to +1. The response moves far less than asked: the gain, the slope of achieved against requested affect, is only 0.26 for valence and 0.13 for arousal on Llama-3.1-8B, where a faithful controller would score 1. The model systematically undershoots requested emotional intensity, which puts a number on the qualitative observation of Fazzi et al. (2025). Our experiments trace this to the preference-learning pipeline. item.title: CodeTD是首个基于代码大语言模型注意力图拓扑数据分析的执行前幻觉检测方法，可预测生成代码的正确性，性能超越现有基线且能跨编程基准迁移。
item.description:
CodeTD：注意力拓扑检测代码大语言模型中的幻觉

CodeTD: Topology of Attention Detects Hallucinations in Code LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07779

CodeTD是首个基于代码大语言模型注意力图拓扑数据分析的执行前幻觉检测方法，可预测生成代码的正确性，性能超越现有基线且能跨编程基准迁移。

随着AI代码助手工具的日益普及，自动评估生成代码的正确性成为一项重大挑战。代码大语言模型（Code LLMs）容易产生幻觉，这可能导致代码无法解决所需的问题，甚至产生存在严重安全漏洞的代码。在本文中，我们提出了CodeTD——首个基于代码大语言模型注意力图的拓扑数据分析（TDA）的代码执行前正确性评估方法。我们的方法利用注意力图的拓扑模式来量化提示与生成结果之间的不匹配。我们在常见基准（HumanEval、MBPP、BigCodeBench、MultiPL-E）、5种编程语言以及10个参数规模最高达34B的代码大语言模型上进行了实验。实验结果表明，所提出的方法优于近期基线方法。此外，CodeTD可在不同编程基准之间迁移。

arXiv:2609.07779v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As AI-code assistant tools become widespread, automatic assessment of the correctness of generated code becomes a significant challenge. Code LLMs are prone to hallucinations, which may lead to code that does not solve the required problem, or even to code with severe security vulnerabilities. In this paper, we introduce CodeTD -- the first approach to pre-execution assessment of code correctness based on topological data analysis (TDA) of Code LLMs' attention maps. Our method quantifies prompt-generation mismatch using topological patterns of attention maps. We carry out experiments with common benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP, BigCodeBench, MultiPL-E), 5 programming languages and 10 Code LLMs of size up to 34B parameters. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms recent baselines. Moreover, CodeTD is transferable between coding benchmarks.

item.title: 研究发现在超奈奎斯特信号的Bi-LSTM检测中，多窗口嵌套架构无法提升误码率性能，真正的瓶颈在于观测模型而非网络架构，因此提出通过预白化和BCJR后验蒸馏来改进。
item.description:
超奈奎斯特信号传输中用于Bi-LSTM检测的预白化与BCJR后验蒸馏

Pre-Whitening and BCJR Posterior Distillation for Bi-LSTM Detection in Faster-than-Nyquist Signaling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07762

研究发现在超奈奎斯特信号的Bi-LSTM检测中，多窗口嵌套架构无法提升误码率性能，真正的瓶颈在于观测模型而非网络架构，因此提出通过预白化和BCJR后验蒸馏来改进。

循环检测器，如双向长短期记忆网络，是超奈奎斯特信号传输中最优的Bahl-Cocke-Jelinek-Raviv（BCJR）检测器的低复杂度替代方案。受将码间干扰（ISI）结构嵌入自身架构的卷积检测器的启发，我们探究在独立的循环分支中处理嵌套的ISI窗口能否改善Bi-LSTM的误码率（BER）。在大约260次受控训练中，结果表明并不能：在匹配的参数预算和匹配的读取层条件下，多窗口架构从未显著优于普通的Bi-LSTM。嵌套窗口化是一种可逆的重新排列，不会增加任何信息；额外的分支只会带来瓶颈；蒸馏诊断表明该网络在其窗口范围内已接近最优。因此，限制因素在于观测模型，而非网络架构。在保持架构不变的前提下，我们对预……（原文摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2609.07762v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recurrent detectors such as bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) networks are low-complexity alternatives to the optimal Bahl-Cocke-Jelinek-Raviv (BCJR) detector for faster-than-Nyquist (FTN) signaling. Motivated by convolutional detectors that build the intersymbol interference (ISI) structure into their architecture, we ask whether processing nested ISI windows in separate recurrent branches improves the bit error rate (BER) of a Bi-LSTM. Across roughly 260 controlled trainings it does not: at a matched parameter budget and a matched readout, the multi-window architecture never significantly beats a plain Bi-LSTM. Nested windowing is an invertible rearrangement that adds no information, extra branches only add bottlenecks, and a distillation diagnostic shows the network is already near optimal for its window. item.description:
分解引导的扩散语言模型用于惯性约束聚变预测

Decomposition-Guided Diffusion Language Models for Inertial Confinement Fusion Prediction

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07756

提出据信首个基于语言模型的惯性约束聚变预测器ICF-DLM，通过物理类型化分解、双向去噪和物理驱动PPO奖励，直接从激光脉冲与靶设计参数准确预测中子率波形。

arXiv:2609.07756v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：惯性约束聚变（ICF）是迈向清洁能源的主要途径之一，但国家点火装置（NIF）每一次实验的成本约为一百万美元，这使得精确的AI代理模型成为极具价值的研究目标。我们研究了外生驱动的ICF波形预测问题，即需要直接从激光脉冲和靶设计参数推断出512步的中子率诊断信号，而无需观测任何历史响应数据。该场景对标准时间序列预测器提出了严峻挑战：时间稀疏性（纳秒级时间窗口中仅存在皮秒级峰值）、输入输出尺度不匹配（仅有不到300次真实实验数据），以及峰值敏感性（皮秒级时序精度）。我们提出了ICF-DLM，据我们所知这是首个基于语言模型的ICF预测器，它结合了：（i）物理类型化分解，将输出分解为产额 $Y_{DT}$、峰值时刻 $t_{\mathrm{peak}}$ 和局部波形 $w_{\mathrm{local}}$；（ii）双向去噪机制，推迟对峰值位置的确定；（iii）物理驱动的PPO奖励。

arXiv:2609.07756v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inertial confinement fusion (ICF) is a leading pathway toward clean energy, but each shot at the National Ignition Facility costs on the order of one million dollars, making accurate AI surrogates a high-value target. We study exogenous-driven ICF waveform prediction, where a 512-step neutron-rate diagnostic must be inferred directly from a laser pulse and target design parameters, with no historical response observed. The regime stresses standard time-series predictors with temporal sparsity (picosecond peak in a nanosecond window), input-output scale mismatch (under 300 real shots), and peak sensitivity (picosecond timing). item.title: 本文提出了一个理论框架，证明了带权重衰减的梯度下降会收敛到经验损失全局极小值的邻域，并将总体误差分解为数据误差、优化误差和预测变化误差分别进行界定，其中通过局部近似齐次性对预测变化误差给出了明确的逐单元和逐层界。
item.description:
带权重衰减的梯度下降下神经网络泛化动力学的理论分析

A Theoretical Analysis of Generalization Dynamics in Neural Networks under Gradient Descent with Weight Decay

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07755

本文提出了一个理论框架，证明了带权重衰减的梯度下降会收敛到经验损失全局极小值的邻域，并将总体误差分解为数据误差、优化误差和预测变化误差分别进行界定，其中通过局部近似齐次性对预测变化误差给出了明确的逐单元和逐层界。

理解泛化仍然是机器学习中的核心挑战，因为它需要同时考虑数据、架构和训练动力学。在本文中，我们开发了一个理论框架，刻画这些因素如何在整个训练过程中共同塑造泛化性能。更确切地说，我们研究了在ℓ²损失下通过带权重衰减的梯度下降（GD）训练的一类广泛的神经网络，并证明了GD收敛到经验损失全局极小值的一个邻域。通过基于输入数据对空间进行划分，我们将总体误差分解为数据误差、优化误差和预测变化误差，并分别对它们进行界定。特别是，对于衡量学习函数振荡的预测变化误差，我们提出了（局部）近似齐次性，并推导出其演变过程的明确的逐单元和逐层界。

arXiv:2609.07755v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding generalization remains a central challenge in machine learning because it requires jointly considering data, architecture, and training dynamics. In this paper, we develop a theoretical framework that characterizes how these factors jointly shape generalization performance throughout training. More precisely, we study a broad class of neural networks trained under the $\ell^2$ loss by gradient descent (GD) with weight decay, and prove the convergence of GD to a neighbourhood of the global minimizers of the empirical loss. By partitioning the space based on the input data, we then decompose the population error into data error, optimization error, and prediction variation error, and bound them separately. Cross-modal learning for SAR target recognition using optical vision foundation models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07753

本文提出一种跨模态EO到SAR原型对齐框架，利用基于DINOv3的冻结光学编码器构建类别级光学原型，无需严格的EO/SAR配对数据即可为SAR目标识别提供类别级监督，缓解SAR标注数据稀缺和域差距问题。

arXiv:2609.07753v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：合成孔径雷达（SAR）凭借其多功能、远距离和近全天候的工作能力，在广泛的成像应用中是一种重要的成像模态。然而，由于标记数据有限、SAR图像中存在强斑点噪声，以及SAR与更丰富的光学图像之间存在显著的域差距，自动目标识别（ATR）仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。相比之下，电光（EO）图像受益于海量数据集、更清晰的视觉结构以及强大的基础模型。在这项工作中，我们研究了在光学数据上训练的视觉基础模型如何能够为SAR分类提供类别级别的监督。我们提出了一种从EO到SAR的跨模态原型对齐框架，其中使用基于DINOv3视觉基础模型的冻结EO编码器来构建类别级别的光学原型，而无需严格的EO/SAR配对图像。随后训练SAR模型对SAR图像进行分类，同时……

arXiv:2609.07753v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) is an important modality in a wide range of imaging applications due to its versatile, long range and near all weather operating capabilities. However, Automatic Target Recognition (ATR) remains a challenging problem due to limited labelled data, the strong speckle in SAR images and the significant domain gap between SAR and more abundant optical imagery. In contrast, electro-optical (EO) imagery benefits from massive datasets, clearer visual structure and powerful foundation models. We propose a cross-modal EO to SAR prototype alignment framework in which a frozen EO encoder, based on a DINOv3 vision foundation model, is used to construct class level optical prototypes without requiring strict EO/SAR pairs. item.title: 提出局部梯度神经算子（LGNO），一种基于非线性梯度离散化先验的轻量级、可解释的神经算子，可高效解决力学问题中的场时间演化预测与源识别任务。
item.description:
局部梯度神经算子

Local gradient neural operator

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07752

提出局部梯度神经算子（LGNO），一种基于非线性梯度离散化先验的轻量级、可解释的神经算子，可高效解决力学问题中的场时间演化预测与源识别任务。

场的时间演化预测与源识别是动力系统中的经典问题。解决这些问题的传统方法依赖于对控制偏微分方程（PDE）的透彻理解。近年来，以神经算子为代表的深度学习为处理此类任务提供了一种数据驱动的范式。然而，现有的面向PDE的全局神经算子大多需要大量训练数据和众多可学习参数，且可解释性与泛化能力有限。我们提出局部梯度神经算子（LGNO），作为解决典型力学问题中场时间演化预测与源识别的轻量级、可解释的替代方案。该方法建立在非线性梯度离散化的先验知识基础上，利用多层感知机卷积层学习平移不变的局部核，这些局部核类似于离散模板。一个零一致模板……

arXiv:2609.07752v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Field temporal prediction and source identification constitute canonical problems in dynamical systems. Conventional approaches to these problems depend on a thorough understanding of the governing partial differential equations (PDEs). Recently, deep learning, as represented by neural operators, has provided a data-driven paradigm for addressing such tasks. However, most existing global neural operators for PDEs require large training datasets and many learnable parameters, with limited interpretability and generalization. We propose the local gradient neural operator (LGNO) as a lightweight and interpretable alternative for field temporal evolution prediction and source identification in typical mechanical problems. The method builds on priors from nonlinear gradient discretization and uses multilayer perceptron convolutional layers to learn translation-invariant local kernels that resemble discrete stencils. item.title: 本文提出贪心多项式时间框架GRAF及由大语言模型驱动的进化框架LLMScore，用于在众包竞赛中为工作者推荐竞赛，在Tullock竞赛自选择模型下实现工作者零遗憾和平台最优性。

引导众包竞赛中的工作者自选择：一种LLM增强的算法方法

Guiding Worker Self-Selection in Crowdsourcing Contests: An LLM-Augmented Algorithmic Approach

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07749

本文提出贪心多项式时间框架GRAF及由大语言模型驱动的进化框架LLMScore，用于在众包竞赛中为工作者推荐竞赛，在Tullock竞赛自选择模型下实现工作者零遗憾和平台最优性。

众包平台协调着大量在线工作者，这些工作者会策略性地选择参加哪些竞赛以及投入多少努力。这种自选择可能导致重要的竞赛参与者过少或努力投入不足，而工作者也可能会后悔参加那些使其境况不如其他可选方案的竞赛。我们研究平台如何利用Tullock竞赛中的自选择（SSTC）向工作者推荐竞赛，SSTC是一个两阶段模型，工作者首先选择竞赛，然后在其中展开竞争。我们提出了GRAF，一个贪心的多项式时间框架，它通过根据分数向量对工作者进行排序来构建自选择结果，并在SSTC的特殊情况下保证工作者零遗憾和平台最优性。由于在工作者存在异质性的情况下难以设计有效的排序，我们提出了LLMScore，一个由大语言模型驱动的进化框架，能够自动设计GRAF的评分算法。

arXiv:2609.07749v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crowdsourcing platforms coordinate large pools of online workers who strategically choose which contests to enter and how much effort to invest. This self-selection can leave important contests with too few participants or too little effort, while workers may regret entering contests that leave them worse off than available alternatives. We introduce GRAF, a greedy polynomial-time framework that constructs self-selection outcomes by ordering workers according to a score vector, with guarantees of zero worker regret and platform optimality in special cases of SSTC. item.title: 本文首次系统性地研究了Kolmogorov-Arnold网络在多节点多GPU高性能计算系统上的数据并行训练可扩展性，实验表明在8个GPU上可实现74.7%的并行效率和5.97倍加速。
item.description:
高性能计算系统上分布式Kolmogorov-Arnold网络训练的可扩展性分析

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07740

本文首次系统性地研究了Kolmogorov-Arnold网络在多节点多GPU高性能计算系统上的数据并行训练可扩展性，实验表明在8个GPU上可实现74.7%的并行效率和5.97倍加速。

Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）用网络边上可学习的单变量函数取代了多层感知机（MLPs）的固定激活函数和线性权重，提供了更好的可解释性，并且在某些设置下具有有竞争力的参数效率。虽然KANs的逼近性质已受到广泛关注，但其在分布式多GPU训练下的行为尚未得到系统性的表征。本文对多节点、多GPU高性能计算（HPC）基础设施上的数据并行KAN训练进行了实证可扩展性研究，从四个维度进行评估：强扩展性、弱扩展性、通信开销和模型规模扩展。实验在FinisTerrae III超级计算机上进行，使用PyTorch分布式数据并行（DDP），跨4个节点最多使用8块NVIDIA A100 GPU。KAN训练在8个GPU上达到74.7%的并行效率，加速比达5.97倍。

arXiv:2609.07740v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) replace the fixed activation functions and linear weights of Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) with learnable univariate functions on network edges, offering improved interpretability and, in some settings, competitive parameter efficiency. While the approximation properties of KANs have received considerable attention, their behavior under distributed, multi-GPU training has not been systematically characterized. This paper presents an empirical scalability study of data-parallel KAN training on multi-node, multi-GPU high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure, evaluated along four dimensions: strong scaling, weak scaling, communication overhead, and model-size scaling. Experiments were conducted on the FinisTerrae III supercomputer using up to 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs across 4 nodes with PyTorch Distributed Data Parallel (DDP). 归因Cohen's d：常模年龄生物标志物中疾病相关效应的训练数据归因

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07729

本文提出一种基于Cohen's d的闭式影响泛函，可直接将常模年龄模型中疾病相关的年龄差距效应归因到个体训练样本，并在UK Biobank上证明移除最有影响力的训练样本可显著提高疾病相关效应量。

常模年龄模型在名义上健康的队列中进行训练，用于预测实际年龄（实际年龄）。当应用于患者时，模型会产生偏差，预测年龄与实际年龄之间的差距被解读为疾病风险。本文将年龄差距的疾病相关效应量直接归因于个体训练样本，而不是以预测级别的损失作为归因目标。对于Cohen's d，由此得到的闭式影响泛函（经留一法重训练验证）可根据训练样本对留出数据的病例-对照分离效果的影响对其进行排序。在英国生物银行（UK Biobank）的四种疾病和两种生物标志物模态上，移除最具影响力的10%训练样本在所有随机种子下均能提高留出的疾病相关效应量：对于2型糖尿病，代谢组学年龄效应增加了一倍以上；对于多发性硬化症，脑年龄效应提高了约三分之一。而随机移除即使达到50%，效应量也保持不变，这证实了……

arXiv:2609.07729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Normative age models are trained to predict chronological age in a nominally healthy cohort. Applied to patients, they deviate, and the gap between predicted and chronological age is read as disease risk. Here, we attribute the disease-related effect size of the age gap directly to individual training samples, rather than using a prediction-level loss as the attribution target. For Cohen's $d$, the resulting closed-form influence functional, validated against leave-one-out retraining, ranks training samples by their effect on held-out case-control separation. Across four diseases and two biomarker modalities in UK Biobank, removing the 10% most influential training samples raises held-out disease-related effect size in every seed. 基于课程微调CNN-Transformer的Sub-6 GHz频段空中自动调制分类

Sub-6 GHz Over-the-Air AMC via Curriculum Fine-Tuned CNN-Transformers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07726

本研究提出一种课程微调策略，将在915 MHz线缆链路数据上训练的CNN-Transformer自动调制分类模型迁移至4 GHz真实空中链路环境，并系统评估了不同距离和天线失准条件下的分类性能。

自动调制分类（AMC）模型通常在合成数据或信道线缆连接的数据上进行训练和验证，这留下了一个悬而未决的问题：当真实自由空间链路引入路径损耗和天线指向误差后，这些模型的表现如何。我们报告了一项针对混合CNN-Transformer AMC模型的课程微调研究。支撑该模型的通用全32类数据集完全在915 MHz频率下，通过受控的时钟/PPS同步MIMO扩展线缆链路（而非空间复用传输）构建；随后所有的自由空间真实硬件实验——包括顺序微调课程、匹配距离评估以及所有报告的空中准确率数据——均在4 GHz频率下进行，覆盖五种定向天线距离（25、35、50、70、75厘米），并在固定的收发增益条件下完成。其中三个距离采用近乎理想的天线对准（约99%），两个距离采用故意引入的部分失准（约8%）

item.title: 提出一种调制随空间变化的新型条件化层SpFiLM，使单一网络能够对造影剂注射前后的T1w脑部MRI均实现可靠的脑区分割。
item.description:
用于造影剂感知脑区分割的空间特征级线性调制（SpFiLM）

Spatial Feature-wise Linear Modulation (SpFiLM) for Contrast Agent-Aware Brain Parcellation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07718

提出一种调制随空间变化的新型条件化层SpFiLM，使单一网络能够对造影剂注射前后的T1w脑部MRI均实现可靠的脑区分割。

大多数自动化脑区分割工具都是在T1加权（T1w）MRI上开发和验证的。然而，某些与脑区分割相关的临床工作流程仅使用对比增强T1w（T1ce）MRI，而基于T1w训练的模型在此类图像上准确性较低。我们提出了一种统一的网络，能够可靠地对造影剂注射前后的T1w MRI进行脑区分割，该网络在两种图像的组合上进行训练，并通过条件化机制对每种模态产生不同的空间响应调制。特征级线性调制是网络中基于输入进行调制的已知方法，它在整个输入上均匀地应用逐通道的缩放和平移。然而，造影剂注射前后脑部外观的变化在脑内是局部性变化的，这使得FiLM在我们的应用场景中并非最优选择。在这项工作中，我们引入了空间FiLM（SpFiLM），这是一种调制随空间位置变化的条件化层，它从图像导出的空间模式中组装逐体素的缩放和平移。

arXiv:2609.07718v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Most automated brain parcellation tools are developed and validated on T1-weighted (T1w) MRI. Yet, some clinical workflows for which parcellation is relevant only use contrast-enhanced T1w (T1ce) MRI, on which T1w-trained models are less accurate. We present a unified network that parcellates both pre- and post-contrast agent T1w MRI reliably, trained on a combination of the two with conditioning that spatially modulates its response differently for each. Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) is a known approach for input-based modulation in networks. It applies a per-channel scale and shift uniformly across the input. However, the appearance change between pre- and post-contrast varies locally across the brain, making FiLM suboptimal for our use case. item.title: 提出ParetoTransport，一种无需训练的流匹配模型引导方法，利用质量传输与Wasserstein匹配将离线设计的分布迭代推向帕累托前沿并在其上有效分布，从而在种群分布层面实现生成式多目标优化。

ParetoTransport：通过质量传输向帕累托前沿推进的生成式优化

ParetoTransport: Generative Optimization by Mass Transport Toward The Pareto Front

提出ParetoTransport，一种无需训练的流匹配模型引导方法，利用质量传输与Wasserstein匹配将离线设计的分布迭代推向帕累托前沿并在其上有效分布，从而在种群分布层面实现生成式多目标优化。

离线多目标优化不仅需要将候选设计的目标向量向帕累托前沿推进，还需要使其在帕累托前沿上有效分布。生成式方法近来成为一种自然的途径，因为它们学习可行设计上的分布，同时允许将生成过程引导向有前景的设计。然而，现有方法在很大程度上保留了经典的逐样本引导策略，使得生成式方法的分布级建模能力未被充分利用。我们提出ParetoTransport，这是一种面向预训练流匹配模型的无训练引导方法，能够在目标空间中显式指定并细化种群级分布。ParetoTransport引导流匹配采样器迭代地将经验离线分布向帕累托前沿传输，并通过Wasserstein距离与中间代理分布进行匹配。这直接控制了分布层面（摘要在此处截断）……

提出仅依靠局部信息（自身时间预算和广播的充电站占用情况）运行相同策略的学习智能体，使电动配送车队无需中央控制即可实现涌现式充电协调，在二十个城市的真实路网仿真中按时完成99.5%的班次，远超贪心规则的73%。

在电动配送车队中，班次中途充电并非易事：每辆车必须决定何时、何地以及充多少电，才能在电量高于安全底线的前提下按时完成任务。这些决策是相互耦合的：当过多车辆选择同一个充电站时便会形成排队。以往的工作通过中央调度、预先计算的排程或预约机制来解决这种耦合，但充电基础设施很少支持这类机制。相反，我们采用一族纯粹局部控制的学习智能体：每辆车运行相同的策略，仅依据自身的时间预算和广播的充电站占用情况独立决策，从而在没有中央控制或消息传递的情况下实现涌现式协调。我们在二十个城市的真实OpenStreetMap路网上通过仿真验证了这一范式，每个城市均设有一个由全知Oracle校准的冻结场景（99.5%的班次按时完成），而朴素的贪心规则（低电量时选择最近充电站）仅能完成73%。所训练的智能体

arXiv:2609.07689v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In electric delivery fleets, mid-shift charging is non-trivial: each vehicle must decide when, where and how much to charge to finish on time with battery above a safety floor. The choices are coupled: queues build where too many vehicles pick the same station. Prior work resolves this coupling with central dispatching, precomputed schedules or reservations, machinery that charging infrastructure rarely supports. Instead, we use a family of learning agents under purely local control: every vehicle runs the same policy, deciding alone from its time budgets and broadcast station occupancies, leading to emergent coordination without central control or messaging. We validate this paradigm in simulation on real OpenStreetMap networks of twenty cities, each with a frozen scenario calibrated by an omniscient Oracle (99.5% of shifts completed on time), whereas a naive greedy rule (nearest station on low battery) completes just 73%. arXiv:2609.07681v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Associative Recall (AR) is the cognitive ability to learn and retrieve links between items in memory. In NLP, AR is used as a benchmark for evaluating the in-context memory capacity of architectures such as Mamba, and has been found to strongly correlate with language modeling performance. This paper explores AR from the perspective of mechanistic interpretability, aiming to reverse-engineer the exact internal algorithm used by Mamba to perform recall. Our key insight is that Mamba performs recall by implicitly learning linear hash functions, and we identify the low-level circuit that enables this behavior. The subspace gradient is estimated by central differences, a trial step is computed from a linear trust-region model, and the trust-region radius adapts according to the agreement between predicted and observed loss reduction, eliminating the learning rate.
