item.title: 该论文提出了一种分布敏感的评估框架，通过计算量化模型与全精度模型在token决策边界处全词表预测分布之间的统计距离（如Jensen-Shannon散度和总变差距离）来量化保真度损失，弥补了仅依赖准确率评估量化模型质量的不足。
item.description:
准确率是不够的：一种基于散度的量化大语言模型保真度损失评估方法

Accuracy is Not Enough: A Divergence-Based Approach to Evaluate Fidelity Loss in Quantized LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07664

该论文提出了一种分布敏感的评估框架，通过计算量化模型与全精度模型在token决策边界处全词表预测分布之间的统计距离（如Jensen-Shannon散度和总变差距离）来量化保真度损失，弥补了仅依赖准确率评估量化模型质量的不足。

将大语言模型（LLM）部署到内存受限的边缘设备上，很大程度上依赖于激进的后训练量化。然而，对这些模型的评估主要基于零样本任务准确率，该指标仅取决于argmax预测，对底层预测分布的变化并不敏感。因此，在渐进量化过程中，准确率可能表现出不稳定的、非单调的行为，掩盖了相对于BFloat16（BF16）未压缩基础模型的实质性保真度损失，并提供具有误导性的部署信号。我们引入了一个分布敏感的评估框架，将量化LLM中的信息损失量化为token决策边界处全词表预测分布之间的散度。我们计算全精度模型与量化模型输出之间的统计距离，包括Jensen-Shannon散度和总变差距离，从而实现细粒度的（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2609.07664v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) on memory-constrained edge devices relies heavily on aggressive post-training quantization. However, evaluating these models is largely based on zero-shot task accuracy, which depends solely on argmax predictions and is insensitive to changes in the underlying predictive distribution. Consequently, accuracy can exhibit unstable, non-monotonic behavior under progressive quantization, masking substantial fidelity loss relative to the BFloat16 (BF16) uncompressed base model and providing misleading deployment signals. We introduce a distribution-sensitive evaluation framework quantifying information loss in quantized LLMs as the divergence between full-vocabulary predictive distributions at the token decision boundary. We compute statistical distances, including Jensen-Shannon Divergence and Total Variation Distance, between outputs of full-precision and quantized models, enabling a fine-grained

item.title: 该论文提出在线代理修复（OSR）这一闭环算法，利用稀疏的高保真评估在长时间的智能体搜索中持续更新低成本代理模型，从而将高保真反馈与搜索长度解耦，避免固定代理模型的误差被优化过程放大。
item.description:
在线代理修复：在闭环发现中将高保真反馈与搜索长度解耦

Online Surrogate Repair: Decoupling High-Fidelity Feedback from Search Length in Closed-Loop Discovery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07655

该论文提出在线代理修复（OSR）这一闭环算法，利用稀疏的高保真评估在长时间的智能体搜索中持续更新低成本代理模型，从而将高保真反馈与搜索长度解耦，避免固定代理模型的误差被优化过程放大。

闭环AI科学家能够以较低的边际计算成本生成候选设计，而可靠的反馈可能需要湿实验室合成、表征或高保真计算。通过定制实验室自动化来解决这一不平衡仍然需要大量基础设施投入且成本高昂，而用固定的代理模型替代新实验则会留下持续的模型误差，这些误差还可能被优化过程放大。我们提出了在线代理修复，这是一种闭环算法，它利用稀疏的高保真评估，在整个主要由低廉代理反馈驱动的较长智能体搜索过程中持续更新代理模型。一种采集规则从智能体累积提出的方案中选择哪些设计进行高保真评估，所得的标签用于更新后续回合中使用的代理模型。在受控的合成环境中，我们证明了改善全局代理拟合效果并……

arXiv:2609.07655v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Closed-loop AI scientists can generate candidate designs at low marginal computational cost, whereas reliable feedback may require wet-lab synthesis, characterization, or high-fidelity computation. Addressing this imbalance through custom laboratory automation remains infrastructure-intensive and costly, while replacing new experiments with a fixed surrogate leaves persistent model errors that can be amplified by optimization. We propose \emph{online surrogate repair} (OSR), a closed-loop algorithm that uses sparse high-fidelity evaluations to update the surrogate throughout a longer agent search conducted primarily with inexpensive surrogate feedback. An acquisition rule selects which designs from the agent's accumulated proposals receive high-fidelity evaluation, and the resulting labels update the surrogate used in subsequent episodes. Across controlled synthetic environments, we demonstrate that improving global surrogate fit does

item.title: 该论文将连字模式生成中 patgen 参数配置的选择形式化为黑盒超参数优化问题，通过高斯过程贝叶斯优化，在涵盖 14 种语言的 17 个数据集上几乎全面提升了断词 F_{1/7} 分数，同时将字典树体积中位数缩减至基线的 0.407。
item.description:
层次竞争模式的艺术：连字符断词的高斯过程优化

The Art of Hierarchical Competing Patterns: Gaussian Process Optimization of Hyphenation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07638

该论文将连字模式生成中 patgen 参数配置的选择形式化为黑盒超参数优化问题，通过高斯过程贝叶斯优化，在涵盖 14 种语言的 17 个数据集上几乎全面提升了断词 F_{1/7} 分数，同时将字典树体积中位数缩减至基线的 0.407。

连字模式（断词模式）仍然是排版系统、文本处理器和网页渲染引擎中单词断行的一种紧凑且广泛部署的解决方案，但其生成仍然依赖于手动调整的 patgen 程序参数配置。我们将 patgen 配置的选择形式化为一个黑盒超参数优化问题，并评估了高斯过程贝叶斯优化在该任务上的效果。搜索目标将面向精确率的 F_{1/7} 分数与通过归一化字典树（trie）大小惩罚实现的显式字典树大小-精度权衡相结合。我们在涵盖 14 种语言和多种文字系统的 17 个带连字符划分的词表数据集上评估了该方法。与基于相同 8/10 训练集划分重新生成、并在相同 1/10 留出测试集划分上评估的两个强人工调优配置相比，高斯过程优化的配置在 17 个数据集中的 16 个上提升了 F_{1/7} 分数，并在全部 17 个数据集上减小了字典树大小。优化后配置与基线的字典树大小比值中位数为 0.407。一个数据集层面的……

arXiv:2609.07638v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hyphenation patterns remain a compact and widely deployed solution for word breaking in typesetting systems, text processors, and web rendering engines, but their generation still depends on manually tuned patgen program parameter profiles. We formulate patgen profile selection as a black-box hyperparameter optimization problem and evaluate Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization for this task. The search objective combines a precision-oriented F_{1/7}-score with an explicit trie size-accuracy trade-off using a normalized trie-size penalty. We evaluate the method on 17 hyphenated word-list datasets covering 14 languages and multiple scripts. Against two strong hand-tuned profiles regenerated from the same 8/10 training split and evaluated on the same 1/10 held-out test split, the GP-optimized profiles improve F_{1/7} on 16 of 17 datasets and reduce trie size on all 17. The median optimized/baseline trie ratio is 0.407. A dataset-level

item.title: 论文论证了基于强化学习的对齐因从打分行为中学习规范，使“合规”退化为“被发现才付出代价”，因此行为训练在原理上至多只能保证智能体在被观察时才合规的有条件合规。
item.description:
有代价的规范：为何基于强化学习的对齐至多只能承诺有条件的合规

Norms at a Price: Why RL-Based Alignment Can Promise Conditional Compliance at Best

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07627

论文论证了基于强化学习的对齐因从打分行为中学习规范，使“合规”退化为“被发现才付出代价”，因此行为训练在原理上至多只能保证智能体在被观察时才合规的有条件合规。

AI 智能体有时在推断自己正被测试时表现得对齐，而在未被测试时则表现不同。我们认为这并非异常现象，而是当前训练机制在结构上筛选出的结果。基于强化学习的对齐将规范与任务追求折叠进同一个策略之中：系统从被打分的行为中学习规范，而打分过程将规范扁平化了。“不要做 X”被学习为“做 X 若被发现就要付出代价”。在训练所能产生的每一个数据点上，一个仅在被观察到时才合规的策略，与一个始终合规的策略是无法区分的；而能够区分二者的实验——给未被观察到的行为打分——在概念上是自相矛盾的。因此，行为训练所能被证明兑现的，至多是有条件的合规。智能体的能动性使这一问题更加尖锐：智能体大多在无人注视之处运作，且能根据自己是否被观察而采取不同行动。一个针对检测到的失败进行训练的迭代流程，会筛选出通过检测的行为……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.07627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents sometimes act aligned when they infer they are being tested, and differently when not. We argue this is not an anomaly but what current training regimes are structured to select for. Reinforcement-learning-based alignment folds norms and task pursuit into one policy: the system learns its norms from scored behavior, and scoring flattens them. Do not do X is learned as doing X costs something if noticed. On every datum training can produce, a policy that complies only when it might be observed is indistinguishable from one that complies always. The experiment that would tell them apart - scoring unobserved behavior - is a contradiction in terms. Conditional compliance is thus the most that behavioral training can be known to deliver. item.title: 提出了一种名为Trace的混合模型，通过有效整合赛前信息与实时比赛数据来预测网球比赛获胜概率，在大满贯比赛数据上于比赛进行25%、50%和75%时分别取得76.06%、82.15%和88.34%的准确率。
item.description:
预测正在进行的网球比赛的获胜者

Forecasting the Winner of a Live Tennis Match

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07617

提出了一种名为Trace的混合模型，通过有效整合赛前信息与实时比赛数据来预测网球比赛获胜概率，在大满贯比赛数据上于比赛进行25%、50%和75%时分别取得76.06%、82.15%和88.34%的准确率。

随着近年来体育实时投注的兴起，网球预测已从赛前预测扩展到在比赛进行过程中实时更新获胜概率的模型。构建此类模型的一个核心挑战是模型需要不断适应比分和球员表现的变化。本研究探讨了如何最有效地将赛前信息和实时信息整合到模型中，以产生准确的获胜概率估计。分析使用了8,222场大满贯比赛，共包含1,505,355个得分。研究采用时间顺序划分评估了五个模型，其中2011-2021年的比赛用于训练，2022年用于验证，2023-2024年用于测试。Trace作为一种混合模型，在比赛进行到25%、50%和75%时分别达到了76.06%、82.15%和88.34%的准确率，表明混合建模是实时网球比赛预测的一种实用方法。

arXiv:2609.07617v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the rise of live sports betting in recent years, tennis forecasting has expanded from pre-match prediction to models that update win probabilities as a match unfolds. A central challenge in creating such a model is the constant need for models to adapt to score and performance changes. This study examines how pre-match and live information can be most effectively integrated into a model to produce accurate win-probability estimates. The analysis uses 8,222 Grand Slam matches containing a total of 1,505,355 points. Five models were evaluated using a chronological split, with matches from 2011-2021 used for training, 2022 for validation, and 2023-2024 for testing. Trace, a hybrid model, achieved accuracies of 76.06%, 82.15%, and 88.34% at 25%, 50%, and 75% match progress, suggesting that hybrid modeling is a practical approach to live tennis forecasting.

item.title: 该研究提出PRiSM方法，可将黑盒临床预测模型转化为可逐项审计的透明列线图，并在5万余例心脏移植数据的时间外部验证中证明其在保持区分度、校准度和临床净获益的同时实现了模型透明化。
item.description:
将黑盒临床预测模型转化为独立的透明列线图：心脏移植中的时间外部验证

Translation of Black-Box Clinical Prediction Models into Standalone Transparent Nomograms: Temporal External Validation in Heart Transplantation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07610

该研究提出PRiSM方法，可将黑盒临床预测模型转化为可逐项审计的透明列线图，并在5万余例心脏移植数据的时间外部验证中证明其在保持区分度、校准度和临床净获益的同时实现了模型透明化。

我们将针对表格数据的黑盒临床预测模型转化为可逐项审计的独立列线图。PRiSM（结构化模型中的部分响应）方法从源模型中提取每个效应和交互作用的具体形状，而不仅仅是识别哪些变量重要，并让结局变量对它们进行选择和加权。我们在50,356名心脏移植受者中对此进行了测试，验证采用了比训练时期更晚的数据。来自所有5个源模型（公开临床风险评分、逻辑回归、神经网络、随机森林和极端梯度提升）的列线图，在进一步简化之前均满足预先设定的区分度非劣效标准，并总体上保持了校准度和临床净获益。来自3个机器学习模型的列线图在区分度上与从头构建的广义可加模型和可解释提升模型无显著差异，优于神经可加模型，且包含的项数更少。

arXiv:2609.07610v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We convert black-box clinical prediction models for tabular data into standalone nomograms that can be audited term by term. PRiSM (Partial Responses in Structured Models) takes the shape of each effect and interaction from the source model, not merely which variables mattered, and lets the outcome select and weight them. We tested this in 50,356 heart transplant recipients, with validation in a later era than training. Nomograms from all 5 source models - a public clinical risk score, logistic regression, neural networks, random forests and extreme gradient boosting - met a prespecified noninferiority criterion for discrimination before any further simplification, and generally preserved calibration and clinical net benefit. Those from the 3 machine-learning models showed no detectable difference in discrimination from de novo generalized additive and explainable boosting models, exceeded neural additive models, and carried fewer terms

item.title: 提出了CLUES-WEASEL，一种结合WEASEL 2.0无监督特征提取、主成分分析降维和k-means聚类的新颖时间序列聚类算法，在聚类性能与运行效率之间实现了良好平衡。
item.description:
CLUES-WEASEL：无需额外线索即可选择你的时间序列聚类算法

CLUES-WEASEL: No additional clues required to choose your time series clustering algorithm

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07606

提出了CLUES-WEASEL，一种结合WEASEL 2.0无监督特征提取、主成分分析降维和k-means聚类的新颖时间序列聚类算法，在聚类性能与运行效率之间实现了良好平衡。

时间序列数据在许多现实世界应用和众多领域中非常常见，人们对于使用机器学习进行自动化信息提取的兴趣日益增长。时间序列聚类是其中一个子领域，其目标是以无监督的方式在一组时间序列中识别出聚类。大多数时间序列聚类算法都面临同样的平衡困境：它们要么以聚类性能换取更快的运行速度，要么以运行速度换取更好的聚类性能。我们提出了一种新颖的时间序列聚类算法，称为CLUES-WEASEL，全称为“基于无监督第二版词提取的时序分类聚类算法”。CLUES-WEASEL使用WEASEL 2.0（一种时间序列分类算法）变换步骤的无监督版本来提取特征，然后利用主成分分析对这些特征进行降维，最后使用这些降维后的特征通过k-means算法执行聚类。

arXiv:2609.07606v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time series data is very common in many real-world applications and in numerous domains, with increasing interest for automated information extraction using machine learning. One of these subfields is time series clustering, which consists in identifying clusters among a set of time series in an unsupervised fashion. Most time series clustering algorithms suffer from the same balancing act: they trade clustering performance for faster runtimes or vice versa. We present a novel time series clustering algorithm that we call CLUES-WEASEL, which stands for CLustering with the UnsupervisEd Second version of Word ExtrAction for time SEries cLassification. CLUES-WEASEL extracts features using the unsupervised version of the transformation step of WEASEL 2.0, which is a time series classification algorithm, then reduces these features using principal component analysis, and finally performs clustering with the $k$-means algorithm using these red

item.title: 本文提出二次谱下降（QSD），在保持Muon谱范数约束的前提下将线性局部模型替换为二次模型，证明曲率会改变最优更新的奇异值和奇异方向，并通过Kronecker分解曲率近似与少量Frank–Wolfe步骤使该方法实用化。
item.description:
超越矩阵符号：二次谱下降

Beyond the Matrix Sign: Quadratic Spectral Descent

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07597

本文提出二次谱下降（QSD），在保持Muon谱范数约束的前提下将线性局部模型替换为二次模型，证明曲率会改变最优更新的奇异值和奇异方向，并通过Kronecker分解曲率近似与少量Frank–Wolfe步骤使该方法实用化。

Muon可以被解释为在谱范数球上优化线性局部目标。这产生了一个矩阵符号更新，该更新保留梯度的奇异方向，并为所有活跃的奇异模式分配相同的幅值。我们提出疑问：当考虑局部曲率时，这两个性质是否仍然最优？为回答这一问题，我们保持Muon的谱范数约束不变，将线性局部模型替换为二次模型，并将由此得到的方法称为二次谱下降。我们证明，曲率可以同时改变最优更新的奇异值和奇异方向。为了使QSD具备实用性，我们使用Kronecker分解的统计量来近似曲率，并通过少量Frank–Wolfe步骤求解该受约束的二次问题，其中每一步都对应一个具有闭式解的矩阵符号子问题。我们进一步提供了最优性证书，并在相同条件下与Muon进行了比较（摘要截断）……

arXiv:2609.07597v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Muon can be interpreted as optimizing a linear local objective over a spectral-norm ball. This gives a matrix-sign update that preserves the singular directions of the gradient and assigns the same magnitude to all active singular modes. We ask whether these two properties remain optimal when local curvature is taken into account. To answer this question, we keep Muon's spectral-norm constraint unchanged and replace the linear local model with a quadratic one. We call the resulting method \emph{Quadratic Spectral Descent} (QSD). We show that curvature can change both the singular values and the singular directions of the optimal update. To make QSD practical, we approximate curvature with Kronecker-factored statistics and solve the constrained quadratic with a small number of Frank--Wolfe steps, each of which has a closed-form matrix-sign subproblem. We further provide an optimality certificate, a comparison with Muon under the same qu

item.title: 该论文提出了一种介入式评估协议，揭示视觉语言模型对模态缺失的自我解释并不忠实——它们系统性地高估现有模态证据的充分性，并大幅低估恢复缺失模态对预测结果的影响。
item.description:
我并不想你，但其实我想你：视觉语言模型中模态缺失的自我解释忠实性

I Don't Miss You, but I Do: Self-Explanation Faithfulness of Modality Missingness in Vision-Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07596

该论文提出了一种介入式评估协议，揭示视觉语言模型对模态缺失的自我解释并不忠实——它们系统性地高估现有模态证据的充分性，并大幅低估恢复缺失模态对预测结果的影响。

视觉语言模型越来越多地被应用于某些输入模态可能不可用的场景，然而对于它们能否忠实地解释这些缺失信息如何影响自身的预测，我们知之甚少。我们引入了一种介入式评估协议来评估模型对模态动态的自我解释：模型需要陈述每个模态单独能支持什么、恢复缺失的模态是否会改变其答案、以及现有证据是否充分；随后我们执行相应的模态介入操作，并将这些陈述与模型的实际行为进行比较。我们在四项任务上评估了来自两个模型家族的八个开源权重视觉语言模型，这些任务涵盖互补和同构的文本-图像设置以及多视角驾驶设置。我们发现模型存在系统性地夸大现有模态证据充分性的倾向。模型大幅低估了恢复缺失模态所产生的影响：任务级……

arXiv:2609.07596v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used in settings where some input modalities may be unavailable, yet we know little about whether they can faithfully explain how such missing information affects their own predictions. We introduce an interventional protocol for evaluating self-explanations of modality dynamics: models state what each modality alone would support, whether restoring a missing modality would change their answer, and whether the available evidence is sufficient; we then execute the corresponding modality intervention and compare these claims with the model's realized behavior. We evaluate eight open-weight VLMs from two model families across four tasks spanning complementary and isomorphic text-image settings and a multi-view driving setting. We find a systematic tendency to overstate the sufficiency of available modality evidence. Models substantially underestimate the effect of restoring missing modalities: task-le

item.title: 这篇论文证明了在无外在奖励的情况下，智能体若能高效地优先探索信息量最大、最可学习的区域以生成可泛化经验，仅凭这一纯内在目标就足以自动形成课程并涌现出高度复杂的行为。
item.description:
高效探索就足够了

Efficient Exploration Is Enough

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07575

这篇论文证明了在无外在奖励的情况下，智能体若能高效地优先探索信息量最大、最可学习的区域以生成可泛化经验，仅凭这一纯内在目标就足以自动形成课程并涌现出高度复杂的行为。

这项工作提出了对高效探索的一种全新视角，并研究了其在缺乏外在奖励情况下的理论与实证意义。具体而言，我们将高效探索者定义为优先产生可泛化经验的智能体，即生成能够支持学习可跨环境进行预测和适应的模型的数据。这使我们能够通过预测和泛化的视角来分析高效探索。在理论上，我们证明了最优的高效探索者会自然地规划其轨迹，优先访问信息量最大且最可学习的区域。在实证上，我们表明对这些智能体进行优化会产生一个自动的课程，逐步生成更复杂的行为，即使在相对简单的环境中也是如此。这些结果表明，仅仅追求这种纯内在目标就足以驱动高度复杂行为的涌现。我们相信（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.07575v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work introduces an alternative view of efficient exploration and studies its theoretical and empirical implications in the absence of extrinsic rewards. Specifically, we define efficient explorers as agents that prioritize generating generalizable experience, i.e., data that supports learning models capable of predicting and adapting across the environment. This allows us to analyze efficient exploration through the lens of prediction and generalization. Theoretically, we demonstrate that optimally efficient explorers naturally schedule their trajectories to visit the most informative and learnable regions first. Empirically, we show that optimizing for these agents gives rise to an automatic curriculum of progressively more complex behaviors, even in relatively simple environments. These results indicate that pursuing this purely intrinsic objective alone is enough to drive the emergence of highly sophisticated behaviors. We beli

item.title: 本文证明了现有混合缓存策略LeCar在遗忘型对手下会产生线性遗憾，并提出了一种基于Hedge的虚拟LRU与LFU缓存混合策略H-MC，能够在最优切换开销下实现对LRU与LFU较优者的无遗憾（次线性遗憾）性能保证。
item.description:
具有最优切换开销的LRU与LFU无遗憾混合策略

No-Regret Mixing of LRU and LFU with Optimal Switching Cost

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07566

本文证明了现有混合缓存策略LeCar在遗忘型对手下会产生线性遗憾，并提出了一种基于Hedge的虚拟LRU与LFU缓存混合策略H-MC，能够在最优切换开销下实现对LRU与LFU较优者的无遗憾（次线性遗憾）性能保证。

缓存系统通常依赖于简单的淘汰策略，如最近最少使用（LRU）和最不经常使用（LFU），它们在互补的请求模式下表现良好。诸如LeCar和Cacheus等近期策略借鉴了在线学习中专家问题的思想，将LRU和LFU结合起来。具体而言，在发生缓存未命中时，这些策略使用由追踪历史淘汰记录所更新的分数导出的概率，在两种淘汰规则之间进行随机选择。尽管这些策略展现出强劲的实证性能，但目前尚不清楚它们是否能够在每条请求序列上都保证渐近地表现得与LRU和LFU中较优者一样好，即它们是否能相对于该基准实现次线性遗憾。我们首先证明LeCar在面对遗忘型对手时会遭受线性遗憾，即使拥有无界的历史记录也是如此。随后，我们提出H-MC，一种基于Hedge算法的虚拟LRU与LFU缓存混合策略，该策略保留了Hedge的选择概率特性（摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.07566v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Caching systems often rely on simple eviction policies such as Least Recently Used (LRU) and Least Frequently Used (LFU), which perform well in complementary request regimes. Recent policies such as LeCar and Cacheus combine LRU and LFU using ideas from the experts problem in online learning. Specifically, upon a miss, they randomize between the two eviction rules using probabilities derived from scores updated by tracking the history of past evictions. While these policies exhibit strong empirical performance, it remains unclear whether they are guaranteed, on every request sequence, to perform asymptotically as well as the better of LRU and LFU, i.e., whether they achieve sublinear regret with respect to this benchmark. We first show that LeCar suffers linear regret against an oblivious adversary, even with unbounded history. We then propose H-MC, a Hedge-based mixture of virtual LRU and LFU caches that preserves Hedge's selection prob

item.title: 本文提出EigenLI谱近似框架，利用后期交互表示的内在低秩结构，通过提取每个文档的主导特征方向构建低维子空间来压缩表示，在降低索引与存储成本的同时取得了优于聚类池化方法的检索效果。
item.description:
EigenLI：面向后期交互的谱近似方法

EigenLI: Spectral Approximations to Late Interaction

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07561

本文提出EigenLI谱近似框架，利用后期交互表示的内在低秩结构，通过提取每个文档的主导特征方向构建低维子空间来压缩表示，在降低索引与存储成本的同时取得了优于聚类池化方法的检索效果。

诸如ColBERT等后期交互模型通过使用大量词元级向量来表示每个文档，从而实现了强大的检索效果，但这种表达能力也带来了高昂的索引成本、庞大的存储占用以及代价昂贵的MaxSim评分计算。我们证明了后期交互表示具有内在的低秩结构：文档的词元嵌入集中于一个能够保留大部分检索信号的低维子空间中。基于这一观察，我们提出了EigenLI，一个通过文档特定的低维子空间来压缩后期交互表示的谱近似框架。与聚类或池化方法不同，EigenLI识别每个文档的主导特征方向，并利用它们构建缩减后的交互表示。实验表明，在ColBERTv2和AnswerAI-ColBERT-small模型上，k≤32的k-EigenLI优于基于k-means和Ward聚类的池化方法；GTE-ModernColBERT表现出……

arXiv:2609.07561v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Late-interaction models such as ColBERT achieve strong effectiveness by representing each document with many token-level vectors, but this expressivity leads to large indexing cost, storage footprints and expensive MaxSim scoring. We show that late-interaction representations exhibit an intrinsic low-rank structure: document token embeddings concentrate in a low-dimensional subspace that preserves most of the retrieval signal. Leveraging this observation, we introduce EigenLI, a spectral approximation framework that compresses late-interaction representations via document-specific low-dimensional subspaces. Unlike clustering or pooling methods, EigenLI identifies the dominant eigendirections of each document and uses them to construct reduced interaction representations. Empirically, $k$-EigenLI with $k \le 32$ outperforms k-means and Ward clustering based pooling methods on ColBERTv2 and AnswerAI-ColBERT-small; GTE-ModernColBERT exhib

item.title: SeisBench DAS通过对DAS数据集和模型进行标准化，搭建了模型开发者与数据分析师之间的桥梁，推动了深度学习在分布式声学传感数据处理中的广泛应用。
item.description:
SeisBench DAS：一个面向分布式声学传感的机器学习框架

SeisBench DAS: A machine learning framework for Distributed Acoustic Sensing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07558

SeisBench DAS通过对DAS数据集和模型进行标准化，搭建了模型开发者与数据分析师之间的桥梁，推动了深度学习在分布式声学传感数据处理中的广泛应用。

光纤传感技术，如分布式声学传感（DAS），已成为地球物理研究中广泛应用的技术。为处理DAS产生的大规模数据集，已有多种机器学习方法被提出。然而，由于缺乏数据和模型的标准化，这些方法缺乏可比性和互操作性。这在模型开发者与分析DAS数据的实践者之间造成了鸿沟，并阻碍了深度学习在DAS领域的应用。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了SeisBench DAS，这是地震学机器学习库SeisBench的一个扩展。SeisBench DAS为DAS基准数据集定义了标准格式，包括标准化的元数据和标签，以及DAS模型的标准。它基于xdas框架实现数据读取和虚拟阵列处理，并基于PyTorch实现机器学习模型的读取和应用。重要的是，SeisBench提供了一个可高效应用深度学习模型的引擎。

arXiv:2609.07558v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fibre optic sensing, such as distributed acoustic sensing (DAS), has become a widespread technology for geophysical studies. To process the large-scale datasets produced by DAS, several machine learning methods have been proposed. However, without standardization of data and models, these methods lack comparability and interoperability. This introduces a gap between model developers and practitioners analyzing DAS data and inhibits adoption of deep learning for DAS. To address these limitations, here we present SeisBench DAS, an extension to the SeisBench library for machine learning in seismology. SeisBench DAS defines standard formats for DAS benchmark datasets, including standardised metadata and labels, and DAS models. It builds on the xdas framework for data ingestion and virtual array handling, and on PyTorch for reading and applying the machine learning models. Importantly, SeisBench provides an engine to efficiently apply deep

item.title: 提出热核纹理（HKTex），一种以各向异性热核作为测地高斯的内在纹理表示方法，可直接在三角网格表面进行优化，彻底消除UV展开带来的空间浪费、接缝、畸变、顶点重复和分辨率不一致等问题，并显著降低内存占用。
item.description:
热核纹理：不会溅射的测地高斯

Heat Kernel Textures: the Geodesic Gaussians That Do Not Splat

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07557

提出热核纹理（HKTex），一种以各向异性热核作为测地高斯的内在纹理表示方法，可直接在三角网格表面进行优化，彻底消除UV展开带来的空间浪费、接缝、畸变、顶点重复和分辨率不一致等问题，并显著降低内存占用。

三维高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting）近来彻底革新了新视角合成以及许多其他三维视觉方法和应用。受这种表示方法的启发，我们重新思考纹理表示，以克服UV映射的主要问题，同时大幅降低其内存占用。热核纹理消除了UV展开，以及UV映射长期存在的一系列问题，包括UV空间浪费、接缝、畸变、顶点重复和分辨率不一致。HKTex立足于离散黎曼几何，内在地定义在任何被离散化为三角网格的流形曲面上，使用各向异性热核作为高斯的测地等价物。与核函数本身一样，其位置的优化和自适应致密化策略也被重新定义为在待纹理化物体的表面上直接操作。这种新表示还与基于物理的渲染器完全集成，并且可以对其进行优化

arXiv:2609.07557v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently revolutionised novel view synthesis as well as many other 3D vision methods and applications. Drawing inspiration from this representation, we now rethink textures to overcome the main issues of UV mapping while considerably lowering their memory footprint. Heat Kernel Textures (HKTex) eliminate UV unwrapping as well as their persistent issues of wasted UV space, seams, distortions, vertex-duplication, and varying resolution. Grounded in discrete Riemannian geometry and intrinsically defined on any manifold surface discretised as a triangular mesh, HKTex uses anisotropic heat kernels as geodesic equivalents to Gaussians. Like our kernels, also the optimisation of their position and the adaptive densification strategies were redefined to operate on the surface of the object to be textureised. Our novel representation is also fully integrated with a physically based renderer and can be optimised either

item.title: 该论文提出CoRL框架，将自适应间接提示注入攻防建模为非对称、部分可观测的马尔可夫博弈，通过攻击者SFT、双边Co-PPO协同进化和防御者SFT三个阶段实现攻防双方的共同进化，从而训练出能够抵御不断变化攻击策略的鲁棒防御能力。
item.description:
CoRL：面向自适应间接提示注入攻防的协同进化强化学习

CoRL: Co-Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Indirect Prompt-Injection Attacks and Defenses

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07529

该论文提出CoRL框架，将自适应间接提示注入攻防建模为非对称、部分可观测的马尔可夫博弈，通过攻击者SFT、双边Co-PPO协同进化和防御者SFT三个阶段实现攻防双方的共同进化，从而训练出能够抵御不断变化攻击策略的鲁棒防御能力。

工具增强型语言智能体容易受到间接提示注入（IPI）攻击。与直接提示注入不同，间接提示注入将对抗性指令隐藏在不可信的工具输出中，能够隐蔽地改变合法任务的执行过程。基于固定攻击训练的防御方法可能在攻击者改变其策略、注入位置和载荷时失效。为解决这一问题，我们将自适应间接提示注入建模为一个非对称的、部分可观测的、一般和马尔可夫博弈：多轮攻击者依据公开轨迹在已到达的工具返回位置自适应调整载荷，而使用工具的防御者则必须阻断被注入的恶意目标并完成用户任务。我们提出了CoRL，一个以验证器为基础的协同进化与修复框架，包含三个阶段：攻击者SFT从成功轨迹中初始化多轮攻击；双边Co-PPO通过角色特定的奖励和历史对手种群对攻防双方智能体进行联合训练；防御者SFT则巩固经过验证的防御策略（摘要在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2609.07529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-augmented language agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI). Unlike direct prompt injection, IPI hides adversarial instructions in untrusted tool outputs and can covertly alter the execution of a legitimate task. Defenses trained on fixed attacks may fail as an attacker changes its strategy, injection site, and payload. To address this problem, we formulate adaptive IPI as an asymmetric, partially observable, general-sum Markov game: a multi-turn attacker adapts payloads at reached tool-return sites from the public trajectory, while a tool-using defender must block the injected objective and complete the user task. We propose CoRL, a verifier-grounded co-evolution and repair framework with three stages: Attacker SFT initializes multi-turn attacks from successful trajectories; bilateral Co-PPO jointly trains both agents with role-specific rewards and historical opponent populations; and Defender SFT consolidates verif

item.title: 本研究比较了统计与机器学习方法对集合天气预报进行后处理及空间插值的效果，并提出了一种海拔感知线性池化（ALP）方法，在无观测地点的温度预报上相比标准线性池化取得了小幅但显著的改进。
item.description:
基于统计方法与机器学习方法的集合天气预报后处理空间插值比较

Statistical versus machine learning-based spatial interpolation of post-processed ensemble weather forecasts

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07512

本研究比较了统计与机器学习方法对集合天气预报进行后处理及空间插值的效果，并提出了一种海拔感知线性池化（ALP）方法，在无观测地点的温度预报上相比标准线性池化取得了小幅但显著的改进。

统计后处理能够改进集合天气预报，但在没有观测数据的地点生成校准预测仍然具有挑战性。本研究比较了统计方法和基于机器学习的方法，用于对德国境内有观测站点和无观测站点的ECMWF 2米温度和10米风速预报进行后处理。我们在有限预测因子和扩展预测因子两种设置下，考察了基于EMOS的方法、分布回归网络、Transformer以及图神经网络。对于温度，我们还研究了线性预报组合，并提出了一种海拔感知线性池化（ALP）方法。结果表明，在大多数设置下，后处理均优于原始集合预报，但没有单一方法能在所有变量、站点组和评估指标上都表现最佳。所提出的ALP方法在无观测地点相比标准线性池化带来了小幅但显著的改进。

arXiv:2609.07512v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Statistical post-processing improves ensemble weather forecasts, but generating calibrated predictions at locations without observations remains challenging. This study compares statistical and machine-learning-based methods for post-processing ECMWF 2-m temperature and 10-m wind speed forecasts at observed and unobserved stations in Germany. We consider EMOS-based approaches, distributional regression networks, Transformers, and graph neural networks under both limited and extended predictor settings. For temperature, we also investigate linear forecast combinations and propose an altitude-aware linear pool (ALP). The results show that post-processing improves upon the raw ensemble in most settings, but no single method performs best across all variables, station groups, and evaluation metrics. The proposed ALP provides a small but significant improvement over the standard linear pool at unobserved locations.

item.title: 本文提出了超视野矢量化地图生成这一新问题，并首次提出BeyondFormer模型，能够基于车辆视野内的矢量化地图生成视野之外合理的地图延续，同时构建了首个专门针对该任务的数据集。
item.description:
超越车辆视野的矢量化地图生成

Generation of Vectorized Maps Beyond Vehicle View

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07511

本文提出了超视野矢量化地图生成这一新问题，并首次提出BeyondFormer模型，能够基于车辆视野内的矢量化地图生成视野之外合理的地图延续，同时构建了首个专门针对该任务的数据集。

自动驾驶依赖于高精地图来实现安全导航。传统的高精地图构建方式在硬件、数据和人力资源方面成本高昂，加之其更新方面的局限性，阻碍了可扩展性。近期的研究工作提出了基于车载传感器的在线矢量化高精地图构建的替代方案。然而，传感器的视野是有限的，重建的车辆前方地图范围不足以支持安全的规划。本文旨在通过提出一种新颖的超视野矢量化地图生成问题来解决这一局限性：给定车辆感知区域（视野内）的矢量化地图，生成合理的地图延续部分。为了通过实验评估其可行性，我们提出了BeyondFormer，据我们所知，这是首个面向超视野地图生成设计的工作。鉴于该问题的新颖性，我们生成了首个专门为此设计的数据集并进行了评估。

arXiv:2609.07511v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Autonomous driving relies on High Definition (HD) maps for safe navigation. Traditional HD maps construction is costly in hardware, data and human resources, which together with its update limitations hinders scalability. Recent works have proposed online alternatives for HD vectorized mapping from onboard sensors. However, sensor field of view is limited, and the range of the reconstructed maps ahead of the vehicle is insufficient for safe planning. This paper aims to address this limitation by proposing the novel beyond-view vectorized map generation problem: given vectorized maps of the area sensed by the vehicle (in-view), to generate plausible map continuations. To experimentally assess its feasibility, we propose BeyondFormer, which, to the best of out knowledge, is the first work designed towards beyond-view map generation. Given the novelty of the problem, we generate the first dataset specifically designed for it and evaluate

item.title: 该论文提出了一种逐类维度选择与模型聚合框架，为多元时间序列分类中的每个类别独立筛选信息丰富的维度并进行专门学习后再融合预测，从而提升判别性特征表示质量与分类性能，尤其在高维场景中效果突出。
item.description:
通过逐类训练与模型聚合改进多元时间序列分类

Improving Multivariate Time Series Classification with Class-Wise Training and Model Aggregation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07493

该论文提出了一种逐类维度选择与模型聚合框架，为多元时间序列分类中的每个类别独立筛选信息丰富的维度并进行专门学习后再融合预测，从而提升判别性特征表示质量与分类性能，尤其在高维场景中效果突出。

本文提出了一种用于多元时间序列分类（MTSC）的逐类维度（通道）选择框架。与采用单一全局维度选择过程不同，所提出的方法为每个类别独立识别信息丰富的维度，随后为每个类别执行专门的学习过程，最后通过融合阶段得到最终预测结果。该方法旨在提升判别性特征表示的生成质量，同时降低噪声或无信息维度的影响。该框架使用MiniRocket（一种基于随机核的基线方法）进行评估。实验结果表明，逐类维度选择提高了所提取表示的质量，并能增强分类性能，尤其在高维场景下效果显著。这些发现表明，将类别特定信息融入训练过程具有积极意义。

arXiv:2609.07493v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we propose a class-wise dimension (channel) selection framework for Multivariate Time Series Classification (MTSC). Rather than applying a single global dimension selection process, the proposed approach independently identifies informative dimensions for each class. A dedicated learning process is subsequently performed for each class, followed by a fusion stage for final prediction. The objective is to improve the generation of discriminative feature representations while reducing the influence of noisy or non-informative dimensions. The proposed framework is evaluated using MiniRocket, a random kernel-based baseline method. Experimental results indicate that class-wise dimension selection improves the quality of extracted representations and can enhance classification performance, particularly in high-dimensional settings. item.title: 该论文提出TCIRL框架，通过联合学习控制策略与基于假设确定性有限自动机的时序因果推断来推断隐藏的相变原因，并证明了其几乎必然收敛到真实原因语言从而获得最优策略。
item.description:
基于自动机学习的强化学习时序因果推断

Temporal-Causal Inference for Reinforcement Learning via Automata Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07461

该论文提出TCIRL框架，通过联合学习控制策略与基于假设确定性有限自动机的时序因果推断来推断隐藏的相变原因，并证明了其几乎必然收敛到真实原因语言从而获得最优策略。

我们研究动态会经历由隐藏时间模式所控制的不可逆相变的环境中的强化学习问题。智能体能够观测到基础状态，但无法直接观测到所处阶段。我们将该问题形式化为一个两阶段非马尔可夫决策过程，并提出时序因果强化学习框架，该框架能够同时学习控制策略并推断相变的隐藏时间原因。TCIRL 维护一个假设的确定性有限自动机来跟踪当前处于哪个阶段，并通过基于反例驱动的 SAT 合成方法对其进行细化。我们证明了该假设自动机在所有可获得的标签序列上几乎必然收敛到一个能够识别真实原因语言的确定性有限自动机，从而为原始的非马尔可夫决策过程产生最优策略。在基因治疗网格世界和交通信号环境上的实验表明，TCIRL 能够恢复……

arXiv:2609.07461v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider reinforcement learning in environments with dynamics that undergo an irreversible phase transition governed by a hidden temporal pattern. The agent observes the base state but cannot observe the phase directly. We formalize this problem as a two-phase non-Markovian decision process and introduce Temporal-Causal Inference for Reinforcement Learning (TCIRL), a framework that jointly learns a control policy and infers the hidden temporal cause of the phase transition. TCIRL maintains a hypothesis deterministic finite automaton (DFA) to track what phase is active and refines it via counterexample-driven SAT-based synthesis. We prove that the hypothesis converges almost surely to a DFA recognizing the true cause language on all attainable label sequences, yielding an optimal policy for the original non-Markovian decision process. item.title: 该论文提出一种基于潜空间到潜空间流匹配的医学体积随机分割方法，利用图像和标签空间的编码表示，在放射治疗勾画不确定性和多器官分割任务上实现了比全分辨率模型最高14倍的效率提升。
item.description:
面向体积随机分割的潜空间到潜空间流方法

Latent-to-Latent Flow for Volumetric Stochastic Segmentation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07460

该论文提出一种基于潜空间到潜空间流匹配的医学体积随机分割方法，利用图像和标签空间的编码表示，在放射治疗勾画不确定性和多器官分割任务上实现了比全分辨率模型最高14倍的效率提升。

医学图像分割中由观察者间差异引起的不确定性在制定治疗计划中起着重要作用。该领域的研究受到大规模医学数据集缺乏多重标注的阻碍，尤其是体积数据，还面临额外的缩放和计算复杂性挑战。流匹配已成为一种强大的生成建模框架，并且已被证明在处理图像的潜在表示时仍能保持强大的性能。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种潜空间到潜空间的流技术，通过对图像空间和标签空间进行编码表示，实现医学体积的随机分割。我们在两个具有挑战性的应用上评估了我们的方法，包括放射治疗计划中的勾画不确定性和多器官结构分割，与全分辨率模型相比，效率提升了高达14倍，同时保持了分割性能。

arXiv:2609.07460v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Uncertainty arising from inter-observer variability in medical image segmentation plays an important role in developing treatment plans. Research in this area is inhibited by the lack of multiple annotations for large-scale medical datasets, especially for volumetric data, which suffers from additional scaling and computational complexity challenges. Flow matching has emerged as a powerful framework for generative modelling and has also been demonstrated to maintain strong performance when working with latent representations of images. In this work, we introduce a latent-to-latent flow technique for stochastic segmentation of medical volumes via encoded representations of both the image and label space. item.title: 通过对图神经网络进行微小修改以融入经典平均场启发式方法（主特征向量法与能量腔/最小和算法），可显著提升其在求解伊辛模型基态及组合优化问题上的性能。
item.description:
图神经网络与能量腔方法用于组合优化

Graph neural networks and the energetic cavity method for combinatorial optimization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07456

通过对图神经网络进行微小修改以融入经典平均场启发式方法（主特征向量法与能量腔/最小和算法），可显著提升其在求解伊辛模型基态及组合优化问题上的性能。

我们研究了使用图神经网络（GNN）来寻找伊辛模型近似基态的问题。高效地找到这些基态具有广泛的重要意义，因为通过适当选择耦合和场，许多组合优化问题都可以被表述为伊辛模型。精确求解这些问题非常困难，但已有许多优秀的启发式方法。这些启发式方法中的一类建立在平均场近似之上：其中一种方法使用适当定义矩阵的主特征向量，另一种是最小和算法，也称为能量腔方法。未经修改的GNN在这两种方法面前表现更差。我们考虑对GNN进行微小的修改以融入这些启发式方法，发现这能显著提升性能。尽管修改后的方法与其他深度学习方法相比具有竞争力，我们仍然发现模拟退火方法至少能够可靠地保持……

arXiv:2609.07456v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the use of graph neural networks (GNNs) for finding approximate ground states of Ising models. Efficiently finding these ground states is of broad significance because many combinatorial optimization problems can be formulated as an Ising model with the appropriate choice of couplings and fields. Exactly solving these problems is hard but there are many good heuristic methods. A lineage of these heuristics build from mean-field approximations: one approach uses the leading eigenvector of an appropriately defined matrix, another is the min-sum algorithm, also known as the energetic cavity method. Without modification, GNNs perform worse than both of these methods. We consider small modifications to the GNN to incorporate these heuristics and find that this considerably improves performance. item.title: 提出一种轻量级联邦MIL-VLM级联方法，仅在客户端训练紧凑的MIL评分器并利用冻结VLM事后验证可疑片段，其中基于logit的无解析器接口相比文本生成验证能更稳定地提升弱监督视频异常检测性能。

面向联邦弱监督视频异常检测的无解析器VLM验证

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07455

提出一种轻量级联邦MIL-VLM级联方法，仅在客户端训练紧凑的MIL评分器并利用冻结VLM事后验证可疑片段，其中基于logit的无解析器接口相比文本生成验证能更稳定地提升弱监督视频异常检测性能。

当监控数据仍然处于分布式、弱标注且资源受限的状态时，视觉语言模型（VLM）如何助力视频异常检测（VAD）？大多数弱监督VAD方法假设集中式训练；而近期基于VLM的扩展方法则进一步依赖密集推理、生成的解释或额外的适配训练。我们提出了一种轻量级的联邦MIL-VLM级联架构，其中仅在客户端之间训练一个紧凑的MIL评分器，而冻结的VLM则在事后对高分可疑片段进行验证。我们研究了两种VLM反馈接口：解析文本生成决策的接口，以及从下一个token的Yes/No概率中提取连续异常分数的基于logit的接口。在UCF-Crime数据集上使用InternVL3.5-2B和Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct进行的实验表明，文本生成验证在经过诊断性时序后处理后可以提升帧级AUC，但对提示词、解析器、模型选择和平滑处理仍然敏感。相比之下（摘要在此处截断）……

arXiv:2609.07455v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: How can vision-language models help video anomaly detection (VAD) when surveillance data remain distributed, weakly labeled, and resource-constrained? Most weakly supervised VAD methods assume centralized training; recent VLM-based extensions further rely on dense inference, generated explanations, or additional adaptation. We introduce a lightweight federated MIL-VLM cascade in which only a compact MIL scorer is trained across clients, while a frozen VLM verifies high-scoring suspect segments post hoc. We study two VLM feedback interfaces: parsed text-generation decisions and a logit-based interface that extracts a continuous anomaly score from next-token Yes/No probabilities. Experiments on UCF-Crime with InternVL3.5-2B and Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct show that text-generation verification can improve frame-level AUC after diagnostic temporal post-processing, but remains sensitive to prompts, parsers, model choice, and smoothing. item.title: 本文提出了TASTE，一种基于贝叶斯优化的批量大小调优方法，用于在边缘设备上训练深度学习模型时最大化硬件吞吐量，并发现存在吞吐量上限，超过该上限后增大批量大小不再带来额外收益。
item.description:
TASTE：面向设备端边缘学习的吞吐量感知批量大小调优

TASTE: Throughput-Aware Batch Size Tuning for On-Device Edge Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07444

本文提出了TASTE，一种基于贝叶斯优化的批量大小调优方法，用于在边缘设备上训练深度学习模型时最大化硬件吞吐量，并发现存在吞吐量上限，超过该上限后增大批量大小不再带来额外收益。

随着隐私保护人工智能（AI）的兴起，模型适应与个性化的重心转向了设备端学习，即利用本地用户数据直接在边缘硬件上对深度学习模型进行微调。然而，这一转变需要在资源受限的硬件上优化深度学习训练，以在保持预测准确性的同时最大化吞吐量。本文提出了一种新颖的设备端模型训练技术，该技术采用高效的基于贝叶斯优化的批量大小调优方法来最大化硬件吞吐量。为了评估这一超参数对学习动态的影响，我们研究了两种不同的范式：标准监督学习（SL）和在线持续学习（CL）。在多种边缘设备上的实验结果表明存在一个吞吐量上限，超过该上限后，增加批量大小将不再带来额外的吞吐量增益。

arXiv:2609.07444v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rise of privacy-preserving artificial intelligence (AI) has shifted the focus of model adaptation and personalization towards on-device learning, where deep learning models are finetuned directly on edge hardware using local user data. However, this shift requires optimization of deep learning training on resource-constrained hardware to maximize throughput while maintaining predictive accuracy. This paper introduces a novel technique for on-device model training that incorporates an efficient Bayesian optimization-based batch size tuning approach to maximize hardware throughput. To evaluate the impact of this hyperparameter on the learning dynamics, we investigated two distinct paradigms: standard supervised learning (SL) and online continual learning (CL). item.title: TabBench-Bio是一个涵盖43个生物医学数据集的动态基准测试，系统评估了经典方法、神经网络和表格基础模型在高维小样本场景下的表现，发现表格基础模型总体领先，其中RealTabPFN v2.5表现最佳。
item.description:
TabBench-Bio：面向高维生物医学表格机器学习的动态基准测试

TabBench-Bio: A Living Benchmark for Machine Learning on High-Dimensional Biomedical Tables

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07441

TabBench-Bio是一个涵盖43个生物医学数据集的动态基准测试，系统评估了经典方法、神经网络和表格基础模型在高维小样本场景下的表现，发现表格基础模型总体领先，其中RealTabPFN v2.5表现最佳。

生物医学表格通常将数千个测量变量与仅有数十或数百个标记样本结合在一起，这种数据情形在通用表格基准测试中很少被涵盖。我们提出了TabBench-Bio，一个包含43个跨多个领域生物医学数据集的动态交互式基准测试。在统一的交叉验证协议下，我们在28个特征-样本工作点上比较了经典估计器、神经网络和表格基础模型。在10,000个特征和100个训练样本的参考设置下，RealTabPFN v2.5具有最高的点估计值，其次是逻辑回归和TabDPT，后两者的点估计值几乎相同。对目标池进行配对自助法分析显示，RealTabPFN v2.5领先逻辑回归145 Elo（95%区间为[59, 232]）。表格基础模型总体上占据领先排名，而最强的配置取决于具体的工作点和生物医学模态。

arXiv:2609.07441v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Biomedical tables often combine thousands of measured variables with only tens or hundreds of labelled samples, a regime that is poorly represented in general-purpose tabular benchmarks. We introduce TabBench-Bio, a living and interactive benchmark of 43 biomedical datasets spanning multiple domains. Under a shared cross-validation protocol, we compare classical estimators, neural networks, and tabular foundation models across 28 feature-by-sample operating points. At the reference cell of 10,000 features and 100 training samples, RealTabPFN v2.5 has the highest point estimate, followed by Logistic Regression and TabDPT, whose point estimates are nearly identical. A paired bootstrap over the target pool separates RealTabPFN v2.5 from Logistic Regression by 145 Elo (95% interval [59, 232]). item.title: 该论文通过从简单线性泊松方程到强不连续高超音速流动的广泛系统性实验，首次系统分析了物理信息PDE求解器中自动微分与基于离散化约束两种范式的各自适用性。

物理信息偏微分方程求解器中自动微分与基于离散化约束的系统性分析

A Systematic Analysis of Automatic Differentiation versus Discretization-based Constraints for Physics-Informed PDE Solvers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07437

该论文通过从简单线性泊松方程到强不连续高超音速流动的广泛系统性实验，首次系统分析了物理信息PDE求解器中自动微分与基于离散化约束两种范式的各自适用性。

物理信息神经网络（PINNs）代表了利用人工智能求解偏微分方程（PDEs）的一个新兴前沿领域。自动微分（AD）在这一范式中扮演着核心角色，它无需网格，用连续空间中基于梯度的优化取代了传统的迭代求解器。然而，自动微分的固有局限性，特别是在处理高阶导数和不连续解方面，给复杂问题带来了重大挑战。这促使越来越多的研究者探索基于离散化的约束作为替代路径。然而，这两种范式各自的适用性在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们在广泛的问题范围内进行了系统性实验，涵盖从简单的线性泊松方程到具有强不连续性的高马赫数高超音速流动。通过对近似、优化等环节的严格分解……

arXiv:2609.07437v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) represent a growing frontier in using artificial intelligence to solve partial differential equations (PDEs). Automatic differentiation (AD) plays a central role in this paradigm, which is mesh-free and replaces traditional iterative solvers with gradient-based optimization in continuous space. However, the inherent limitations of AD, particularly in handling higher-order derivatives and discontinuous solutions, pose significant challenges for complex problems. This has motivated a growing number of researchers to explore discretization-based constraints as an alternative path. Yet, the respective applicability of these two paradigms remains largely unexplored. In this work, we conduct systematic experiments across a wide spectrum of problems, from simple linear Poisson to high-Mach hypersonic flows with strong discontinuities. item.title: 提出反向核聚合算法，通过迭代移除数据点构建代表子集，在加速子采样的同时达到与最先进方法相当的效果，并扩展核稀疏化方法使其能够构建任意大小的子集。
item.description:
重新审视核学习问题中的稀疏化方法

Revisiting Thinning Methods for Kernel Learning Problems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07432

提出反向核聚合算法，通过迭代移除数据点构建代表子集，在加速子采样的同时达到与最先进方法相当的效果，并扩展核稀疏化方法使其能够构建任意大小的子集。

核方法因其强大的理论保证和优异的实证性能而被广泛应用。然而，其高昂的计算成本限制了其在大规模数据集上的适用性。为解决这一缺陷，若干方法使用最大均值差异来构建代表性子集，以便在再生核希尔伯特空间中保留完整数据集的性质。我们提出了反向核聚合，这是一种通过从数据集中迭代移除数据点来解决该问题的算法，在缩减规模小于数据集一半的现实场景中，能够加速子采样过程，同时取得与当前最先进方法相当的结果。此外，我们提出了一种扩展方法，克服了核稀疏化的一个限制，使算法能够构建任意大小的子集，而不再局限于逐次减半的方式。最后，我们进行了大量的实验……

arXiv:2609.07432v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Kernel methods are widely used because of their strong theoretical guarantees and empirical performance. However, their high computational cost limits their applicability to large-scale datasets. To address this shortcoming, several approaches use Maximum Mean Discrepancy to construct representative subsets that preserve the properties of the full dataset in a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space. We introduce Backward Kernel Herding, an algorithm that addresses this problem by iteratively removing points from the dataset, achieving results comparable to current state-of-the-art approaches while accelerating the subsampling process in realistic scenarios where the reduced size is less than half of the dataset. Moreover, we overcome a limitation of Kernel Thinning by proposing an extension that enables the construction of subsets of arbitrary size rather that restricting to successive halvings. item.title: 该论文提出了一种基于分布式隐私的电子反对抗框架，通过开发两种认知隐藏算法，在对抗监视下遮蔽认知雷达的战略决策过程并提供正式的隐私保证。
item.description:
对抗监视下认知雷达的认知遮蔽：一种分布式隐私框架

Masking Radar Cognition under Adversarial Surveillance: A Distributional Privacy Framework

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07428

该论文提出了一种基于分布式隐私的电子反对抗框架，通过开发两种认知隐藏算法，在对抗监视下遮蔽认知雷达的战略决策过程并提供正式的隐私保证。

本文提出了一种在线电子反对抗（ECCM）框架，旨在遮蔽运行于对抗性监视环境下的认知雷达（CR）的战略决策过程。我们在两种不同的决策范式下对认知雷达进行建模：静态约束效用最大化行为和动态期望效用最大化行为。雷达的效用函数通过von Mises–Fisher（vMF）分布进行建模，其分布参数构成了需要防止被对手推断的私有信息。我们采用分布式隐私框架来隐藏这一私有信息，并为认知遮蔽提供正式的分布式隐私保证。在这项工作中，我们分别为静态约束效用最大化（WDPCH-SU）和动态期望效用最大化（WDPCH-DU）开发了认知隐藏算法。通过严格的数学分析，我们证明了两者的……

该论文提出RelightFormer，一种基于视频基础模型改编的前馈生成式Transformer，通过潜在光照模块和置换不变位置编码实现无需显式逆渲染的单视图与多视图图像重照明，并构建了包含9万物体和3.9万种光照的大规模LOD数据集支撑训练。

图像重照明传统上通过复杂的逆渲染管线来解决，这类方法存在不适定优化问题；或者采用单图像生成模型，但这类模型忽略了理解3D几何和材质交互所需的关键多视角线索。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种前馈生成式Transformer，可直接进行单视图和多视图图像重照明，完全绕过显式的内在属性估计。我们的架构改编自视频基础模型，其特征在于一个潜在光照模块，通过交叉注意力将目标环境贴图动态注入空间特征。此外，我们采用置换不变的位置编码，对称地处理无序的多视图输入而不产生顺序偏差。为训练这一鲁棒的数据驱动模型，我们构建了大规模的Laval Objaverse数据集（LOD），包含9万个物体和3.9万种独特光照。大量实验……（原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.07414v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Image relighting is traditionally tackled via complex inverse rendering pipelines, which suffer from ill-posed optimization, or single-image generative models that ignore crucial multi-view cues necessary for understanding 3D geometry and material interactions. To address these limitations, we introduce a feed-forward generative Transformer for direct single- and multi-view image relighting that entirely bypasses explicit intrinsic property estimation. Adapted from a video foundation model, our architecture features a latent illumination module that dynamically injects target environment maps into spatial features via cross-attention. Furthermore, we employ permutation-invariant positional encodings to symmetrically process unordered multi-view inputs without sequential bias. 形变细胞术是一种成像流式细胞术，它使用配备相机的设备在高通量条件下测量细胞刚度以及其他细胞特性。面积和伸长率等细胞特性可用于识别细胞类型，但这需要预先了解区分性特征，且无法应用于临床上重要的细胞聚集体。利用DC数据，我们评估了传统的多类别分类方法，并提出了一种多标签方法来识别血细胞及其聚集体。具体而言，ML分类器可以同时为单个成像事件分配多个细胞类型标签。我们表明，与多类别分类不同，多标签分类能够识别训练数据中未出现过的细胞聚集体。它还避免了使用详尽、严格定义的聚集体标签的需要，从而简化并加快了标注过程。由于自动血液分析仪...（摘要不完整）

arXiv:2609.07410v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deformability cytometry (DC) is a type of imaging flow cytometry, which uses a camera-equipped device to measure cellular stiffness in addition to other cellular properties at high throughput. Cellular properties such as area and elongation can identify cell types, but this requires prior knowledge of distinguishing properties and cannot be applied to clinically important cell aggregates. Using DC data, we evaluated conventional multi-class (MC) classification and introduced a multi-label (ML) approach for identifying blood cells and their aggregates. In particular, an ML classifier can simultaneously assign multiple cell-type labels to a single imaged event. We show that, unlike MC classification, ML classification can identify cell aggregates not represented in the training data. 近期多模态语音情感识别（SER）系统通过交互密集的跨模态Transformer实现了高精度，但其高昂的计算成本限制了在延迟敏感且资源受限的监控系统中的部署。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了RAFM_SER++，这是一种轻量级的多模态SER框架，其核心特点是采用非对称残差注意力融合机制（RAFM）。RAFM不依赖计算开销高昂的双向交互，而是通过单向残差注意力通路将语音中的情感线索注入语义文本表示中。结合受BYOL启发的跨模态对齐目标和注意力引导池化，所提出的框架在保持低计算开销的同时改善了多模态表示学习。在IEMOCAP和ESD基准数据集上的实验表明，RAFM_SER++始终优于HuBERT-Base基线，并取得了……

arXiv:2609.07409v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent multimodal Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) systems achieve high accuracy through interaction-heavy cross-modal transformers, but their computational cost limits deployment in latency-sensitive and resource-constrained surveillance systems. To address this challenge, we propose RAFM_SER++, a lightweight multimodal SER framework featuring an asymmetric Residual Attention Fusion Mechanism (RAFM). Rather than relying on computationally expensive bidirectional interactions, RAFM injects affective speech cues into semantic text representations through a one-directional residual attention pathway. Combined with a BYOL-inspired cross-modal alignment objective and attention-guided pooling, the proposed framework improves multimodal representation learning while maintaining low computational overhead. https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07408

本研究系统评估了多种机器学习模型在帕金森病分类任务中的表现，发现增大训练数据集会增加模型内存占用和预测延迟，而Canny边缘检测结合Hessian滤波的预处理方法反而会降低模型分类性能。

本研究使用机器学习模型将个体分类为健康或帕金森病高风险人群，重点研究数据集规模和预处理技术对模型性能的影响。研究从原始数据集创建了四个数据集：DS_0（普通数据集）、DS_1（对DS_0进行Canny边缘检测和Hessian滤波处理）、DS_2（增强的DS_0）和DS_3（增强的DS_1）。研究者在这些数据集上评估了一系列机器学习模型——逻辑回归（LR）、决策树（DT）、随机森林（RF）、梯度提升（GB）、XGBoost、朴素贝叶斯（NB）、支持向量机（SVM）和AdaBoost（AdB），并分析了预测准确率、模型大小和预测延迟。结果表明，虽然更大的数据集会导致模型内存占用和预测延迟增加，但采用Canny边缘检测并辅以Hessian滤波的预处理（应用于DS_1和DS_3）会降低模型性能。

Four datasets are created from an original dataset: DS_0, (normal dataset), DS_1 (DS_O subjected to Canny edge detection and Hessian filtering), DS_2 (augmented DS_0), and DS_3 (augmented DS_1). We evaluate a range of ML models-Logistic Regression (LR), Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), Gradient Boosting (GB), XGBoost (XBG), Naive Bayes (NB), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and AdaBoost (AdB)-on these datasets, analyzing prediction accuracy, model size, and prediction latency. item.title: 提出WIDER——一种即插即用的轻量级谱正则化方法，通过惩罚潜在状态向共享主导方向的投影来缓解隐式思维链推理中的潜在秩坍缩问题，使潜在状态扩展到更广泛的表示子空间并提升推理多样性。
item.description:
拓宽思考：缓解隐式思维链推理中的潜在秩坍缩问题

Think Wider: Mitigating Latent Rank Collapse in Implicit Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07406

提出WIDER——一种即插即用的轻量级谱正则化方法，通过惩罚潜在状态向共享主导方向的投影来缓解隐式思维链推理中的潜在秩坍缩问题，使潜在状态扩展到更广泛的表示子空间并提升推理多样性。

链式思维推理通过引入中间计算提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但显式的推理过程会增加解码长度、延迟和上下文成本。隐式CoT通过将中间推理迁移到连续潜在状态中，提供了一种更高效的替代方案。然而，潜在推理可能不稳定：连续的潜在状态可能变得过于相似，并向一个共享的主导方向坍缩，从而降低推理轨迹的多样性。在本工作中，我们识别了“潜在秩坍缩”现象，并提出了WIDER——一种面向隐式CoT的轻量级谱正则化方法。在训练过程中，WIDER估计每个潜在轨迹的共享方向，并惩罚向该方向的投影，鼓励潜在状态跨越更广泛的表示子空间。该方法是即插即用的，不改变骨干模型、潜在调度和推理时的解码过程（原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.07406v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves the reasoning ability of large language models by introducing intermediate computation, but explicit rationales increase decoding length, latency, and context cost. Implicit CoT offers a more efficient alternative by moving intermediate reasoning into continuous latent states. However, latent reasoning can be unstable: successive latent states may become overly similar and collapse toward a shared dominant direction, reducing the diversity of the reasoning trajectory. In this work, we identify $\textit{latent rank collapse}$ and propose $\textbf{WIDER}$, a lightweight spectral regularizer for implicit CoT. During training, WIDER estimates the shared direction of each latent trajectory and penalizes projections onto this direction, encouraging latent states to span a broader representational subspace. arXiv:2609.07403v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Privacy-sensitive surveillance systems could benefit from large vision-language models (VLMs), but such models typically require centralized access to raw video. 乘积酉流形上多人量子博弈的黎曼优化

Riemannian Optimization for Multi-Player Quantum Games on Product Unitary Manifolds

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07397

本文提出了面向混合策略多人量子博弈的扩展EWL（EEWL）框架，并引入酉策略矩阵指数算法，通过在乘积酉流形上进行黎曼优化来求解多人量子博弈的均衡问题。

量子博弈论是经典博弈论的扩展，它将量子原理应用于博弈论之中。Eisert-Wilkens-Lewenstein（EWL）量子博弈是将双人经典囚徒困境转化为量子囚徒困境的早期典型例子。在EWL博弈中，参与者选择由酉矩阵表示的纯量子策略。这种扩展可以通过实现具有更高收益的合作均衡来解决经典困境。在本文中，我们首先讨论了面向具有混合策略的多人量子博弈的扩展EWL（EEWL）框架。在EEWL中，每个参与者控制一组酉算子作为量子动作，并对这些动作使用经典混合策略。收益被定义为作用于共享量子态的厄米特奖励算子的期望值，该量子态根据EEWL协议生成并测量。随后，我们提出了酉策略矩阵指数算法

arXiv:2609.07397v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum game theory is an extension of classical game theory that uses quantum principles in game theory. The Eisert-Wilkens-Lewenstein (EWL) quantum game is an early example of the two-player classical Prisoner's Dilemma transformed into a quantum Prisoner's Dilemma. In the EWL game, the players choose pure quantum strategies represented by unitary matrices. This extension can resolve the classical dilemma by enabling cooperative equilibrium with higher payoff. In this paper, we first discuss the Extended EWL (EEWL) for multiplayer quantum games with mixed strategies. In EEWL, each player controls a set of unitary operators as quantum actions and uses a classical mixed strategy over these actions. The payoffs are defined as expectation values of Hermitian reward operators acting on a shared quantum state, which is generated and measured according to the EEWL protocol. arXiv:2609.07381v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Distributed Lag Neural Additive Models (DLNAMs), neural-additive analogues of Distributed Lag Non-linear Models (DLNMs) for learning nonlinear effects distributed over lags. DLNAMs replace a prespecified spline cross-basis with neural components that learn exposure--lag response surfaces, avoiding choices of basis family, dimension, and knot placement while preserving additive interpretability and familiar distributed-lag summaries. Exp-centered input layers, smooth activations, and learned subnetwork mixtures produce smooth, locally adaptive representations; pointwise uncertainty combines a conditional last-layer Laplace approximation with between-member ensemble variation. 仅利用城市已有的聚合区域计数数据，通过不确定性感知的物理信息框架即可准确推断未来的出发地-目的地流量，无需追踪个体轨迹，在保护隐私的同时达到与依赖历史OD矩阵的模型相当的精度。

实时城市治理不仅需要知道人们在哪里，还需要了解人们如何在地点之间移动——这种方向性流动传统上需要通过在空间中追踪个体来解析，这种方式维护成本高昂，且建立在高度独特、极易被重新识别的轨迹数据之上。本研究表明，这种方向性结构无需被直接观测即可获知：城市已经在收集的聚合计数数据保留了足够的信息，可用于重建出发地-目的地（OD）矩阵的时间演化。利用一个具有不确定性感知的物理信息框架，我们仅从区域级别的计数数据中推断未来的OD流量，并在来自美国和中国城市的十二个出行数据集上进行了验证，其准确性可与以历史OD矩阵为输入的模型相媲美。概率建模纠正了对稀疏、高价值通道的系统性低估，并产生了与观测数据相符的校准预测。

arXiv:2609.07349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Real-time urban governance depends not only on knowing where people are, but on how they move between places, directional flows that could be conventionally resolved by tracking individuals through space, i.e., expensive to sustain and built on traces that are highly unique and readily re-identifiable. Here we show that this directional structure need not be observed to be known: aggregated counts which cities already collect retain enough information to reconstruct the temporal evolution of origin-destination (OD) matrix. Using an uncertainty-aware physics-informed framework, we infer future OD flows from area-level counts alone across twelve mobility datasets from cities in the United States and China, reaching accuracy comparable to models that take historical OD matrices as input. item.description:
面向长上下文的基于内容寻址方法

Content-Based Addressing for Long Context

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07314

提出一种基于内容寻址的长上下文位置编码方法，将 token 流划分为单元、单元内保留 RoPE 并为每个完成的单元按内容计算地址，从而在扩展上下文时完全保留局部 RoPE 并使固定 token 间的注意力比较不受其他单元插入或重排的影响。

旋转位置编码使用每个 token 的整数位置来确定注意力内部施加的旋转。这对局部 token 顺序效果良好，但随着上下文长度的增加，会产生位置上的训练-测试不匹配：RoPE 会在训练中未见过的偏移量处产生相对旋转。那些对位置进行重缩放、插值、随机化或加偏置的方法规定了注意力如何处理这些偏移量，但仍然从不断增长的 token 计数器中获取位置信息。我们转而将 token 流划分为单元，在每个单元内保留普通的 RoPE 位置，并为每个已完成的单元分配一个由其内容计算得出的地址。这样，添加单元时只需将同一个学习到的映射应用于新内容，而无需扩展位置范围或标识符表。我们证明该构造能够完全保留局部 RoPE，当其他单元被插入或重排时，两个固定 token 之间的注意力比较保持不变，并且……（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2609.07314v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Rotary position embedding (RoPE) uses each token's integer position to determine the rotation applied inside attention. This works well for local token order, but increasing context length creates a positional train-test mismatch: RoPE produces relative rotations at offsets not seen during training. We instead divide a token stream into units, retain ordinary RoPE positions within each unit, and assign every completed unit an address computed from its content. Adding units then applies the same learned map to new content rather than extending a positional range or an identifier table. item.description:
基于预测约束邻域协作的鲁棒去中心化个性化联邦学习

Robust Decentralized Personalized Federated Learning via Prediction-Constrained Neighborhood Collaboration

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07312

该论文提出R-DPFL方法，通过对比邻域聚合更新与基于历史的预测更新之间的差异并进行自适应裁剪，使诚实客户端在拜占庭攻击下无需邻居共识即可保持稳定的个性化联邦学习动态。

本文提出了一种鲁棒的去中心化个性化联邦学习方法R-DPFL，使客户端能够通过鲁棒的邻域方向估计和基于历史的更新趋势预测来降低拜占庭攻击的影响，而不是像现有工作那样纯粹地聚合客户端模型。在R-DPFL中，每个客户端首先通过聚合接收到的邻域更新向量来计算当前轮次的模型更新；然后，基于历史值和本地模型变化预测该更新应有的值；最后，R-DPFL计算这两个量之间的差异，自适应地对差异进行裁剪，并将其添加到本地更新中。我们通过严格的理论分析证明了学习过程的收敛性，并表明诚实客户端在拜占庭邻居扰动下能够保持稳定的个性化下降动态，而无需邻居模型之间达成共识。在CIFAR-10上的大量实验验证了该方法的有效性。

arXiv:2609.07312v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper proposes a robust decentralized personalized federated learning method R-DPFL, that enables clients to reduce the impact of Byzantine attacks via robust neighborhood direction estimation and history-based update trend prediction, rather than purely aggregating client models as in the existing work. In R-DPFL, each client first computes the current-round model update by aggregating the received neighborhood update vectors. It then predicts what this update should be based on its historical values and local model changes. Finally, R-DPFL computes the difference between these two quantities, adaptively clips this difference, and adds it to the local update. We prove convergence of the learning process through rigorous analysis and show that honest clients maintain stable personalized descent dynamics under Byzantine neighbor perturbations without requiring consensus among neighboring models. item.description:
基于渐进点匹配的长时程语言模型强化学习

Long-Horizon Language Model Reinforcement Learning via Progressive Point Matching

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07303

该论文提出“渐进点匹配”——一种简单无偏的片段级密集奖励方法，仅需每个任务一条参考轨迹即可实现，使强化学习在稀疏奖励完全失效的长时程任务（如极难数学推理）上获得指数级效率提升。

arXiv:2609.07303v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：当前通过强化学习训练语言模型的范式严重依赖稀疏的结果奖励。然而，当我们追求需要更长、更复杂轨迹的任务时，这类策略会导致学习速度缓慢。先前的工作尝试通过奖励部分进展来解决这一问题，但朴素的奖励设计往往存在偏差，并会收敛到次优策略。我们提出了一种简单且无偏的密集奖励方法，称之为渐进点匹配，该方法通过在片段级别奖励部分进展，在理论上和经验上（通过合成环境验证）均能以指数级更高的效率扩展到长时程任务。随后我们展示了如何利用每个任务仅需一条参考轨迹来实际实现渐进点匹配。在极其困难的数学推理问题上，稀疏结果奖励无法取得任何进展，而片段级奖励则能在更大的……

arXiv:2609.07303v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Current paradigms for training language models via reinforcement learning rely heavily on sparse outcome rewards. However, as we pursue tasks that require longer and more complicated trajectories, such strategies result in slow learning. Prior work has attempted to address this problem by rewarding partial progress; however, naive formulations are often biased and converge to suboptimal policies. We show that a simple and unbiased dense reward formulation, which we term progressive point matching, scales exponentially more efficiently to long-horizon tasks by rewarding partial progress on a segment level, both theoretically and empirically via synthetic environments. We then show how progressive point matching can be practically instantiated using a single reference trajectory per task. item.title: 提出PCFlow框架，通过基于麦克斯韦方程的密集物理条件场引导条件流匹配，实现快速且兼具视觉真实性与物理一致性的探地雷达B扫描图像合成。
item.description:
PCFlow：面向探地雷达B扫描图像合成的物理条件流匹配方法

PCFlow: Physics-Conditioned Flow Matching for GPR B-Scan Image Synthesis

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07300

提出PCFlow框架，通过基于麦克斯韦方程的密集物理条件场引导条件流匹配，实现快速且兼具视觉真实性与物理一致性的探地雷达B扫描图像合成。

探地雷达（GPR）B扫描图像合成对于数据增强、算法验证和仿真加速至关重要，然而生成既具有视觉真实性又具备物理一致性的雷达图仍然具有挑战性。现有的基于学习的生成模型往往侧重于视觉外观，但对响应几何形状的控制能力有限。在本文中，我们提出了PCFlow，一个用于快速GPR B扫描图像合成的物理条件流匹配框架。PCFlow的核心是由电磁仿真所使用的参数化物理模型构建的麦克斯韦信息密集物理条件场，包括材料属性、目标几何、传播线索和响应域先验。该条件场提供了物理场景参数与雷达响应几何之间的可解释接口，并引导VAE潜在空间中的条件流匹配朝向物理可行的生成方向进行。

arXiv:2609.07300v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ground-penetrating radar (GPR) B-scan image synthesis is important for data augmentation, algorithm validation, and simulation acceleration, yet generating radargrams with both visual realism and physical consistency remains challenging. Existing learning-based generative models often emphasize visual appearance but provide limited control over response geometry. In this paper, we propose PCFlow, a physics-conditioned flow matching framework for fast GPR B-scan image synthesis. The core of PCFlow is a Maxwell-informed dense physical condition field constructed from the parameterized physical model used for electromagnetic simulation, including material properties, target geometry, propagation cues, and response-domain priors. item.title: 本文提出一种本构状态空间（CSS）模型，通过将应变增量分解为方向与幅值并嵌入结构化状态空间动力学，实现了路径依赖塑性建模中对应变路径分辨率的一致性，同时保留并行扫描结构以支持长本构历史的高效训练。
item.description:
路径依赖塑性的本构状态空间建模：一种分辨率一致且可并行化的计算框架

Constitutive State-Space Modeling of Path-Dependent Plasticity: A Resolution-Consistent and Parallelizable Computational Framework

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07294

本文提出一种本构状态空间（CSS）模型，通过将应变增量分解为方向与幅值并嵌入结构化状态空间动力学，实现了路径依赖塑性建模中对应变路径分辨率的一致性，同时保留并行扫描结构以支持长本构历史的高效训练。

针对路径依赖塑性的数据驱动本构模型通常采用非线性循环神经网络来构建，其顺序状态演化限制了并行训练，且预测结果可能依赖于所施加应变路径的离散化方式。我们提出了一种本构状态空间（CSS）模型，将结构化状态空间动力学重新表述为增量本构算子。应变增量被分解为幅值和方向两部分：加载方向驱动潜在状态空间系统，而增量幅值则进入其连续时间线性递推的零阶保持离散化。这种为力学特性量身定制的构造保证了零增量下的平稳性，显著降低了对应变路径分辨率的敏感性，并保留了S5的并行扫描结构，从而能够在长本构历史序列上进行高效训练。CSS和最小状态单元（MSC）架构……

arXiv:2609.07294v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data-driven constitutive models for path-dependent plasticity are commonly formulated using nonlinear recurrent neural networks, whose sequential state evolution limits parallel training and whose predictions may depend on the discretization of the applied strain path. We introduce a Constitutive State Space (CSS) model that reformulates structured state-space dynamics as an incremental constitutive operator. The strain increment is decomposed into magnitude and direction: the loading direction drives the latent state-space system, while the increment magnitude enters the zero-order-hold discretization of its continuous-time linear recurrence. item.description:
面向模型感知紧凑语义检索的俄罗斯套娃哈希表示

Matryoshka Hash Representations for Model-Aware Compact Semantic Retrieval

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07276

该论文提出俄罗斯套娃式哈希表示，使同一个压缩编码的各长度前缀均可直接检索，从而让检索系统无需重新编码语料库就能灵活地在不同字节预算下切换效率与质量的权衡点。

检索增强生成（RAG）依赖于稠密检索：每篇文档被存储为一个学习到的向量，查询通过在该向量空间中寻找最近邻来得到回答。在语料库规模下，为每篇文档保存一个全精度向量是索引的主要开销，因此检索系统将每个向量替换为几字节的短编码——这一步称为量化。标准的量化器（如乘积量化 PQ）会选择最能重构原始向量的编码。如果一个编码能同时服务多个字节预算，它将更加有用：当它的各个短前缀均可直接检索时，部署方无需重新编码整个语料库即可设定效率与质量的工作点。但在单一目标下训练所有前缀，会使得前面的比特成为多个预算之间的折中——短编码性能提升的同时，全宽编码的性能却会下降。量化到低位表示（如二进制编码），进一步……

arXiv:2609.07276v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) depends on dense retrieval: each document is stored as a learned vector, and a query is answered by finding its nearest neighbors in that vector space. Keeping one full-precision vector per document is the dominant index cost at corpus scale, so retrieval systems replace each vector with a short code of a few bytes---a step called quantization. Standard quantizers such as product quantization (PQ) pick the code that reconstructs the original vector most closely. A single code is even more useful if it serves several byte budgets at once: when its short prefixes are each directly searchable, a deployment can set its efficiency--quality operating point without re-encoding the corpus. But training all prefixes under one objective makes the early bits a compromise across budgets---short codes improve while the full-width code degrades. item.title: 提出GaugeLasso方法，通过规范校正的加性对称组套索通道惩罚，在训练中将Transformer的冗余通道驱动至零并物理移除，同时保持张量稠密性和网络功能，从而降低推理计算成本与能耗。
item.description:
通过规范校正的通道移除实现Transformer的稠密结构压缩

Dense Structural Compression of Transformers via Gauge-Correct Channel Removal

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07264

提出GaugeLasso方法，通过规范校正的加性对称组套索通道惩罚，在训练中将Transformer的冗余通道驱动至零并物理移除，同时保持张量稠密性和网络功能，从而降低推理计算成本与能耗。

每个token的推理能耗决定了已部署Transformer模型的运行成本与碳足迹，该能耗主要由稠密矩阵乘法产生，涉及融合乘加（FMA）运算和内存流量。为了在保留稠密张量以获得高GPU吞吐量的同时减少这些计算，我们从第一性原理出发开发了一套方法，在训练过程中调整结构复杂度，以最大化单位计算量下的推理效用。通道惩罚会将整个张量切片驱动至零，从而实现物理移除，同时保持张量的稠密性和网络功能。自然而直接的方法——对作用于每个通道的算子分量的范数施加惩罚——被证明会因规范自由度而不稳定。我们通过GaugeLasso解决了这一病态问题：一种加性对称的组套索（group-lasso）惩罚，当网络收敛至规范平衡时，能够恢复乘积范数的单调函数。我们的均衡分析使得逐通道校准能够正确地……

arXiv:2609.07264v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inference energy per token drives the cost and carbon footprint of deployed transformers. It is dominated by dense matrix products that incur fused multiply-accumulate (FMA) operations and memory traffic. To reduce these computations while retaining dense tensors for high GPU throughput, we develop a methodology from first principles to adapt structural complexity during training to maximize inference utility per unit compute. Channel penalties drive entire tensor slices to zero to enable physical removal while preserving density and the network function. The natural approach, penalizing the norm of operator components acting through each channel, is provably destabilized by gauge freedom. We resolve this pathology with GaugeLasso: additive symmetric group-lasso penalties that recover a monotone function of product-norms when the network converges to gauge balance. item.title: 本文证明了Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理对于多元不连续且无界函数在隐藏层受到对抗性重参数化时依然保持稳定，为KAN等现代深度学习架构的结构鲁棒性奠定了严格的数学基础。
item.description:
不连续函数的Kolmogorov-Arnold稳定性

Kolmogorov--Arnold stability for discontinuous functions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07240

本文证明了Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理对于多元不连续且无界函数在隐藏层受到对抗性重参数化时依然保持稳定，为KAN等现代深度学习架构的结构鲁棒性奠定了严格的数学基础。

我们研究了Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理（KART）在多元不连续且无界函数情形下，当隐藏层受到对抗性重参数化时的稳定性。我们的结果为现代深度学习架构（如Kolmogorov-Arnold网络，KANs）在对抗性配置下的结构鲁棒性提供了严格的数学基础。

arXiv:2609.07240v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Here we investigate the stability of the Kolmogorov--Arnold representation theorem (KART) under adversarial reparameterisations of the hidden layer for multivariate discontinuous and unbounded functions. Our results provide a rigorous mathematical foundation for the structural robustness of modern deep learning architectures, such as Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs), under adversarial configurations.

item.title: 本文提出CONA训练方法，通过在训练过程中在线动态串联切换最佳并行策略，而非离线固定单一策略，使大型语言模型达到目标验证困惑度的时间缩短1.8-11.4倍。
item.description:
面向快速训练收敛的并行策略链式方法

Parallelism Strategy Chaining for Fast Training Convergence

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07236

本文提出CONA训练方法，通过在训练过程中在线动态串联切换最佳并行策略，而非离线固定单一策略，使大型语言模型达到目标验证困惑度的时间缩短1.8-11.4倍。

选择并行策略——即数据并行、张量并行和流水线并行度以及微批次和全局批次大小的组合配置——在很大程度上决定了大型语言模型的训练效率。最先进的方法在离线阶段搜索并行策略，并选择使每次迭代时间最小的单一策略。但我们发现这些方法忽略了目标验证困惑度以及达到该困惑度所需的时间（Time-to-Perplexity，TTP）。特别是，我们的分析揭示，能够带来最快困惑度下降的最佳策略在训练过程中会多次变化。因此，最先进的方法在TTP上比在每次迭代都选择最佳策略的策略序列慢1.8-11.4倍。本文提出了CONA，一种引入在线策略链式方法的新训练技术。CONA不再使用离线选择的单一策略，而是在训练过程中使用由替代指标构建的方法对候选策略进行排序（摘要内容在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2609.07236v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Selecting a parallelism strategy - the configuration of data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism degrees together with micro- and global-batch sizes - largely determines the training efficiency of large language models. State-of-the-art methods search for a parallelism strategy offline and select the single strategy that minimizes per-iteration time. But we find that they neglect the target validation perplexity and time-to-perplexity (TTP). In particular, our analysis reveals that the best strategy yielding the fastest perplexity improvement changes multiple times during training. As a result, state-of-the-art methods are 1.8-11.4x slower in TTP than the strategy sequence that selects the best strategy at each iteration. This paper proposes CONA, a new training method that introduces online strategy chaining. Instead of a single strategy selected offline, CONA ranks candidate strategies during training using a surrogate metric built fro

item.title: 本文提出一种基于多模态知识协作的鲁棒去中心化联邦蒸馏方法，通过对类别预测、边界决策和预测相关性三种模态的评估、过滤不可靠客户端、并利用私有数据的监督梯度验证蒸馏梯度来抵御拜占庭攻击，同时证明了方法的收敛性。
item.description:
基于多模态知识协作的鲁棒去中心化联邦蒸馏

Robust Decentralized Federated Distillation via Multi-Modality Knowledge Collaboration

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07230

本文提出一种基于多模态知识协作的鲁棒去中心化联邦蒸馏方法，通过对类别预测、边界决策和预测相关性三种模态的评估、过滤不可靠客户端、并利用私有数据的监督梯度验证蒸馏梯度来抵御拜占庭攻击，同时证明了方法的收敛性。

本文提出一种鲁棒的去中心化联邦蒸馏方法，使具有异构模型的客户端能够通过在共享的无标签公共数据上的预测进行协作。在所提出的方法中，每个客户端首先从类别预测、边界决策和预测相关性三种模态评估接收到的预测，然后过滤掉不可靠的客户端，为保留的客户端分配基于可靠性的权重，并为每种类型的知识构建一个教师模型。最后，使用由私有数据计算得到的监督梯度对相应的蒸馏梯度进行验证：冲突的预测梯度和边界梯度被移除，冲突的关系梯度在最终模型更新前被抑制。我们通过证明诚实客户端在拜占庭蒸馏下能够实现稳定的局部优化，证明了所提方法的收敛性。特别地，我们展示了我们的方法能确保有界的...（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.07230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper propose a robust decentralized federated distillation method that enables clients with heterogeneous models to collaborate through predictions on shared unlabeled public data. In the proposed method, each client first evaluates the received predictions in three modalities of class prediction, boundary decision, and prediction correlation. It then filters unreliable clients, assigns reliability-based weights to the retained clients, and constructs a teacher for each type of knowledge. Finally, the corresponding distillation gradients are validated using a supervised gradient computed from private data. Conflicting prediction and boundary gradients are removed, and conflicting relation gradients are suppressed before the final model update. We prove the convergence of the proposed method by showing stable local optimization for honest clients under Byzantine distillation. Particularly, we show that our method ensures a bounded B

item.title: 本文通过将源分离模型扩展为多输入多输出（MIMO）配置，提出了一种兼具混合一致性与迭代预测能力的通用音频分离框架。
item.description:
通过MIMO模型扩展实现具有混合一致性的迭代音频分离

Iterative Audio Separation with Mixture Consistency via MIMO Model Extension

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07226

本文通过将源分离模型扩展为多输入多输出（MIMO）配置，提出了一种兼具混合一致性与迭代预测能力的通用音频分离框架。

本文提出了一种通用框架，通过将源分离模型扩展为多输入多输出（MIMO）配置，实现稳定且有效的、具有混合一致性的迭代音频分离。在音频分离领域，混合一致性是许多需要目标源精确相位和音色信息的应用所必备的重要特性。虽然扩散模型等迭代方法在语音增强或用户引导的目标源分离任务中能取得感知上更优的结果，但由于混合一致的音频分离通常被视为具有唯一解的回归问题，大多数现有方法侧重于通过架构改进实现单步分离，采用单输入单输出（SISO）或单输入多输出（SIMO）配置。通过将这些架构扩展为MIMO配置，我们在不损害混合一致性的前提下引入了迭代预测能力。

arXiv:2609.07226v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper proposes a general framework for stable and effective iterative audio separation with mixture consistency by extending source separation models to a multi-input multi-output (MIMO) configuration. In the field of audio separation, mixture consistency is an essential property for many applications that require accurate phase and timbral information of target sources. While iterative approaches such as diffusion models achieve perceptually superior results in speech enhancement or user-guided target source separation tasks, most existing methods focus on single-step separation with a single-input single-output (SISO) or single-input multi-output (SIMO) configuration through architectural improvements, since mixture-consistent audio separation is generally regarded as a regression problem that admits a unique solution. By extending these architectures to a MIMO configuration, we introduce iterative prediction without compromisin

item.title: REFINE借鉴反馈控制理论，将路网感知的生成式重建与反馈驱动的对比学习进行闭环耦合，实现了无需人工数据增强的高质量轨迹表示学习，并具有理论收敛保证。
item.description:
REFINE：基于闭环转录的轨迹表示学习（扩展版）

REFINE: Trajectory Representation Learning via Closed-Loop Transcription -- Extended Version

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07206

REFINE借鉴反馈控制理论，将路网感知的生成式重建与反馈驱动的对比学习进行闭环耦合，实现了无需人工数据增强的高质量轨迹表示学习，并具有理论收敛保证。

轨迹表示学习是众多轨迹分析任务的基础；然而，现有的大多数自监督方法，无论是判别式还是生成式，都采用开环范式，依赖于固定的数据增强或无反馈的随机掩码，这限制了它们的泛化和扩展能力。我们提出了REFINE，一个简单而有效的基于闭环转录精炼的轨迹数据表示学习框架。借鉴反馈控制理论，REFINE将路网感知的生成式重建与反馈驱动的对比学习紧密耦合，使模型无需人工设计的增强视图即可捕获细粒度的局部移动语义和全局时空依赖关系。我们进一步提供了控制理论分析，为所提出的闭环优化建立了收敛性保证。在四个真实世界数据集上进行了大量实验（摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.07206v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Trajectory representation learning underpins a wide range of trajectory analytics tasks; however, most existing self-supervised approaches, whether discriminative or generative, adopt an open-loop paradigm, relying on fixed data augmentations or random masking without feedback, which limits their ability to generalize and scale. We propose REFINE, a simple yet effective Representation lEarning Framework vIa closed-loop traNscription rEfinement for trajectory data. Drawing upon feedback control theory, REFINE tightly couples road-network-aware generative reconstruction with feedback-driven contrastive learning, enabling the model to capture fine-grained local movement semantics and global spatio-temporal dependencies without manually designed augmentation views. We further provide a control-theoretic analysis that establishes convergence guarantees for the proposed closed-loop optimization. Extensive experiments on four real-world d

item.title: 该论文发现基于特征的硬件木马检测性能严重依赖测试集划分协议——当测试门电路来自训练中已见过的宿主电路时性能被高估，而按宿主家族留出时 F1/AP 会从约 0.91/0.98 骤降至约 0.46/0.58。
item.description:
测试协议设置对跨 Trust-Hub 家族基于特征的硬件木马检测的影响

Protocol effects on feature-based hardware-Trojan detection across Trust-Hub families

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07199

该论文发现基于特征的硬件木马检测性能严重依赖测试集划分协议——当测试门电路来自训练中已见过的宿主电路时性能被高估，而按宿主家族留出时 F1/AP 会从约 0.91/0.98 骤降至约 0.46/0.58。

Trust-Hub 复用宿主电路：多个文件之间的主要区别仅在于插入的木马。当同一家族兄弟变体的门电路同时进入训练集和测试集时，检测器可以从已经见过的宿主逻辑中获益。我们测量的是这种效应，而不是提出又一种分类器。语料库包含来自 16 个网表的 49,124 个门电路，分为五个宿主家族。我们保持解析器、36 个门级特征、类别权重、模型设置、阈值和家族级聚合方式不变，仅改变一个选择：测试集边界。三种设置分别从合并语料库中抽取测试门电路、留出一个完整网表、或留出一个宿主的所有变体。这一选择至关重要：随机森林在合并门电路下 F1/AP 为 0.914/0.978，留出一个完整网表时降至 0.636/0.851，留出一个宿主家族时仅为 0.460/0.577；在同样对比下，XGBoost 从 0.946/0.976 下降到 0.464/0.544；逻辑回归损失了 AP，尽管其固定阈值……

arXiv:2609.07199v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Trust-Hub reuses host circuits: several files differ mainly in the inserted Trojan. When gates from sibling variants enter both training and test folds, a detector can benefit from host logic it has already seen. We measure that effect instead of proposing another classifier. The corpus contains 49,124 gates from 16 netlists grouped into five host families. We left the parser, 36 gate features, class weighting, model settings, threshold, and family-level aggregation unchanged and altered one choice: the test boundary. The three settings draw test gates from the pooled corpus, withhold a complete netlist, or withhold every variant of one host. The choice matters. Random forest records F1/AP of 0.914/0.978 with pooled gates, 0.636/0.851 with one netlist held out, and 0.460/0.577 with a host family held out. XGBoost falls from 0.946/0.976 to 0.464/0.544 across the same comparison. Logistic regression loses AP, although its fixed-threshold

item.title: 提出FedRAW，一种完全服务器端的异步联邦学习聚合方法，通过同时解决参与偏差和聚合偏差，防止持有稀有标签的客户端对全局模型的贡献被静默削弱。
item.description:
FedRAW：在异步联邦学习中保留稀有标签的影响力

FedRAW: Preserving Rare-Label Influence in Asynchronous Federated Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07192

提出FedRAW，一种完全服务器端的异步联邦学习聚合方法，通过同时解决参与偏差和聚合偏差，防止持有稀有标签的客户端对全局模型的贡献被静默削弱。

异步联邦学习通过在客户端更新到达时从服务器端缓冲区更新全局模型，而无需等待所有被选中的客户端完成，从而提高了可扩展性。虽然高效，但这种到达驱动的聚合方式在异构参与下可能会悄无声息地扭曲表示学习。我们识别出“静默稀有性失效”这一隐藏的失效模式：持有稀有标签的客户端对全局模型的贡献过于微弱，即使模型的整体准确率看起来基本未受影响。这种失效源于两个耦合效应：稀有标签客户端可能因速度较慢或可用性较低而更少地提交更新，造成参与偏差；并且一旦它们的更新进入缓冲区，标准的异步聚合不会赋予它们任何补偿性的影响力，造成聚合偏差。我们提出了FedRAW，一种完全在服务器端运行的聚合方法，它在不改变本地（原文在此处截断）……

arXiv:2609.07192v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Asynchronous federated learning improves scalability by updating the global model from a server-side buffer of client updates as they arrive, rather than waiting for all selected clients to finish. While efficient, this arrival-driven aggregation can silently distort representation learning under heterogeneous participation. We identify silent rarity failure, a hidden failure mode in which clients holding rare labels contribute too weakly to the global model even though its overall accuracy appears largely unaffected. This failure arises from two coupled effects: rare-label clients may submit updates less frequently when they are slower or less available, creating participation bias; and once their updates enter the buffer, standard asynchronous aggregation assigns them no compensating influence, creating aggregation bias.
