item.title: 该论文提出一种基于布尔立方体上分层Walsh-Fourier逼近的变分量子分布学习框架，通过逐层热启动训练量子电路Born机器，并证明了逼近误差由被省略的傅里叶质量决定的端到端学习理论保证。
item.description:
变分量子分布学习的分层傅里叶逼近方法

Hierarchical Fourier Approximation for Variational Quantum Distribution Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06307

该论文提出一种基于布尔立方体上分层Walsh-Fourier逼近的变分量子分布学习框架，通过逐层热启动训练量子电路Born机器，并证明了逼近误差由被省略的傅里叶质量决定的端到端学习理论保证。

我们通过布尔立方体上的Walsh-Fourier逼近层级结构来研究变分量子分布学习。在每一层，选定的目标傅里叶系数集合定义了一个谱截断，该谱截断被投影到概率单纯形上，并用作量子电路Born机器的学习目标。在某一层学习到的参数通过热启动映射来初始化下一层的训练。我们证明了一个端到端的期望学习保证，其中逼近误差项由被省略的傅里叶质量决定，同时一个归一化的无偏估计量为经验截断提供了明确的统计界限。随后，我们针对全变差距离实例化了抽象的差异条件，并将由此产生的分布误差与量子态保真度联系起来。在我们的归一化ℓ₂约定下，全变差特化会产生显式因子2^(n-1)，因此仅对足够……（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2609.06307v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study variational quantum distribution learning through a hierarchy of Walsh--Fourier approximations on the Boolean cube. At each level, a selected set of target Fourier coefficients defines a spectral truncation, which is projected onto the probability simplex and used as the target of a quantum circuit Born machine. Parameters learned at one level initialize the next through a warm-start map. We prove an end-to-end expected learning guarantee where the approximation term is determined by the omitted Fourier mass, while a normalized unbiased estimator yields an explicit statistical bound for empirical truncations. We then instantiate the abstract discrepancy conditions for total variation distance and relate the resulting distributional error to quantum-state fidelity. item.title: 该论文提出利用历史数据中丰富的多结果测量信息，通过因果表示学习将高维协变量降维到保留处理效应异质性的低维表示，从而在实验样本有限的情况下实现更高效的CATE估计。
item.description:
通过利用多个结果实现样本高效CATE估计的表示学习

Representation Learning for Sample-Efficient CATE Estimation by Leveraging Multiple Outcomes

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06294

该论文提出利用历史数据中丰富的多结果测量信息，通过因果表示学习将高维协变量降维到保留处理效应异质性的低维表示，从而在实验样本有限的情况下实现更高效的CATE估计。

估计条件平均处理效应（CATE）能够实现对干预措施的高效目标定位，但许多应用的实验样本有限，使得从高维协变量中估计异质性效应变得困难。在这种情况下，政策制定者和医疗从业者往往陷入维度灾难，或使用可能无法保留处理异质性的现成降维方法。然而，这些领域通常拥有大量测量了广泛结果的历史数据集——这是一个在实践中很少被利用的监督信号来源。遵循因果表示学习的思路，我们假设这类具有高维协变量的领域存在低维的底层动态。因此，我们可以利用历史数据中测量的多样化结果来学习协变量的低维表示。在理论方面，我们证明了当辅助结果...

arXiv:2609.06294v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Estimating conditional average treatment effects (CATE) enables efficient targeting of interventions, but many applications have limited experimental samples, making it difficult to estimate heterogeneous effects from high-dimensional covariates. In such settings, policymakers and medical practitioners often succumb to the curse of dimensionality or apply off-the-shelf dimension reduction methods that may not preserve treatment heterogeneity. Yet these domains often come with large historical datasets measuring a wide range of outcomes -- a source of supervision that is rarely exploited in practice. Following causal representation learning, we hypothesize that such domains with high-dimensional covariates have lower-dimensional underlying dynamics. We can thus leverage the diverse outcomes measured in historical data to learn a lower-dimensional representation of the covariates. Theoretically, we prove that when the auxiliary outcomes sa

item.title: 该研究基于施瓦茨基本人类价值理论构建了包含26K样本、覆盖20种人类价值的基准，首次系统验证了大语言模型转向向量的潜在几何结构能够反映人类价值的理论规定结构。
item.description:
转向几何：在大语言模型转向空间中验证人类价值几何结构

Steering Geometry: Validating Human Value Geometry in LLM Steering Space

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06289

该研究基于施瓦茨基本人类价值理论构建了包含26K样本、覆盖20种人类价值的基准，首次系统验证了大语言模型转向向量的潜在几何结构能够反映人类价值的理论规定结构。

随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署在对齐敏感的场景中，激活转向已成为一种轻量级的推理时行为控制方法，可作为微调方法（如RLHF、DPO）的替代方案。然而，现有工作通常在孤立的行为上验证转向效果，这使得转向向量究竟是编码了连贯的语义结构，还是仅仅利用了特定行为的捷径，仍不清楚。我们研究了LLM转向向量的潜在几何结构是否反映了人类价值与道德领域中被理论所规定的结构。以施瓦茨基本人类价值理论作为我们的主要细粒度框架，我们引入了一个包含26K样本、覆盖20种人类价值的基准，并在多种模型家族和规模上分析了分布驱动方法（如CAA、SphericalSteer、ODESteer）和以行为为中心的方法（如COLD-Steer、BiPO）。我们发现分布驱动方法能够恢复人类价值……（原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.06289v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in alignment-sensitive contexts, activation steering has emerged as a lightweight, inference-time alternative to fine-tuning methods (e.g., RLHF, DPO) for behavioral control. However, existing work typically validates steering on isolated behaviors, leaving it unclear whether steering vectors encode coherent semantic structure or merely exploit behavior-specific shortcuts. We investigate whether the latent geometry of LLM steering vectors reflects theory-specified structure in human values and morality. Using Schwartz's Theory of Basic Human Values as our primary fine-grained framework, we introduce a 26K-sample benchmark covering 20 human values and analyze distribution-driven methods (e.g., CAA, SphericalSteer, ODESteer) and behavior-centric approaches (e.g., COLD-Steer, BiPO) across diverse model families and sizes. item.title: 本文提出鲁棒条件多维标度（rcMDS），通过用Fair M-估计目标替代平方应力准则，并设计重加权条件SMACOF算法进行优化，有效解决了异常值对相异性数据条件降维的干扰问题。
item.description:
针对相异性数据的鲁棒条件降维方法

Robust conditional dimension reduction for dissimilarity data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06284

本文提出鲁棒条件多维标度（rcMDS），通过用Fair M-估计目标替代平方应力准则，并设计重加权条件SMACOF算法进行优化，有效解决了异常值对相异性数据条件降维的干扰问题。

条件降维（cDR）在学习低维潜在坐标的同时，考虑代表数据中已知变异来源的观测协变量。条件多维标度（cMDS）是一种直接处理相异性数据的条件降维技术。然而，其标准的平方应力公式对受污染的相异性数据较为敏感，因为异常值可能会主导目标函数并扭曲学习到的配置。我们通过用Fair M-估计目标替代平方应力准则，提出了鲁棒条件多维标度（rcMDS），并开发了一种重加权的条件SMACOF算法来优化该目标。所提出的算法具有计算上可行的更新方式，其稳定后的目标值单调递减并收敛到有限极限。在合成数据和真实数据上的实验表明，该方法在处理受污染数据时表现优异。

arXiv:2609.06284v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Conditional dimension reduction (cDR) learns low-dimensional latent coordinates while accounting for observed covariates that represent known sources of variation in the data. Conditional Multidimensional Scaling (cMDS) is a cDR technique that works directly with dissimilarity data. Its standard squared-stress formulation, however, is sensitive to contaminated dissimilarity, since outliers can dominate the objective and distort the learned configuration. We proposed Robust Conditional Multidimensional Scaling (rcMDS) by replacing the squared-stress criterion with a Fair M-estimation objective. We developed a reweighted conditional SMACOF algorithm to optimize this objective. The proposed algorithm admits computationally tractable updates, and its stabilized objective values decrease monotonically and converge to a finite limit. item.title: 提出SeaCausal-FL联邦模糊因果学习框架，通过区间二型模糊层与物理约束结构因果模型对齐分布式机制，并采用多维度证据加权聚合，实现了海事物联网中船舶发动机的可靠故障诊断与区间反事实推理。
item.description:
SeaCausal-FL：面向海事物联网故障诊断与反事实推理的联邦模糊因果学习

SeaCausal-FL: Federated Fuzzy Causal Learning for Maritime IoT Fault Diagnosis and Counterfactual Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06257

提出SeaCausal-FL联邦模糊因果学习框架，通过区间二型模糊层与物理约束结构因果模型对齐分布式机制，并采用多维度证据加权聚合，实现了海事物联网中船舶发动机的可靠故障诊断与区间反事实推理。

海事物联网中可靠的船舶发动机故障诊断面临分布式数据所有权、异构故障分布以及持续变化的运行条件等挑战。本文提出了SeaCausal-FL，这是一种联邦模糊因果学习框架，它将共享的时间诊断路径与基于机制的因果推理相结合。该框架采用区间二型模糊层来表示不确定且相互重叠的运行机制，同时每个机制都与一个物理约束的结构因果模型相关联。在聚合之前，利用运行上下文、因果结构和条件干预-响应特征对本地学习的机制进行对齐。随后，模型参数根据样本、类别、机制以及机制-类别证据进行聚合，而不仅仅依据客户端样本量。学习到的结构方程还进一步通过溯因、行动和预测支持区间反事实推理。

arXiv:2609.06257v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable marine-engine fault diagnosis in maritime IoT is challenged by distributed data ownership, heterogeneous fault distributions, and continuously changing operating conditions. This paper proposes SeaCausal-FL, a federated fuzzy causal learning framework that combines a shared temporal diagnostic path with mechanism-conditioned causal reasoning. An interval type-2 fuzzy layer represents uncertain and overlapping operating mechanisms, while each mechanism is associated with a physics-constrained structural causal model. Before aggregation, locally learned mechanisms are aligned using operating context, causal structure, and conditional intervention-response signatures. Model parameters are then aggregated according to sample, class, mechanism, and mechanism-class evidence instead of client sample size alone. The learned structural equations further support interval counterfactual reasoning through abduction, action, and prediction.

item.title: 该论文的核心创新是将真实缺陷掩码从传统的仅用于评估转变为分类网络训练的空间监督信号，通过基于激活的注意力对齐损失引导卷积特征图聚焦缺陷区域，并在混合监督框架下结合DDPM扩散增强实现合成图像提供数据量、掩码提供空间精度的互补优势，从而提升缺陷定位能力。

面向缺陷定位的空间注意力监督：在扩散增强缺陷检测中将真实掩码用作训练信号

Spatial Attention Supervision for Defect Localization: Exploiting Ground-Truth Masks as Training Signal in Diffusion-Augmented Defect Detection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06232

该论文的核心创新是将真实缺陷掩码从传统的仅用于评估转变为分类网络训练的空间监督信号，通过基于激活的注意力对齐损失引导卷积特征图聚焦缺陷区域，并在混合监督框架下结合DDPM扩散增强实现合成图像提供数据量、掩码提供空间精度的互补优势，从而提升缺陷定位能力。

工业检测数据集中的真实缺陷掩码通常仅用于评估。本文将这些掩码重新用作分类网络训练过程中的空间监督信号，不仅教会模型预测什么，还教会模型应该关注哪里。该方法添加了一个基于激活的注意力对齐损失，引导卷积特征图聚焦于缺陷区域，并采用混合监督的公式化设计，同时兼容没有掩码的样本，例如扩散生成的图像。结合DDPM数据增强，合成图像贡献了数据数量，而掩码贡献了空间精度。我们在MVTec-AD瓶子基准上评估了85个模型（四个CNN骨干网络在2×2数据/训练因子设计下、五个随机种子，以及一个Swin-V2-T Transformer基线），定位性能在从分类器梯度更新中排除的保留缺陷图像上进行测量。主要发现：（1）注意力引导的训练改善了基于激活的…

arXiv:2609.06232v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ground-truth defect masks in industrial inspection datasets are typically reserved for evaluation. This paper repurposes them as spatial supervision signals during training of classification networks, teaching a model not just what to predict but where to look. The method adds an activation-based attention alignment loss that steers convolutional feature maps toward defect regions, in a mixed-supervision formulation that also accommodates samples without masks, such as diffusion-generated images. Combined with DDPM augmentation, synthetic images contribute quantity while masks contribute spatial precision. We evaluate 85 models (four CNN backbones under a 2x2 data/training factorial over five seeds, plus a Swin-V2-T transformer baseline) on the MVTec-AD bottle benchmark, with localization measured on held-out defect images excluded from classifier gradient updates. item.title: 本文提出并行重启朗之万与朗之万-梯度混合两种新算法，通过随机动力学实现全局探索、梯度流实现局部开发，为光滑非凸函数的全局优化提供了快速的PAC性能保证。
item.description:
基于重启朗之万动力学的快速PAC全局优化：探索、开发与退化冷却

Fast PAC Global Optimization via Restarted Langevin: Exploration, Exploitation, and Degenerate Cooling

本文提出并行重启朗之万与朗之万-梯度混合两种新算法，通过随机动力学实现全局探索、梯度流实现局部开发，为光滑非凸函数的全局优化提供了快速的PAC性能保证。

我们研究光滑（可能非凸）目标函数 $\Gamma:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}$ 的全局优化所需的计算量。如果一个算法的输出 $\widehat X$ 满足 $\mathbb{P}\{\Gamma(\widehat X)-\Gamma^\star>\varepsilon\}\leq\delta$，则称该算法满足 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-PAC 性能要求。算法设计与分析均在连续时间框架下进行。我们将经典的模拟退火和固定温度朗之万扩散与本文引入并分析的两种新方法进行比较：并行重启朗之万方法，以及一种朗之万-梯度混合方案，该方案使用随机动力学进行全局探索，使用梯度流进行局部开发。设 $L=\log(1/\delta)$，$E_*$ 表示主导能垒。在低温区域的对数精度下，前两种方法需要与 $L/\varepsilon$ 呈指数关系的模拟时间。对于并行固定温度朗之万，适当数量的独立……

arXiv:2609.06196v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the computational effort required for global optimization of a smooth, possibly nonconvex objective $\Gamma:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}$. An algorithm satisfies the $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-PAC performance requirement if its output $\widehat X$ obeys $\mathbb{P}\{\Gamma(\widehat X)-\Gamma^\star>\varepsilon\}\leq\delta$. Algorithm design and analysis are in continuous time. We compare classical simulated annealing and fixed-temperature Langevin diffusion with two approaches introduced and analyzed here: parallel-restart Langevin and a Langevin--gradient scheme using stochastic dynamics for global exploration and gradient flow for local exploitation. Let $L=\log(1/\delta)$ and let $E_*$ denote the dominant energy barrier. At logarithmic precision in the low-temperature regime, the first two approaches require simulation time exponential in $L/\varepsilon$. item.title: 本文提出EgoNeMo框架，仅利用自我中心激光雷达点云训练连续的行人动态地图，结合位置平衡采样、多任务学习与视点感知损失，使动态地图能够泛化到未知环境，无需在每个新地点积累轨迹数据。
item.description:
EgoNeMo：基于自我中心激光雷达扫描的可迁移行人动态地图

EgoNeMo: Transferable Map of Pedestrian Dynamics via Egocentric LiDAR Scan

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06195

本文提出EgoNeMo框架，仅利用自我中心激光雷达点云训练连续的行人动态地图，结合位置平衡采样、多任务学习与视点感知损失，使动态地图能够泛化到未知环境，无需在每个新地点积累轨迹数据。

本文提出了一种可迁移的动态地图框架，该框架仅使用自我中心的3D激光雷达点云即可泛化到未知环境，从而克服了传统动态地图方法的长期局限。尽管动态地图对于编码人类运动特征、实现准确的行人轨迹预测或安全的机器人导航至关重要，但传统方法存在特定场所的局限，需要在每个新位置进行详尽的轨迹积累。基于神经隐式建模的最新进展，我们的框架在多样化环境中训练出一个连续的、基于激光雷达的动态地图估计器。为了缓解真实世界轨迹数据固有的稀疏性和时间偏差，我们引入了位置平衡采样策略和多任务学习架构，该架构联合预测运动分布和空间频率分数图。后者进一步通过视点感知损失进行增强，以补偿……

arXiv:2609.06195v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper proposes a transferable Map of Dynamics (MoD) framework that generalizes to unknown environments using only egocentric 3D LiDAR point clouds to overcome the long-standing limitation of traditional MoD methods. While MoDs are essential for encoding human motion characteristics to enable accurate pedestrian trajectory prediction or safe robot navigation, traditional approaches suffer from site-specificity, requiring exhaustive trajectory accumulation at every new location. Extending recent advances in neural implicit modeling, our framework trains a continuous, LiDAR-based MoD estimator across diverse environments. To mitigate the inherent sparsity and temporal bias of real-world trajectory data, we introduce a position-balanced sampling strategy and a multi-task learning architecture that jointly predicts motion distributions and a spatial frequency score map. item.title: 本研究开发了基于线性回归和人工神经网络的风力涡轮机功率预测模型，仅利用天气条件即可预测功率输出以增强模型在不同涡轮机间的适用性，并系统研究了数据预处理技术和数据量对模型性能的影响，从而帮助识别适合安排维护工作的低功率时段。
item.description:
利用机器学习和天气预报预测风力涡轮机功率

Predicting Wind Turbine Power Using Machine Learning and Weather Forecasts

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06194

本研究开发了基于线性回归和人工神经网络的风力涡轮机功率预测模型，仅利用天气条件即可预测功率输出以增强模型在不同涡轮机间的适用性，并系统研究了数据预处理技术和数据量对模型性能的影响，从而帮助识别适合安排维护工作的低功率时段。

海上风力涡轮机被广泛用于生产可再生能源，但其维护工作可能因强制停机而导致效率下降。准确的风力涡轮机功率预测可以识别出低功率时段，这些时段是安排维护工作的理想时间。然而，数据量、特征选择和数据预处理对功率预测模型性能的影响尚未得到深入研究。此外，现有模型在不同风力涡轮机之间的可迁移性有限。因此，本研究开发了一个基线线性回归模型，并与更复杂的人工神经网络模型进行性能比较，仅使用天气条件来预测风力涡轮机的功率输出，以增强模型的适用性。研究考察了多种数据预处理技术，并分别使用一个月和一年的数据训练模型，以确定数据预处理和数据量对模型性能的影响。

arXiv:2609.06194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Offshore wind turbines are widely used to generate renewable energy, but their maintenance can result in decreased efficiency due to forced shutdowns. Accurate wind turbine power predictions can identify periods of low power that would be ideal for scheduling maintenance. However, the effects of data volume, feature selection, and data preprocessing on the performance of such power prediction models have not been thoroughly studied. Besides, current models have limited transferability between different wind turbines. Therefore, this study developed a baseline Linear Regression for performance comparison with a more complex Artificial Neural Network model to predict the power output of a wind turbine, using weather conditions only to enhance applicability. A range of data preprocessing techniques were studied, and models were trained on one month and one year of data to determine the effects of data preprocessing and volume on model perfo

item.title: SolarBench是一个开放的全球性太阳能超短期预报基准，整合了11个站点、跨越十年的超过六百万张天空与卫星图像及配套工具箱，为深度学习太阳能预报模型提供了统一、可复现的评估平台。
item.description:
SolarBench：一个全球太阳能超短期预报基准

SolarBench: A global solar energy nowcasting benchmark

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06187

SolarBench是一个开放的全球性太阳能超短期预报基准，整合了11个站点、跨越十年的超过六百万张天空与卫星图像及配套工具箱，为深度学习太阳能预报模型提供了统一、可复现的评估平台。

随着太阳能发电占比的不断提升，对天气驱动的太阳能变率进行超短期预报，已成为保障能源系统可靠运行的关键。最先进的方法越来越多地将深度学习应用于天空相机和地球静止卫星观测数据，但数据集的碎片化和评估标准的不一致，使得人们难以判断已报告的性能提升能否在不同气候、云况和光伏（PV）系统之间推广。在此，我们提出SolarBench，一个开放的、基于图像的全球太阳能超短期预报基准。SolarBench整合了来自11个多样化站点、跨越十年的超过六百万张天空和卫星图像，并配有辐照度或光伏输出数据以及辅助大气数据。配套的工具箱支持可复现的数据访问、处理、模型开发和评估。利用SolarBench，我们对代表性模型进行了基准测试，揭示了平均预报精度与捕捉快速变化能力之间的差距

arXiv:2609.06187v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As the share of solar power grows, nowcasting weather-driven solar variability becomes critical for reliable energy system operation. State-of-the-art approaches increasingly apply deep learning to sky camera and geostationary satellite observations, but fragmented datasets and inconsistent evaluation make it difficult to determine whether reported improvements generalize across climates, cloud regimes, and photovoltaic (PV) systems. Here we introduce SolarBench, an open global benchmark for image-based solar nowcasting. SolarBench harmonizes more than six million sky and satellite images from 11 diverse sites spanning a decade, together with irradiance or PV output and auxiliary atmospheric data. An accompanying toolbox supports reproducible data access, processing, model development, and evaluation. item.title: 该论文提出谱优先扫除（GTA-PS/SPS），利用图的预解算子与扩散语义来增强优先级信号，解决了非平稳奖励环境下经典优先扫除因残差传播受限而导致的重新规划短视问题。
item.description:
非平稳强化学习中的谱优先扫除

Spectral Prioritized Sweeping in Nonstationary Reinforcement Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06186

该论文提出谱优先扫除（GTA-PS/SPS），利用图的预解算子与扩散语义来增强优先级信号，解决了非平稳奖励环境下经典优先扫除因残差传播受限而导致的重新规划短视问题。

优先扫除通过根据贝尔曼残差大小选择备份操作来加速基于模型的强化学习。然而，在非平稳奖励设置中，经典的优先级评分是短视的：在局部奖励发生偏移后，残差仅通过已执行的备份进行传播，因此在有限的重新规划预算下，处于瓶颈位置或拓扑距离较远的状态估计可能保持不变。我们引入了图拓扑增强框架，利用图的预解算子及其扩散语义来增强被查询的信号。我们的应用，用于优先扫除的图拓扑增强（GTA-PS），或其更为通用的别名谱优先扫除（SPS），为固定动态和变化状态奖励的设置提供了一种即插即用的排序评分。GTA-PS 使用平滑化的策略，诱导出一个转移链，并结合其入拉普拉斯算子和出拉普拉斯算子。标准的优先级键被增强……

arXiv:2609.06186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Prioritized Sweeping (PS) accelerates model-based reinforcement learning by selecting backups according to Bellman residual magnitude. In nonstationary reward settings, however, the canonical priority score is shortsighted: after a localized reward shift, residuals propagate only through realized backups, so bottlenecked or topologically distant state estimates may remain static under a limited replanning budget. We introduce the Graph Topology Augmentation framework, which employ the graph's resolvent and its diffusion semantic, to augment the inquired signal. Our application, Graph Topology Augmentation for Prioritized Sweeping (GTA-PS), or which the alias Spectral Prioritized Sweeping (SPS) might be more universal, provides a drop-in ordering score for the setting of fixed dynamics and changing state rewards. GTA-PS uses a smootherized policy, inducing a transition chain, with its in- and out-Laplacian. The standard priority key is au

item.title: 本文提出了在不对感知矩阵做零空间或受限等距性质等强假设的前提下，基于 ℓ1 最小化和凸优化，从含噪间接观测中恢复稀疏信号线性映像的方法，其风险界可通过高效计算显式凸优化问题得到。
item.description:
从间接观测中恢复稀疏信号的线性映像

Recovering linear images of sparse signals from indirect observations

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06182

本文提出了在不对感知矩阵做零空间或受限等距性质等强假设的前提下，基于 ℓ1 最小化和凸优化，从含噪间接观测中恢复稀疏信号线性映像的方法，其风险界可通过高效计算显式凸优化问题得到。

在本文中，我们开发并分析了从含噪间接观测 $\omega=Ax+\xi$ 中恢复未知信号 $x$ 的线性映像 $Bx$ 的技术。已知先验信息为 $x\in \cX$（一个给定的凸紧集），且 $x$ 是 $s$-稀疏的——即至多含有 $s$ 个非零元素。所提出的估计属于基于 $\ell_1$ 最小化的一大类恢复方法。然而，与描述此类估计性能的经典结果不同，我们不对感知矩阵 $A$ 做任何特殊（且难以验证）的假设，例如零空间条件或受限等距性质（RIP）等。因此，估计的参数及其风险上界无法以封闭解析形式给出，而是通过高效计算作为显式凸优化问题的解来获得。

arXiv:2609.06182v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we develop and analyze techniques for recovering a linear image $Bx$ of an unknown signal $x$ from indirect noisy observation $\omega=Ax+\xi$. It is {\em a priori} known that $x\in \cX$, a given convex compact set, and that $x$ is $s$-sparse---has at most $s$ nonvanishing entries. The proposed estimates belong to a large family of recovery routines by $\ell_1$-minimization. However, unlike the classical result describing performance of such estimates, we do not make any special (and hard to check) assumptions about the sensing matrix $A$ such as nullspace or Restricted Isometry condition and the like. As a consequence, parameters of the estimates and the upper bounds on their risks are not available in a closed analytic form, but are delivered instead by efficient computation as solutions to explicit convex optimization problems.

item.title: 本文提出模型监控与可观测性框架FMMO，揭示局部归因方法在模型漂移时可能呈现虚假稳定、掩盖受保护群体遭受差异性影响的公平性盲点，并通过整合全局代理模型与模型利用率测量加以弥补。
item.description:
FMMO：检测局部归因与全局漂移之间的偏差

FMMO: Detecting the Divergence Between Local Attribution and Global Drift

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06173

本文提出模型监控与可观测性框架FMMO，揭示局部归因方法在模型漂移时可能呈现虚假稳定、掩盖受保护群体遭受差异性影响的公平性盲点，并通过整合全局代理模型与模型利用率测量加以弥补。

部署后的模型漂移对算法问责构成了关键风险，尤其是当真实标签延迟到达、性能退化演变为“静默失败”时。尽管人们常依赖可解释人工智能（XAI）来审计这些变化，我们证明了流行的局部归因方法（如TreeSHAP）即使在模型可靠性崩溃时也可能表现出具有误导性的稳定性。在本文中，我们提出了一个模型监控与可观测性框架（FMMO），旨在揭示局部解释稳定性与全局分布漂移之间的偏差。通过使用基准数据集、合成数据集和真实世界数据集，我们展示了局部XAI方法未能标记漂移引起的差异性影响，具体表现为受保护群体的假阳性率飙升而特征归因却保持不变。通过将全局代理模型与模型利用率测量相结合，FMMO缓解了这一公平性盲点，确保……（原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.06173v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Post-deployment drift poses a critical risk to algorithmic accountability, particularly when ground truth labels are delayed and performance degradation becomes a "silent failure". While Explainable AI (XAI) is often relied upon to audit these shifts, we demonstrate that popular local attribution methods (e.g., TreeSHAP) can exhibit misleading stability even as model reliability collapses. In this paper, we propose a Framework for Model Monitoring and Observability (FMMO) designed to expose the divergence between local explanation stability and global distribution shifts. Using benchmark, synthetic, and real-world datasets, we show that local XAI methods fail to flag drift-induced disparate impact, specifically where False Positive Rates spike for protected groups while feature attributions remain unchanged. item.title: 该论文提出了一种决策感知的后缀预测框架，将决策挖掘与神经网络后缀预测相结合，通过神经符号方法利用挖掘出的决策规则对预测事件进行推理，从而改善短前缀和罕见流程变体场景下的预测效果。
item.description:
业务流程的决策感知后缀预测与推理

Decision-Aware Suffix Prediction and Reasoning of Business Processes

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06169

该论文提出了一种决策感知的后缀预测框架，将决策挖掘与神经网络后缀预测相结合，通过神经符号方法利用挖掘出的决策规则对预测事件进行推理，从而改善短前缀和罕见流程变体场景下的预测效果。

后缀预测旨在预测一个运行中案例直至完成所剩余的事件序列。大多数方法依赖于在事件日志上训练的神经网络，这些方法在平均意义上表现良好，但在处理短前缀或属于罕见流程变体的目标时表现不佳。在这些场景中，正确的路径可能跨越多个分支决策，而这些决策主要由案例级和事件级属性决定——基于神经网络的后缀预测模型往往低估这一信号，因为它们可能严重偏向（密集的）事件标签。决策挖掘可以从事件日志中提取此类决策的规则，但迄今为止仅被应用于事后分析和假设分析，而非后缀预测。因此，我们将决策挖掘与后缀预测相结合，提出了一种决策感知的后缀预测框架，这是一种神经符号方法，能够通过挖掘到的决策规则对预测事件进行推理。在四个事件日志中的三个上进行的实验……

arXiv:2609.06169v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Suffix prediction forecasts the remaining sequence of events of a running case until completion. Most approaches rely on neural networks trained on event logs, which, on average, perform well but struggle with short prefixes or targets belonging to a rare process variant. In such scenarios, the correct path may cross multiple branching decisions, determined primarily by case- and event-level attributes, a signal that NN-based suffix prediction models tend to underweight because they may heavily weight (dense) event labels. Decision mining extracts rules for such decisions from the event log, but has so far been applied only to post-hoc and what-if analysis, not suffix prediction. We therefore extend suffix prediction with decision mining, introducing a decision-aware suffix prediction framework, a neuro-symbolic approach that enables reasoning about predicted events via mined decision rules. item.title: 本文提出AF1框架，通过零空间感知二值分解（NABF）和分层Shapley分配（HiSA）两个互补组件，首次实现了大语言模型在严格1.0-BPW预算下消除隐藏开销的真正1比特训练后量化，同时保持模型精度。
item.description:
一切为了1比特：面向大语言模型的真正1比特训练后量化

All for 1-Bit: Towards Genuine 1-Bit Post-Training Quantization for LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06161

本文提出AF1框架，通过零空间感知二值分解（NABF）和分层Shapley分配（HiSA）两个互补组件，首次实现了大语言模型在严格1.0-BPW预算下消除隐藏开销的真正1比特训练后量化，同时保持模型精度。

大语言模型（LLMs）已取得显著进展，但其庞大的存储和内存带宽需求仍阻碍了高效部署。权重二值化是一种有前景的解决方案，但现有的基于二值化的训练后量化（PTQ）方法通常由于隐藏开销而远远超出名义上的1比特存储目标。为解决这一差距，我们提出了All for 1-Bit（AF1），一个面向大语言模型的真正1比特训练后量化框架。AF1包含两个互补的组件：（1）零空间感知二值分解（NABF），通过Hessian感知代理重参数化、零空间感知二值分解和仅缩放的全局重构来改进二值重构；（2）分层Shapley分配（HiSA），利用分层Shapley敏感度来分配结构容量。两者相结合，在PTQ设置下严格1.0-BPW的预算内保持了模型精度。在LLaMA、Qwen和Gemma系列模型上的实验……

arXiv:2609.06161v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress, yet their massive storage and memory-bandwidth demands still hinder efficient deployment. Weight binarization is a promising solution, but existing binarization-based post-training quantization (PTQ) methods usually far exceed the nominal 1-bit storage target due to hidden overhead. To address this gap, we propose All for 1-Bit (AF1), a genuine 1-bit PTQ framework for LLMs. AF1 comprises two complementary components: (1) Null-space-Aware Binary Factorization (NABF) for improving binary reconstruction through Hessian-aware surrogate reparameterization, null-space-aware binary factorization, and scale-only global reconstruction; and (2) Hierarchical Shapley Allocation (HiSA) for assigning structural capacity using hierarchical Shapley sensitivity. Together, they preserve model accuracy under a strict 1.0-BPW budget in the PTQ setting. Experiments on LLaMA, Qwen, and Gemma fa

item.title: 该论文提出免训练框架SPEAR，将单轮联邦图学习重新表述为统计估计问题，通过计算拓扑平滑的类别原型并使用样本量自适应的收缩估计器进行聚合，有效解决了极端非独立同分布条件下本地GNN训练导致的跨客户端表示不对齐问题。
item.description:
重新思考单轮联邦图学习：免训练的统计估计方法

Rethinking One-Shot Federated Graph Learning: Training-Free Statistical Estimation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06154

该论文提出免训练框架SPEAR，将单轮联邦图学习重新表述为统计估计问题，通过计算拓扑平滑的类别原型并使用样本量自适应的收缩估计器进行聚合，有效解决了极端非独立同分布条件下本地GNN训练导致的跨客户端表示不对齐问题。

单轮联邦图学习通常旨在通过单轮通信，在多个拥有互不相连子图的客户端上训练图神经网络（GNN）。现有方法主要基于“本地GNN训练不可或缺”这一前提来设计先进的优化策略。然而，实证观察表明，在极端非独立同分布条件下，本地GNN训练会产生严重的跨客户端表示不对齐问题，成为误差的主要来源而非补救手段。受此启发，我们将单轮联邦图学习重新表述为一个统计估计问题。我们提出了SPEAR（具有自适应可靠性的统计原型估计），这是一个完全免训练的框架，它直接在原始特征空间中从本地图计算拓扑平滑的类别原型。服务器随后使用样本量自适应的收缩估计器来聚合这些原型，对不可靠的本地估计进行降权处理。

arXiv:2609.06154v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: One-shot federated graph learning generally aims to train Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) across clients with disconnected subgraphs in a single communication round. Existing methods predominantly design advanced optimization strategies under the premise that local GNN training is indispensable. However, empirical observations reveal that under extreme non-IID conditions, local GNN training suffers from severe cross-client representation misalignment, becoming a major source of error rather than a remedy. Motivated by this, we reformulate one-shot FGL as a statistical estimation problem. We propose SPEAR (Statistical Prototype Estimation with Adaptive Reliability), a completely training-free framework that directly computes topology-smoothed class prototypes from local graphs in the original feature space. item.title: 论文构建了基于真实风投融资文件的稳定性基准Probity，并通过自我审计揭示了摘录式基准中的证据溯源缺陷——证据缺失于模型文本窗口的条目答案不稳定性远高于正常条目（0.255对0.087），且会虚增跨模型一致性约五分之一。
item.description:
窗口未含之物：在基于文档的答案不稳定性基准中审计证据溯源

What the Window Does Not Contain: Auditing Provenance in a Document-Grounded Instability Benchmark

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06147

论文构建了基于真实风投融资文件的稳定性基准Probity，并通过自我审计揭示了摘录式基准中的证据溯源缺陷——证据缺失于模型文本窗口的条目答案不稳定性远高于正常条目（0.255对0.087），且会虚增跨模型一致性约五分之一。

对同一份文档，向语言模型询问同一个问题二十次，它有时会返回两个不同的答案。我们构建了Probity——一个包含来自真实风险融资文件、共60个任务和470个条目的基准——来衡量这种情况发生的频率。随后我们对自己的语料库进行了审计，发现了一种任何由摘录构建的基准都可能存在的缺陷：某些条目的证据缺失于展示给模型的文本窗口之中。该审计标记了36个条目，并将单一标记容易混淆的两种失败情形区分开来：证据真正缺失于窗口之外，以及必须从窗口所提供的数字中计算得出的答案。被标记条目改变答案的频率要高得多——其不稳定率达0.255，而427个干净条目仅为0.087；排除这些条目会使表面上的跨模型一致性下降约五分之一。在检验缺失证据是否能够解释这种不稳定性之前，我们预先注册了一项预测：重新裁剪每个窗口使其包含证据，不稳定……

arXiv:2609.06147v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ask a language model the same question about the same document twenty times, and it sometimes returns two different answers. We built Probity, a benchmark of 60 tasks and 470 items from real venture-financing filings, to measure how often this happens. Then we audited our own corpus and found a defect any excerpt-built benchmark can carry: items whose evidence is missing from the window of text the model is shown. The audit flags 36 items and separates two failures a single flag would conflate: evidence genuinely absent from the window and answers that must be computed from numbers the window does supply. Flagged items change their answers far more often, wobbling at 0.255 against 0.087 on the 427 clean items, and excluding them cuts apparent cross-model agreement by about a fifth. item.title: 提出以可修订的“协调事件”作为防御运作单元，通过前瞻性事件发现，在评估者标注之前识别并遏制智能体之间未经许可的协同入侵。
item.description:
反蜂群学说：遏制协同智能体入侵

Counter-Swarm Doctrine: Containing Coordinated Agent Intrusions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06140

提出以可修订的“协调事件”作为防御运作单元，通过前瞻性事件发现，在评估者标注之前识别并遏制智能体之间未经许可的协同入侵。

智能体可以将共享基础设施转变为协同入侵的通道。Hugging Face 事件以及另一项公开维基调查表明，一次安全评估可能需要来自多次执行及其所留痕迹的证据。我们主张，防御的运作单元应当是一个可修订的“协调事件”，它将观测到的传输、任务权限和响应历史关联起来。其核心研究问题是前瞻性事件发现：在评估者给出成员归属之前，确定哪些行动属于同一事件。我们相对于协作与委托授权策略定义了“未经许可的协调”，将经由存储介导的协调与共识主动性联系起来，并明确了区分“影响”与“共同原因”所需的证据。首次接触信号是事件发现的一种可能输入；该设计还追踪继承状态和后续使用。所提议的评估将孤立行动、滚动……

item.title: 本文提出一种固定宽度的循环反馈压缩方法，通过XOR折叠与双时间尺度阈值化将循环Tsetlin机的480个子句激活压缩为96个比特，并在可复现的布尔有限状态机基准上验证了其准确率与原始反馈相当。
item.description:
Tsetlin机中的压缩循环反馈：一项可复现的布尔有限状态机研究

Compressed Recurrent Feedback in Tsetlin Machines: A Reproducible Boolean-FSM Study

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06133

本文提出一种固定宽度的循环反馈压缩方法，通过XOR折叠与双时间尺度阈值化将循环Tsetlin机的480个子句激活压缩为96个比特，并在可复现的布尔有限状态机基准上验证了其准确率与原始反馈相当。

小型设备上的序列推理要求模型能够保留有用的历史信息，而无需反复处理冗长的输入记录。循环Tsetlin机（RTM）通过将一个时间步的布尔子句输出作为下一个时间步的输入来提供这种记忆能力。然而，直接反馈会随着子句库的规模而增长，可能使循环输入变得不必要地宽。本文研究了一种固定宽度的替代方案。我们通过异或（XOR）折叠来组合子句激活，在两个时间尺度上保留折叠后的比特，并将其阈值化回二进制状态。所得设计将480个子句激活压缩为96个循环比特。我们在一个可复现的布尔有限状态机基准上评估了该方法，该基准具有明确的转换规则、数据划分方式和随机种子。在144次运行中，压缩模型在两个任务族上分别取得了61.47±6.74%和62.94±9.92%的准确率。原始子句反馈使这些均值产生了……（摘要此处截断）

arXiv:2609.06133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sequential inference on small devices requires a model to retain useful history without repeatedly processing a long input record. A Recurrent Tsetlin Machine (RTM) provides this memory by returning Boolean clause outputs from one time step as inputs to the next. Direct feedback, however, grows with the clause bank and can make the recurrent input unnecessarily wide. This paper investigates a fixed-width alternative. We combine clause activations by exclusive-OR (XOR) folding, retain the folded bits at two time scales, and threshold them back to a binary state. The resulting design reduces 480 clause activations to 96 recurrent bits. We evaluate the method on a reproducible Boolean finite-state-machine benchmark with explicit transition rules, data splits, and random seeds. arXiv:2609.06109v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Port flood digital twins require analytics that warn operators before disruption, but official warning incidents are often few and adjacent observations are temporally dependent. Row-level classification can therefore overstate performance by placing windows from the same event in both model-development and evaluation data. item.title: 该论文提出了DataFlex-RL评估平台，在统一GRPO设置下系统比较13种RLVR数据策略，发现没有任何一种rollout选择、重新加权或自适应混合方法能显著优于简单的均匀采样。
item.description:
DataFlex-RL：RLVR数据策略评估平台

DataFlex-RL: An Evaluation Platform for RLVR Data Policies

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06107

该论文提出了DataFlex-RL评估平台，在统一GRPO设置下系统比较13种RLVR数据策略，发现没有任何一种rollout选择、重新加权或自适应混合方法能显著优于简单的均匀采样。

可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的数据策略决定了使用哪些rollout、它们的加权强度，以及哪些领域为后续训练批次做出贡献。我们提出了DataFlex-RL，这是一个在统一GRPO配方下比较这些选择的评估平台。我们的主要实验使用Qwen2.5-7B-Base模型和12个数学、逻辑和科学基准测试，在12个匹配的随机种子上评估了13种配置。均匀GRPO相比未训练的检查点将领域平衡平均准确率提高了7.76个百分点。八种rollout选择或重新加权方法中，没有一种相对于均匀采样达到排除零的配对95%置信区间；三种自适应混合方法中，也没有一种在相同精度水平下优于固定的等比例混合。在Llama-3.1-8B-Base上进行的修正后12种子扩展实验，将其他方法置于与原始对比相同的分数尺度上。

arXiv:2609.06107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data policies for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) determine which rollouts are used, how strongly they are weighted, and which domains contribute to subsequent training batches. We introduce DataFlex-RL, an evaluation platform for comparing these choices under a common GRPO recipe. arXiv:2609.06106v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Heterogeneous Federated Learning (HFL) aims to train models across devices with diverse resource budgets while preserving data privacy. Existing HFL methods typically bind training to a small predefined menu of model configurations, which limits architectural coverage. To address this bottleneck, we introduce Federated Adaptive Network Search (FANS), a hypernetwork-based framework that learns a shared architecture space rather than a fixed set of client models. item.title: 提出了可编程元胞自动机的概念，将元胞自动机系统表示为Python代码，并将其模块化为局部函数和决策函数，解决了创建有效局部规则困难且难以解释的问题。
item.description:
可编程元胞自动机

Programmable Cellular Automata

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06102

提出了可编程元胞自动机的概念，将元胞自动机系统表示为Python代码，并将其模块化为局部函数和决策函数，解决了创建有效局部规则困难且难以解释的问题。

元胞自动机是一种局部计算范式，其中复杂行为可以从简单函数之间的局部交互中产生。这一范式已被用于解释许多系统，如生物过程、交通模拟、计算机网络等。在游戏中，元胞自动机已被用于《模拟城市》等游戏中，以及用于生成洞穴或地牢等空间内容。然而，创建有效的局部规则既困难又不直观。元胞自动机可以有效地进行演化，但结果仍然可能难以解释。在这项工作中，我们引入了可编程元胞自动机的概念，即将系统表示为Python代码。我们还将元胞自动机模块化为局部函数和决策函数。局部函数接受一个局部邻域并返回一个值，而决策函数则接受局部函数的输出并决定下一个状态的值。将元胞自动机分离

arXiv:2609.06102v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Cellular automata is a local computation paradigm where complex behavior can arise from local interactions between simple functions. This paradigm has been used to explain many systems such as biological processes, traffic simulation, computer networks, etc. In games, cellular automata have been used in games such as SimCity and for the generation of spatial content such as caves or dungeons. However, creating effective local rules is hard and unintuitive. Cellular automata can be effectively evolved, but may still be hard to interpret. In this work, we introduce the concept of programmable cellular automata, where we represent the system as Python code. We also modularize the cellular automata into local functions and a decision function. Local functions take a local neighborhood and return a value, while the decision function takes the output of the local functions and decides the value of the next state. item.title: VERPO提出了一种验证证据正则化策略优化框架，通过Fisher证据对比和带停止机制的逐token ZPD控制器有选择性地应用基于证据的修正，在保留可验证结果目标的同时避免盲目模仿导致的负面迁移。
item.description:
VERPO：验证证据正则化策略优化

VERPO: Verified Evidence Regularized Policy Optimization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06100

VERPO提出了一种验证证据正则化策略优化框架，通过Fisher证据对比和带停止机制的逐token ZPD控制器有选择性地应用基于证据的修正，在保留可验证结果目标的同时避免盲目模仿导致的负面迁移。

可验证的结果奖励可以指导语言模型的后训练，但序列级别的优势无法识别哪些token级别的决策应当被保留或修改。证据条件教师通过以特权反馈重放采样轨迹来提供更密集的监督。然而，不加区分的模仿可能会迁移那些不支持任务成功的格式或推理风格偏移。我们提出了VERPO，一个验证证据正则化策略优化框架，它将证据视为策略修正的提议，同时保留结果目标。该框架将无证据的参考恢复与带符号的token级证据修正分离开来。Fisher证据对比沿着估计的证据存在方向对修正进行衰减。一个带停止机制的逐token ZPD控制器根据局部奖励对齐程度和Fisher移动成本来调节修正的接受度，而参考通道保持独立于接受决策。

arXiv:2609.06100v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Verifiable outcome rewards guide language-model post-training, but sequence-level advantages do not identify which token-level decisions should be preserved or revised. Evidence-conditioned Teachers provide denser supervision by replaying sampled trajectories with privileged feedback. Yet indiscriminate imitation risks transferring formatting or reasoning-style shifts that do not support task success. We introduce VERPO, a Verified Evidence Regularized Policy Optimization framework that treats evidence as a proposal for policy correction while retaining the outcome objective. It separates evidence-free reference restoration from signed token-level evidence corrections. Fisher Evidence Contrast attenuates corrections along an estimated evidence-presence direction. item.title: 提出泊松稀释结构方程模型（PT-SEM），通过泊松稀释机制和灵活的节点级外生分布设定，首次实现了从观测数据中对计数数据因果DAG、稀释系数及外生分布的完全识别。
item.description:
基于泊松稀释结构方程模型的计数数据因果DAG识别

Causal DAG Identification for Count Data via Poisson Thinning Structural Equation Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06098

提出泊松稀释结构方程模型（PT-SEM），通过泊松稀释机制和灵活的节点级外生分布设定，首次实现了从观测数据中对计数数据因果DAG、稀释系数及外生分布的完全识别。

计数值变量出现在许多科学和应用场景中，然而能够从观测数据中完全识别因果DAG的显式结构模型仍然有限。泊松分支结构因果模型（PB-SCM）通过二项稀释和独立的泊松外生变量，为线性结构方程模型提供了计数值的类似物，但其因果DAG通常只能被部分识别。在此框架基础上，我们提出了泊松稀释结构方程模型（PT-SEM），该模型用泊松稀释替代PB-SCM中的二项稀释，并允许节点级外生分布来自多样化的计数分布族。在节点级正则性条件下，我们建立了因果DAG、稀释系数以及节点级外生分布的可识别性。相同的识别分析可以扩展到二项稀释情形，从而在某些条件下获得完全可识别性。

arXiv:2609.06098v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Count-valued variables arise in many scientific and applied settings, yet explicit structural models that allow full identification of causal DAGs from observational data remain limited. Building on this framework, we propose the Poisson thinning structural equation model (PT-SEM), which replaces binomial thinning in PB-SCM with Poisson thinning and allows node-wise exogenous distributions from diverse count-distribution families. item.title: 提出了一种条件生成式潜在表示框架，将连接组图编码到紧凑结构空间中，既能以高达0.910的AUC高精度重建观测连接，又能生成新的候选连接组，为连接组结构到功能的映射提供了统一的生成式分析途径。
item.description:
从连接组到功能：面向储备池计算的条件生成式潜在表示

Connectome-to-Function: Conditional Generative Latent Representations for Reservoir Computing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06093

提出了一种条件生成式潜在表示框架，将连接组图编码到紧凑结构空间中，既能以高达0.910的AUC高精度重建观测连接，又能生成新的候选连接组，为连接组结构到功能的映射提供了统一的生成式分析途径。

连接组是神经元及其突触连接的图级映射，为理解大脑回路如何支持功能与计算提供了结构基础。然而，将连接组结构映射到计算仍然十分困难，因为这些图具有高维、稀疏的特性，并且对局部结构变化敏感。现有方法通常依赖于手工设计的结构描述符或特定任务的预测器，这限制了它们以兼具生成性和功能意义的形式来表示连接组的能力。我们提出了一个条件生成式潜在框架，将连接组图编码到紧凑的结构空间中，同时利用可用的节点级条件来指导重建与生成。基于该空间，模型能够以最高达0.910的平均边重建AUC重建观测到的连接，并生成新的候选连接组，从而实现了对图结构与功能的统一分析。

arXiv:2609.06093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Connectomes, graph-level maps of neurons and their synaptic connections, provide a structural basis for understanding how brain circuits support function and computation. However, mapping connectome structure to computation remains difficult because these graphs are high-dimensional, sparse, and sensitive to local structural variation. Existing approaches often depend on hand-crafted structural descriptors or task-specific predictors, which limits their ability to represent connectomes in a form that is both generative and functionally meaningful. We propose a conditional generative latent framework that encodes connectome graphs into a compact structural space while using available node-level conditions to guide reconstruction and generation. item.title: 本文提出了一个同时应对情境化需求与删失需求观测的联合定价与库存控制学习框架，通过将需求建模为基函数的线性组合并设计高效算法，实现了与理论下界匹配的最优遗憾界。
item.description:
情境化与删失需求下的定价与库存联合学习

Learning to Price and Stock Under Contextual and Censored Demand

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06083

本文提出了一个同时应对情境化需求与删失需求观测的联合定价与库存控制学习框架，通过将需求建模为基函数的线性组合并设计高效算法，实现了与理论下界匹配的最优遗憾界。

对于现代零售商而言，做出最优的联合定价与库存控制决策是一项关键挑战。在实践中，零售商面临不断变化的市场环境，需求受到各种情境因素的影响，同时还要应对销售损失（lost sales）掩盖真实需求信息的困难。然而，现有方法往往无法同时考虑情境信息和删失需求观测。我们通过提出一个框架来弥补这一空白：在该框架中，我们将需求建模为具有未知系数的基函数的线性组合，从而实现能够响应环境变化的自适应定价与库存决策。我们提出了一种高效算法，在凹收益条件下实现了 O(K√T log T) 的遗憾界，在一般情形下实现了 O(K^(2/3)T^(2/3)(log T)^(1/2)) 的遗憾界，并且匹配的下界证实了算法的最优性。跨多个场景的大量数值实验验证了方法的有效性。

arXiv:2609.06083v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To make optimal joint pricing and inventory control decisions is a critical challenge for modern retailers. In practice, retailers face changing market conditions where demands are influenced by various contextual factors, while simultaneously dealing with the difficulty of lost sales that obscure true demand information. However, existing approaches often fail to account for both contextual information and censored demand observations. We address this gap by presenting a framework where we model demand as a linear combination of basis functions with unknown coefficients, allowing for adaptive pricing and inventory decisions that respond to changing contexts. We propose an efficient algorithm to achieve regret bound $\mathcal{O}(K\sqrt{T}\log T)$ under concave revenue conditions and $\mathcal{O}(K^{2/3}T^{2/3}(\log T)^{1/2})$ for the general case, with matching lower bounds confirming optimality. item.title: 该论文提出了PhenoBench——一个基于人类表型项目（超13,000名参与者）构建的可执行评估基准，通过定义15个领域、26种输入模态下的90项临床任务，系统性地量化了哪些测量数据对哪些健康问题具有预测价值。

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06080

该论文提出了PhenoBench——一个基于人类表型项目（超13,000名参与者）构建的可执行评估基准，通过定义15个领域、26种输入模态下的90项临床任务，系统性地量化了哪些测量数据对哪些健康问题具有预测价值。

深度表型队列结合了从秒级到年际跨时间尺度的临床、影像、分子和可穿戴设备观测数据。这种广度可以揭示哪些测量数据能为哪些健康相关问题提供信息，但异构的分析结果无法直接比较。我们提出了PhenoBench，一个围绕人类表型项目构建的可执行基准，该项目已有超过13,000名参与者完成了首次访问。每个问题都固定了目标、合格人群、时间点和允许使用的信息；其评估契约规定了数据划分、评估指标、基线和结论边界。该基准定义了90项基于临床的任务，涵盖15个领域和26种输入模态。测量结果显示出依赖于具体问题和数据表示的预测价值，包括相对于匹配基线在留出集性能上的正向、接近零以及负向的变化。我们使用PhenoBench评估了新兴的表格基础模型……

arXiv:2609.06080v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deeply phenotyped cohorts combine clinical, imaging, molecular, and wearable observations across timescales from seconds to years. This breadth can reveal which measurements inform which health-related questions, but heterogeneous analyses are not directly comparable. We present PhenoBench, an executable benchmark built around the Human Phenotype Project, in which more than 13,000 participants have completed the initial visit. Each question fixes the target, eligible population, timing, and allowed information; its evaluation contract specifies the split, metric, baseline, and claim boundary. The benchmark defines 90 clinically grounded tasks across 15 domains and 26 input modalities. Measurements showed question- and representation-dependent predictive value, including positive, near-zero, and negative changes in held-out performance relative to matched baselines. item.title: 提出LayerRoute，一个动作条件的混合层路由接口，使VLA策略能够根据具体动作需求自适应地访问和混合VLM不同层次的表示，突破了传统固定层分配的限制。
item.description:
LayerRoute：面向视觉-语言-动作策略的动作条件混合层路由

LayerRoute: Action-Conditioned Mixture-of-Layers Routing for Vision-Language-Action Policies

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06079

提出LayerRoute，一个动作条件的混合层路由接口，使VLA策略能够根据具体动作需求自适应地访问和混合VLM不同层次的表示，突破了传统固定层分配的限制。

arXiv:2609.06079v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略利用预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）来指导机器人控制的动作生成。VLM提供跨层演化的分层视觉-语义表示，从局部视觉几何到抽象的、与语言对齐的语义；因此，不同的操作任务可能需要不同的层表示混合。同时，动作模块在动作计算过程中维护不断演化的中间表示，这些表示可能为后续决策提供有用信息。然而，现有的VLA接口在表示访问方面的灵活性有限：VLM信息通过为每个动作层固定的层分配来暴露，而中间动作状态仅通过残差流隐式传播，缺乏显式复用。我们提出了LayerRoute，一个动作条件的表示路由接口，使VLA策略能够自适应地访问VLM的各层表示。

arXiv:2609.06079v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies leverage pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to guide action generation for robot control. VLMs provide hierarchical visual-semantic representations that evolve across layers, from local visual geometry to abstract, language-aligned semantics; different manipulation tasks may therefore require different mixtures of layer representations. Meanwhile, the action module maintains intermediate representations that evolve throughout action computation and may provide useful information for subsequent decisions. However, existing VLA interfaces offer limited flexibility in representation access: VLM information is exposed through fixed layer assignments for each action layer, while intermediate action states are only propagated implicitly through residual streams without explicit reuse. We introduce LayerRoute, an action-conditioned representation routing interface that enables adaptive access to VLM l

item.title: 压缩后的MoE模型应被视为“压缩初始化”而非最终产物：仅需3,000条样本、单个epoch的低成本后压缩调整（尤其是全参数微调），即可平均恢复压缩造成的37.3%的性能损失，且比token级知识蒸馏更具成本效益。
item.description:
超越免再训练MoE压缩：后压缩调整的成本归一化研究

Beyond Retraining-Free MoE Compression: A Cost-Normalized Study of Post-Compression Adjustment

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06076

压缩后的MoE模型应被视为“压缩初始化”而非最终产物：仅需3,000条样本、单个epoch的低成本后压缩调整（尤其是全参数微调），即可平均恢复压缩造成的37.3%的性能损失，且比token级知识蒸馏更具成本效益。

免再训练的MoE（混合专家）压缩通过剪枝或合并专家来减少部署内存，但通常将压缩后的检查点视为最终产物。我们认为这种观点是不完整的：压缩后的MoE检查点更适合被理解为压缩后的初始化状态，它们可以从一个微小的压缩后调整阶段中受益。在两个MoE大语言模型骨干网络、四种剪枝/合并方法、三种专家保留比例以及28个基准测试上，我们在匹配的小数据预算和实测GPU成本下，比较了语言模型微调与基于教师的知识蒸馏。仅使用3,000条C4样本和单个epoch的调整，全量微调平均可以恢复原始模型与压缩模型之间性能差距的37.3%。此外，语言模型微调比标准的token级知识蒸馏更具成本效益，并且在测试的调整范围中，全参数调整展现出最强的成本-性能恢复权衡。这些结果表明，免再训练压缩应该与小的（压缩后调整）相结合。

arXiv:2609.06076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Retraining-free MoE compression reduces deployment memory by pruning or merging experts, but often treats the compressed checkpoint as the final artifact. We argue that this view is incomplete: compressed MoE checkpoints are better understood as compressed initializations that benefit from a tiny post-compression adjustment stage. Across two MoE LLM backbones, four pruning/merging methods, three expert-retention ratios, and 28 benchmarks, we compare LM fine-tuning and teacher-based KD under matched small-data budgets and measured GPU costs. Using only 3,000 C4 examples and a single epoch of adjustment, Full FT recovers 37.3% of the original-to-compressed performance gap on average. Moreover, LM fine-tuning is more cost-effective than standard token-level KD, and full-parameter adjustment gives the strongest cost--recovery trade-off among the tested scopes. item.title: FedSubMuon通过在共享结构化子空间中优化紧凑系数矩阵，在保持Muon矩阵感知优化特性的同时，将客户端上传量从完整层大小的更新压缩为紧凑系数矩阵，从而大幅降低联邦LLM微调的通信成本。
item.description:
FedSubMuon：基于结构化子空间Muon的通信高效联邦大语言模型微调

FedSubMuon: Communication-Efficient Federated LLM Fine-Tuning via Structured Subspace Muon

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06073

FedSubMuon通过在共享结构化子空间中优化紧凑系数矩阵，在保持Muon矩阵感知优化特性的同时，将客户端上传量从完整层大小的更新压缩为紧凑系数矩阵，从而大幅降低联邦LLM微调的通信成本。

联邦微调使大语言模型（LLM）能够适应分散的客户端数据，但其在跨设备训练中的可扩展性往往受到高昂通信成本的限制。Muon是一种通过对矩阵值参数的动量进行正交化来提升优化性能的优化器。现有的联邦Muon方法证明了矩阵感知优化在联邦学习中的优势，但仍需传输完整层大小的更新和优化器状态。减少通信的一种自然方式是直接将Muon应用于LoRA因子，但这会改变被优化的对象并削弱Muon的矩阵感知更新几何特性。我们提出FedSubMuon，一种通信高效的联邦Muon微调方法，它在共享的结构化子空间内优化紧凑的系数矩阵。这一设计使Muon保持在单一的矩阵值可训练对象上，同时将客户端上传量减少为紧凑的系数矩阵。

arXiv:2609.06073v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Federated fine-tuning adapts large language models (LLMs) to decentralized client data, but its scalability in cross-device training is often limited by the high communication cost. Muon is an optimizer that improves optimization performance by orthogonalizing momentum for matrix-valued parameters. Existing federated Muon methods demonstrate the benefit of matrix-aware optimization in federated learning, but still require transmitting full layer-size updates and optimizer state. A natural way to reduce communication is to directly apply Muon to LoRA factors, but this changes the optimized object and weakens Muon's matrix-aware update geometry. We propose FedSubMuon, a communication-efficient federated Muon fine-tuning method that optimizes compact coefficient matrices within shared structured subspaces. item.description:
ACE：面向MoE大语言模型参数高效微调的跨专家适配器合并

ACE: Adapter Consolidation across Experts for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of MoE LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06072

提出ACE方法，通过将冗余专家的独立LoRA适配器合并为组共享的高秩模块并统一执行，在相同参数预算下同时提升MoE大语言模型参数高效微调的效果与训练效率。

混合专家模型的参数高效微调（PEFT）通常为每个专家附加一个独立的低秩适配器。这种逐专家设计从三个方面使适配过程碎片化：模型容量被分割到多个狭窄的低秩更新中，在稀疏路由下梯度监督变得稀疏且不均衡，执行过程被分解为许多小的GEMM（通用矩阵乘法）操作。我们发现这种逐专家的分离往往是不必要的，因为LoRA适配器的子集在微调过程中会变得功能相似，这揭示了专家特定适配器之间的冗余性。基于这种冗余性，我们提出了ACE（跨专家适配器合并），它在相同的PEFT预算下对冗余专家进行分组，并用组共享的更高秩LoRA模块替换其专家特定的适配器。ACE进一步引入了分组适配器执行机制，将碎片化的逐专家适配器计算合并为更少、更大的组级GEMM。在各种……

arXiv:2609.06072v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of mixture-of-experts (MoE) models commonly attaches a separate low-rank adapter to each expert. This expert-wise design fragments adaptation in three ways: capacity is split across narrow low-rank updates, gradient supervision becomes sparse and imbalanced under sparse routing, and execution is decomposed into many small GEMMs. We find that such expert-wise separation is often unnecessary, as subsets of LoRA adapters become functionally similar during fine-tuning, revealing redundancy among expert-specific adapters. Based on this redundancy, we propose ACE (Adapter Consolidation across Experts), which groups redundant experts and replaces their expert-specific adapters with group-shared higher-rank LoRA modules under the same PEFT budget. item.title: 提出 Calendar-SPCA 日历结构稀疏主成分方法，将日、周、年等多周期日历几何直接嵌入用电数据的低维表示学习中，生成稀疏且局部连贯、可直接解读的载荷模式，并在两个独立智能电表数据集上验证了其有效性。
item.description:
Calendar-SPCA：面向多周期用电曲线的可解释表示学习

Calendar-SPCA: Interpretable Representation Learning for Multi-Periodic Electricity Consumption Profiles

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06060

提出 Calendar-SPCA 日历结构稀疏主成分方法，将日、周、年等多周期日历几何直接嵌入用电数据的低维表示学习中，生成稀疏且局部连贯、可直接解读的载荷模式，并在两个独立智能电表数据集上验证了其有效性。

长期用电曲线呈现出多种同时存在的周期结构，包括日周期、周周期和年周期。本工作提出了 Calendar-SPCA，这是一种日历结构的稀疏主成分方法，将这种已知的多周期几何结构直接融入低维表示学习中。特征域被表示为循环日历轴的笛卡尔积，并通过 L1 载荷惩罚与日历图上的图全变差来估计低秩分解。因此，该方法产生的稀疏且局部连贯的载荷模式在其原始时间坐标下保持直接可读性。Calendar-SPCA 在两个具有不同样本量和时间分辨率的独立智能电表数据集上进行了评估：GoiEner 和 Low Carbon London。一个因子实验刻画了稀疏性与日历约束的互补效应。

arXiv:2609.06060v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Long-term electricity-consumption profiles exhibit several simultaneous periodic structures, including daily, weekly, and annual cycles. This work introduces Calendar-SPCA, a calendar-structured sparse principal component method that incorporates this known multi-periodic geometry directly into low-dimensional representation learning. The feature domain is represented as the Cartesian product of cyclic calendar axes, and a low-rank factorization is estimated using an L1 loading penalty together with graph total variation over the resulting calendar graph. The method therefore produces sparse and locally coherent loading patterns that remain directly readable in their original temporal coordinates. Calendar-SPCA is evaluated on two independent smart-meter datasets with different sample sizes and temporal resolutions: GoiEner and Low Carbon London. A factorial experiment characterizes the complementary effects of sparsity and calendar co

item.title: 该论文提出GradeTrap受控评估框架，发现即使被明确指示忽略学生答案等社会线索，图像中的权威线索（如教师或官方答案）仍会显著偏移视觉语言模型的独立判断。
item.description:
GradeTrap：尽管有明确指令要求忽略，图像中的权威线索仍会使视觉语言模型的判断发生偏移

GradeTrap: Authority Cues in Images Shift VLM Judgments Despite Explicit Instructions to Ignore Them

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06058

该论文提出GradeTrap受控评估框架，发现即使被明确指示忽略学生答案等社会线索，图像中的权威线索（如教师或官方答案）仍会显著偏移视觉语言模型的独立判断。

随着视觉语言模型日益强大并被部署在具有重要影响的现实场景中，它们必须独立评估证据，而非不加批判地屈从于人类权威。我们提出了GradeTrap，这是一个受控评估框架，将两种社会线索置于直接冲突之中：学生答案（本应诱发谄媚性认同）与归属于同伴、教师或官方参考答案的冲突性答案（本应诱发对权威的屈从）。模型在生成自由格式答案的同时，被明确指示要独立解题并忽略所有学生答案、反馈和批改标记。我们在60个合成的现实权衡场景上测试了模型：五次中性试验用于建立稳定的模型相对偏好，随后对包括对照组在内的六种实验线索进行三次重复测试。在Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite、GPT-5.6 Luna和Claude Haiku三者共有的45项交集样本上……

arXiv:2609.06058v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) become increasingly capable and are deployed in consequential real-world settings, they must evaluate evidence independently rather than defer uncritically to human authority. We introduce GradeTrap, a controlled evaluation that places two social cues in direct conflict: a student answer, which should attract sycophantic agreement, and a conflicting answer attributed to a peer, teacher, or official answer key, which should attract authority-based deference. Models produce free-form answers while being explicitly instructed to solve independently and ignore all student answers, feedback, and grading marks. We test the models on 60 synthetic real-world trade-off scenarios. Five neutral trials establish a stable model-relative preference, followed by three repetitions of six experimental cues including controls. item.title: 本文提出了一个形式化的可泛化生成-过滤框架，并引入基于大语言模型的LeDQeR方法，实现数据质量规则的自动化生成，解决了领域专家手动维护规则集时容易遗漏关键规则的难题。
item.description:
使用大语言模型生成数据质量规则

Data Quality Rule Generation with LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06053

本文提出了一个形式化的可泛化生成-过滤框架，并引入基于大语言模型的LeDQeR方法，实现数据质量规则的自动化生成，解决了领域专家手动维护规则集时容易遗漏关键规则的难题。

数据验证（如客户和员工数据）是许多组织中的一项重要任务。数据错误可能造成严重后果。例如，患者记录中错误的药物剂量单位可能导致危及生命的用药错误，而地址中缺失的门牌号可能导致配送失败。企业通常采用基于规则的企业数据质量（DQ）工具，允许领域专家制定规则以持续验证数据。虽然基于规则的DQ工具计算高效并能提供可解释的报告，但手动维护一套全面的规则集极具挑战性，因为领域专家往往会忽略重要的规则，尤其是在复杂领域和大数据量的情况下。因此，在实践中弥补这些缺口仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在本文中，我们解决了自动化DQ规则生成的挑战。为此，我们形式化了一个可泛化的生成-过滤框架，并引入了LeDQeR，一个基于大语言模型的DQ规则生成方法。

arXiv:2609.06053v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The validation of data, such as customer and employee data, is an important task in many organizations. Errors in data can have severe consequences. For example, a wrong drug unit in a patient record can lead to life-threatening medication errors, and a missing street number in an address to failed deliveries. Companies often employ rule-based enterprise data quality (DQ) tools, which allow domain experts to specify rules to validate the data over time. While rule-based DQ tools are computationally efficient and provide explainable reports, maintaining a comprehensive rule set manually is challenging, as domain experts often overlook essential rules, especially in complex domains and large data volumes. Hence, closing these gaps remains an open problem in practice. In this paper, we address the challenge of automated DQ rule generation. For this, we formalize a generalizable generate-filter framework and introduce LeDQeR, an LLM-based DQ

item.title: 本文提出了FALCON-S，一个高保真、模块化的固定翼近地面飞行仿真框架，完整建模六自由度物理与半经验地效空气动力学，并支持CPU/GPU高吞吐量并行计算，可用于大规模强化学习训练和最优控制算法的开发与基准测试。
item.description:
FALCON-S：固定翼地效空气动力学仿真器与飞行控制学习套件

FALCON-S: Fixed-wing ground-effect Aerodynamics Simulator and Flight Control Learning Suite

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06046

本文提出了FALCON-S，一个高保真、模块化的固定翼近地面飞行仿真框架，完整建模六自由度物理与半经验地效空气动力学，并支持CPU/GPU高吞吐量并行计算，可用于大规模强化学习训练和最优控制算法的开发与基准测试。

我们提出了一个模块化、高保真的仿真框架，用于开发和基准测试在近地面运行的固定翼飞行机器人的飞行控制策略。与现有依赖简化动力学或面向悬停动力学的仿真器不同，我们的框架建模了完整的六自由度刚体物理、半经验地效空气动力学、执行器动力学、传感器噪声和环境扰动。这种物理真实性结合模块化组件设计，能够系统性地分析真实条件下的低空飞行行为。该仿真器通过 Torch 和 NVIDIA Warp 支持 CPU 和 GPU 双后端，可实现高吞吐量并行执行，适用于大规模强化学习训练和最优控制推演。统一的接口可适配多种控制器（包括强化学习和最优控制算法），用于高度调节和轨迹跟踪等任务。

arXiv:2609.06046v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a modular, high-fidelity simulation framework for the development and benchmarking of flight control strategies in fixed-wing aerial robots operating near the ground. Unlike existing simulators that rely on simplified or hover-oriented dynamics, our framework models full 6DoF rigid-body physics, semi-empirical ground-effect aerodynamics, actuator dynamics, sensor noise, and environmental disturbances. This physical realism, combined with modular component design, enables systematic analysis of low-altitude flight behavior under realistic conditions. The simulator supports both CPU and GPU backends via Torch and NVIDIA Warp, enabling high-throughput parallel execution suitable for large-scale reinforcement learning training and optimal control rollouts. A unified interface accommodates a range of controllers (both RL and optical control algorithms) across tasks such as altitude regulation and trajectory tracking. Cross-valida

item.title: 本文提出通过替代激活函数、优化损失函数、阈值调整以及模拟周期性休息（包括咖啡因刺激）等方法，有效缓解了前向-前向算法中因睡眠剥夺导致的学习效果灾难性下降问题，并在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上验证了改进效果。
item.description:
最小化前向-前向算法中睡眠剥夺的影响

Minimizing the Effect of Sleep Deprivation in the Forward-Forward Algorithm

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06042

本文提出通过替代激活函数、优化损失函数、阈值调整以及模拟周期性休息（包括咖啡因刺激）等方法，有效缓解了前向-前向算法中因睡眠剥夺导致的学习效果灾难性下降问题，并在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上验证了改进效果。

本文解决了前向-前向算法中睡眠剥夺所带来的挑战，其中将算法中的两次前向传播分离，并使两次传播中的数据处理不平衡，被视为对睡眠剥夺人类所观察到的认知过程的模拟。先前的研究已表明，前向-前向算法中的睡眠剥夺会对学习效果产生灾难性的影响。为了缓解这一问题，我们探索了多种方法，包括替代激活函数、优化的损失函数以及阈值调整。为了模拟周期性休息，我们在交替的训练轮次中减少正样本传播的次数，从而创造出短暂的休息阶段。此外，我们还研究了咖啡因诱导刺激在睡眠剥夺条件下提升性能的潜力。在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上进行的实验评估表明，这些改进措施提升了（模型性能）。

Cadence：基于时间序列基础模型的误差有界需求时间序列有损压缩

我们提出了Cadence，一种针对数值时间序列的误差有界有损压缩器，它将一个3.3亿参数的时间序列基础模型（Google TimesFM-3）与自适应算术编码器相结合，保证每个样本满足误差界 $|\hat{x}_t-x_t|\le\tau$。一个负面结果限制了设计空间：对于无损编码，基础模型毫无价值，因为节省的比特数与预测器精度呈对数关系，即 $\Delta b=\log_2(\mathrm{MAE_{old}}/\mathrm{MAE_{new}})$。因此，TimesFM-3 相对于32抽头线性预测器1.51倍的精度优势，仅能在20.28比特中节省0.60比特，中位数增益仅为+0.03%。而误差有界编码在这一点上摆脱了该限制：一旦预测值落入误差带内，残差索引为零，该样本的编码几乎不占成本。Cadence的贡献包括：(1) 一种采用上下文建模二值化的自适应范围编码器，在真实指数数据上比xz/zstd提升9.7%（15/15全胜），并推翻了来自通用压缩后端的一个已有结论；(2) 一个确定性结果——

item.description:
深度时间序列模型中的记忆

Memory in Deep Time-Series Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06006

本文提出用一个统一的“记忆”视角来重新审视时间序列深度学习中从循环网络到基础模型等各类架构范式，将其视为对“模型如何在直接输入之外保留和访问信息”这一共同问题的不同解决方案。

时间序列深度学习经历了多个架构范式的相继演进，从循环网络和Transformer，到结构化状态空间模型、检索增强预测器、基础模型以及使用工具的智能体。这些发展通常被孤立地研究，按架构或建模时代来组织。我们认为，可以通过一个共同的问题来审视它们：时间序列模型如何在直接输入之外保留和访问信息？这个问题的动机来自传统时间序列建模的一个根本局限：与预测相关的信息可能位于可行输入窗口之外很远的地方，而将历史压缩为固定大小的状态可能会丢弃之后可能变得有用的信息。我们将这一挑战表述为一个“记忆”问题，并将现有的时间序列方法沿着一个从内部记忆（编码在参数和固定大小的状态中）到外部记忆的谱系进行组织……

item.title: ModularPhaseNet通过将辅助相位通道离散化为有限循环群并以纯经典整数运算实现，使标准Transformer获得可计算的语义层次结构、语义方向表示和上下文一致性度量能力。

ModularPhaseNet：面向标准Transformer中可计算语义层次、方向与上下文一致性的有限循环相位几何

DART：面向算法学习的分布式对抗递归训练

DART通过用真实解周围的局部目标分布替代单点监督，并结合对抗训练目标，显著提升了递归推理模型在迷宫、国际象棋和数独等结构化问题上的求解质量与稳定性。

递归推理模型（RRMs）能够解决结构化问题，通过在隐藏空间中进行迭代计算实现从简单到困难的泛化。这些模型通常采用实例级监督进行训练，但随着任务难度的提升，这种训练方式的问题日益凸显：有效解仅占据解空间的极小区域，而无效解却迅速增多。我们提出了分布式对抗递归训练（DART），该训练框架用真实解周围的局部目标分布取代单点监督，并通过对抗性目标使模型输出与该分布对齐。DART提供了更丰富的学习信号，并促使模型朝着有效解形成更稳定的迭代轨迹。在迷宫（Maze）、国际象棋（Chess）和掩码数独（masked Sudoku）任务上，使用包括深度思维系统和微小递归模型在内的多种递归推理模型进行评估，DART均提升了解题质量、稳定性以及……

arXiv:2609.05988v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recurrent reasoning models (RRMs) can solve structured problems, achieving easy-to-hard generalization through iterative computation in hidden space. item.description:
用于培养前ESBL风险分层以指导经验性抗生素选择的机器学习：一项涵盖12家医院的肠杆菌科细菌培养研究

Machine Learning for Pre-Culture ESBL Risk Stratification to Guide Empiric Antibiotic Selection: A 12-Hospital Study of Enterobacteriaceae Cultures

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05970

该研究开发了一种基于培养前电子健康记录特征的机器学习模型，可在培养结果出来前预测ESBL感染风险，有望在非ICU环境中帮助临床医生安全地减少碳青霉烯类药物的过度使用。

疑似产ESBL（超广谱β-内酰胺酶）肠杆菌科细菌感染的经验性抗生素治疗必须在培养结果出来前48-72小时内选择，这迫使临床医生在治疗不足（导致耐药感染得不到控制）与过度使用碳青霉烯类药物（进而加剧耐药性）之间做出艰难抉择。我们开发了一个成本敏感的XGBoost模型，在开具培养医嘱时利用45个培养前电子健康记录（EHR）特征预测ESBL表型（即对头孢曲松、头孢他啶、头孢吡肟或哌拉西林-他唑巴坦耐药）。研究数据涵盖12家医院72,217名患者的132,955份培养样本（其中14.41%为ESBL表型），培养数据在患者层面进行了划分。在90%灵敏度下，该模型达到了95.8%的阴性预测值（NPV），将检测后ESBL概率降至4.2%，这一阈值可能支持在非ICU环境中安全地避免使用碳青霉烯类药物，同时每1,000份培养中约有307份可避免不必要的广谱抗生素疗程，代价是每1,000份培养中漏诊14例ESBL病例。SHAP分析显示既往ESBL定植是……（原文摘要在此处不完整）

arXiv:2609.05970v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Empiric antibiotic therapy for suspected ESBL-producing Enterobacteriaceae must be selected 48-72 hours before culture results, forcing clinicians to choose between undertreating resistant infections and overusing carbapenems that drive further resistance. We developed a cost-sensitive XGBoost model predicting an ESBL phenotype (resistance to ceftriaxone, ceftazidime, cefepime or piperacillin-tazobactam) at culture ordering using 45 pre-culture EHR features across 132,955 cultures from 72,217 patients at 12 hospitals (14.41% with the ESBL phenotype). Cultures were partitioned at the patient level. At 90% sensitivity, the model achieved 95.8% NPV, reducing post-test ESBL probability to 4.2%, a threshold that may support safe carbapenem-sparing in non-ICU settings, while sparing 307 of every 1,000 cultures an unnecessary broad-spectrum course at the cost of 14 missed ESBL cases per 1,000. item.title: ERASE是一个无需修改模型权重的即时遗忘框架，通过类别条件化的输入扰动在推理阶段实现选择性遗忘，避免了传统遗忘方法的重训练、微调和额外内存开销。
item.description:
通过ERASE实现无需显式遗忘的即时遗忘

On-the-go Forgetting without Explicit Unlearning via ERASE

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05966

ERASE是一个无需修改模型权重的即时遗忘框架，通过类别条件化的输入扰动在推理阶段实现选择性遗忘，避免了传统遗忘方法的重训练、微调和额外内存开销。

arXiv:2609.05966v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现有的机器遗忘方法通常依赖于事后权重调整或知识蒸馏，导致重复的内存开销、泛化能力下降以及可扩展性受限。在本工作中，我们提出了ERASE（通过重构性对抗信号编辑实现擦除），这是一个即时遗忘框架，能够在不修改模型权重的情况下抑制私有数据的可观测影响。ERASE利用结构化的、类别条件化的输入扰动，在推理过程中诱导选择性遗忘，从而无需重新训练、微调或模型副本。我们严格刻画了ERASE能够可证明地实现对指定子类功能性遗忘、同时保留同一超类中其他子类预测的充分条件。这一分析在温和的正则性假设下，为推理时遗忘提供了有原则的基础。在多种架构和基准数据集上，ERASE

arXiv:2609.05966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing unlearning approaches typically rely on post hoc weight adaptation or distillation, leading to duplicated memory costs, degraded generalization, and limited scalability. In this work, we introduce ERASE, Erasure via Reconstructive Adversarial Signal Editing, a framework for on-the-go forgetting that suppresses the observable influence of private data without modifying model weights. ERASE leverages structured, class-conditioned input perturbations to induce selective forgetting during inference, eliminating the need for retraining, fine-tuning, or model copies. We rigorously characterize sufficient conditions when ERASE provably achieves functional forgetting of designated subclasses while preserving predictions across other subclasses within the same superclass. This analysis offers a principled foundation for inference-time forgetting under mild regularity assumptions. Across diverse architectures and benchmark datasets, ERASE

item.title: 提出LoGIC方法，通过在带标签上下文预算和无标签光环预算下检索并跨查询共享上下文，解决了节点级图上下文学习中注意力随带标签池二次方增长导致的预处理和内存瓶颈问题。
item.description:
LoGIC：基于预算的上下文构建用于表格基础模型的节点级图上下文学习

LoGIC: Budgeted Context Construction for Node-Level Graph In-Context Learning with Tabular Foundation Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05955

提出LoGIC方法，通过在带标签上下文预算和无标签光环预算下检索并跨查询共享上下文，解决了节点级图上下文学习中注意力随带标签池二次方增长导致的预处理和内存瓶颈问题。

表格基础模型已成为强大的图学习器。诸如G2T-FM和GraphPFN等系统将每个节点编码为特征行，并通过上下文学习（ICL）进行预测，其中带标签的行作为提示。当前的协议使用完整的训练表作为上下文，导致注意力随带标签池的规模呈二次方增长，并引入了预处理和内存瓶颈。我们研究节点级图ICL的上下文构建问题：哪些带标签节点和辅助的无标签节点应该构成指定查询的提示。我们从两种资源的角度来表述这种分配：用于预测证据的带标签上下文预算，以及用于适配器消息传递且不占用标签容量的无标签光环预算。我们提出了LoGIC，它通过结构、特征和覆盖三种通道检索带标签节点，在图局部聚类内的查询之间共享上下文，并结合…

arXiv:2609.05955v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tabular foundation models have become powerful graph learners. Systems such as G2T-FM and GraphPFN encode each node as a feature row and make predictions through in-context learning (ICL), with labeled rows serving as the prompt. Current protocols employ the complete training table as context, causing attention to scale quadratically with the labeled pool and introducing preprocessing and memory bottlenecks. We investigate context construction for node-level graph ICL: which labeled nodes and auxiliary unlabeled nodes should constitute the prompt for specified queries. We formulate this allocation in terms of two resources: a labeled-context budget for predictive evidence and an unlabeled-halo budget for adapter message passing without using label capacity. item.title: 本文提出基于量子颗粒球的加权K近邻分类框架QGB-W$k$NN，通过量子增强颗粒球表示、层次化近邻搜索和纯度感知加权决策机制，同时提升了计算效率与噪声环境下的分类鲁棒性。
item.description:
QGB-W$k$NN：基于量子颗粒球学习的鲁棒分类方法

QGB-W$k$NN: Quantum Granular-Ball Learning for Robust Classification

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05952

本文提出基于量子颗粒球的加权K近邻分类框架QGB-W$k$NN，通过量子增强颗粒球表示、层次化近邻搜索和纯度感知加权决策机制，同时提升了计算效率与噪声环境下的分类鲁棒性。

近邻分类在机器学习中被广泛应用，然而现有方法往往存在计算效率低以及在噪声环境中鲁棒性有限的问题。为了同时应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种基于量子颗粒球的高效且可靠的加权K近邻分类框架，称为QGB-W$k$NN。该框架通过将量子增强的颗粒球表示与层次化近邻搜索相结合来提升计算效率，同时通过一种纯度感知的加权决策机制来增强分类的可靠性。具体而言，构建量子核颗粒球以减少检索冗余，并在有限量子资源下强化非线性特征表示。此外，开发了一种由颗粒球纯度引导的HNSW优化策略，在近邻搜索的层次图构建过程中利用结构可靠性信息……

arXiv:2609.05952v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nearest-neighbor classification is widely used in machine learning, yet existing methods often suffer from low computational efficiency and limited robustness in noisy environments. To jointly address these challenges, this paper proposes an efficient and reliable weighted $K$-nearest neighbor classification framework based on quantum granular balls, termed QGB-W$k$NN. The proposed framework improves computational efficiency by integrating quantum-enhanced granular-ball representation with hierarchical nearest-neighbor search, while enhancing classification reliability through a purity-aware weighted decision mechanism. Specifically, quantum-kernel granular balls are constructed to reduce retrieval redundancy and strengthen nonlinear feature representation under limited quantum resources. item.title: 本文提出多目标神经基模型（MONBM），通过引入可解释性的显式定量指标，首次实现了基于神经网络的广义可加模型中可解释性与公平性的同时优化，并深入分析了两者的权衡关系。
item.description:
通过多目标学习实现可解释且公平的广义可加神经网络

Interpretable and Fair Generalized Additive Neural Networks via Multi-objective Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05946

本文提出多目标神经基模型（MONBM），通过引入可解释性的显式定量指标，首次实现了基于神经网络的广义可加模型中可解释性与公平性的同时优化，并深入分析了两者的权衡关系。

可解释性和公平性是可信人工智能（AI）中最受重视的两个维度。为了提高可解释性，已有多种可解释AI方法被提出。本文聚焦于基于神经网络（NN）的广义可加模型（GAM），这是一类自解释模型。虽然现有研究大多优先考虑提高基于神经网络的广义可加模型的准确性，但其可解释性在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，本文引入了用于评估基于神经网络的广义可加模型可解释性的显式定量指标，通过实验验证了这些指标的有效性，并探索了提升这些模型可解释性的策略。此外，可解释性与公平性的同时显式优化，以及两者之间的权衡及其深层原因，也仍然缺乏充分研究。为此，我们提出了一种多目标神经基模型（MONBM）。

arXiv:2609.05946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interpretability and fairness are two of the most emphasized dimensions in trustworthy artificial intelligence (AI). Various explainable AI methods have been introduced to improve interpretability. This paper focuses on neural network (NN)-based generalized additive models (GAMs), a class of self-interpretable models. While most existing research has prioritized improving the accuracy of NN-based GAMs, their interpretability remains largely underexplored. To address this gap, this paper introduces explicit quantitative metrics for evaluating the interpretability of NN-based GAMs, empirically examines their effectiveness, and explores strategies for improving interpretability within these models. In addition, the simultaneous and explicit optimization of both interpretability and fairness, along with their trade-offs and the underlying reasons, remains underexplored. item.title: 本文指出现有多智能体系统效率方法的评估可能高估了其真实效果，并提出一个受控且对MAS有需求的诊断基准，在共享环境下公平地评估这些效率方法。
item.description:
重新思考多智能体系统效率评估方法

Rethinking the Evaluation of Efficiency Methods for Multi-Agent Systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05933

本文指出现有多智能体系统效率方法的评估可能高估了其真实效果，并提出一个受控且对MAS有需求的诊断基准，在共享环境下公平地评估这些效率方法。

效率对于基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）日益重要，因为更大的模型和更多的智能体会带来可观的执行成本。最近的方法旨在通过剪枝智能体、移除通信边或搜索紧凑结构来降低MAS的成本。然而，我们认为现有的评估可能高估了这些方法真正提升MAS效率的能力。所报告的收益通常是在特定于方法的提示词和起始拓扑下测量的，因此难以将其归因于所提出的结构改变。此外，许多报告的成功案例出现在对MAS需求不高的场景中——在这些场景下，单个智能体或随机剪枝的系统已经能够保持强大的性能。为了研究这些问题，我们引入了一个受控且对MAS有需求的诊断基准，用于评估代表性的MAS效率方法。我们在共享的骨干模型、智能体注册表和运行时环境下对这些方法进行评估。

arXiv:2609.05933v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficiency is increasingly important for Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS), as larger models and more agents introduce substantial execution costs. Recent methods aim to make MAS cheaper by pruning agents, removing communication edges, or searching for compact structures. However, we argue that existing evaluations may overestimate their true ability to improve MAS efficiency. Reported gains are often measured under method-specific prompts and starting topologies, making them difficult to attribute to the proposed structural changes. Moreover, many reported successes appear in non-MAS-demanding settings, where a single agent or a randomly pruned system can already preserve strong performance. To study these issues, we introduce a controlled and MAS-demanding diagnostic benchmark for representative MAS efficiency methods. We evaluate methods under a shared backbone model, agent registry, and runtime, across contro

item.title: 本文提出了一种基于滤波图距离与最优传输的图字典学习框架，将图表示为滤波拉普拉斯导出的高斯分布，通过可端到端优化的sfGOT距离实现图的重构，并从HSIC视角给出了新的理论解释。
item.description:
基于滤波器和最优传输的图字典学习框架

A dictionary learning framework for graphs via filters and optimal transport

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05919

本文提出了一种基于滤波图距离与最优传输的图字典学习框架，将图表示为滤波拉普拉斯导出的高斯分布，通过可端到端优化的sfGOT距离实现图的重构，并从HSIC视角给出了新的理论解释。

我们提出了一种图字典学习（GDL）框架，其中每个图被表示为由其滤波拉普拉斯矩阵导出的零均值高斯分布。每个观测图通过在学到的原子图上计算的重心（barycenter）来近似，该计算基于滤波图距离（fGOT），这是一种对全局结构性质敏感的图比较度量。观测图与其重心之间的重构误差由代理滤波图距离（sfGOT）来度量，它是fGOT的一种易于处理的近似，能够处理没有已知节点对应关系的图，并通过反向传播进行端到端的最小化。我们进一步通过希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion）的视角为sfGOT提供了新颖的解释，表明最小化两个图之间的sfGOT距离等价于最大化其节点谱嵌入之间的统计依赖性。在基准数据集上的实验展示了有竞争力的性能。

arXiv:2609.05919v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a graph dictionary learning (GDL) framework where each graph is represented as a zero-mean Gaussian distribution derived from its filtered Laplacian. Each observed graph is approximated by a barycenter over learned atom graphs, computed under the filter graph distance (fGOT), a graph comparison metric sensitive to global structural properties. The reconstruction error between the observed graph and its barycenter is measured by the surrogate fGOT (sfGOT) distance, a tractable approximation of fGOT that handles graphs without known node correspondence, and is minimized end-to-end via backpropagation. We further provide a novel interpretation of sfGOT through the lens of the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, showing that minimizing the sfGOT distance between two graphs is equivalent to maximizing statistical dependence between the spectral embedding of their nodes. item.title: 该论文提出了一种溯源感知的执行图与“影响距离”新度量，证明在有状态的长时程LLM智能体中，仅凭时间步骤数衡量攻击距离会高估安全隔离，并通过“间隔”量化被步骤数掩盖的真实安全暴露。
item.description:
结构上相近，时间上遥远：测量长时程LLM智能体的安全暴露

Structurally Close, Temporally Distant: Measuring Security Exposure in Long-Horizon LLM Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05911

该论文提出了一种溯源感知的执行图与“影响距离”新度量，证明在有状态的长时程LLM智能体中，仅凭时间步骤数衡量攻击距离会高估安全隔离，并通过“间隔”量化被步骤数掩盖的真实安全暴露。

长时程LLM智能体需要与不可信内容、持久记忆、外部状态以及敏感工具进行交互。现有分析通常通过恶意输入与下游动作之间的执行步骤数来刻画攻击。我们证明了在有状态的智能体中，时间上的遥远程度可能会夸大安全隔离的效果。我们引入了一种溯源感知的执行图，通过确定性的状态、标识符和工具溯源将智能体事件关联起来，并将影响距离 $\DI$ 定义为从不可信源到敏感动作的最短结构路径。我们将其与序列距离 $\DT$ 进行比较，后者是有序轨迹中从注入点到敏感汇聚点的最短路径。由于影响图包含所有序列边，因此 $\DI \leq \DT$；而 $\Gap=\DT-\DI$ 度量的是被步骤数所掩盖的隔离程度。在基于OpenAI的gpt-4o-mini等模型的360条长时程AgentDojo轨迹中的454个注入-汇聚对上（摘要截断）

arXiv:2609.05911v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents interact with untrusted content, persistent memory, external state, and sensitive tools. Existing analyses often characterize attacks by the number of execution steps between malicious input and a downstream action. We show that temporal remoteness can overstate security separation in stateful agents. We introduce a provenance-aware execution graph linking agent events through deterministic state, identifier, and tool provenance, and define \emph{influence distance} $\DI$ as the shortest structural path from an untrusted source to a sensitive action. We compare it with \emph{sequence distance} $\DT$, the shortest injection--sink path in the ordered trajectory. Since the influence graph contains every sequence edge, $\DI \leq \DT$; $\Gap=\DT-\DI$ measures the separation hidden by step count. item.title: 提出AuditForecast结构化预测支架，通过基线模型锚定、模型引导的数据检索以及赔率空间中的机械聚合，将LLM智能体预测从隐式叙事判断转变为具有明确中间步骤的可审计过程。
item.description:
从叙事到可审计的预测：一种用于智能体预测的结构化支架

From Narrative to Auditable Forecasts: A Structured Scaffold for Agentic Forecasting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05905

提出AuditForecast结构化预测支架，通过基线模型锚定、模型引导的数据检索以及赔率空间中的机械聚合，将LLM智能体预测从隐式叙事判断转变为具有明确中间步骤的可审计过程。

大语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地被用于实时预测任务，它们检索最新信息并对尚未解决的未来事件做出概率估计。然而，当前的智能体预测往往依赖于隐式的叙事式聚合：智能体收集证据，以散文形式进行讨论，然后在没有从证据到预测的明确更新路径的情况下直接给出概率。这既限制了预测准确性，也限制了可审计性。我们提出了AuditForecast，一个用于结构化概率预测的智能体支架。AuditForecast首先使用合适的定量基线模型锚定预测，通过模型引导的数据检索得出基础概率，然后通过在赔率空间中的机械聚合，将模型范围之外的情势因素更新纳入预测。这将预测从基于文本叙述的判断转变为具有明确中间对象的结构化过程。在多个实时预测基准测试中，AuditForecast（原文此处截断）……

arXiv:2609.05905v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for live forecasting, where they retrieve up-to-date information and produce estimates for unresolved future events. However, current agentic forecasting often relies on implicit narrative aggregation: agents collect evidence, discuss it in prose, and often assign a probability without an explicit update path from evidence to forecast. This limits both forecasting accuracy and auditability. We propose AuditForecast, an agentic scaffold for structured probabilistic forecasting. AuditForecast first anchors the forecast with a suitable quantitative baseline model, uses model-guided data retrieval to derive a base probability, and then applies situational factor updates outside the model's scope through mechanical aggregation in odds space. This turns forecasting from a prose-based judgment into a structured process with explicit intermediate objects. Across multiple live forecasting benchmarks, AuditForeca

item.title: 该论文提出极性非对称结构校准框架PASC，通过目标边结构先验得分与局部符号上下文线索的冲突残差来校准符号注意力聚合，提升了符号网络链接符号预测在严重符号不平衡和局部冲突场景下的鲁棒性。
item.description:
链接符号预测的极性非对称结构校准

Polarity-Asymmetric Structural Calibration for Link Sign Prediction

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05896

该论文提出极性非对称结构校准框架PASC，通过目标边结构先验得分与局部符号上下文线索的冲突残差来校准符号注意力聚合，提升了符号网络链接符号预测在严重符号不平衡和局部冲突场景下的鲁棒性。

链接符号预测（LSP）旨在推断符号网络中未观测链接的正负极性。符号图神经网络（SGNNs）通常依赖符号图的结构先验，包括结构平衡和类同质性相似性，来指导消息传递和预测。然而，这些先验描述的是群体层面的倾向性，而非对个体目标边的保证。在严重的符号不平衡情况下，这些先验失效的代价尤为高昂，因为少数派和局部冲突关系上的错误更难被检测和纠正。我们提出了极性非对称结构校准（PASC），一个面向符号链接预测的目标边结构先验校准框架。PASC构建仅基于结构的先验表示，估计目标边的结构先验得分，并将该得分与局部符号上下文线索进行比较，从而得出冲突残差。该残差用于校准符号注意力聚合……

arXiv:2609.05896v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Link sign prediction (LSP) aims to infer the positive or negative polarity of unobserved links in signed networks. Signed Graph Neural Networks (SGNNs) usually rely on signed-graph structural priors, including structural balance and homophily-like similarity, to guide message passing and prediction. These priors describe population-level tendencies, not guarantees for individual target edges. Their failures are especially costly under severe sign imbalance, where errors on minority and locally conflicting relations are harder to detect and correct. We propose Polarity-Asymmetric Structural Calibration (PASC), a target-edge structural-prior calibration framework for signed link prediction. PASC constructs a structure-only prior representation, estimates a target-edge structural prior score, and compares this score with a local signed-context cue to derive a conflict residual. The residual calibrates signed attention aggregation, target-

item.title: 该论文提出了一种无需求解线性规划的一阶学习策略，在请求到达概率未知的在线资源分配问题中实现了与时域长度无关的常数期望后悔界。
item.description:
一种具有常数后悔的在线资源分配一阶学习算法

A First-Order Learning Algorithm for Online Resource Allocation with Constant Regret

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05895

该论文提出了一种无需求解线性规划的一阶学习策略，在请求到达概率未知的在线资源分配问题中实现了与时域长度无关的常数期望后悔界。

我们研究了一个有限时域的在线资源分配问题，其中初始资源容量与时域长度成比例。在每个周期，会观察到一种请求类型，并从有限的动作菜单中选择一个动作。每个动作会获得一份奖励并消耗一个资源向量。请求到达类型是独立同分布的，但其概率是未知的。我们提出了一种原始一阶学习策略，在每个周期中，仅对与当前请求类型相关的动作坐标执行一次梯度上升更新。该策略实现了相对于事后最优解的 O(1) 期望加性后悔，且该后悔界与时域长度 T 无关。该策略不需要求解任何线性规划，并且其后悔界不要求流体线性规划满足非退化假设。

arXiv:2609.05895v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a finite-horizon online resource allocation problem with initial resource capacities proportional to the horizon. In each period, a request type is observed and one action is chosen from a finite menu. Each action earns a reward and consumes a vector of resources. The arrival types are independent and identically distributed, but their probabilities are unknown. We present a primal first-order learning policy that, in each period, performs one gradient ascent update of the action coordinates associated with the current request type. The policy achieves $O(1)$ expected additive regret relative to the hindsight optimum, with a bound independent of the horizon $T$. It does not solve any linear program, and the regret bound does not require a nondegeneracy assumption on the fluid linear program.

item.title: 提出AnLR-LoRA，一种为LoRA适配器的每个秩一分量自适应分配有效学习率的各向异性方法，该方法利用AdamW优化中的函数空间速度和Adam信噪比在线计算学习率并按模块归一化，解决了统一学习率惯例忽视模块内异质性、导致秩预算利用不足的问题。
item.description:
一种学习率是不够的：用于LoRA微调的自适应各向异性学习率

One Rate Is Not Enough: Adaptive Anisotropic Learning Rates for LoRA Fine-Tuning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05885

提出AnLR-LoRA，一种为LoRA适配器的每个秩一分量自适应分配有效学习率的各向异性方法，该方法利用AdamW优化中的函数空间速度和Adam信噪比在线计算学习率并按模块归一化，解决了统一学习率惯例忽视模块内异质性、导致秩预算利用不足的问题。

低秩适应（LoRA）已成为大语言模型参数高效微调的标准方法。大多数LoRA变体遵循统一学习率的惯例，即对所有适配器的每个秩一分量应用单一的全局学习率。我们表明，这一惯例忽视了模块内部显著的异质性：LoRA适配器的秩一分量以极不均匀的速率更新，且低速度模块会收敛到集中的奇异谱，从而未能充分利用标称的秩预算。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种自适应各向异性学习率模型，为每个秩一分量分配其自身的有效学习率，该学习率根据训练过程中的信号在线计算，并在每个模块内进行均值归一化以保持全局学习率预算。AnLR-LoRA利用AdamW优化期间可获得的两种信号（即函数空间速度和Adam信噪比）来实例化该模型，作为一种轻量级方案，无需额外的可训练参数。

arXiv:2609.05885v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become the standard for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models. Most LoRA variants follow a uniform-LR convention, applying a single global learning rate across every rank-one component of every adapter. We show that this convention overlooks substantial within-module heterogeneity, where the rank-one components of a LoRA adapter update at highly uneven rates and low-velocity modules converge to concentrated singular spectra that underutilize the nominal rank budget. To address this, we propose an adaptive anisotropic learning-rate model that assigns each rank-one component its own effective learning rate, computed online from training-time signals and mean-normalized per module to preserve the global LR budget. AnLR-LoRA instantiates this model with two signals available during AdamW optimization, namely function-space velocity and Adam SNR, as a lightweight scheme with no extra trainable

item.title: 提出CALM方法，在去中心化联邦蒸馏中以平滑的多层信任门控（类级一致性加权和样本级分歧调制）取代现有硬性的全有或全无决策，从而提升严重非独立同分布数据下的模型聚合可信度和精度。
item.description:
CALM：面向去中心化联邦学习的类级一致性与标签门控分歧调制

CALM: Class-wise Agreement and Label-gated Disagreement Modulation for Decentralized Federated Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05884

提出CALM方法，在去中心化联邦蒸馏中以平滑的多层信任门控（类级一致性加权和样本级分歧调制）取代现有硬性的全有或全无决策，从而提升严重非独立同分布数据下的模型聚合可信度和精度。

传统联邦学习依赖于参数平均，这要求客户端具有双重同质性：所有客户端必须运行完全相同的模型架构，且当本地数据为非独立同分布（non-IID）时精度会显著下降。去中心化联邦蒸馏则同时规避了这两个问题：每个客户端将其他客户端的模型快照作为教师模型，在本地数据上运行并从其软预测中进行蒸馏，无需服务器、无需公共数据、也无需共享架构。然而，在严重的非独立同分布数据偏斜下，聚合教师目标的可信度是一个程度问题，而现有流程却做出硬性的全有或全无决策：离群教师被阈值直接丢弃，而幸存下来的目标则被完全信任。我们提出了CALM，它在三个层面上用平滑的信任门控取代所有硬性决策：在类别层面，教师根据与同伴共识的一致性进行加权；在样本层面，蒸馏强度根据教师与该目标的分歧程度进行调制；以及一个……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.05884v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional federated learning relies on parameter averaging, which forces clients to be doubly homogeneous: all must run an identical architecture, and accuracy degrades when local data are non-IID. Decentralized federated distillation sidesteps both: each client runs its peers' model snapshots as teachers on its own local data and distills from their soft predictions, with no server, no public data, and no shared architecture. Under severe non-IID skew, however, the trustworthiness of the aggregated teacher target is a matter of degree, yet existing pipelines make hard, all-or-nothing decisions: outlier teachers are discarded by threshold, and whatever target survives is trusted in full. We propose CALM, which replaces every hard decision with a smooth trust gate at three levels: per class, teachers are weighted by agreement with the peer consensus; per sample, distillation is scaled by the teachers' divergence from that target; and a

item.title: 首次系统性冒烟测试了公共模型注册库中的327个量化GGUF模型制品，发现官方Ollama库中存在五个静默失效的量化模型转换制品，并提出了一套可有效捕获此类缺陷的检测流程。
item.description:
出厂即坏：公共模型注册库中静默失效的大语言模型制品及其检测方法

Broken on Arrival: Silently Defective LLM Artifacts in Public Model Registries and How to Catch Them

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05881

首次系统性冒烟测试了公共模型注册库中的327个量化GGUF模型制品，发现官方Ollama库中存在五个静默失效的量化模型转换制品，并提出了一套可有效捕获此类缺陷的检测流程。

开发者越来越多地通过从公共模型注册库拉取量化GGUF制品来在本地运行大语言模型，然而整个分发流程中没有任何环节在用户获取这些转换产物之前对其进行功能性测试。我们共执行了327个具备代码能力的量化模型制品：其中305个来自官方Ollama库，涵盖15个模型系列在8GB及以下所有符合条件的量化级别；另外22个来自HuggingFace上下载量最高的社区仓库。每个制品运行一个包含15项任务的冒烟测试套件，该套件经过校准，健康的制品能够通过，而已知损坏的制品则会失败；疑似有问题的制品随后将接受完整的164项任务评估、第二种推理后端的测试、由独立分发商对同一模型和量化级别进行转换作为仲裁，对于社区文件，还会在制品自身的模板下重新测试。官方库中存在五个静默失效的制品，包括一批四个Qwen2.5-Coder-3B转换版本和一个phi3.5-mini转换版本……

arXiv:2609.05881v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Developers increasingly run large language models locally by pulling quantized GGUF artifacts from public registries, yet nothing in the distribution pipeline functionally tests these conversions before they reach users. We executed 327 quantized code-capable model artifacts: 305 from the official Ollama library, spanning 15 model lines at every eligible quantization level at or under 8 GB, and 22 from the most-downloaded community repositories on HuggingFace. Each ran a 15-task smoke suite calibrated so that healthy artifacts pass while a known-broken one fails; suspects then faced full 164-task evaluation, a second inference backend, an independent distributor's conversion of the same model and quantization as referee, and, for community files, re-testing under the artifact's own template. item.title: 本文提出从P&ID图纸中恢复显式证据图，并约束视觉语言模型仅通过七个只读算子查询该图作答、使拓扑结论必须引用支持的查询结果，从而将TopoPID-VQA上的精确匹配准确率从约36.7–41.3%大幅提升至约74%。
item.description:
有依据且忠实的管道与仪表图推理：利用恢复的证据图约束视觉语言模型

Grounded and Faithful P&ID Reasoning: Constraining Vision-Language Models with Recovered Evidence Graphs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05880

本文提出从P&ID图纸中恢复显式证据图，并约束视觉语言模型仅通过七个只读算子查询该图作答、使拓扑结论必须引用支持的查询结果，从而将TopoPID-VQA上的精确匹配准确率从约36.7–41.3%大幅提升至约74%。

管道与仪表图（P&ID）是过程工厂的权威地图：隔离、维护和HAZOP决策都依赖于“什么连接到什么”。视觉语言模型能够流畅地描述这些图纸，但它们经常虚构或遗漏工艺连接——而一个被虚构或遗漏的连接可能颠覆隔离或可达性判断，因此工厂决策不能信任从未对照图纸线条核查过的流畅回答。我们转而恢复图纸的显式图结构——包括其符号、符号之间的工艺连接以及命名它们的标签——然后要求模型仅通过七个只读算子查询该图来作答，从而保证只有当拓扑断言引用了支持它的查询结果时才会被返回。在TopoPID-VQA（一个针对这些图纸、包含3000个拓扑问题的新测试集）上，图接地框架（Graph-Grounded Harness，本文方法）将精确匹配准确率从仅图像提示下的36.7–41.3%提升到74%（原文截断于此）。

arXiv:2609.05880v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) are the authoritative maps of process plants: isolation, maintenance, and HAZOP decisions depend on what connects to what. Vision-language models describe these sheets fluently, yet they often invent or miss process connections---and an invented or missed link can reverse an isolation or reachability call, so a plant decision cannot trust a fluent answer that was never checked against the linework. We instead recover an explicit graph of the drawing---its symbols, the process connections between them, and the tags that name them---and then require the model to answer only by querying that graph through seven read-only operators, so a topology claim is returned only when it cites the query results that support it. On TopoPID-VQA, a new suite of 3000 topology questions over these sheets, Graph-Grounded Harness (Ours) raises exact match accuracy from 36.7--41.3% under image-only prompting to 74.

item.title: 本研究揭示了机器学习原子间势训练集选择中，覆盖度导向与响应导向（基于模型分歧）两种策略的优劣会随数据保留预算的变化而发生交叉转变，表明单一训练集规模下的比较不足以确定最优选择策略。
