机器学习原子间势训练集选择中覆盖度导向与响应导向方法之间随数据预算变化的交叉转变

A budget-dependent crossover between coverage- and response-based training-set selection for machine-learned interatomic potentials

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05877

本研究揭示了机器学习原子间势训练集选择中，覆盖度导向与响应导向（基于模型分歧）两种策略的优劣会随数据保留预算的变化而发生交叉转变，表明单一训练集规模下的比较不足以确定最优选择策略。

为机器学习原子间势选择紧凑训练集时，需要决定是保留结构的多样性，还是针对模型之间存在分歧的构型。哪种选择更优可能取决于保留多少数据，因此仅在单一训练集规模下进行比较是不充分的。本研究通过对GAP-20 Carbon和合并修订版MD17数据集上重新训练的MACE模型进行按数据预算分辨的比较，将选择标准与预测精度联系起来。研究者将结构覆盖度方法与一种响应导向选择器进行对比，后者针对覆盖度训练模型与全数据参考模型之间的分歧。这种回溯性响应见证方法检验了模型分歧对于压缩已标记数据池的价值。在5%数据保留率下，在两个数据集的四个力端点上，覆盖度方法相比随机采样与全数据误差的绝对偏差更小。见证方法在1%和5%时比覆盖度方法偏差更大，但排序关系……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.05877v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Selecting compact training sets for machine-learned interatomic potentials requires deciding whether to preserve structural diversity or target configurations on which models disagree. The better choice can depend on how much data is retained, making a comparison at one training-set size insufficient. Here we link selection criteria to prediction accuracy through a budget-resolved comparison of retrained MACE models on GAP-20 Carbon and pooled revised MD17. Structural coverage is compared with a response-guided selector that targets disagreement between a coverage-trained model and a full-data reference. This retrospective response witness tests the value of model disagreement for compressing an already labelled pool. At 5\%, coverage gives smaller absolute deviations from the full-data error than random sampling across four force endpoints in both datasets. item.title: 本文提出轻量级框架Scout，能在预算约束下学习查询动态网络中每个节点对下游任务的价值，从而智能地选择性刷新过时的图信息，在绝大多数基准设置中取得最优下游性能。
item.description:
预算约束下面向任务的动态网络信息获取

Budgeted Task-Aware Acquisition of Dynamic Networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05862

本文提出轻量级框架Scout，能在预算约束下学习查询动态网络中每个节点对下游任务的价值，从而智能地选择性刷新过时的图信息，在绝大多数基准设置中取得最优下游性能。

当底层网络的变化只能被部分观测时，在动态图上进行学习变得十分困难。获取最新的图信息会产生观测成本和计算成本，使得在资源受限的条件下进行完整更新并不现实。本文聚焦于动态网络上预算约束下的任务感知获取问题，即模型需要决定应为下游任务刷新哪些过时的图信息。我们提出了Scout，一个轻量级框架，它能够从所维护的图和观测历史中学习查询每个节点所带来的任务价值。我们的评估涵盖一个合成动态网络和四个真实世界动态网络、两个下游任务、九种获取基线方法以及多种查询预算。Scout在21个基准-预算设置中的19个中取得了最高的平均下游性能。在16个真实世界设置中的13个中，任务效用监督也优于结构变化监督。在同一动态网络上，任务

arXiv:2609.05862v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Learning on dynamic graphs is difficult when changes in the underlying network are only partially observed. Acquiring current graph information incurs observation and computational costs, making complete updates impractical under limited resources. This paper focuses on budgeted task-aware acquisition on dynamic networks, where a model needs to decide which stale graph information to refresh for a downstream task. We propose Scout, a lightweight framework that learns the task value of querying each node from the maintained graph and observation history. Our evaluation covers one synthetic and four real-world dynamic networks, two downstream tasks, nine acquisition baselines, and several query budgets. Scout achieves the highest mean downstream performance in 19 of the 21 benchmark-budget settings. item.title: 本文提出一种基于稳定性感知约束PPO（带自适应拉格朗日惩罚）的强化学习框架，用于5G NG-RAN的SLA安全节能控制，在保障用户QoS和SLA的前提下动态优化小区节能模式切换。

使用稳定性感知约束PPO的AI原生NG-RAN的SLA安全节能控制

SLA-Safe Energy Control for AI-Native NG-RAN Using Stability-Aware Constrained PPO

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05861

本文提出一种基于稳定性感知约束PPO（带自适应拉格朗日惩罚）的强化学习框架，用于5G NG-RAN的SLA安全节能控制，在保障用户QoS和SLA的前提下动态优化小区节能模式切换。

一个重要的AI赋能无线接入网（AI-for-RAN）应用场景是节能，其中需要对无线资源和小区节能模式进行动态控制，同时不能违反用户服务质量（QoS）或服务等级协议（SLA）的要求。然而，激进的休眠状态或去激活决策可能会以吞吐量下降、延迟增加、SLA违规以及不稳定的模式切换为代价来降低能耗，尤其是在时变和突发的流量条件下。本文提出了一种面向5G NG-RAN中SLA安全节能控制的稳定性感知约束强化学习框架。该问题被建模为一个约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），其中AI原生控制器基于小区负载、队列状态、活跃用户信息、当前节能模式以及SLA相关指标来选择闭环节能动作。所提出的框架采用带自适应拉格朗日惩罚的约束近端策略优化（PPO）……

However, aggressive sleep-state or deactivation decisions may reduce energy consumption at the cost of throughput degradation, delay increase, SLA violations, and unstable mode switching, especially under time-varying and bursty traffic conditions. This paper proposes a stability-aware constrained reinforcement learning framework for SLA-safe energy control in 5G NG-RAN. The problem is formulated as a constrained Markov decision process in which an AI-native controller selects closed-loop energy-saving actions based on cell load, queue status, active-user information, current energy mode, and SLA-related indicators. item.description:
超越任意几何：神经偏微分方程算子的拓扑泛化

Beyond Arbitrary Geometry: Topology Generalization In neural PDE Operators

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05860

该论文引入TopoBox-3D基准并通过霍奇热流的受控分析，揭示了神经PDE算子拓扑泛化的主要困难来自谱特性（初始瑞利商是最稳定的误差预测指标）而非调和维度变化，且显式拓扑坐标信息并不总是最优方案。

接受任意网格输入的神经算子通常被视为具有几何通用性，但未见过的域拓扑会同时改变偏微分方程算子的不变子空间和衰减子空间。我们使用霍奇热流作为受控视角来考察这一区别，并引入了TopoBox-3D基准，其中隧道和空腔改变贝蒂数支撑，同时精确的霍奇分解将调和核与正谱分离。在六种架构中，隐式推断拓扑的模型在45个模型-任务拓扑分布外组合中的37个遭受了过度的匹配退化，然而改变调和维度的情形平均而言并未受到更强的惩罚。主要的困难反而是谱方面的：初始瑞利商是误差最稳定的预测指标，而谱展宽为边链和面链增添了信息。最引人注目的是，受控探针实验表明，显式的关联矩阵与调和坐标并不能带来最佳的核一致性准确率……

arXiv:2609.05860v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural operators that accept arbitrary meshes are often treated as geometry-general, but unseen domain topology changes both the invariant and decaying subspaces of a PDE operator. We use Hodge heat flow as a controlled lens on this distinction and introduce TopoBox-3D, where tunnels and cavities vary Betti support while the exact Hodge decomposition separates the harmonic kernel from the positive spectrum. Across six architectures, models that infer topology implicitly suffer excess matched degradation in 37 of 45 model--task topology-OOD cells, yet cases that change harmonic dimension are not more strongly penalized on average. The dominant difficulty is instead spectral: the initial Rayleigh quotient is the most stable predictor of error, and spectral broadening adds information for edge and face cochains. item.description:

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05859

提出选择性后验边际正则化（SPMR），在保留前向校正目标的基础上，将反向后验主导类别与标注的不一致转化为按后验间隔分级缩放的成对边际更新，从而有效抑制网络对噪声标签的记忆。

在类条件标签噪声下进行学习通常依赖于一个从潜在干净类别到观测标注的转移模型。前向校正将这种转移嵌入到似然中，然而有限样本的网络仍然可能记忆损坏的标签。校正后的似然还会诱导出一个关于干净类别的反向后验，该后验可以解释每个标注。当其主导类别与标注不一致时，模型和转移矩阵提供了反对该标注的证据，但主导的备选类别可能仍然几乎持平。我们提出了选择性后验边际正则化（SPMR），该方法保留前向目标函数，并将这种不一致转化为对干净分类器的分级更新。SPMR选择主导的反向后验类别，利用两个主导后验类别之间的间隔来缩放一个分离的成对边际，并对模糊冲突赋予相应较小的影响力。该差距...

arXiv:2609.05859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Learning with class-conditional label noise often relies on a transition model from latent clean classes to observed annotations. Forward correction embeds this transition in the likelihood, yet finite-sample networks may still memorize corrupted labels. The corrected likelihood also induces a reverse posterior over the clean classes that could explain each annotation. When its leading class differs from the annotation, the model and transition matrix provide evidence against that annotation, but the leading alternatives can remain nearly tied. We introduce Selective Posterior Margin Regularization (SPMR), which preserves the Forward objective and converts this disagreement into a graded update on the clean classifier. SPMR selects the leading reverse-posterior class, scales a detached pairwise margin by the separation between the two leading posterior classes, and assigns correspondingly little influence to diffuse conflicts. item.title: 提出统一检测框架SAFEGuard，结合基于跨层分布距离与困惑度的混合流畅度测量以及基于梯度匹配的有害语义分析，有效检测针对LLM的基于优化的越狱攻击。
item.description:
SAFEGuard：通过有害语义分析和流畅度测量检测基于优化的越狱攻击

SAFEGuard: Detect Optimization-Based Jailbreak Attacks Through Harmful Semantic Analysis and Fluency Measurement

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05850

提出统一检测框架SAFEGuard，结合基于跨层分布距离与困惑度的混合流畅度测量以及基于梯度匹配的有害语义分析，有效检测针对LLM的基于优化的越狱攻击。

尽管人们在将大型语言模型（LLM）与人类价值观对齐并确保其安全部署方面付出了巨大努力，但最近的研究表明，LLM仍然容易受到对抗性越狱攻击，这些攻击能够绕过安全防护机制并引发有害响应。目前已有许多防御方法被提出来检测越狱攻击，但它们在应对广泛的基于优化的越狱机制方面效果有限，这类机制可以生成高度流畅优化或有害语义混淆的提示。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个统一的检测框架SAFEGuard，它结合了基于跨层分布距离和困惑度的混合流畅度测量方法，以及通过梯度匹配进行的有害语义分析。我们的方法基于一个至关重要的观察：高流畅度的提示其恶意意图与有害提示保持接近，而有害语义混淆的提示通常……

arXiv:2609.05850v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Despite the significant efforts devoted to aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values and ensuring safe deployment, recent work has revealed that LLMs remain vulnerable to adversarial jailbreak attacks that can bypass safety guardrails and elicit harmful responses. Many defense methods are proposed to detect jailbreaks but they are limited in their effectiveness to counter wide-range optimization-based jailbreak mechanisms that can yield highly fluency-optimized or harmful semantic obfuscated prompts. 提出FAIR方法，通过坐标特征与自注意力机制直接学习函数对函数回归中系数面的复杂支撑结构，实现局部与全局尺度的自适应信息共享，并在稀疏与平滑约束下获得边界连贯的局部化估计。

在函数对函数回归中，系数面 β(s,t) 可能表现出复杂的支撑结构——从局部斑块到诸如不连通区域、带状或环状等全局模式——此时效应相似性与欧氏邻近性并不一致。依赖固定基展开的投影方法可能会掩盖这种结构，而直接平滑方法则存在过度平滑曲面及其边界的风险。我们提出了函数型注意力可解释回归（FAIR），该方法通过坐标特征直接表示 β(s,t)，并利用自注意力机制学习效应自适应的邻域，从而实现局部和全局尺度上的信息共享。一个标量压缩网络将这些学习到的表示映射到系数面上。在这些邻域上施加的稀疏性与平滑性惩罚促进了具有连贯边界的局部化支撑。我们建立了筛等价理论以...

arXiv:2609.05846v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In function-on-function regression, the coefficient surface $\beta(s,t)$ may exhibit complex support structure---from localized patches to global patterns such as disconnected regions, bands, or rings---where effect similarity does not align with Euclidean proximity. Projection-based methods that rely on fixed basis expansions can obscure such structure, while direct smoothing approaches risk oversmoothing the surface and its boundaries. We propose Functional Attentive Interpretable Regression (FAIR), which represents $\beta(s,t)$ directly through coordinate features and uses self-attention to learn effect-adaptive neighborhoods, enabling information sharing at both local and global scales. A scalar compression network maps these learned representations to the coefficient surface. 量子AI会在路径中做梦吗？通过Grover干涉实现路径积分式慢思考

Do Quantum AIs Dream in Paths? Path-Integral Slow Thinking through Grover Interference

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05842

该论文提出将“慢思考”建模为推理轨迹上的量子路径积分，借助Grover振幅放大使接受与拒绝轨迹发生干涉，使最优成功概率收敛于一个内部解析值，从而避免传统强化学习中的策略坍缩问题。

带有可验证奖励的强化学习使大型语言模型能够进行“慢思考”，但同样的训练可能引发策略坍缩：概率集中到少数成功轨迹上，探索性多样性逐渐丧失。我们探讨量子AI能否以不同的方式实现慢思考。我们将慢思考表述为推理轨迹上的相干动力学，即一个离散路径积分，其中动作序列以叠加态共存，并在测量前重新组合。在我们的可训练实现中，一个精确验证器将系综划分为集体接受与集体拒绝两个部分，它们在Grover振幅放大下发生干涉。当放大前的成功概率处于一个解析确定的、小于1的内部值时，有限的Grover演化被最大化，因此推理过程本身定义了一个内部训练目标，消除了向单位成功概率单调推进的压力。在精确态矢量模拟中……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.05842v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards enables large language models to think slowly, but the same training can induce policy collapse: probability concentrates onto a few successful trajectories and exploratory diversity erodes. We ask whether quantum AI can realize slow thinking differently. We formulate slow thinking as coherent dynamics over reasoning trajectories, a discrete path integral in which action sequences coexist in superposition and recombine before measurement. In our trainable realization, an exact verifier partitions the ensemble into collective accepted and rejected components that interfere under Grover amplitude amplification. A finite Grover evolution is maximized when the pre-amplification success probability lies at an analytically determined value below one, so inference itself defines an interior training target and removes the monotonic pressure toward unit success. item.title: 该论文提出基于STreeD的加权与自适应联合特征-样本缩减框架，通过合并重复样本记录并迭代细化候选特征集，在保证候选集内最优性的前提下将最优分类树的求解速度提升最高121倍以上。
item.description:
通过自适应特征与样本缩减实现最优分类树的可扩展求解

Scaling Optimal Classification Trees via Adaptive Feature and Sample Reduction

该论文提出基于STreeD的加权与自适应联合特征-样本缩减框架，通过合并重复样本记录并迭代细化候选特征集，在保证候选集内最优性的前提下将最优分类树的求解速度提升最高121倍以上。

arXiv:2609.05826v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：随着特征数量和训练样本数量的增加，用于求解最优分类树的动态规划方法的计算成本变得极为高昂。我们基于STreeD开发了一个联合特征空间与样本空间缩减框架。加权STreeD将在投影到固定候选特征集后产生的重复记录合并为带权重的代表记录，从而在不改变固定候选集优化问题的前提下减少依赖样本的计算量。自适应STreeD则反复细化一个有界的候选特征集，保留当前最优树所使用的特征，重建加权表示，并求解由此得到的缩减问题。每一个经过验证的加权STreeD解对于其当前候选集而言都是最优的，而外层的特征搜索在整个特征空间上则保持启发式策略。在五个数据集上的实验表明，加权STreeD相比标准STreeD实现了高达121.41倍的加速。自适应STreeD降低了运行时间……

arXiv:2609.05826v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dynamic programming for optimal classification trees becomes computationally expensive as the numbers of features and training samples increase. We develop a joint feature- and sample-space reduction framework based on STreeD. Weighted STreeD merges duplicate records created after projection onto a fixed candidate set into weighted representatives. This reduces sample-dependent computation without changing the fixed-candidate optimization problem. Adaptive STreeD repeatedly refines a bounded candidate set, retains features used by the incumbent tree, rebuilds the weighted representation, and solves the resulting reduced problems. Each certified Weighted STreeD solution is optimal for its current candidate set, while the outer feature search remains heuristic over the full feature space. item.title: 提出了基于物理信息归一化流的自适应域随机化强化学习控制器NOMAD-RL，无需精确建筑模型或现场调参，即可通过通用非侵入式恒温器接口在异构热区之间实现HVAC控制的泛化迁移。
item.description:
基于域随机化强化学习的HVAC控制泛化方法

Generalizing HVAC Control With Domain Randomized Reinforcement Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05822

提出了基于物理信息归一化流的自适应域随机化强化学习控制器NOMAD-RL，无需精确建筑模型或现场调参，即可通过通用非侵入式恒温器接口在异构热区之间实现HVAC控制的泛化迁移。

大规模部署先进的HVAC（供暖、通风与空调）控制器仍然十分困难，因为其性能往往依赖于精确的建筑模型或针对每个现场进行的重新调参。我们提出了NOMAD-RL（Neural Online Meta-Adaptation for Dynamics，面向动力学的神经在线元自适应），这是一个通用的强化学习（RL）控制器，旨在通过一个通用的、非侵入式的恒温器接口，在异构的热区之间实现迁移。该控制器基于区域温度测量值和预测值对温度设定点进行操作，同时其循环策略支持在部分可观测条件下的在线自适应。我们的主要贡献是一种基于物理信息归一化流的自适应域随机化方案，该方案在保持物理合理性和可控性的同时，能够对热区参数的相关性和多峰分布进行建模。由此产生了一个逼真且渐进自适应的训练课程，改善了跨建筑的迁移能力（原文摘要到此被截断）。

arXiv:2609.05822v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deploying advanced HVAC (Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning) controllers at scale remains difficult because performance often depends on accurate building models or per-site retuning. We propose NOMAD-RL (Neural Online Meta-Adaptation for Dynamics), a general-purpose Reinforcement Learning (RL) controller designed to transfer across heterogeneous thermal zones through a universal, non-invasive thermostat interface. The controller acts on temperature setpoints from zone measurements and forecasts, while a recurrent policy supports online adaptation under partial observability. Our main contribution is an adaptive domain randomization scheme based on physics-informed normalizing flows, which models correlated and multimodal distributions of thermal-zone parameters while maintaining physical plausibility and controllability. This produces a realistic and progressively adaptive training curriculum that improves transfer across build

item.title: 该论文提出了在有限反馈预算下将提示自适应路由到LLM专家的在线学习算法，在完全信息设置和老虎机设置下分别实现了$\tilde{O}(dT/\sqrt{m})$和$\tilde{O}(dT\sqrt{K/m})$的遗憾界，能够高效学习高质量的LLM路由策略。
item.description:
基于有限反馈的LLM专家在线学习

Online Learning with LLM Experts from Limited Feedback

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05820

该论文提出了在有限反馈预算下将提示自适应路由到LLM专家的在线学习算法，在完全信息设置和老虎机设置下分别实现了$\tilde{O}(dT/\sqrt{m})$和$\tilde{O}(dT\sqrt{K/m})$的遗憾界，能够高效学习高质量的LLM路由策略。

我们研究在有限反馈的在线环境中，如何自适应地将提示路由到大语言模型（LLM）专家以最大化响应质量。我们将其表述为一个老虎机问题，其中$K$个动作代表专家，$d$个特征对提示进行编码，时间范围为$T$轮。我们提出了策略性地选择和观察奖励以最小化遗憾的算法。在完全信息设置下，我们实现了$\tilde{O}(dT/\sqrt{m})$的遗憾，而在老虎机设置下我们实现了$\tilde{O}(dT\sqrt{K/m})$的遗憾，其中$m \ll T$是反馈预算。我们的实验表明，我们能够从有限反馈中高效地学习跨多样化LLM的高质量路由策略。

arXiv:2609.05820v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study adaptive routing of prompts to large language model (LLM) experts to maximize response quality in an online setting with limited feedback. We formulate it as a bandit problem with $K$ actions that represent experts and $d$ features that encode prompts, over a horizon of $T$ rounds. We propose algorithms that strategically select and observe rewards to minimize regret. In the full-information setting, we achieve a regret of $\tilde{O}(d T / \sqrt{m})$, while in the bandit setting we achieve $\tilde{O}(d T \sqrt{K / m})$, where $m \ll T$ is a budget on feedback. Our experiments show that we efficiently learn high-quality routing strategies across diverse LLMs from limited feedback.

item.title: 本文提出了策略梯度定理的物理对应形式——一种随机伴随梯度估计器，通过用非简并扩散取代互易性限制，仅凭测量得到的随机轨迹即可直接从物理系统中原位提取参数梯度，并在非线性谐振器网络上成功实现了训练。

Physical policy gradient theorem for in situ stochastic-adjoint training

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05808

本文提出了策略梯度定理的物理对应形式——一种随机伴随梯度估计器，通过用非简并扩散取代互易性限制，仅凭测量得到的随机轨迹即可直接从物理系统中原位提取参数梯度，并在非线性谐振器网络上成功实现了训练。

原位伴随训练可以直接从测量中提取参数梯度，但迄今为止仅限于互易系统或受限系统。在本文中，我们引入了策略梯度定理的物理对应形式：一种随机伴随梯度估计器，它通过用非简并扩散替代互易性来解除这些限制。作为验证，我们训练了一个非线性谐振器网络——其自身动力学充当策略——仅利用从测量的随机轨迹中获得的梯度来对抗拮抗性时间调制，而无需有限差分或单独的伴随实验。

arXiv:2609.05808v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In situ adjoint training extracts parameter gradients directly from measurement, but has so far been limited to reciprocal or restricted systems. Here, we introduce the physical counterpart of the policy gradient theorem: a stochastic-adjoint gradient estimator that lifts these constraints by trading reciprocity for nondegenerate diffusion. As validation, we train a nonlinear resonator network, whose own dynamics supply the policy, against antagonistic temporal modulations with gradients from measured stochastic trajectories alone, without finite differences or a separate adjoint experiment.

item.title: 提出对角衰减方法，通过降低坐标方向样本方差、保留样本交叉协方差来校正有限样本下PCA的旋转偏差，并给出一致的期望风险显式定理及渐近最优衰减强度。
item.description:
对角衰减：主成分分析（PCA）的有限样本校正

Diagonal Attenuation: A Finite-Sample Correction for PCA

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05796

提出对角衰减方法，通过降低坐标方向样本方差、保留样本交叉协方差来校正有限样本下PCA的旋转偏差，并给出一致的期望风险显式定理及渐近最优衰减强度。

当协方差矩阵由有限数据估计时，主成分分析（PCA）可能会偏离其总体目标方向。我们引入了对角衰减方法，该方法在保留样本交叉协方差的同时降低坐标方向上的样本方差。该方法通过对随机输入掩码下的线性全输出重构损失取平均而被精确揭示；直接研究这一校正可将其扩展到掩码方法所能达到的范围之外。我们分离出保留与舍弃的总体方向之间随机耦合中由样本方差误差所贡献的部分，并展示衰减如何能够减小由此导致的旋转偏差。在边际方差平衡的条件下，我们推导出一个显式的期望风险定理，该定理对所有足够大的有限样本在整条衰减路径上一致成立，并得到了渐近风险最小化的衰减强度。对于一般协方差，我们刻画了衰减在何种条件下保持总体主成分不变。

arXiv:2609.05796v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Principal component analysis (PCA) can rotate away from its population target when a covariance matrix is estimated from limited data. We introduce diagonal attenuation, which preserves sample cross-covariances while reducing coordinatewise sample variances. The method is revealed exactly by averaging a linear full-output reconstruction loss over random input masks; studying the correction directly extends it beyond the range attainable by masking. We isolate the part of the random coupling between retained and omitted population directions that is contributed by sample-variance errors, and show how attenuation can reduce the resulting rotation. Under balanced marginal variances, we derive an explicit expected-risk theorem, uniform over the attenuation path for all sufficiently large finite samples, and obtain the asymptotically risk-minimizing strength. item.title: 本文提出采用参数化Deep Ritz方法求解非线性椭圆均匀化中的参数化胞元问题，从而获得胞元问题解的可微表示，以支持非线性均匀化本构关系的数值计算。
item.description:
基于参数化Deep Ritz方法的非线性椭圆均匀化

Nonlinear elliptic homogenization with the parametric Deep Ritz method

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05778

本文提出采用参数化Deep Ritz方法求解非线性椭圆均匀化中的参数化胞元问题，从而获得胞元问题解的可微表示，以支持非线性均匀化本构关系的数值计算。

椭圆均匀化用于确定具有小尺度特征的材料在粗粒化尺度上的性质。当这些小尺度特征具有快速的周期性波动时，基于均匀化本构关系得到的解场与基于非均匀材料的真实解非常接近。材料的这种均匀化行为通过求解胞元问题（cell problem）计算得到，其中一个胞元被定义为波动材料的一个周期。在线性椭圆偏微分方程的背景下，均匀化本构关系仅由一个常系数张量定义；但对于非线性问题，均匀化响应依赖于宏观状态和/或其梯度，因此需要求解参数化的胞元问题。在使用均匀化本构关系计算数值解时，拥有胞元问题解的可微表示是非常有用的。

arXiv:2609.05778v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Elliptic homogenization is used to determine coarse-grained properties of materials with features on small scales. When these small scale features have rapid, periodic fluctuations, the solution field corresponding to a homogenized constitutive relation closely resembles the true solution based on the heterogeneous material. This homogenized behavior of the material is computed from a cell problem, where a cell is defined to be one period of the fluctuating material. In the context of linear elliptic partial differential equations, the homogenized constitutive relation is defined simply by a constant coefficient tensor, but for nonlinear problems, the homogenized response depends on the macroscopic state and/or its gradient, thus requiring solutions to parametric cell problems. item.title: RAPTOR提出了一种角色感知的差分隐私训练框架，通过专家特定的裁剪与噪声、公共期望所有者分母和计数无关的更新计划，解决了现有DP微调方法在稀疏MoE模型上的三种失效模式，同时保持(ε,δ)-DP保证。
item.description:
RAPTOR：面向混合专家模型的角色感知隐私训练

RAPTOR: Role-Aware Private Training for Mixture-of-Experts

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05770

RAPTOR提出了一种角色感知的差分隐私训练框架，通过专家特定的裁剪与噪声、公共期望所有者分母和计数无关的更新计划，解决了现有DP微调方法在稀疏MoE模型上的三种失效模式，同时保持(ε,δ)-DP保证。

差分隐私（DP）微调方法将稀疏的混合专家模型视为单个密集整体，忽略了共享层能看到所有数据、而专家只能看到被路由到自己的记录这一差异。我们识别并正式刻画了由此产生的三种失效模式：全局梯度裁剪会抑制专家梯度、批次级归一化会稀释稀疏的专家更新、固定的隐私噪声会降低低负载专家的信噪比。我们提出了RAPTOR——一个角色感知的隐私训练框架，它交替进行共享层和专家层的优化，并直接针对每种失效模式，采用专家特定的裁剪与噪声，结合一个公共的期望所有者分母以及与专家计数无关的更新计划，从而避免以私有的、实际实现的专家计数为条件。我们证明了所得机制满足$(\varepsilon,\delta)$-差分隐私：由于每条记录被恰好分配给一个所有者专家，层内的各专家机制……

arXiv:2609.05770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Differentially private (DP) fine-tuning methods treat sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models as a single dense block, ignoring that shared layers see all data while experts only see routed records. We identify and formally characterize three resulting failure modes: global clipping suppresses expert gradients, batch-level normalization dilutes sparse expert updates, and fixed privacy noise degrades signal-to-noise ratio on low-load experts. We introduce RAPTOR - a Role-Aware Private Training framework, which alternates shared and expert optimization and targets each failure directly, using expert-specific clipping and noise together with a public expected-owner denominator and a count-independent update schedule that avoids conditioning on private, realized expert counts. item.title: Data Scout提出用“定向爬取”取代传统的“过滤存档”范式，利用LLM将主题扩展为分类体系和搜索查询，并借助子域名级分类器探针进行筛选，使爬取页面中高质量数学内容占比达到21.9%，是传统过滤方法的70倍。
item.description:
Data Scout：面向领域特定预训练语料库的定向网络爬取

Data Scout: Targeted Web Crawling for Domain-Specific Pretraining Corpora

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05766

Data Scout提出用“定向爬取”取代传统的“过滤存档”范式，利用LLM将主题扩展为分类体系和搜索查询，并借助子域名级分类器探针进行筛选，使爬取页面中高质量数学内容占比达到21.9%，是传统过滤方法的70倍。

arXiv:2609.05766v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：构建领域特定预训练语料库的主流方法是对大型网络存档（如CommonCrawl）进行过滤。这种方法对热门领域效果良好，但对于专业领域则会失效，因为专业领域的相关内容稀疏，且往往超出了基于流行度的爬虫的覆盖范围。我们提出了Data Scout，它颠覆了这一模式：不是过滤存档，而是引导定向爬取。一个LLM将根主题扩展为分类体系及数千个搜索查询；返回的URL（种子）按子域名分组，并用用户提供的分类器（探针）进行筛选，基于小样本决定是否接纳每个子域名。这种方法有效的原因在于相关性在子域名层面存在清晰的边界：在数学领域，一个页面比其兄弟子域名上的页面相关性高21倍。以FineMath分类器作为探针，爬取的页面中有21.9%是高质量数学内容，是从可比网络存档中过滤所得0.31%比率的70倍。

arXiv:2609.05766v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The dominant approach to building domain-specific pretraining corpora is to filter large web archives such as CommonCrawl. This works well for popular domains but breaks down for specialized ones, where relevant content is sparse and often beyond the reach of popularity-driven crawlers. We present Data Scout, which inverts this: instead of filtering an archive, it directs a targeted crawl. An LLM expands a root topic into a taxonomy and thousands of search queries; the returned URLs (seeds) are grouped by subdomain and screened with a user-supplied classifier (the probe), admitting each subdomain on the basis of a small sample. This works because relevance has a sharp boundary at the subdomain level: in mathematics, a page is 21x more likely to be relevant than one on a sibling subdomain. item.title: 该研究提出采集感知的评估框架AAMBERS-UAV，揭示了数据集划分方式对无人机杂草稻分割中多模态输入排名的关键影响——完全采集留存时RGB表现最佳，而目标采集暴露后RGB+多光谱最优，且这一结论在U-Net/ResNet18上得到复现验证。
item.description:
AAMBERS-UAV：面向无人机杂草稻分割的采集感知多模态骨干网络评估与排序

AAMBERS-UAV: Acquisition-Aware Multimodal Backbone Evaluation and Ranking for UAV Weedy Rice Segmentation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05762

该研究提出采集感知的评估框架AAMBERS-UAV，揭示了数据集划分方式对无人机杂草稻分割中多模态输入排名的关键影响——完全采集留存时RGB表现最佳，而目标采集暴露后RGB+多光谱最优，且这一结论在U-Net/ResNet18上得到复现验证。

无人机图像采集包含空间和时间上相关的帧，然而语义分割基准通常在图像层面进行数据集划分。这种划分方式可能将来自同一次采集的样本同时放入模型开发和测试集中，从而掩盖了模型向真正新调查场景迁移的能力。利用包含734个样本的WeedyRice-RGBMS-DB数据集，我们固定了一个包含124张图像的目标采集测试集，并在训练、验证和测试数量完全相同的条件下比较两种协议：目标留存协议将目标采集从模型开发中完全排除，目标暴露协议则纳入目标采集的其余图像。研究在两个固定划分种子上评估了SegFormer-B0使用RGB、四波段多光谱（MS）以及七通道RGB+MS输入的表现。结果表明，在完全采集留存条件下RGB表现最强（0.7317±0.0201 IoU），而在目标暴露后RGB+MS变为最强（0.7822±0.0269）。固定划分的U-Net/ResNet18复现实验证实了所有三种输入在暴露条件下均获得正向增益，

arXiv:2609.05762v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: UAV image collections contain spatially and temporally related frames, yet semantic-segmentation benchmarks commonly split them at image level. Such splitting can place samples from one acquisition in both model development and testing, obscuring transfer to a genuinely new survey. item.title: 该论文提出一种将基于物品的协同过滤与图神经网络检索相结合的多源混合候选生成架构，在拥有超过200万房源的度假租赁平台上将替代房源推荐的Recall@300提升了14.8%。
item.description:
面向替代性度假租赁房源推荐的候选生成多源集成方法

A Multi-Source Ensemble Approach to Candidate Generation for Alternative Vacation Rental Property Recommendations

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05748

该论文提出一种将基于物品的协同过滤与图神经网络检索相结合的多源混合候选生成架构，在拥有超过200万房源的度假租赁平台上将替代房源推荐的Recall@300提升了14.8%。

替代性房源推荐在度假租赁市场中起着至关重要的作用，能够帮助用户在浏览某个具体房源时发现相关的其他选项。然而，生成高质量的候选替代房源面临着独特的挑战：库存的异构性、地理限制、可用性的快速变化以及房源分布的长尾特性。本文对度假租赁替代房源的候选生成方法进行了全面研究，比较了协同过滤、浅层嵌入以及图神经网络方法。我们在一个大型度假租赁平台（拥有超过200万个活跃房源）上的实验表明，将基于物品的协同过滤与基于图神经网络的检索相结合的混合架构，通过利用两种来源的互补优势，使Recall@300相比最强基线提升了14.8%：协同过滤在召回具有丰富交互信息的房源方面表现出色……

arXiv:2609.05748v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Alternative property recommendations play a critical role in vacation rental marketplaces, helping users discover relevant options when viewing a specific listing. However, generating high-quality candidate alternatives presents unique challenges: heterogeneous inventory, geographic constraints, rapid availability changes, and long-tail property distributions. 提出高斯线性泛函流形（GLFM）物理信息统计框架，结合SVD降秩算法实现线性时间参数估计，解决了复杂城乡交错带环境中海量机载LiDAR点云的连续地形重建难题，兼具结构可解释性与无需逐点标注的优势。

从海量、非结构化的机载激光雷达（LiDAR）点云中重建连续地形流形，在复杂的城乡交错带（WUI）环境中仍然具有挑战性，因为深度神经网络需要代价高昂的逐点标注，而非参数曲面重建方法往往缺乏结构可解释性。本文提出了高斯线性泛函流形（GLFM），这是一种基于物理信息的统计框架，利用确定性线性泛函基表示连续的地形表面，同时将微观尺度的激光漫反射后向散射建模为各向同性高斯过程。为了避免精确约束极大似然估计的二次方计算成本，我们开发了一种代数奇异值分解（SVD）降秩算法，实现了线性时间的参数估计和闭式二次曲面分类。在35.2平方公里的真实机载激光雷达数据上的评估表明，GLFM能够自动……

arXiv:2609.05744v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reconstructing continuous terrain manifolds from massive, unstructured airborne LiDAR point clouds remains challenging in complex Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI) environments, where deep neural networks require costly point-wise annotations and nonparametric surface reconstruction methods often lack structural interpretability. item.title: RenderFormer-V2是一个无需针对每个场景训练的统一Transformer神经渲染模型，通过在视角无关阶段引入窗口注意力与渲染信息注意力池相结合的新机制，在保持渲染精度的同时提升可扩展性，并能处理焦散、体积散射、环境光照等多样化全局光传输效果。
item.description:
RenderFormer-V2：基于异构场景基元的神经渲染

RenderFormer-V2: Neural Rendering with Heterogeneous Scene Primitives

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05738

RenderFormer-V2是一个无需针对每个场景训练的统一Transformer神经渲染模型，通过在视角无关阶段引入窗口注意力与渲染信息注意力池相结合的新机制，在保持渲染精度的同时提升可扩展性，并能处理焦散、体积散射、环境光照等多样化全局光传输效果。

我们提出了"RenderFormer-V2"，这是一个统一的、基于Transformer的神经渲染学习模型，与现代基于物理的渲染系统互补，能够处理多种光传输效果，如焦散、体积散射、环境光照、带纹理和位移的表面以及分布外材质，而无需针对每个场景进行训练或专门的代码。RenderFormer-V2将全局光传输建模为序列到序列的转换。与其前身一样，RenderFormer-V2也采用两阶段流程：一个与视角无关的阶段，用于解析场景内基元到基元之间的传输；一个与视角相关的阶段，将内部神经场景表示转换为图像像素。与RenderFormer不同，我们的模型在与视角无关的阶段中采用了新颖的窗口注意力与渲染信息注意力池相结合的机制，在保持渲染精度的同时提升了可扩展性。

arXiv:2609.05738v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present 'RenderFormer-V2', a unified learned transformer-based neural rendering model, complementary to modern physics-based rendering systems, that can handle diverse light-transport effects such as caustics, volumetric scattering, environment lighting, textured and displaced surfaces and out-of-distribution materials without per-scene training or specialized code. RenderFormer-V2 models global light transport as a sequence-to-sequence transformation. Following its predecessor, RenderFormer-V2 also employs a two stage process: a view-independent stage that resolves intra-scene primitive to primitive transport, and a view-dependent stage that transforms the internal neural scene representation into image pixels. Different from RenderFormer, our model employs a novel combined windowed-attention and rendering-informed attention sink in the view-independent stage to improve scalability while maintaining render accuracy. arXiv:2609.05727v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop Newton Matching, a unified framework for fine-tuning and sampling in generative modeling. The target is $\pi\propto\mu e^{\tau r}$, where $r$ is the reward, $\tau>0$ the inverse temperature, and $\mu$ denotes the pretrained model's terminal density for fine-tuning or the constant $1$ for sampling. We shift the paradigm from isolated losses to iterative optimization over canonical models: population minimizers of standard conditional matching for terminal densities. Transporting the Fisher-Rao metric and mixture connection to this manifold, we show that the reverse-KL Hessian equals the metric, so the Newton direction coincides with the negative Fisher-Rao gradient. 本文证明了在每次测量最多使用 $k$ 个新鲜副本且无量子存储的受限纠缠设定下，$d$ 维量子态层析的副本复杂度下界为 $\max\{d^3/(\sqrt{k}\epsilon^2), d^2/\epsilon^2\}$，与已知上界紧致匹配，并适用于任意块内测量和块间自适应策略。

我们研究量子态层析问题，其中每次测量最多作用于 $k$ 个新鲜副本，且各测量块之间不保留量子存储器。我们证明了一个与 [arXiv:2510.07788] 中上界相匹配的下界。因此，对于每个 $k$ 以及所有足够小的 $\epsilon$，在迹距离 $\epsilon$ 下估计任意 $d$ 维量子态的副本复杂度（在绝对常数因子范围内）为 $\max\{d^3/(\sqrt{k}\epsilon^2), d^2/\epsilon^2\}$。这消除了早期要求 $k$ 必须随精度参数保持较小的限制。该下界适用于每个块内的任意测量以及块之间的自适应选择。该下界在最小本征值数量级为 $1/d$ 的任意量子态的小邻域内即已成立，即使该中心态是已知的。证明的核心是一个仅依赖于量子态最小本征值的单个测量块的一致费希尔信息界。该证明避免了之前的...

arXiv:2609.05718v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study state tomography when each measurement acts on at most $k$ fresh copies and no quantum memory is retained between blocks. We prove a lower bound matching the upper bound in [arXiv:2510.07788]. Thus the copy complexity of estimating an arbitrary $d$-dimensional state to trace distance $\epsilon$ is, up to absolute constant factors, $\max\{d^3/(\sqrt{k}\epsilon^2),d^2/\epsilon^2\}$ for every $k$ and all sufficiently small $\epsilon$. This removes the earlier restriction that $k$ be small as a function of the accuracy. The lower bound applies to arbitrary measurements within each block and adaptive choices between blocks. The lower bound already applies in a small neighborhood of any state whose smallest eigenvalue is of order $1/d$, even when the center is known. item.title: 提出了无需训练的CUSP框架，通过语义意见池化量化多智能体多模态推理的系统级不确定性，并能将集体熵精确分解为模型个体语义熵均值与模型间冲突（JSD）两个可解释的信号。
item.description:
CUSP：面向多智能体多模态推理的可分解集体不确定性

CUSP: Decomposable Collective Uncertainty for Multi-Agent Multimodal Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05708

提出了无需训练的CUSP框架，通过语义意见池化量化多智能体多模态推理的系统级不确定性，并能将集体熵精确分解为模型个体语义熵均值与模型间冲突（JSD）两个可解释的信号。

聚合异构视觉语言模型（VLMs）可以提升多模态推理能力，但无论是单个模型的置信度还是聚合答案的置信度，都无法衡量系统层面的可靠性。我们提出了CUSP（通过语义意见池化实现的集体不确定性），这是一个无需训练的不确定性量化框架，它将多个VLM的响应映射到共享的语义响应空间，将其池化为一个池化语义意见，并报告两个互补的系统级信号：集体不确定性，即池化意见的离散程度；以及Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD），即模型级意见之间的冲突程度。在该池化语义意见中，未归一化的集体熵可以精确分解为各个模型个体语义熵的均值与JSD之和，从而将总离散度与模型间冲突分离开来。CUSP既不需要token logits也不需要校准标签，因此适用于开源权重和商业模型（原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.05708v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Aggregating heterogeneous vision-language models (VLMs) can improve multimodal reasoning, but neither an individual model's confidence nor that of the aggregated answer measures reliability at the system level. We present CUSP (Collective Uncertainty through Semantic Opinion Pooling), a training-free uncertainty quantification framework that maps multiple VLM responses to a shared semantic response space, pools them into a pooled semantic opinion, and reports two complementary system-level signals: collective uncertainty, the dispersion of the pooled opinion, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD), the conflict among the model-level opinions. Within this pooled semantic opinion, the unnormalized collective entropy decomposes exactly into the mean of the models' individual semantic entropies and the JSD, separating total dispersion from model conflict. item.title: 本文突破了以往假设攻击者仅有经典计算能力的局限，首次系统刻画了在用户/攻击者具备量子计算能力和量子信息访问权限的量子原生场景下，量子机器学习模型（如成员推断攻击）所面临的隐私风险。
item.description:
新兴量子原生访问下量子机器学习隐私风险的刻画

Characterizing Privacy Risks of Quantum Machine Learning with Emergent Quantum-Native Access

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05702

本文突破了以往假设攻击者仅有经典计算能力的局限，首次系统刻画了在用户/攻击者具备量子计算能力和量子信息访问权限的量子原生场景下，量子机器学习模型（如成员推断攻击）所面临的隐私风险。

量子机器学习（QML）通过利用量子计算执行机器学习任务而取得了快速进展。与此同时，伴随QML产生的隐私风险也开始受到研究关注，这些风险既继承了“经典”机器学习的隐私泄露渠道，也包含量子独有的风险。现有的隐私保护QML研究主要聚焦于QML即服务（QML-as-a-service）场景，该场景通常假设QML模型所有者仅向查询提供经典比特输出，而用户（及攻击者）仅具备经典计算能力。然而，在一个量子原生世界中，具备量子能力的用户/攻击者可能同时拥有量子计算能力并能访问服务提供商量子信息输出，这使得上述假设日益受到挑战。本文旨在通过研究针对QML模型的成员推断攻击来弥合这一差距，证明随着量子访问权限和量子计算能力的提升……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.05702v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum Machine Learning (QML) has shown rapid advances by utilizing quantum computing for machine learning tasks. Meanwhile, the privacy risks accompanying QML is also starting to be studied, which inherit privacy leakage channels from "classical" ML and also quantum-unique risks. Existing work on privacy-preserving QML largely focuses on a QML-as-a-service scenario, which generally assumes that the QML model owner provides only classical bit outputs to queries, while users (and adversaries) have only classical computing abilities. However, this view is increasingly challenged in a quantum-native world of quantum-capable users/adversaries, which may have access to both quantum computing abilities and access to quantum information output from service providers. item.title: 本文开发了三种深度神经网络架构，利用呼吸性窦性心律不齐现象直接从心电图信号预测呼吸波形以估计呼吸频率，实现了无需人工预处理的稳健可扩展的无创呼吸监测方案。
item.description:
基于神经网络的呼吸性窦性心律不齐分析

Analysis of Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia with Neural Networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05698

本文开发了三种深度神经网络架构，利用呼吸性窦性心律不齐现象直接从心电图信号预测呼吸波形以估计呼吸频率，实现了无需人工预处理的稳健可扩展的无创呼吸监测方案。

本文介绍了一种基于神经网络的方法，通过利用呼吸性窦性心律不齐（RSA）现象来分析心电图（ECG）信号以估计呼吸频率。我们的方法采用经过训练的深度学习模型，可直接从ECG输入数据预测呼吸波形。为实现这一目标，我们开发并评估了三种不同的神经网络架构，这些架构能够自动从ECG信号中提取相关特征，无需人工预处理。所提出的方法为无创呼吸监测提供了一种强大且可扩展的解决方案，在医疗保健和可穿戴技术领域具有潜在的应用前景。

arXiv:2609.05698v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The paper introduces a neural network-based approach for analyzing ECG signals to estimate respiratory rate by leveraging the phe- nomenon of Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia (RSA). Our method employs a deep learning model trained to predict respiratory waveforms directly from ECG input data. To achieve this, we developed and evaluated three different neural network architectures capable of automatically extract- ing relevant features from ECG signals without the need for manual preprocessing. The proposed approach offers a robust and scalable solu- tion for non-invasive respiratory monitoring, with potential applications in healthcare and wearable technology

item.description:
GraphNOSE：嗅觉领域的图Transformer

GraphNOSE: A Graph Transformer in Olfaction

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05694

GraphNOSE是一个开源图Transformer框架，能从SMILES字符串预测单分子和二元混合物的气味描述符，其参数量仅为标准GNN的六分之一，同时在AUROC指标上平均超越现有方法4.52%。

从分子结构预测嗅觉特性是化学信息学中的一个开放性问题。尽管线性模型可以将分子特征与气味描述符关联起来，但在外推到新的化学骨架、极端分子量或复杂气味混合物时，它们往往表现不佳。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了GraphNOSE，一个开源的图Transformer框架，它可以从简化分子线性输入规范（SMILES）字符串中预测单个分子和二元混合物的多标签气味描述符。通过在基于Transformer的图架构中整合位置编码和结构编码，GraphNOSE以比标准图神经网络（GNN）基线少六倍的参数量实现了强劲的性能，同时在平均ROC曲线下面积（AUROC）上以4.52%的优势（p < 0.01）持续超越线性模型、分子语言模型嵌入、分子指纹和基线GNN。

arXiv:2609.05694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting olfactory qualities from molecular structure is an open problem in chemoinformatics. Although linear models can link molecular features to odor descriptors, they often fail when extrapolating to novel chemical scaffolds, extreme molecular weights, or complex odor mixtures. To address this, we introduce GraphNOSE, an open-source graph transformer framework that predicts multi-label odor descriptors from simplified molecular-input line-entry system (SMILES) strings for single molecules and binary mixtures. By integrating positional and structural encodings within a transformer-based graph architecture, GraphNOSE achieves strong performance with six times fewer parameters than standard graph neural network (GNN) baseline while consistently outperforming linear models, molecular language model embeddings, molecular fingerprints, and baseline GNNs by an average area under the ROC curve (AUROC) margin of 4.52% (p < 0.01). Connecting Score Matching, Maximum Likelihood, and Expectation-Maximization in Mixed Linear Regression

我们研究了在具有未知混合权重的混合线性回归（MLR）中响应变量的方差保持扩散问题。我们的分析将得分匹配的统计保证与固定扩散噪声水平下的损失几何结构和优化信号分离开来。KL散度将在扩散路径上积分的去噪得分匹配目标与似然函数及终端差异联系起来。在温和的正则性条件和终端调度下，所得估计器收敛于MLR的真实参数，且其缩放误差收敛到最大似然估计器的高斯极限。在固定扩散噪声水平尺度下，我们推导出一个将得分匹配损失与交叉熵和期望最大化（EM）算子联系起来的分解。该分解产生了一个与EM相关的低噪声梯度展开，其中包含潜在方差的额外修正项。在高噪声极限下，我们（摘要在此处截断）……

Our analysis separates the statistical guarantees of score matching from the loss geometry and optimization signal at a fixed diffusion noise level. The KL divergence links the denoising score matching objective integrated over the diffusion path with the likelihood and a terminal discrepancy. Under mild regularity conditions and terminal schedule, the resulting estimator converges up to the ground truth parameters of MLR, and its scaled error converges to the Gaussian limit of the maximum-likelihood estimator. At a fixed scale of the diffusion noise level, we derive a decomposition linking the score matching loss to cross-entropy and Expectation-Maximization (EM) operators. item.title: 本文将PAC隐私保护预测从分类任务首次扩展到自回归生成，通过在128个重叠世界（各自训练适配器）上投票，并根据各世界后验加权的分歧程度动态校准噪声，在预测一致时减少噪声，从而在保护隐私的同时提升生成质量。
item.description:
PAC-隐私保护自回归生成：将噪声校准至集成分歧程度

PAC-Private Autoregressive Generation: Calibrating Noise to Ensemble Disagreement

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05676

本文将PAC隐私保护预测从分类任务首次扩展到自回归生成，通过在128个重叠世界（各自训练适配器）上投票，并根据各世界后验加权的分歧程度动态校准噪声，在预测一致时减少噪声，从而在保护隐私的同时提升生成质量。

在私有文本上微调的语言模型通常通过API提供服务，因此隐私泄露是通过生成的输出而非暴露的模型权重发生的。私有预测（Private prediction）正是为了保护这类发布。诸如PMixED之类的方法在每次发布时都会产生隐私成本，且在长序列生成中越来越依赖公共模型。PAC隐私（PAC privacy）则根据可能秘密之间的输出变异性来校准噪声，当预测稳定时添加更少的噪声。据我们所知，PAC隐私保护预测此前尚未从分类任务扩展到自回归生成任务。我们从私有语料库中构建了m=128个相互重叠的“世界”，每条记录恰好出现在m/2个世界中，并在冻结的公共模型之上为每个世界训练一个适配器。实际实现的世界即为秘密。在生成每个词元时，公共模型定义一个候选集合，各世界进行投票，其后验加权分歧程度决定PAC噪声的大小；当所有世界完全一致时则无需（文本在此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.05676v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Language models adapted on private text are often served through APIs, so privacy leakage occurs through generated outputs rather than exposed weights. Private prediction protects these releases. Methods such as PMixED incur privacy cost at each release and increasingly rely on the public model over long horizons. PAC privacy instead calibrates noise to output variability across possible secrets, adding less noise when predictions are stable. To our knowledge, PAC-private prediction has not previously been extended from classification to autoregressive generation. We construct $m=128$ overlapping worlds from the private corpus, with each record appearing in exactly $m/2$ worlds, and train one adapter per world over a frozen public model. The realized world is the secret. item.title: Srijika通过复用排版完整模板字体的OpenType布局数据（cmap、GSUB闭包和GPOS）来重新样式化字形轮廓，为九种印度文字生成构造上保证排版一致性的可安装字体，从而解决了合体字等复杂文本形式难以保持一致的生成难题。
item.description:
Srijika：面向九种印度文字的复用OpenType排版的字体重样式化系统

Srijika: OpenType-Layout-Reusing Font Restyling for Nine Indic Scripts

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05661

Srijika通过复用排版完整模板字体的OpenType布局数据（cmap、GSUB闭包和GPOS）来重新样式化字形轮廓，为九种印度文字生成构造上保证排版一致性的可安装字体，从而解决了合体字等复杂文本形式难以保持一致的生成难题。

我们提出Srijika，一个用于生成九种婆罗米文字可安装OpenType字体的系统，涵盖天城文、泰米尔文、孟加拉文、泰卢固文、卡纳达文、马拉雅拉姆文、古吉拉特文、古尔穆奇文和奥里亚文。Srijika并非从零开始生成字体，而是对排版完整的模板字体的字形轮廓进行重新样式化。它在文档化的度量策略下保留模板的cmap与GSUB闭包以及GPOS数据，使得每个输出在构造上都必然是完整的字体。这解决了印度文字字体生成的核心挑战：数百乃至数千个合体字、半形式和元音符号变体必须在OpenType排版下保持相互一致。Srijika生成了66个TTF文件：57个精心策划的预设字体和九个开放词汇的展示字体。所有字体均通过OpenType Sanitizer检查，并且HarfBuzz和CoreText在合体字密集的测试用例上重现了模板的字形ID序列。一项涵盖80,915个字形和54,812个锚点的全闭包审计量化了度量变化。

arXiv:2609.05661v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present Srijika, a system for producing installable OpenType fonts for nine Brahmic scripts: Devanagari, Tamil, Bengali, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Gurmukhi, and Odia. Rather than generating fonts from scratch, Srijika restyles glyph outlines from shaping-complete template fonts. It preserves the template's cmap and GSUB closure and its GPOS data under a documented metric policy, making every output a complete font by construction. This addresses a central challenge of Indic font generation: hundreds to thousands of conjuncts, half forms, and matra variants must remain mutually consistent under OpenType shaping. Srijika produces 66 TTFs: 57 curated presets and nine open-vocabulary showcase fonts. All pass the OpenType Sanitizer, while HarfBuzz and CoreText reproduce the template glyph-ID sequences on conjunct-heavy probes. item.title: 本文提出了一种受控蜕变评估方法，通过操作数重排序、标识符重命名和冗余括号化三种语义保持的RTL变换，系统评估了LLM生成SystemVerilog断言的输出稳定性，揭示了传统单一点准确率无法反映模型鲁棒性的问题。
item.description:
LLM生成的SystemVerilog断言对语义保持RTL变换的鲁棒性

Robustness of LLM-Generated SystemVerilog Assertions to Semantics-Preserving RTL Transformations

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05658

本文提出了一种受控蜕变评估方法，通过操作数重排序、标识符重命名和冗余括号化三种语义保持的RTL变换，系统评估了LLM生成SystemVerilog断言的输出稳定性，揭示了传统单一点准确率无法反映模型鲁棒性的问题。

大型语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地探索用于自动化SystemVerilog断言（SVA）生成，然而大多数评估仅报告输入在单一语法表示下的正确性。这种点准确率无法揭示当相同的RTL行为以不同方式编写时，模型的正确输出是否保持稳定。本文针对基于LLM的SVA生成，在语义保持的RTL变换下进行了受控的蜕变评估。从VERT数据集出发，我们构建了一个经过质量筛选的条件控制池，以及一个包含295个赋值行为的分层40程序评估集。我们使用相同的评估提示词和贪心解码评估了两个开源代码模型：Qwen2.5-Coder-7B和DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite。研究了三种变换：操作数重排序、确定性标识符重命名和冗余括号化。除了基线和变换后的准确率之外，我们还测量了……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.05658v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for automating SystemVerilog Assertion (SVA) generation, yet most evaluations report correctness on a single syntactic representation of an input. Such point accuracy does not reveal whether a model's correct output is stable when the same RTL behavior is written differently. This paper presents a controlled metamorphic evaluation of LLM-based SVA generation under semantics-preserving RTL transformations. Starting from the VERT dataset, we construct a quality-filtered conditional-control pool and a stratified 40-program evaluation set containing 295 assignment behaviors. We evaluate two open code models, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite, with an identical evaluation prompt and greedy decoding. Three transformations are studied: operand reordering, deterministic identifier renaming, and redundant parenthesization. Beyond baseline and transformed accuracy, we measure c

item.title: 该论文提出一种由内在好奇心驱动探索的强化学习框架，基于“有效探索产生于中等不一致水平”这一核心假设，在液态状态机基底上实现，并在LunarLanderv2和BipedalWalkerv3两个基准上达到了与PPO等成熟算法相当的性能。
item.description:
基于内在好奇心的强化学习内生探索

Endogenous Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Intrinsic Curiosity

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05650

该论文提出一种由内在好奇心驱动探索的强化学习框架，基于“有效探索产生于中等不一致水平”这一核心假设，在液态状态机基底上实现，并在LunarLanderv2和BipedalWalkerv3两个基准上达到了与PPO等成熟算法相当的性能。

我们提出了一种由内在好奇心驱动探索的强化学习框架，适用于环境非平稳且奖励稀疏、延迟、无信息或缺失的场景。在该模型中，动作选择由外部奖励与一种认知动机机制相结合来引导，该机制使智能体倾向于沿着结构化的探索方向行动。其核心假设是：有效探索在中等程度的不一致性水平下产生，而在过于僵化或过于无序的动态下性能都会退化。为验证这一想法，我们在液态状态机（LSM）基底上实现了该框架，并在两个标准基准上进行评估：离散动作的LunarLanderv2和连续控制的BipedalWalkerv3。所提出的方法在这两项任务上均取得了与成熟深度强化学习算法（包括近端策略优化PPO）相当的性能。

arXiv:2609.05650v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a reinforcement learning framework in which exploration is driven by intrinsic curiosity, designed for scenarios where environments are non-stationary and rewards are sparse, delayed, uninformative, or absent. In our model, action selection is guided by a combination of external rewards and an epistemic motivation mechanism that biases the agent toward structured exploratory directions. The central hypothesis is that effective exploration emerges at intermediate levels of incoherence, while performance degrades under both overly rigid and overly disordered dynamics. To test this idea, we implement the framework on top of a Liquid State Machine (LSM) substrate and evaluate it on two standard benchmarks: the discrete-action LunarLanderv2 and the continuous-control BipedalWalkerv3. The proposed method achieves competitive performance on both tasks relative to established deep RL algorithms, including Proximal Policy Optimization

item.title: 该论文证明了矩阵乘积抖动标量量化误差的核范数下界，并通过SVD对齐的Hadamard构造证明该下界是紧的。
item.description:
矩阵乘积抖动标量量化的核范数下界

A Nuclear-Norm Lower Bound for Dithered Scalar Quantization of Matrix Products

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05641

该论文证明了矩阵乘积抖动标量量化误差的核范数下界，并通过SVD对齐的Hadamard构造证明该下界是紧的。

我们研究量化矩阵乘法 $C=AB$ 中最小化误差的问题。对标量因子进行量化会引入舍入误差，其大小取决于各行和各列的最大绝对值——即范围，这些范围决定了量化网格步长。为了降低误差，我们在不改变 $C$ 的前提下，对能够改变因子范围和网格步长的保乘积变换进行优化。具体而言，我们在可逆的内基变换和正交的外旋转下寻找最小的首项期望平方误差。在无界格上施加独立、零均值减性抖动噪声的条件下，我们证明了仅依赖输出的下界 $E_{\rm lead} \ge (c_A+c_B)/K \Vert AB\Vert_*^2$，其中 $K$ 是内维数，$c_A$ 和 $c_B$ 是归一化噪声方差，$\Vert AB\Vert_*$ 是核范数。该下界是紧的：SVD对齐的Hadamard构造在Hadamard存在的条件下可以达到该下确界。

arXiv:2609.05641v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We consider the problem of minimizing error in quantized matrix multiplication $C=AB$. Scalar quantization of the factors introduces rounding errors whose scale depends on the maximum absolute entries -- the ranges -- of their rows and columns. These ranges determine the quantization grid steps. To reduce the error, we optimize over product-preserving transformations that alter the factor ranges and grid steps without changing $C$. Specifically, we seek the smallest leading expected squared error over invertible inner changes of basis and orthogonal outer rotations. Under independent, zero-mean subtractive dither noise on an unbounded lattice, we prove the output-only bound $E_{\rm lead} \ge (c_A+c_B)/K \Vert AB\Vert_*^2$, where $K$ is the inner dimension, $c_A$ and $c_B$ are normalized noise variances, and $\Vert AB\Vert_*$ is the nuclear norm. item.title: 提出HB-PVI框架，通过层次贝叶斯模型与EVSI停止规则，联合量化复杂活动识别中参与者异质性、四种个性化机制的收益以及校准标签的经济价值。
item.description:
HB-PVI：一种用于复杂活动识别的层次贝叶斯个性化与信息价值框架

HB-PVI: A Hierarchical Bayesian Personalization and Value-of-Information Framework for Complex Activity Recognition

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05582

提出HB-PVI框架，通过层次贝叶斯模型与EVSI停止规则，联合量化复杂活动识别中参与者异质性、四种个性化机制的收益以及校准标签的经济价值。

个性化可以提升活动识别性能，但参与者特定的收益是异质的，且每增加一个校准标签都有获取成本。本研究提出了HB-PVI，一个层次贝叶斯个性化与信息价值框架，针对47名参与者的MUSIC-CAR复杂活动队列，联合建模参与者异质性、四种个性化机制的收益与损害，以及额外标签的经济价值。一种无泄漏的留一参与者评估方法将序贯蒙特卡洛参与者效应更新器、学生t分布层次增益模型与一步样本信息期望值（EVSI）停止规则相结合。适配器个性化产生了小幅的正平均F1增益，从一个标签时的0.00099增长到十个标签时的0.00198，而适配器加头部以及原型残差个性化平均为负。在主要的实际应用……

arXiv:2609.05582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Personalization can improve activity-recognition performance, but participant-specific gains are heterogeneous, and every additional calibration label has an acquisition cost. This study presents HB-PVI, a hierarchical Bayesian personalization and value-of-information framework jointly modeling participant heterogeneity, the benefit and harm of four personalization mechanisms, and the economic value of an additional label, for the 47-participant MUSIC-CAR complex-activity cohort. A leakage-safe, leave-one-participant-out evaluation combines a sequential-Monte-Carlo participant-effect updater with a Student-$t$ hierarchical gain model and a one-step expected-value-of-sample-information (EVSI) stopping rule. Adapter personalization produced small positive mean F1 gains, growing from 0.00099 at one label to 0.00198 at ten, while adapter-plus-head and prototype-residual personalization were negative on average. item.title: 提出Capsule Lens框架，通过闭式拟合由可解释参数定义的胶囊几何形状，来定位和追踪机器学习模型表示中概念的几何结构，并可同时应用于静态与动态表示场景。
item.description:
胶囊透镜：在模型表示中定位与追踪概念几何结构

Capsule Lens: Locating and Tracking Concept Geometry in Model Representations

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05575

提出Capsule Lens框架，通过闭式拟合由可解释参数定义的胶囊几何形状，来定位和追踪机器学习模型表示中概念的几何结构，并可同时应用于静态与动态表示场景。

理解概念如何编码在机器学习模型的内部表示中，是机制可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）领域的核心问题，这对于深度学习的科学研究以及日益强大的模型的可信部署都至关重要。现有的模型表示解释方法主要将表示映射到更可解释的空间中，并未直接刻画概念如何占据表示空间；尽管已有多种假设被提出，但往往缺乏严格的验证，且大多聚焦于静态表示。在本工作中，我们提出了Capsule Lens，这是一个将概念所占区域与一种简单、可追踪的几何形状——胶囊（capsule）——相匹配的框架。该胶囊由若干可解释的参数定义，以闭式形式拟合到每个概念的几何结构上，并在留出样本上进行了验证。我们将Capsule Lens应用于两大场景：静态表示和动态表示。在静态表示上……

arXiv:2609.05575v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how concepts are encoded in the internal representations of machine learning models is a central problem in mechanistic interpretability, essential both for the science of deep learning and for the trustworthy deployment of increasingly capable models. Existing approaches to interpret model representations mainly map representations onto more interpretable spaces and do not directly characterize how concepts occupy representation space; various hypotheses have been proposed, but often lack of rigorous validation and largely focus on static representations. In this work, we introduce Capsule Lens, a framework that matches the region a concept occupies with a simple, trackable geometric form, a capsule, defined by several interpretable parameters, fitted in closed form to each concept's geometry and validated on held-out samples. We apply Capsule Lens in two major settings: static and dynamic representations. On static repres

item.title: 提出了基于粒球的多粒度超图表示学习框架MGHRL，通过自适应粒度超图生成策略在多个粒度层级上生成超边，从而自适应地发现图中的高阶关系并高效处理复杂结构信息。
item.description:
基于粒球的多粒度自适应超图表示学习

Multi-granularity Adaptive Hypergraph Representation Learning via Granular-ball

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05574

提出了基于粒球的多粒度超图表示学习框架MGHRL，通过自适应粒度超图生成策略在多个粒度层级上生成超边，从而自适应地发现图中的高阶关系并高效处理复杂结构信息。

超图表示学习旨在通过构造能同时连接多个节点的超边来捕捉图中的高阶信息。这些超边能够适应图的拓扑特征，从而有助于在多个粒度上提取高阶关系。以往的大多数工作依赖预定义的方式来生成超边，忽视了图拓扑结构的多样性以及超边的多粒度特性。因此，这限制了它们有效且自适应地发现高阶关系、高效处理复杂结构信息的能力。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了一个名为多粒度超图表示学习（MGHRL）的新颖框架。MGHRL 引入了一种自适应粒度超图生成策略，该策略可在多个粒度层级上生成超边

arXiv:2609.05574v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hypergraph representation learning aims to capture high-order information in graphs by constructing hyperedges that simultaneously connect multiple nodes. These hyperedges adapt to the graph's topological features, facilitating the extraction of high-order relationships at multiple granularities. Most prior work relies on predefined definitions to generate hyperedges, overlooking the diversity in graph topological structures and the multi-granularity characteristics of hyperedges. As a result, this limits their ability to effectively and adaptively discover high-order relationships and efficiently process complex structural information. To address this limitation, we propose a novel framework called \underline{M}ulti-\underline{G}ranularity \underline{H}ypergraph \underline{R}epresentation \underline{L}earning (MGHRL). item.title: 本文证明了 \(\{-1,1\}^n\) 上任意严格正的概率分布都能被有限参数的 Sigmoid 信念网络精确表示，利用布劳威尔不动点定理回答了 Sutskever 和 Hinton 的开放性问题。
item.description:
深度信念网络是精确的

Deep belief networks are exact

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05572

本文证明了 \(\{-1,1\}^n\) 上任意严格正的概率分布都能被有限参数的 Sigmoid 信念网络精确表示，利用布劳威尔不动点定理回答了 Sutskever 和 Hinton 的开放性问题。

我们证明，定义在 \(\{-1,1\}^n\) 上的每一个严格正的概率分布，都可以被一个具有有限参数的 Sigmoid 信念网络精确表示。这回答了 Sutskever 和 Hinton 提出的一个问题。该证明利用布劳威尔（Brouwer）不动点定理，将他们的概率共享近似方法升级为精确表示。

arXiv:2609.05572v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove that every strictly positive probability distribution on \(\{-1,1\}^n\) is represented exactly by a sigmoid belief network with finite parameters. This answers a question of Sutskever and Hinton. The proof upgrades their probability-sharing approximation to exact representation using Brouwer's fixed-point theorem.

item.title: 本文综合现有系统研究成果，归纳出可复用的设计模式，提出面向llm-d分布式推理控制平面的能源、碳排与缓存感知的可持续推理控制平面（SICP）框架与研究议程。
item.description:
迈向可持续的分布式大语言模型推理：面向能源、碳排与缓存感知的llm-d控制平面的系统综合与研究议程

Toward Sustainable Distributed LLM Inference: A Systems Synthesis and Research Agenda for an Energy-, Carbon-, and Cache-Aware llm-d Control Plane

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05565

本文综合现有系统研究成果，归纳出可复用的设计模式，提出面向llm-d分布式推理控制平面的能源、碳排与缓存感知的可持续推理控制平面（SICP）框架与研究议程。

大语言模型（LLM）的可持续性日益成为一个服务系统问题，而不仅仅是训练问题。在生产环境中，能源和碳排的影响不仅取决于模型大小：工作负载形态、批处理、键值（KV）缓存复用、预填充/解码任务放置、模型与加速器选择、电源状态、地理碳强度以及服务级目标（SLO）等因素都至关重要。近期的系统研究论文分别单独探讨了其中的许多因素。本文将这些研究结果联系起来，并提出一个实际的工程问题：当决策点是像llm-d这样的分布式推理控制平面时，这些研究结果意味着什么？本文的贡献在于综合归纳，而非提出新的基准测试结果。所报告的性能、能源、碳排和成本方面的改进仍是所引用论文和系统的成果。我将相关文献归纳为反复出现的设计模式，并利用这些模式为llm-d勾勒出一个可持续推理控制平面（SICP）。

arXiv:2609.05565v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM) sustainability is increasingly a serving-systems problem, not only a training problem. In production, energy and carbon impact depend on more than model size: workload shape, batching, key-value (KV) cache reuse, prefill/decode placement, model and accelerator choice, power state, geographic carbon intensity, and service-level objectives (SLOs) all matter. Recent systems papers study many of these factors separately. This paper connects those results and asks a practical engineering question: what do they imply when the decision point is a distributed inference control plane such as llm-d? The contribution here is synthesis, not a new set of benchmark results. Reported performance, energy, carbon, and cost improvements remain the results of the cited papers and systems. I group the literature into recurring design patterns and use those patterns to sketch a Sustainable Inference Control Plane (SICP) for llm

item.title: Rollcast 提出了一种用适当评分门控的滚动统计锚点集合替代单一全局模型的概率预测方法，通过状态依赖门控机制和相似历史状态的残差分布，在多种时间序列动态过程中实现自适应的不确定性量化。
item.description:
Rollcast：用于自适应概率时间序列预测的适当评分门控滚动锚点

Rollcast: Proper-Score Gated Rolling Anchors for Adaptive Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05561

Rollcast 提出了一种用适当评分门控的滚动统计锚点集合替代单一全局模型的概率预测方法，通过状态依赖门控机制和相似历史状态的残差分布，在多种时间序列动态过程中实现自适应的不确定性量化。

Rollcast 是一种针对单变量时间序列的概率预测方法，它结合了一组紧凑的滚动统计锚点，而非依赖单一的全局模型。滚动均值、中位数、极值、回归端点和分位数定义了候选预测位置以及当前状态的表示。一个状态依赖的 softmax 门控通过最小化负对数预测密度来学习锚点权重，同时从相似历史状态中检索的残差分布提供局部不确定性。递归模拟将所得混合分布传播到多个预测视界上。该方法在涵盖八种数据生成过程的蒙特卡洛研究中进行评估，包括自回归、随机游走、局部趋势、阈值、状态切换、随机波动、厚尾和方差突变等动态过程。在 2,000 个独立拟合序列上，Rollcast 与真实条件预测分布进行了比较（摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.05561v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Rollcast is a probabilistic forecasting method for univariate time series that combines a compact set of rolling statistical anchors rather than relying on a single global model. Rolling means, medians, extrema, regression endpoints, and quantiles define candidate forecast locations and a representation of the current state. A state-dependent softmax gate learns anchor probabilities by minimizing negative log predictive density, while residual distributions retrieved from similar historical states provide local uncertainty. Recursive simulation propagates the resulting mixture over multiple forecast horizons. The method is evaluated in a Monte Carlo study covering eight data-generating processes, including autoregressive, random-walk, local-trend, threshold, regime-switching, stochastic-volatility, heavy-tailed, and variance-break dynamics. Across 2,000 independent fitted series, Rollcast is compared with the true conditional predictiv

item.title: 本研究将基于Savage-Hutter方程的深度平均物理信息神经网络（PINN）扩展至指数弯曲溜槽上的颗粒雪崩动力学，证明分阶段时间课程学习可将保留观测的轨迹误差降低约两个数量级，且稀疏数据下观测点的位置比观测数量更为重要。
item.description:
曲面地形上深度平均颗粒雪崩动力学的物理信息神经网络

Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Depth-Averaged Granular Avalanche Dynamics on Curved Topography

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05542

本研究将基于Savage-Hutter方程的深度平均物理信息神经网络（PINN）扩展至指数弯曲溜槽上的颗粒雪崩动力学，证明分阶段时间课程学习可将保留观测的轨迹误差降低约两个数量级，且稀疏数据下观测点的位置比观测数量更为重要。

物理信息神经网络（PINNs）为求解控制方程提供了一种无网格框架，但其在弯曲地形上颗粒雪崩动力学中的应用在很大程度上尚未被探索。本研究将基于Savage-Hutter方程的深度平均PINN公式扩展到一个具有空间变化倾角的指数弯曲溜槽，并采用了应变率相关的莫尔-库仑土压力闭合关系。该模型通过实验室颗粒雪崩实验中测量的前缘和后缘轨迹进行了验证，其中部分观测数据在训练中被保留（不参与训练）。分阶段的时间课程学习策略对准确预测至关重要，与从一开始就在整个时间域上进行训练相比，该策略将保留轨迹的预测误差降低了约两个数量级。稀疏数据实验进一步表明，在配置固定的情况下，观测点的位置比观测数量对结果的影响更大。

arXiv:2609.05542v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a mesh-free framework for solving governing equations, but their application to granular avalanche dynamics over curved terrain remains largely unexplored. This study extends a depth-averaged PINN formulation based on the Savage-Hutter equations to an exponentially curved chute with spatially varying inclination and a strain-rate-dependent Mohr-Coulomb earth-pressure closure. The model is validated against measured front- and rear-edge trajectories from a laboratory granular-avalanche experiment, with selected observations withheld from training. A staged temporal curriculum proved essential for accurate prediction, reducing the held-out trajectory error by approximately two orders of magnitude compared with training over the full time domain from the outset. SimpleMemVLA：一种简单而有效的面向视觉-语言-动作模型的原生视频记忆

SimpleMemVLA: A Simple but Effective Native-Video Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models

SimpleMemVLA提出了一种无需专用记忆模块的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过完整保留历史信息并以时间戳视频格式直接输入骨干网络，利用子任务隐藏状态作为历史到流匹配动作头的唯一通道，从而有效解决长时程操作中的部分可观测问题。

长时程操作是部分可观测的：选择下一个动作所需的信息可能仅出现在几分钟之前的观测中。现有的记忆机制——检索库、学习型压缩器、循环状态——必须在不知道未来决策需要什么的情况下，先决定从过去保留哪些信息。这一设计源于一种假设，即分钟级的历史数据过于庞大而无法直接处理，但现代VLM骨干网络已不再受此限制。在这项工作中，我们提出了SimpleMemVLA，一种无需专用记忆模块的VLA模型。它完整保留采样的历史信息，并以骨干网络预训练时所用的时间戳视频格式将其传递给骨干网络；生成的子任务的隐藏状态随后构成从历史信息到标准流匹配动作头的唯一通道。由于连续决策共享大部分历史信息，在动作执行期间预填充共享前缀可使延迟保持在接近

arXiv:2609.05533v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Long-horizon manipulation is partially observable: the information needed to choose the next action may appear only in observations from minutes earlier. Existing memory mechanisms: retrieval banks, learned compressors, recurrent states must decide what to keep from the past before knowing what a future decision will require. This was motivated by the assumption that minute-scale history is too large to process directly, which modern VLM backbones no longer make true. In this work, we introduce SimpleMemVLA, a VLA without a dedicated memory module. It keeps the sampled history intact and passes it to the backbone in the timestamped video format the backbone was pretrained to process; the hidden states of a generated sub-task then form the only channel from history to a standard flow-matching action head. 一种用于解读头颈癌PET/CT的专用大型多模态模型

研究者利用大规模多机构PET/CT数据集和两级训练课程微调LLaVA-NeXT，开发出一种专用大型多模态模型，实现了头颈癌PET/CT的自动化解读，验证了专用LMM在医学影像诊断中的可行性。

背景：由于头颈部区域解剖结构的复杂性，使用PET/CT诊断头颈癌在临床上具有挑战性且耗时，这推动了计算机辅助诊断（CAD）的发展。通用大型多模态模型（LMM）在医学领域的应用仍然受限，原因包括领域专业知识不足、隐私与安全问题以及输出冗长，这促使了专用独立LMM的发展。目的：我们利用大规模多机构PET/CT数据集、定制化训练课程和自回归训练，评估了专用LMM在头颈癌PET/CT自动解读中的可行性。方法：LLaVA-NeXT通过两级课程进行微调，其图像-对话对由两位放射科医生从公开数据中整理而成。数据集包含临床重要标注，如原发肿瘤的存在和转移性淋巴结的位置。第一级使用28,000个图像-对话对来学习……

arXiv:2609.05532v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Background: Diagnosing head and neck cancer using PET/CT is clinically challenging and time-consuming due to the anatomical complexity of the region, motivating computer-aided diagnosis (CAD). 本文提出了一种单阶段学习框架，将路边单目相机图像直接映射到地面固定坐标系中的车辆状态。与先在图像平面中检测车辆、随后进行几何后处理的传统方法不同，所提出的方法利用预训练目标检测器提取的特征，联合估计每辆车的地面平面位置、尺寸和偏航角。因此，该框架不仅将视觉特征用于车辆检测，还将其用于直接的空间位置和朝向估计。为支持模型训练和评估，我们开发了一个基于路边相机与无人机（UAV）同步视频的数据采集和标签生成流水线。作为临时性的俯视感知平台，无人机提供车辆轨迹、尺寸和朝向信息，这些信息被转换到地面固定坐标系中。

The framework therefore uses visual features not only for vehicle detection but also for direct spatial and orientation estimation. To support model training and evaluation, we develop a data-collection and label-generation pipeline based on synchronized video from a roadside camera and an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). item.title: 本文提出多分辨率对比蒸馏（MCD）方法，无需正负样本对，通过拉近/推远师生网络特征距离，实现多光照/多焦点显示图像中微小缺陷的异常检测。
item.description:
多光照/多焦点显示图像异常检测的对比知识蒸馏方法

Contrastive Knowledge Distillation for Anomaly Detection in Multi-Illumination/Focus Display Images

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05520

本文提出多分辨率对比蒸馏（MCD）方法，无需正负样本对，通过拉近/推远师生网络特征距离，实现多光照/多焦点显示图像中微小缺陷的异常检测。

本文研究多光照和多焦点显示图像中的自动异常检测问题。显示表面的微小缺陷在RGB图像中很难被发现，仅用正常数据训练的模型也难以将其检测出来。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的对比学习方案，用于基于知识蒸馏的异常检测。在我们的框架中，采用多分辨率知识蒸馏作为基线，该方法通过测量教师网络和学生网络之间的特征相似度来工作。基于MKD，我们提出了一种新颖的对比学习方法，即多分辨率对比蒸馏，它不需要带有锚点的正/负样本对，而是通过拉近/推远教师和学生特征之间的距离来进行学习。此外，我们还提出了一个融合模块，用于将多通道信息转换并聚合到MCD的三通道输入层。

arXiv:2609.05520v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we tackle automatic anomaly detection in multi-illumination and multi-focus display images. The minute defects on the display surface are hard to spot out in RGB images and by a model trained with only normal data. To address this, we propose a novel contrastive learning scheme for knowledge distillation-based anomaly detection. In our framework, Multiresolution Knowledge Distillation (MKD) is adopted as a baseline, which operates by measuring feature similarities between the teacher and student networks. Based on MKD, we propose a novel contrastive learning method, namely Multiresolution Contrastive Distillation (MCD), which does not require positive/negative pairs with an anchor but operates by pulling/pushing the distance between the teacher and student features. 本文提出频率感知任务加权（FTW）方法，通过分析近期损失历史轨迹的低频能量比率来估计任务稳定性，并据此动态调整任务权重，以改善基于YOLOv8的统一驾驶感知中多任务联合优化的平衡问题。

arXiv:2609.05516v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：统一感知使自动驾驶系统能够在单个网络内执行目标检测、可行驶区域分割和车道分割，从而提高效率并降低部署复杂性。联合优化多个感知任务仍然具有挑战性，因为不同任务表现出不同的收敛速度、损失尺度和优化稳定性。现有的任务加权方法使用损失幅值、学习到的不确定性、短期损失变化或梯度统计；在此，我们探索将近期损失历史窗口的频率结构作为补充信号。我们实现并研究了频率感知任务加权，这是一种动态任务平衡规则，它从近期损失历史的低频能量比率中估计损失轨迹稳定性代理。FTW为那些均值中心化后的损失轨迹中包含更大比例低频功率的任务分配更大的权重。我们记录了FTW和两种

arXiv:2609.05516v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Unified perception enables autonomous driving systems to perform object detection, drivable-area segmentation, and lane segmentation within a single network, improving efficiency and reducing deployment complexity. Jointly optimizing multiple perception tasks remains challenging because tasks exhibit different convergence rates, loss scales, and optimization stability. Existing task-weighting methods use loss magnitude, learned uncertainty, short-term loss changes, or gradient statistics; here, we explore the frequency structure of a recent loss-history window as a complementary signal. We implement and examine Frequency-aware Task Weighting (FTW), a dynamic task-balancing rule that estimates a loss-trajectory stability proxy from the low-frequency energy ratio of recent loss histories. FTW assigns larger weights to tasks whose mean-centered loss trajectories contain a larger proportion of low-frequency power. We document FTW and two

item.title: 该论文提出了一种预算感知的在线教学框架，通过可解性感知的教师门控决定何时查询教师模型，并通过分数引导的轨迹修剪筛选教学内容，从而避免在不可解决的回合和冗余执行步骤上浪费训练预算。
item.description:
何时教与教什么：面向网络智能体的预算感知在线适应

When and What to Teach: Budget-Aware Online Adaptation for Web Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05513

该论文提出了一种预算感知的在线教学框架，通过可解性感知的教师门控决定何时查询教师模型，并通过分数引导的轨迹修剪筛选教学内容，从而避免在不可解决的回合和冗余执行步骤上浪费训练预算。

网络智能体在自动化复杂互联网任务方面已取得显著成功，但将其部署到真实环境中需要持续的在线适应。鉴于部署强大的专有模型在商业上成本过高，从业者必须依赖轻量级本地模型，这些模型在部署后通过来自更强教师模型的在线教学不断进化。然而，标准的交互式反馈会带来难以承受的成本。我们证明了传统的轨迹级偏好优化会在不可解决的回合和冗余的执行步骤上浪费预算。为解决这些低效问题，我们提出了“带预算轨迹修剪的分数引导在线教学”，这是一个预算感知框架，系统地编排何时教和教什么。具体而言，我们的框架集成了一个可解性感知的教师门控来决定何时查询教师模型，以及一个分数引导的轮（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.05513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Web agents have achieved significant success in automating complex internet tasks but deploying them in real-world environments requires continuous online adaptation. Given that deploying powerful proprietary models remains commercially cost-prohibitive, practitioners must rely on lightweight local models that evolve post-deployment via online teaching from a stronger teacher. However, standard interactive feedback imposes prohibitive costs. We show that conventional trajectory-level preference optimization wastes budget on both unresolvable episodes and redundant execution turns. To resolve these inefficiencies, we propose \textbf{Score-Guided Online Teaching with Budgeted Trajectory Trimming}, a budget-aware framework that systematically orchestrates \textbf{when} and \textbf{what} to teach. item.title: 该论文通过理论和实验证明，Option-Critic中学习到的终止规则毫无作用（甚至可能阻碍探索并产生Ω(T)的遗憾），且选项内部策略几乎不探索会导致“策略坏死”，从而解释了性能提升实际来源于增加选项数量所带来的冗余覆盖。
item.description:
选项何时有用？Option-Critic中的策略坏死与冗余覆盖

When Do Options Help? Policy Necrosis and Redundant Coverage in Option-Critic

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05508

该论文通过理论和实验证明，Option-Critic中学习到的终止规则毫无作用（甚至可能阻碍探索并产生Ω(T)的遗憾），且选项内部策略几乎不探索会导致“策略坏死”，从而解释了性能提升实际来源于增加选项数量所带来的冗余覆盖。

Option-Critic（选项-评论家）方法学习“选项”：即子策略，同时学习一个规则来决定每个选项何时将控制权交回。其标志性结果是：随着选项数量的增加，性能会得到提升。我们通过理论和实验解释了这一结果。首先，Option-Critic通过最大化回报所学习到的终止规则实际上毫无作用。当终止测试和选择选项的策略读取相同的值时，该测试在每一步都会触发，因此学习到的规则与“总是终止”完全相同。当该策略进行探索而终止测试不进行探索时（正如Option-Critic本身的情况），该规则可能会阻碍探索；在某些实例中，它会产生 Ω(T) 的遗憾，而“总是终止”则能保持 O(log T) 的遗憾。强制在每一步终止后，选项数量与性能的曲线依然保持不变。其次，选项内部的策略几乎不进行探索，因此某个状态会锁定在第一个看起来不错的动作上，并且再也不更新。我们将这种现象命名为“策略坏死”。

arXiv:2609.05508v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Option-critic learns options: sub-policies together with a learned rule for when each one hands control back. Its headline result is that performance improves as options are added. We explain that result, with theory and experiment. First, the termination rule option-critic learns by maximising return contributes nothing. When the termination test and the policy that picks options read the same values, the test fires at every step, so the learned rule is identical to always terminating. When that policy explores and the test does not, as in option-critic itself, the rule can block the exploration; there are instances where it suffers $\Omega(T)$ regret while always terminating holds to $O(\log T)$. Forcing termination at every step leaves the option-count curve intact. Second, the policy inside an option barely explores at all, so a state locks onto the first action that looked good and never updates again. We name this policy necrosis

item.title: 本文提出一类渐近信息驱动的神经网络架构，通过门控函数系统对价格域进行可训练划分并结合专门化的局部近似，实现了Black-Scholes隐含波动的稳健高效计算，尤其适用于极端价格、行权价或期限的渐近区域。
item.description:
面向Black-Scholes隐含波动率计算的渐近信息驱动神经网络

Asymptotically-informed neural networks for Black-Scholes implied volatility computation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05491

本文提出一类渐近信息驱动的神经网络架构，通过门控函数系统对价格域进行可训练划分并结合专门化的局部近似，实现了Black-Scholes隐含波动的稳健高效计算，尤其适用于极端价格、行权价或期限的渐近区域。

Black-Scholes隐含波动率的计算是量化金融中的一项基础任务，支撑着期权估值、模型校准和风险管理。尽管隐含波动率在实践中被常规使用，但Black-Scholes定价公式的反演仍然是一个具有挑战性的数值问题，特别是在对应于极端期权价格、行权价或期限的渐近区域中，此时逆映射对价格的扰动变得高度敏感。在本文中，我们引入了一类新的渐近信息驱动的神经网络架构用于隐含波动率计算。利用Black-Scholes定价函数在不同波动率区域中的不同行为，我们提出了一族架构，它们通过门控函数系统学习价格-对数货币性域的可训练划分，并结合隐含波动率函数的专门化局部近似……

arXiv:2609.05491v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The computation of Black-Scholes implied volatility is a fundamental task in quantitative finance, underpinning option valuation, model calibration and risk management. Although implied volatility is routinely used in practice, the inversion of the Black-Scholes pricing formula remains a challenging numerical problem, particularly in asymptotic regimes corresponding to extreme option prices, strikes or maturities, where the inverse map becomes highly sensitive to perturbations of the price. In this paper, we introduce a new family of asymptotically-informed neural-network architectures for implied-volatility computation. Exploiting the distinct behaviours of the Black-Scholes pricing function in different volatility regimes, we propose a family of architectures that learn a trainable partition of the price-log-moneyness domain through a system of gating functions and combines specialised local approximations of the implied-volatility f

item.title: 本文通过系统性消融实验发现，在深度学习医学图像配准中，正则化损失对性能提升的贡献远大于仿射预对齐等架构增强组件，仅正则化即可带来21.3%的相对增益。
item.description:
深度学习医学图像配准中的架构组件与正则化组件：系统性消融研究

Architectural and Regularization Components in Deep Learning Medical Image Registration: Systematic Ablation Study

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05484

本文通过系统性消融实验发现，在深度学习医学图像配准中，正则化损失对性能提升的贡献远大于仿射预对齐等架构增强组件，仅正则化即可带来21.3%的相对增益。

深度学习配准方法通常在基础网络上叠加两类增强手段：架构层面的附加组件（如仿射预对齐阶段）和训练目标层面的附加组件（如正则化损失）。由于论文往往同时采用两者，因此不清楚究竟是哪一类在发挥作用。本研究进行了受控消融实验将二者区分开来。使用OASIS脑部MRI数据集（394个训练受试者、20个测试受试者），作者训练了同一配准流程的四个变体：采用基础相似性损失的基线3D U-Net、采用完整正则化套件的相同U-Net、采用基础损失的仿射加可变形架构，以及采用完整套件的仿射架构。研究评估了配准精度（MSE、NCC、SSIM）、形变质量（雅可比行列式保持度、位移统计量、解剖学合理性评分）以及计算成本。结果表明，仅正则化一项就贡献了大部分性能增益，相对提升了21.3%……

arXiv:2609.05484v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deep learning registration methods routinely stack two kinds of enhancement on a base network: architectural additions such as affine pre-alignment stages, and training-objective additions such as regularization losses. Papers tend to adopt both at once, so it is unclear which is doing the work. I ran a controlled ablation to separate them. Using the OASIS brain MRI dataset (394 training subjects, 20 test subjects), I trained four variants of the same registration pipeline: a baseline 3D U-Net with basic similarity losses, the same U-Net with a full regularization suite, an affine-plus-deformable architecture with basic losses, and the affine architecture with the full suite. I evaluated registration accuracy (MSE, NCC, SSIM), deformation quality (Jacobian determinant preservation, displacement statistics, an anatomical plausibility score), and computational cost. Regularization alone accounted for most of the gain: a 21.3% relative ga

item.title: 该论文提出ARC-Bench无泄漏审计协议，揭示冻结JEPA世界模型中“潜在距离可正确排序动作”的核心假设严重且结构性失效，且该缺陷在不同视觉骨干网络下均持续存在。
item.description:
ARC-Bench：闭环重规划掩盖了冻结JEPA世界模型中失效的动作排序

ARC-Bench: Closed-Loop Replanning Masks Broken Action Ranking in Frozen JEPA World Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05461

该论文提出ARC-Bench无泄漏审计协议，揭示冻结JEPA世界模型中“潜在距离可正确排序动作”的核心假设严重且结构性失效，且该缺陷在不同视觉骨干网络下均持续存在。

无奖励的潜在世界模型通过在冻结的潜在空间中以距离对候选动作进行评分来进行规划：如果一个动作预测的未来嵌入更接近目标嵌入，则该动作会被优先选择。这悄然假设了潜在接近度是可对动作进行排序的，即按潜在距离对候选动作排序与按真实代价排序是一致的。我们直接审计了这一假设。我们提出了ARC-Bench，一种无泄漏、固定候选集的评测协议，用于衡量冻结的JEPA式目标能否正确排序候选动作，并将其应用于官方发布的JEPA-WM检查点，涵盖导航和操作类控制任务。这一假设严重且结构性地失效了：在官方的操作任务审计中，得分最高的候选动作几乎总是次优的，同样的排序倒置现象也出现在迷宫环境中。一项受控的视觉骨干网络扩展实验表明，当将DINOv2替换为视频预训练的V-JEPA 1时，该缺陷依然存在。

arXiv:2609.05461v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reward-free latent world models plan by scoring candidate actions with distances in a frozen latent space: an action is preferred if its predicted future embedding lands closer to the goal embedding. This silently assumes that latent closeness is action-rankable, i.e., that ordering candidates by latent distance agrees with ordering them by true cost. We audit this assumption directly. We introduce ARC-Bench, a no-leak, fixed-candidate protocol that measures whether frozen JEPA-style objectives rank candidate actions correctly, and apply it to official released JEPA-WM checkpoints across navigation and manipulation-style control. The assumption fails, severely and structurally: on the official manipulation audits the top-scored candidate is almost always suboptimal, and the same inversion appears in the maze domains. A controlled visual-backbone extension shows that the defect persists when DINOv2 is replaced by video-pretrained V-JEPA 1

item.description:
条件感知学习实现对不同化学修饰与检测条件下寡核苷酸熔解行为的稳健预测

Condition aware learning enables robust prediction of oligonucleotide melting behavior across diverse chemistries and assay conditions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05454

提出了一种条件感知的核苷酸语言模型，将上下文序列表示与反应环境信息相结合，能够在多种实验条件下准确预测未修饰和化学修饰寡核苷酸的熔解行为，克服了传统固定参数热力学模型难以推广的局限。

寡核苷酸熔解温度是核酸杂交的基本决定因素，是分子诊断、聚合酶链式反应（PCR）检测以及众多其他生物技术应用设计的基础。然而，准确预测熔解行为仍然十分困难，因为它不仅取决于序列组成，还取决于现代检测设计中常用的实验条件和化学修饰。现有的热力学模型依赖于固定的参数化方法，往往难以推广至不同的反应环境和核苷酸化学体系。在本研究中，我们展示了一种条件感知的核苷酸语言模型，能够在多种实验条件下准确预测未修饰和化学修饰寡核苷酸的熔解行为。通过将上下文序列表示与描述反应环境的显式信息相结合，该框架……

arXiv:2609.05454v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Oligonucleotide melting temperature is a fundamental determinant of nucleic acid hybridization and underpins the design of molecular diagnostics, polymerase chain reaction assays, and many other biotechnology applications. However, accurately predicting melting behavior remains difficult because it depends not only on sequence composition, but also on experimental conditions and chemical modifications commonly used in modern assay design. Existing thermodynamic models rely on fixed parameterizations that are often difficult to extend across diverse reaction environments and nucleotide chemistries. Here we show that a condition-aware nucleotide language model can accurately predict oligonucleotide melting behavior across diverse experimental conditions and both unmodified and chemically modified oligonucleotides. item.title: ZetaDial 提出了一种围绕固定骨架 ProteinMPNN 的采样后逐蛋白割线控制器，能够在推理时将治疗性蛋白质结合物的净电荷精确调节至目标设定值，显著降低电荷误差并提升药物可开发性。
item.description:
ZetaDial：在推理时调节蛋白质结合物的净电荷以提升治疗性药物的可开发性

ZetaDial: dialing net charge of protein binders at inference time for therapeutic developability

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05451

ZetaDial 提出了一种围绕固定骨架 ProteinMPNN 的采样后逐蛋白割线控制器，能够在推理时将治疗性蛋白质结合物的净电荷精确调节至目标设定值，显著降低电荷误差并提升药物可开发性。

净电荷是治疗性结合物中与可开发性相关的一个特性，与黏度、清除率、非特异性相互作用和聚集有关，抗体筛选已经在使用电荷相关标准。然而，逆折叠流程尚未提供将其设定为目标值的方法。ProteinMPNN 和 BindCraft 虽然提供了氨基酸偏好、权重选择和自定义损失函数，但两者都没有提供逐蛋白的反馈回路，即无法在采样后测量实际电荷并将其校正至设定值。ZetaDial 在固定骨架的 ProteinMPNN 周围构建了一个采样后、逐蛋白的割线控制器。在匹配的随机基准测试中，与固定斜率回路相比，割线回路降低了平均绝对误差：在 RCSB 复合物上（5.17 对 6.46 电荷单位），在 Cas13 单体上（5.57 对 8.23）。相对于优化后的匹配全局偏好，它将 RCSB 误差从 11.71 降至 5.17（聚类自助法 p < 0.001），而在 Cas13 上统计上无显著差异（5.47 对……）。

arXiv:2609.05451v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Net charge is a developability-relevant property of therapeutic binders, linked to viscosity, clearance, nonspecific interaction and aggregation, and antibody screens already use charge-related criteria. Yet inverse-folding pipelines expose no way to set it to a target value. ProteinMPNN and BindCraft offer amino-acid biases, weight choices and custom losses, but neither supplies a per-protein feedback loop that measures realised charge after sampling and corrects it to a setpoint. ZetaDial contributes a post-sampling, per-protein secant controller around fixed-backbone ProteinMPNN. On matched stochastic benchmarks the secant loop reduced mean absolute error relative to a fixed-slope loop on RCSB complexes (5.17 vs 6.46 charge units) and Cas13 monomers (5.57 vs 8.23). item.title: 提出了一种损伤感知的多臂赌博机框架，通过配对损伤评估和UCB/分数Beta汤普森采样策略，在固定评估预算下为视觉和语言Transformer选择抑制后性能损失最小的结构单元（注意力头和MLP通道组）。
item.description:
面向视觉与语言Transformer的损伤感知赌博机剪枝方法

Damage-Aware Bandit Pruning for Vision and Language Transformers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05448

提出了一种损伤感知的多臂赌博机框架，通过配对损伤评估和UCB/分数Beta汤普森采样策略，在固定评估预算下为视觉和语言Transformer选择抑制后性能损失最小的结构单元（注意力头和MLP通道组）。

Transformer的结构化训练后剪枝需要选择那些被抑制后仅造成有限性能下降的完整功能单元。我们将语言和视觉Transformer的结构化单元选择形式化为固定候选评估预算下的损伤感知多臂赌博机问题。在校准批次上临时掩蔽注意力头和MLP通道组，配对损伤定义为同一批次上掩蔽后的损失减去基准损失，从而减少批次间的波动。一个平滑有界的奖励驱动UCB风格的策略或分数Beta汤普森采样，最终掩蔽通过每步添加一个单元的方式顺序构建。所选单元在原始稠密模型检查点中被功能性地置零；因此，报告的参数效应代表有效的结构性抑制，而非物理压缩或实测加速。在WikiText-2、LAMBADA和Imagenette上的实验涵盖了GPT-2等模型。

arXiv:2609.05448v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structured post-training pruning of transformers requires selecting complete functional units whose suppression causes limited degradation. We formulate structured-unit selection for language and vision transformers as a damage-aware multi-armed bandit problem under a fixed candidate-evaluation budget. Attention heads and MLP channel groups are temporarily masked on calibration batches. Paired damage is the masked loss minus the base loss on the same batch, reducing batch-to-batch variation. A smooth bounded reward drives either a UCB-style policy or fractional-Beta Thompson Sampling, and the final mask is constructed sequentially by adding one unit at each step. The selected units are functionally zeroed in the original dense checkpoint; therefore, the reported parameter effects represent effective structural suppression rather than physical compression or measured speedup. item.title: 本文提出自监督学习框架Champollion，能从结构MRI中学习可解释的皮层折叠局部表征，其性能超越现有神经影像及通用基础模型，并揭示出比传统形态学指标更丰富的遗传关联和持久的神经发育特征。
item.description:
人类大脑皮层折叠的表征学习以揭示持久的神经发育特征

Representation learning of human cortical folding to reveal long lasting neurodevelopmental signatures

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05438

本文提出自监督学习框架Champollion，能从结构MRI中学习可解释的皮层折叠局部表征，其性能超越现有神经影像及通用基础模型，并揭示出比传统形态学指标更丰富的遗传关联和持久的神经发育特征。

人类大脑在子宫内发生折叠，主要发生在妊娠晚期。出生后不久，皮层折叠模式即已确立并在此后保持稳定，使其成为极具前景的早期神经发育标志物。然而，目前尚不清楚现有神经影像基础模型所提供的表征能否捕捉皮层折叠的变异性。在此，我们提出Champollion，一个自监督学习框架，可从结构磁共振成像中学习可解释的皮层折叠局部表征。通过在代表性折叠相关任务上进行优化，Champollion能够准确捕捉跨皮层区域和外部数据集的已知折叠模式。在一项全面的基准测试中，它始终优于神经影像基础模型和通用基础模型。此外，Champollion揭示了比传统形态计量描述符更丰富的遗传关联，并识别出与海马不完全……相关的局部折叠特征。

arXiv:2609.05438v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The human brain folds in utero, primarily during late gestation. Shortly after birth, cortical folding patterns are established and remain stable thereafter, making them promising early neurodevelopmental markers. Yet it is unclear whether representations given by current neuroimaging foundation models capture cortical folding variability. Here, we introduce Champollion, a self-supervised learning framework that learns interpretable local representations of cortical folding from structural MRI. Optimized on representative folding-related tasks, Champollion accurately captures known folding patterns across cortical regions and external datasets. In a comprehensive benchmark, it consistently outperforms neuroimaging and general-purpose foundation models. Furthermore, Champollion reveals richer genetic associations than conventional morphometric descriptors and identifies localized folding signatures associated with incomplete hippocampal

item.title: 本研究提出了一种融合加权机器学习集成、束搜索和质量约束重排序的混合框架，用于解决蛋白质序列重建中已知缺口大小和质量条件下的支架缺口填充问题。
item.description:
基于加权机器学习集成、束搜索和质量约束重排序的新型混合蛋白质支架缺口填充方法

Novel hybrid protein scaffold gap filling using weighted machine learning ensemble, beam search, and mass-constrained reranking

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05436

本研究提出了一种融合加权机器学习集成、束搜索和质量约束重排序的混合框架，用于解决蛋白质序列重建中已知缺口大小和质量条件下的支架缺口填充问题。

蛋白质支架缺口填充是蛋白质序列重建中的一项重要计算任务，需要根据不完整的支架信息推断缺失的氨基酸区域。本研究提出了一种混合机器学习与质量约束重排序框架，用于已知缺口大小和已知缺口质量两种设置下的蛋白质支架缺口填充。研究使用来自MabCampath、P5A蛋白质型和碳酸酐酶2的同源蛋白质序列，生成掩码的11聚体残基级样本和完整缺口评估案例。残基预测任务被表述为采用首位、中间位和末位掩码策略的20类氨基酸分类问题。研究使用原始编码、行平均和SVD降维特征训练了多个经典机器学习模型，并通过验证准确率加权集成的方式组合了表现最强的模型。对于已知大小的缺口重建，使用束搜索方法生成填补序列，并通过质量约束重排序对候选序列进行筛选优化。

arXiv:2609.05436v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Protein scaffold gap filling is an important computational task in protein sequence reconstruction, where missing amino acid regions must be inferred from incomplete scaffold information. This study proposes a hybrid machine learning and mass constrained reranking framework for protein scaffold gap filling under known-gap-size and known-gapmass settings. Homologous protein sequences from MabCampath, P5A proteoform, and carbonic anhydrase 2 were used to generate masked 11-mer residue-level samples and fullgap evaluation cases. The residue prediction task was formulated as a 20-class amino acid classification problem using first-, middle-, and last-position masking. Multiple classical machine learning models were trained using raw encoded, row-average, and SVD-reduced features, and the strongest models were combined through a validation-accuracy-weighted ensemble. For known-size gap reconstruction, beam search was used to generate comple

item.title: AhaBench 是一个长时程持续学习基准，通过谜题探索、带精确验证器的数学任务和自动售货机模拟三个组件，评估固定模型在获得先验经验后，在相关但支持已被移除、改变或延迟的条件下行为是否真正得到改善。
item.description:
AhaBench：智能体能从先验经验中学习吗？一个面向长时程持续学习的基准测试

AhaBench: Do Agents Learn from Prior Experience? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Continual Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05435

AhaBench 是一个长时程持续学习基准，通过谜题探索、带精确验证器的数学任务和自动售货机模拟三个组件，评估固定模型在获得先验经验后，在相关但支持已被移除、改变或延迟的条件下行为是否真正得到改善。

arXiv:2609.05435v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：现代语言智能体被期望在长时程上运行：它们会提出后续问题、复用已解决的示例、处理工具反馈，并适应延迟出现的后果。然而大多数评估仍然在每次提示后重置智能体，或仅对单条轨迹的最终状态进行评分。AhaBench 提出了一个更具操作性的问题：当一个固定模型获得有用的经验后，在一个明显的支持已被移除、改变或延迟的相关评估条件下，其后续行为是否会得到改善？该测试套件包含三个组成部分：Aha-Puzzle 测试智能体在解开隐藏状态谜题后的无提示探索能力；Aha-Euler 将类似 Project Euler 的数学思想转化为带有精确验证器的生成式教学/保留任务；Aha-Vending 是一个受 Vending-Bench 启发的开源实现，测试模拟的自动售货机智能体在处理延迟反馈和运营事故时能否保持盈利。AhaBench 报告了一个由三部分组成的评估结果

arXiv:2609.05435v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern language agents are expected to operate over long horizons: they ask follow-up questions, reuse worked examples, handle tool feedback, and adapt to delayed consequences. Most evaluations still reset the agent after a prompt or score only the final state of one trajectory. AhaBench asks a more operational question: when a fixed model receives useful experience, does its later behavior improve under a related evaluation condition where the obvious support has been removed, changed, or delayed? The suite contains three components. Aha-Puzzle tests no-hint exploration after solved hidden-state puzzles; Aha-Euler turns Project-Euler-style mathematical ideas into generated taught/held-out tasks with exact validators; and Aha-Vending, an open-source implementation inspired by Vending-Bench, tests whether a simulated vending agent remains profitable while handling delayed feedback and operational incidents.
