item.title: 该论文提出逐步拒答内部动力学（SRI）信号，揭示了扩散语言模型的重掩码采样机制能够从有害的中间生成内容中恢复，从而显著提升越狱鲁棒性，且这一优势在固定模型权重、仅切换采样方式时依然成立。
item.description:
自回归与扩散语言模型中的逐步拒答动力学

Step-Wise Refusal Dynamics in Autoregressive and Diffusion Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02600

该论文提出逐步拒答内部动力学（SRI）信号，揭示了扩散语言模型的重掩码采样机制能够从有害的中间生成内容中恢复，从而显著提升越狱鲁棒性，且这一优势在固定模型权重、仅切换采样方式时依然成立。

扩散语言模型（DLM）近来已成为自回归（AR）模型的有力竞争替代方案，具备并行解码、具有竞争力的生成质量，以及改进越狱鲁棒性的初步证据。尽管取得了这些进展，采样机制在塑造拒答行为中所扮演的角色仍鲜为人知。为填补这一空白，我们对逐步拒答动力学进行了全面研究。我们证明扩散重掩码（remasking）能够促进模型从有害的中间生成内容中恢复，提供证据表明该行为与采样机制紧密相关，并证明从自回归采样切换到扩散采样可以提升越狱鲁棒性，即使在模型权重固定的情况下也是如此。为了捕捉文本层面无法观察到的生成动力学，我们提出了逐步拒答内部动力学（Step-Wise Refusal Internal Dynamics, SRI）信号。与文本层面的发现相一致，SRI表明恢复失败主要发生在自回归采样下。

arXiv:2602.02600v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a competitive alternative to autoregressive (AR) models, offering parallel decoding, competitive generation quality, and initial evidence of improved jailbreak robustness. Despite this progress, the role of sampling mechanisms in shaping refusal behavior remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we present a comprehensive study of step-wise refusal dynamics. We show that diffusion remasking can promote recovery from harmful intermediate generations, provide evidence that this behavior is tied to the sampling mechanism, and demonstrate that switching from AR to diffusion sampling improves jailbreak robustness, including under fixed model weights. item.title: 本论文提出利用滑动窗口路径签名（SW-PS）提取局部结构特征，并结合轻量级线性循环单元（LRU）作为分类器，实现了对手写体字符在±180°任意旋转下仍保持高准确率的鲁棒识别。
item.description:
基于线性循环单元的旋转无关在线手写字符识别

Rotation-free Online Handwritten Character Recognition Using Linear Recurrent Units

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01533

本论文提出利用滑动窗口路径签名（SW-PS）提取局部结构特征，并结合轻量级线性循环单元（LRU）作为分类器，实现了对手写体字符在±180°任意旋转下仍保持高准确率的鲁棒识别。

在线手写字符识别利用笔画顺序和动态特征，与离线识别相比通常能提供更高的准确率和鲁棒性。然而，在实际应用中，旋转变形会破坏笔画的空间布局，显著降低识别准确率。因此，提取旋转不变特征仍然是一个具有挑战性的开放问题。在本工作中，我们采用滑动窗口路径签名（SW-PS）来捕获字符的局部结构特征，并引入轻量级的线性循环单元（LRU）作为分类器。LRU结合了循环神经网络（RNN）的快速增量处理能力和状态空间模型（SSM）的高效并行训练，同时能够可靠地建模动态笔画特征。我们在CASIA-O数据集的三个子集上进行了随机旋转角度高达±180°的识别实验。

arXiv:2602.01533v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Online handwritten character recognition leverages stroke order and dynamic features, which generally provide higher accuracy and robustness compared with offline recognition. However, in practical applications, rotational deformations can disrupt the spatial layout of strokes, substantially reducing recognition accuracy. Extracting rotation-invariant features therefore remains a challenging open problem. In this work, we employ the Sliding Window Path Signature (SW-PS) to capture local structural features of characters, and introduce the lightweight Linear Recurrent Units (LRU) as the classifier. The LRU combine the fast incremental processing capability of recurrent neural networks (RNN) with the efficient parallel training of state space models (SSM), while reliably modelling dynamic stroke characteristics. 基于贝叶斯不确定性量化与自适应残差学习的多保真物理信息神经网络用于参数化偏微分方程的高效求解

Multi-Fidelity Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification and Adaptive Residual Learning for Efficient Solution of Parametric Partial Differential Equations

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01176

本文提出MF-BPINN框架，通过融合物理信息神经网络、贝叶斯不确定性量化和自适应残差学习，利用低保真模拟与稀疏高保真数据的分层架构，实现了参数化偏微分方程的高效求解。

物理信息神经网络（PINNs）通过将物理定律直接嵌入到神经网络训练中，已成为求解偏微分方程（PDEs）的一种强大范式。然而，求解高保真PDE在计算上仍然代价高昂，特别是对于需要在多种参数配置下进行多次评估的参数化系统。本文提出了MF-BPINN，这是一种新颖的多保真框架，将物理信息神经网络与贝叶斯不确定性量化和自适应残差学习协同结合。我们的方法通过分层神经架构，利用丰富的低保真模拟与稀疏的高保真数据，学习不同保真度级别之间的非线性相关性。我们引入了一种具有可学习门控机制的自适应残差网络，能够动态平衡线性与非线性保真度差异。此外，我们还开发了一个严格的...

arXiv:2602.01176v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) by embedding physical laws directly into neural network training. However, solving high-fidelity PDEs remains computationally prohibitive, particularly for parametric systems requiring multiple evaluations across varying parameter configurations. This paper presents MF-BPINN, a novel multi-fidelity framework that synergistically combines physics-informed neural networks with Bayesian uncertainty quantification and adaptive residual learning. Our approach leverages abundant low-fidelity simulations alongside sparse high-fidelity data through a hierarchical neural architecture that learns nonlinear correlations across fidelity levels. item.title: 提出了名为1S-DAug的单次测试时数据增强方法，仅从单张原始图像通过受控噪声注入的几何扰动和图像条件去噪生成增强样本，无需模型训练或参数访问即可实现高达20%的相对准确率提升。
item.description:
单次测试时数据增强能否帮助泛化？

Can One-Shot Test-Time Data Augmentation Help with Generalization?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.00114

提出了名为1S-DAug的单次测试时数据增强方法，仅从单张原始图像通过受控噪声注入的几何扰动和图像条件去噪生成增强样本，无需模型训练或参数访问即可实现高达20%的相对准确率提升。

数据增强对模型泛化至关重要，但现有方法大多集中在训练阶段。测试时数据增强虽然研究不足，但可以在避免额外模型参数或微调的情况下，对泛化产生实际有效的提升。鉴于训练成本日益增加以及相关文献的空白，我们研究了是否有可能仅从单张原始图像通过图像生成来执行有效的测试时数据增强。我们首先分析了测试时数据增强的重要性，然后设计并研究了一个简单而自然的算子，命名为1S-DAug，它包含带受控噪声注入的几何扰动和基于图像条件的去噪。我们在四个数据集和多个模型的标准图像分类基准上获得了积极的结果，在不进行模型训练或访问模型参数的情况下，实现了高达20%的相对准确率提升。代码将会发布。

arXiv:2602.00114v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Data augmentation is crucial for model generalization, but existing methods are mostly centered on the training stage. Test-time augmentation, while underexplored, can be practically effective for generalization while avoiding extra model parameters or fine-tuning. Given the increasing training cost and the literature gap, we study whether it is possible to perform effective test-time augmentation using image generation from just the single original image. We first analyze the importance of test-time augmentation, and then design and study a simple yet natural operator named 1S-DAug, which comprises geometric perturbations with controlled noise injection and image-conditioned denoising. We obtain positive results on well-established image-classification benchmarks across four datasets and multiple models, achieving up to 20\% relative accuracy improvement without model training or parameter access. Code will be released.

item.title: 本文提出一种地理上下文引导的视觉Transformer，通过将异构地理空间变量嵌入为与图像块对齐的表示来增强遥感影像分析，从而实现基于遥感影像的健康结果观测。

视觉Transformer推动了遥感图像分析的重大进展，尤其是在目标检测和分割方面。近期的视觉-语言与多模态模型通过整合辅助信息（包括描述文本、问答对和元数据）进一步扩展了这些能力，将应用范围拓宽至传统计算机视觉任务之外。然而，这些模型通常针对视觉内容与文本内容之间的语义对齐进行优化，而非针对地理空间理解，因此并不适合表示或推理结构化的地理空间图层。在本研究中，我们提出了地理上下文引导的视觉Transformer（Geo-Context Guided Visual Transformer），利用辅助地理空间信息增强遥感影像的处理。所提出的方法引入了一种地理空间嵌入机制，将异构的地理空间变量转换为与图像块对齐的表示，以及一种非对称

item.title: 提出持续策略巩固（CPC）教师-学生框架，通过持续策略蒸馏、优先经验回放和可扩展专家，将强化学习驱动的技能习得与有监督的策略巩固相分离，使机器人能够终身学习新技能的同时保留已习得的行为。

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22475

提出持续策略巩固（CPC）教师-学生框架，通过持续策略蒸馏、优先经验回放和可扩展专家，将强化学习驱动的技能习得与有监督的策略巩固相分离，使机器人能够终身学习新技能的同时保留已习得的行为。

构建通用机器人策略需要在持续集成新技能的同时保留已习得的行为。由于机器人交互成本高昂、任务分布异构、且顺序更新会引发干扰，直接在持续增长的任务流上优化单一策略十分困难。为解决这些问题，我们提出了持续策略巩固（CPC），这是一种结合持续策略蒸馏、优先经验回放和可扩展专家的教师-学生框架。该架构将技能习得与策略巩固相分离：教师通过强化学习独立训练，其行为被持续蒸馏到一个中心化的通用学生策略中。这种分解既保留了强化学习在任务专用训练方面的实用优势，又将学生端的策略巩固转化为一个有监督的策略学习问题。

arXiv:2601.22475v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Building a generalist robot policy requires continuously integrating new skills while preserving previously acquired behaviors. Directly optimizing a single policy over a growing task stream is difficult because robotic interaction is expensive, task distributions are heterogeneous, and sequential updates induce interference. To address these problems, we propose continual policy consolidation (CPC), a teacher--student framework that combines continual policy distillation with prioritized experience replay and expandable experts. This architecture separates skill acquisition from policy consolidation: teachers are trained independently through reinforcement learning, and their behaviors are continually distilled into a central generalist student. This decomposition retains the practical strength of reinforcement learning for task-specialized training while casting student-side consolidation as a supervised policy-learning problem. To

item.title: 该论文提出了一个在环境维度与潜在表示同时增长情形下的低秩加稀疏矩阵迁移学习框架，通过锚定交替投影估计器在保留已迁移子空间的同时仅估计低维创新与稀疏修改，实现了严格更优的误差率。
item.description:
增长表示与环境维度下的低秩加稀疏矩阵迁移学习

Low-Rank Plus Sparse Matrix Transfer Learning under Growing Representations and Ambient Dimensions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21873

该论文提出了一个在环境维度与潜在表示同时增长情形下的低秩加稀疏矩阵迁移学习框架，通过锚定交替投影估计器在保留已迁移子空间的同时仅估计低维创新与稀疏修改，实现了严格更优的误差率。

学习系统往往会随时间扩展其环境特征或潜在表示，将早期表示嵌入到更大的空间中，而仅引入有限的新潜在结构。我们研究了在环境维度与内在表示同时增长情况下的结构化矩阵估计迁移学习问题，其中估计良好的源任务被嵌入为更高维目标任务的一个子空间。我们提出了一个通用的迁移框架，其中目标参数分解为嵌入的源分量、低维低秩创新分量以及稀疏编辑分量，并开发了一种锚定交替投影估计器，该估计器在保留已迁移子空间的同时，仅估计低维创新和稀疏修改。我们建立了确定性的误差界，将目标噪声、表示增长和源估计误差的贡献分离开来，当秩与稀疏度增量受限时可获得严格更优的误差率。

arXiv:2601.21873v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Learning systems often expand their ambient features or latent representations over time, embedding earlier representations into larger spaces with limited new latent structure. We study transfer learning for structured matrix estimation under simultaneous growth of the ambient dimension and the intrinsic representation, where a well-estimated source task is embedded as a subspace of a higher-dimensional target task. We propose a general transfer framework in which the target parameter decomposes into an embedded source component, low-dimensional low-rank innovations, and sparse edits, and develop an anchored alternating projection estimator that preserves transferred subspaces while estimating only low-dimensional innovations and sparse modifications. We establish deterministic error bounds that separate target noise, representation growth, and source estimation error, yielding strictly improved rates when rank and sparsity increm

item.title: 本文提出重置与丢弃（ReD）查询方法，克服了pass@k幂律行为导致的边际收益递减问题，在固定预算下显著提升大语言模型回答独特问题的数量（coverage@cost），并能定量预测节省的尝试次数。
item.description:
物有所值：使用重置与丢弃（ReD）方法在固定预算下提升大语言模型的推理能力

More Bang for the Buck: Improving the Inference of Large Language Models at a Fixed Budget using Reset and Discard (ReD)

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21522

本文提出重置与丢弃（ReD）查询方法，克服了pass@k幂律行为导致的边际收益递减问题，在固定预算下显著提升大语言模型回答独特问题的数量（coverage@cost），并能定量预测节省的尝试次数。

大语言模型（LLM）在可验证任务上的性能通常用pass@k来衡量，即在k次尝试中至少一次正确回答问题的概率。在固定预算下，更合适的指标是coverage@cost，即作为总尝试次数函数的已正确回答的独特问题平均数量。我们建立了这两个指标之间的联系，并证明在经验上观察到的pass@k幂律行为会导致coverage@cost的次线性增长（即边际收益递减）。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了重置与丢弃（ReD），这是一种大语言模型查询方法，无论pass@k的具体形式如何，都能在给定预算下提高coverage@cost。此外，在给定pass@k的情况下，我们可以定量预测使用ReD所能节省的总尝试次数。如果模型的pass@k不可用，ReD可以推断其幂律指数。我们在三个大语言模型上进行了实验，涵盖编程（HumanEval）、数学（GSM8K）和推理（MMLU-Pro）任务。

arXiv:2601.21522v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The performance of large language models (LLMs) on verifiable tasks is usually measured by pass@k, the probability of answering a question correctly at least once in k trials. At a fixed budget, a more suitable metric is coverage@cost, the average number of unique questions answered as a function of the total number of attempts. We connect the two metrics and show that the empirically-observed power-law behavior in pass@k leads to a sublinear growth of the coverage@cost (diminishing returns). To solve this problem, we propose Reset-and-Discard (ReD), a query method of LLMs that increases coverage@cost for a given budget, regardless of the pass@k form. Moreover, given a pass@k, we can quantitatively predict the savings in the total number of attempts using ReD. If pass@k is not available for the model, ReD can infer its power-law exponent. item.title: 提出Hypersolid自监督学习方法，通过将视图对齐与短程排斥（局部碰撞避免）相结合，诱导出低各向异性、语义对齐的紧凑潜在几何结构，在无监督聚类和细粒度区分任务上表现尤为出色。
item.description:
Hypersolid：通过短程排斥涌现视觉表征

Hypersolid: Emergent Vision Representations via Short-Range Repulsion

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21255

提出Hypersolid自监督学习方法，通过将视图对齐与短程排斥（局部碰撞避免）相结合，诱导出低各向异性、语义对齐的紧凑潜在几何结构，在无监督聚类和细粒度区分任务上表现尤为出色。

自监督学习的一个核心问题是防止表征坍缩。大多数方法通过全局机制来避免这一问题，例如对比扩展、方差约束、维度去相关或强制特定的输出分布。在本工作中，我们研究了另一种不同的设计：短程排斥。我们提出了Hypersolid，这是一种将视图对齐与局部碰撞避免相结合的自监督目标函数。我们的方法诱导出一种由紧凑的、语义对齐的邻域构成的低各向异性潜在几何结构。这种几何结构在无监督聚类和细粒度区分方面尤为有效，尽管其代价是迁移能力较弱。

arXiv:2601.21255v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A central problem in self-supervised learning is preventing representation collapse. Most methods avoid it through global mechanisms, such as contrastive expansion, variance constraints, decorrelating dimensions, or enforcing certain output distributions. In this work, we study a different design: short-range repulsion. We introduce Hypersolid, a self-supervised objective that combines view alignment with local collision avoidance. Our method induces a latent geometry of compact, semantically aligned neighborhoods with low anisotropy. This geometry is especially effective for unsupervised clustering and fine-grained separation, although it comes at the cost of weaker transferability.

item.title: 本文提出一种结合Lovász扩展次梯度与高斯平滑的零阶方法，解决了非光滑次模-凹函数的离线与在线极小极大问题，证明了离线情形收敛到ε-鞍点，并在在线情形达到O(√(N(1+P̄_N)))的对偶间隙。
item.description:
求解非光滑次模-凹函数的离线与在线极小极大问题：一种零阶方法

Solving the Offline and Online Min-Max Problem of Non-smooth Submodular-Concave Functions: A Zeroth-Order Approach

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21243

本文提出一种结合Lovász扩展次梯度与高斯平滑的零阶方法，解决了非光滑次模-凹函数的离线与在线极小极大问题，证明了离线情形收敛到ε-鞍点，并在在线情形达到O(√(N(1+P̄_N)))的对偶间隙。

我们考虑目标函数可能非光滑、关于极小化变量为次模函数且关于极大化变量为凹函数的极大-极小和极小-极大问题。我们研究了应用于该问题的零阶方法的性能。该方法基于目标函数关于极小化变量的Lovász扩展的次梯度，并基于高斯平滑来估计关于极大化变量的平滑函数梯度。在期望意义下，我们证明了该算法在离线情形下收敛到ε-鞍点。此外，我们证明在期望意义下，在在线设置中，该算法实现了O(√(N(1+P̄_N)))的在线对偶间隙，其中N是迭代次数，P̄_N是最优决策序列的路径长度。我们为所有情形给出了复杂度分析和超参数选择。

arXiv:2601.21243v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We consider max-min and min-max problems with objective functions that are possibly non-smooth, submodular with respect to the minimiser and concave with respect to the maximiser. We investigate the performance of a zeroth-order method applied to this problem. The method is based on the subgradient of the Lov\'asz extension of the objective function with respect to the minimiser and based on Gaussian smoothing to estimate the smoothed function gradient with respect to the maximiser. In expectation sense, we prove the convergence of the algorithm to an $\epsilon$-saddle point in the offline case. Moreover, we show that, in the expectation sense, in the online setting, the algorithm achieves $O(\sqrt{N(1+\bar{P}_N)})$ online duality gap, where $N$ is the number of iterations and $\bar{P}_N$ is the path length of the sequence of optimal decisions. The complexity analysis and hyperparameter selection are presented for all the cases

item.title: PatchFormer是一种基于补丁的时间序列基础模型，通过层次化掩码重建自监督预训练、跨时间尺度可学习聚合、跨域知识蒸馏以及轻量级适配器迁移，在24个基准数据集上实现了最先进的零样本多步预测并显著降低均方误差。
item.description:
PatchFormer：一种基于补丁的时间序列基础模型，采用层次化掩码重建与跨域迁移学习实现零样本多步预测

PatchFormer: A Patch-Based Time Series Foundation Model with Hierarchical Masked Reconstruction and Cross-Domain Transfer Learning for Zero-Shot Multi-Horizon Forecasting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.20845

PatchFormer是一种基于补丁的时间序列基础模型，通过层次化掩码重建自监督预训练、跨时间尺度可学习聚合、跨域知识蒸馏以及轻量级适配器迁移，在24个基准数据集上实现了最先进的零样本多步预测并显著降低均方误差。

时间序列预测是一个基础性问题，在气候、能源、医疗健康和金融等领域具有广泛应用。许多现有方法需要针对特定领域的特征工程以及大量的标注数据。我们提出了PatchFormer，这是一种基于补丁的时间序列基础模型，利用层次化掩码重建进行自监督预训练，并通过轻量级适配器实现高效迁移。PatchFormer将时间序列分割为补丁，通过跨时间尺度的可学习聚合来学习多尺度时间表示。预训练采用带动态掩码的掩码补丁重建，其目标函数同时鼓励局部准确性和全局一致性，随后进行跨域知识蒸馏。在涵盖天气、能源、交通、金融和医疗健康领域的24个基准数据集上的实验表明，该模型实现了最先进的零样本多步预测性能，将均方误差降低了2（原文摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2601.20845v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Time series forecasting is a fundamental problem with applications in climate, energy, healthcare, and finance. Many existing approaches require domain-specific feature engineering and substantial labeled data for each task. We introduce PatchFormer, a patch-based time series foundation model that uses hierarchical masked reconstruction for self-supervised pretraining and lightweight adapters for efficient transfer. PatchFormer segments time series into patches and learns multiscale temporal representations with learnable aggregation across temporal scales. Pretraining uses masked patch reconstruction with dynamic masking and objectives that encourage both local accuracy and global consistency, followed by cross-domain knowledge distillation. Experiments on 24 benchmark datasets spanning weather, energy, traffic, finance, and healthcare demonstrate state-of-the-art zero-shot multi-horizon forecasting, reducing mean squared error by 2

item.title: 本文提出一种半监督学习框架，利用数百万个无需原子级标注的文献谱图大规模学习核磁共振化学位移预测，显著提升了预测准确性、鲁棒性和泛化能力。
item.description:
从人工标注到文献：大规模核磁共振化学位移的半监督学习

From Human Labels to Literature: Semi-Supervised Learning of NMR Chemical Shifts at Scale

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18524

本文提出一种半监督学习框架，利用数百万个无需原子级标注的文献谱图大规模学习核磁共振化学位移预测，显著提升了预测准确性、鲁棒性和泛化能力。

核磁共振（NMR）化学位移的准确预测是谱图分析和分子结构解析的基础，然而现有的机器学习方法依赖于有限的、需要大量人工劳动的原子级标注数据集。我们提出了一种半监督框架，能够从数百万个文献提取的谱图中学习NMR化学位移，而无需显式的原子级标注，将少量标注数据与大规模未标注谱图相结合。我们将从文献谱图中预测化学位移的问题表述为置换不变的集合监督问题，并证明在损失函数满足通常可满足的条件下，最优二分匹配可以简化为基于排序的损失，从而实现超越传统精选数据集的稳定大规模半监督训练。我们的模型在准确性和鲁棒性方面显著优于最先进的方法，并展现出更强的泛化能力。

arXiv:2601.18524v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate prediction of nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) chemical shifts is fundamental to spectral analysis and molecular structure elucidation, yet existing machine learning methods rely on limited, labor-intensive atom-assigned datasets. We propose a semi-supervised framework that learns NMR chemical shifts from millions of literature-extracted spectra without explicit atom-level assignments, integrating a small amount of labeled data with large-scale unassigned spectra. We formulate chemical shift prediction from literature spectra as a permutation-invariant set supervision problem, and show that under commonly satisfied conditions on the loss function, optimal bipartite matching reduces to a sorting-based loss, enabling stable large-scale semi-supervised training beyond traditional curated datasets. Our models achieve substantially improved accuracy and robustness over state-of-the-art methods and exhibit stronger generalization

item.title: 提出SFO神经算子，利用基于希尔伯特矩阵特征模态的通用谱基参数化积分核，仅学习快速衰减特征值的谱系数即可高效捕捉偏微分方程解映射中的长程非局部相互作用，在六个基准测试中达到最先进精度。
item.description:
SFO：通过谱滤波学习偏微分方程算子

SFO: Learning PDE Operators via Spectral Filtering

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.17090

提出SFO神经算子，利用基于希尔伯特矩阵特征模态的通用谱基参数化积分核，仅学习快速衰减特征值的谱系数即可高效捕捉偏微分方程解映射中的长程非局部相互作用，在六个基准测试中达到最先进精度。

偏微分方程（PDE）控制着复杂系统，然而神经算子往往难以高效地捕捉其解映射中固有的长程、非局部相互作用。我们提出了谱滤波算子（SFO），这是一种利用通用谱基（USB）来参数化积分核的神经算子，通用谱基是由谱滤波理论中希尔伯特矩阵的特征模态导出的固定全局正交基。基于我们的理论发现——平移不变的偏微分方程离散化的离散格林函数表现出空间线性动力系统（LDS）结构——我们证明了这些核在通用谱基中容许紧凑的近似。通过仅学习快速衰减特征值的谱系数，SFO实现了高度高效的表示。在包括反应扩散、流体动力学和三维电磁学在内的六个基准测试中，SFO达到了最先进的精度。

arXiv:2601.17090v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Partial differential equations (PDEs) govern complex systems, yet neural operators often struggle to efficiently capture the long-range, nonlocal interactions inherent in their solution maps. We introduce Spectral Filtering Operator (SFO), a neural operator that parameterizes integral kernels using the Universal Spectral Basis (USB), a fixed, global orthonormal basis derived from the eigenmodes of the Hilbert matrix in spectral filtering theory. Motivated by our theoretical finding that the discrete Green's functions of shift-invariant PDE discretizations exhibit spatial Linear Dynamical System (LDS) structure, we prove that these kernels admit compact approximations in the USB. By learning only the spectral coefficients of rapidly decaying eigenvalues, SFO achieves a highly efficient representation. Across six benchmarks, including reaction-diffusion, fluid dynamics, and 3D electromagnetics, SFO achieves state-of-the-art accur

item.title: 提出了战略条令语言模型框架，通过融合多文档注意力、时间编码和条令一致性层，在多文档战略推理中实现条令一致性与校准不确定性，其战略质量和长程地缘政治预测能力超越通用大语言模型基线，并可与人类专家媲美。
item.description:
战略条令语言模型：一个面向条令一致性与地缘政治预测的学习系统框架

Strategic Doctrine Language Models (sdLM): A Learning-System Framework for Doctrinal Consistency and Geopolitical Forecasting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.14862

提出了战略条令语言模型框架，通过融合多文档注意力、时间编码和条令一致性层，在多文档战略推理中实现条令一致性与校准不确定性，其战略质量和长程地缘政治预测能力超越通用大语言模型基线，并可与人类专家媲美。

我们提出了战略条令语言模型，这是一个面向多文档战略推理的学习系统框架，具备条令一致性约束和校准的不确定性。该方法结合了多文档注意力机制、时间编码和条令一致性层，以提升长程预测能力和计划合理性，同时减少严重的条令违规。我们通过以下三种方式评估sdLM：(i) 对战略情景进行专家小组评分（N=47）；(ii) 在336份条令出版物（12,847条陈述）上检验条令一致性；(iii) 在127个历史反事实案例（1945-2020年）上进行跨越12-60个月时间范围的地缘政治预测。在这些基准测试中，sdLM相比强大的通用大语言模型基线实现了更高的战略质量和更好的校准性，并且在长程判断方面与人类专家保持竞争力。我们还进一步报告了消融实验、扩展趋势以及面向部署的性能/延迟表现。

arXiv:2601.14862v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce Strategic Doctrine Language Models (sdLM), a learning-system framework for multi-document strategic reasoning with doctrinal consistency constraints and calibrated uncertainty. The approach combines multi-document attention, temporal encoding, and a doctrine-consistency layer to improve long-horizon forecasting and plan plausibility while reducing severe doctrinal violations. We evaluate sdLM using (i) expert-panel scoring of strategic scenarios (N=47), (ii) doctrine consistency on 336 doctrine publications (12,847 statements), and (iii) geopolitical forecasting on 127 historical counterfactuals (1945-2020) across 12-60 month horizons. Across these benchmarks, sdLM achieves higher strategic quality and better calibration than strong general-purpose LLM baselines, and remains competitive with human experts on long-horizon judgments. item.title: 提出 SWE-Tester 流程，通过从2600个开源仓库构建的4.1万实例高质量数据集微调开源大语言模型，使其能够自动生成问题复现测试，成功率最高提升10%。
item.description:
SWE-Tester：训练开源大语言模型在真实世界代码仓库中进行问题复现

SWE-Tester: Training Open-Source LLMs for Issue Reproduction in Real-World Repositories

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.13713

提出 SWE-Tester 流程，通过从2600个开源仓库构建的4.1万实例高质量数据集微调开源大语言模型，使其能够自动生成问题复现测试，成功率最高提升10%。

软件测试对于确保软件系统的正确性和可靠性至关重要。从自然语言问题描述中自动生成问题复现测试，能够通过简化根本原因分析来提高开发人员的工作效率，促进测试驱动开发——“先写测试，后写代码”，并可用于提升编码智能体等自动化问题解决系统的有效性。针对该任务提出的现有方法主要依赖于闭源大语言模型，对开源模型的探索十分有限。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 SWE-Tester——一个用于训练开源大语言模型生成问题复现测试的新型流程。首先，我们从2600个开源GitHub仓库中精心构建了一个包含4.1万个实例的高质量训练数据集，并用它训练了不同规模和不同系列的大语言模型。微调后的模型在成功率和变更方面分别实现了高达10%和21%的绝对提升。

arXiv:2601.13713v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Software testing is crucial for ensuring the correctness and reliability of software systems. Automated generation of issue reproduction tests from natural language issue descriptions enhances developer productivity by simplifying root cause analysis, promotes test-driven development -- "test first, write code later", and can be used for improving the effectiveness of automated issue resolution systems like coding agents. Existing methods proposed for this task predominantly rely on closed-source LLMs, with limited exploration of open models. To address this, we propose SWE-Tester -- a novel pipeline for training open-source LLMs to generate issue reproduction tests. First, we curate a high-quality training dataset of 41K instances from 2.6K open-source GitHub repositories and use it to train LLMs of varying sizes and families. The fine-tuned models achieve absolute improvements of up to 10\% in success rate and 21\% in change

item.title: 本文提出了一种人工智能新策略——直接在人类大脑数据（神经影像数据）上训练基础模型，以获取文本等人类生成数据无法体现的认知信息，从而克服基础模型的现有局限性。
item.description:
人工智能的新策略：直接在人类大脑数据上训练基础模型

A New Strategy for Artificial Intelligence: Training Foundation Models Directly on Human Brain Data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.12053

本文提出了一种人工智能新策略——直接在人类大脑数据（神经影像数据）上训练基础模型，以获取文本等人类生成数据无法体现的认知信息，从而克服基础模型的现有局限性。

尽管基础模型已经在众多领域取得了显著成果，但它们仍然依赖人类生成的数据（如文本）作为知识的基本来源。然而，这些数据归根结底是人类大脑的产物，是更深层次神经复杂性的过滤投影。在本文中，我们探索一种人工智能的新策略：通过直接在人类大脑数据上训练基础模型，超越表层的统计规律。我们假设神经影像数据可以为我们打开一扇窗口，揭示通过可观察行为无法获取的人类认知要素，并论证这些额外知识可以与传统训练数据相结合，用以克服基础模型当前的一些局限性。虽然此前的研究已经证明了在神经模式上训练经典机器学习、深度学习或强化学习模型的可能性……

arXiv:2601.12053v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: While foundation models have achieved remarkable results across a diversity of domains, they still rely on human-generated data, such as text, as a fundamental source of knowledge. However, this data is ultimately the product of human brains, the filtered projection of a deeper neural complexity. In this paper, we explore a new strategy for artificial intelligence: moving beyond surface-level statistical regularities by training foundation models directly on human brain data. We hypothesize that neuroimaging data could open a window into elements of human cognition that are not accessible through observable actions, and argue that this additional knowledge could be used, alongside classical training data, to overcome some of the current limitations of foundation models. While previous research has demonstrated the possibility to train classical machine learning, deep learning, or reinforcement learning models on neural patterns

item.title: 该论文提出GIFT方法，通过token级变分代理目标引入有限温度Gibbs初始化，使SFT目标与后续RL阶段结构兼容，避免分布坍缩并保留探索空间，从而提升大型推理模型的后训练效果。
item.description:
GIFT：通过变分有限温度Gibbs初始化调和后训练目标

GIFT: Reconciling Post-Training Objectives via Variational Finite-Temperature Gibbs Initialization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.09233

该论文提出GIFT方法，通过token级变分代理目标引入有限温度Gibbs初始化，使SFT目标与后续RL阶段结构兼容，避免分布坍缩并保留探索空间，从而提升大型推理模型的后训练效果。

大型推理模型（LRM）主流的后训练范式——先监督微调（SFT）后强化学习（RL）——存在固有的优化失配问题：SFT中刚性的似然最大化会导致分布坍缩，从而耗尽后续RL所必需的探索空间。受KL正则化RL的Gibbs最优解启发，我们推导出一个token级别的变分代理目标，使SFT目标在结构上与后续RL阶段兼容，并提出了有限温度Gibbs初始化（GIFT）。标准SFT是该代理目标的退化零温极限，而有限温度则能保留结构多样性。我们的实验表明，GIFT优于标准SFT，并在用作RL初始化时超越了具有竞争力的基线方法。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/zzy1127/GIFT 获取。

arXiv:2601.09233v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The prevailing post-training paradigm for Large Reasoning Models (LRMs)---Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning (RL)-suffers from an intrinsic optimization mismatch: the rigid likelihood maximization in SFT induces distributional collapse, thereby exhausting the exploration space necessary for subsequent RL. Motivated by the Gibbs optimum of KL-regularized RL, we derive a token-level variational surrogate that makes the SFT target structurally compatible with the subsequent RL stage, and propose Gibbs Initialization with Finite Temperature (GIFT). Standard SFT emerges as a degenerate zero-temperature limit of this surrogate, while a finite temperature preserves structural diversity. Our experiments demonstrate that GIFT outperforms standard SFT and surpasses competitive baselines when utilized for RL initialization. Our code is available at https://github.com/zzy1127/GIFT.

item.title: 本文提出了Dynafit方法，通过逼近Koopman算子并结合核技巧学习训练数据与底层动力学之间的距离度量，实现对非线性动力系统生成轨迹的最小距离分类。
item.description:
面向非线性动力系统的最小距离分类

Minimum distance classification for nonlinear dynamical systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.04058

本文提出了Dynafit方法，通过逼近Koopman算子并结合核技巧学习训练数据与底层动力学之间的距离度量，实现对非线性动力系统生成轨迹的最小距离分类。

我们研究了将由非线性动力系统生成的轨迹或序列进行分类的问题，其中每个类别对应一个不同的动力系统。我们提出了Dynafit，一种基于核方法的技术，用于学习训练数据与底层动力学之间的距离度量。根据学习到的度量，新的观测数据被分配到其动力学最能拟合该观测数据的类别。该学习算法通过逼近Koopman算子，在与核函数相关的（可能是无限维的）特征空间中对动力学进行全局线性化。通过利用机器学习中常用的核技巧，距离度量可以在特征空间中计算，且与特征空间的维度无关。当可以获得动力学的先验知识时，还可以对核函数进行定制以融入这些先验信息。我们考虑了一个经典的测试例子——作为离散动力系统的逻辑斯蒂映射（logistic map），并推导了…

arXiv:2601.04058v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We address the problem of classifying trajectories or sequences generated by nonlinear dynamical systems, where each class corresponds to a distinct dynamical system. We propose Dynafit, a kernel-based method that learns a distance metric between training data and the underlying dynamics. New observations are assigned to the class whose dynamics best fit the observations according to the learned metric.The learning algorithm approximates the Koopman operator, which globally linearizes the dynamics in a (potentially infinite-dimensional) feature space associated with a kernel function. The distance metric is computed in the feature space independently of its dimensionality by exploiting the kernel trick commonly used in machine learning. The kernel function can be tailored to incorporate prior knowledge of the dynamics when available. item.title: 本文提出了一种结合线性与非线性前馈神经网络结构的多元混合神经网络架构，并整合了一种新颖的部分在线学习策略（将热启动与各训练阶段的不同超参数配置相结合），从而在计算成本与预测精度之间取得平衡，提升日前电力价格预测的准确性。

电力价格预测：连接线性模型、神经网络与在线学习

精确的日前电力价格预测对于确保高效的投资组合管理、支持电厂运营的战略决策以及实现有效的电池优化至关重要。然而，在不确定且波动的市场环境中开发准确的预测模型极具挑战性。例如，虽然线性模型通常在预测电力价格方面表现出具有竞争力的性能，且计算需求极小，但它们无法捕捉相关的非线性关系。另一方面，非线性模型能够在计算成本大幅增加的情况下提高预测精度。我们采用了一种多元混合神经网络架构，该架构结合了线性和非线性前馈神经网络结构。随后，我们将该架构与一种新颖的部分在线学习策略相结合，该策略将热启动与各训练阶段不同的超参数配置相融合。这一……

arXiv:2601.02856v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Precise day-ahead forecasts for electricity prices are crucial to ensure efficient portfolio management, support strategic decision-making for power plant operations, and enable effective battery optimization. However, developing an accurate prediction model is highly challenging in an uncertain and volatile market environment. For instance, although linear models generally exhibit competitive performance in predicting electricity prices with minimal computational requirements, they fail to capture relevant nonlinear relationships. Nonlinear models, on the other hand, can improve forecasting accuracy with a surge in computational costs. We employ a multivariate hybrid neural architecture that combines linear and nonlinear feed-forward neural structures. We then integrate this architecture with a novel partial online learning strategy that combines warm-starting with distinct hyperparameter configurations for each training stage. This

item.title: 本文提出时序Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（T-KAN），用可学习的B样条激活函数替代LSTM的固定线性权重来预测限价订单簿，在k=100时间范围内F1分数相对提升19.1%，实现132.48%的回报并显著缓解阿尔法衰减问题，同时具备良好的可解释性。
item.description:
用于高频限价订单簿预测的时序Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（T-KAN）：效率、可解释性与阿尔法衰减

Temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (T-KAN) for High-Frequency Limit Order Book Forecasting: Efficiency, Interpretability, and Alpha Decay

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.02310

本文提出时序Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（T-KAN），用可学习的B样条激活函数替代LSTM的固定线性权重来预测限价订单簿，在k=100时间范围内F1分数相对提升19.1%，实现132.48%的回报并显著缓解阿尔法衰减问题，同时具备良好的可解释性。

高频交易（HFT）环境的特点是存在海量的限价订单簿（LOB）数据，这些数据以噪声大和非线性著称。阿尔法衰减是一个重大挑战，传统模型如DeepLOB随着预测时间范围（k）的增加而逐渐失去预测能力。本文基于FI-2010数据集的数据，引入时序Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（T-KAN），用可学习的B样条激活函数取代标准LSTM中固定的线性权重。这使得模型能够学习市场信号的“形状”，而不仅仅是其幅度。该方法在k = 100时间范围内使F1分数相对提升了19.1%。T-KAN网络的有效性不容小觑，在1.0个基点交易成本下产生了132.48%的回报，而DeepLOB的回撤为-82.76%。此外，T-KAN模型被证明具有良好的可解释性，“死区”清晰可见。

arXiv:2601.02310v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High-Frequency trading (HFT) environments are characterised by large volumes of limit order book (LOB) data, which is notoriously noisy and non-linear. Alpha decay represents a significant challenge, with traditional models such as DeepLOB losing predictive power as the time horizon (k) increases. In this paper, using data from the FI-2010 dataset, we introduce Temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (T-KAN) to replace the fixed, linear weights of standard LSTMs with learnable B-spline activation functions. This allows the model to learn the 'shape' of market signals as opposed to just their magnitude. This resulted in a 19.1% relative improvement in the F1-score at the k = 100 horizon. The efficacy of T-KAN networks cannot be understated, producing a 132.48% return compared to the -82.76% DeepLOB drawdown under 1.0 bps transaction costs. item.title: 该论文基于奇异学习理论提出了一个可微分因果发现框架，验证了WBIC在线性高斯ADMG奇异模型上的一致性，通过ADVI实现其可扩展近似，并利用Gumbel-Softmax松弛实现了在有向与双向邻接结构上的可微分搜索，从而在存在未观测混杂因素时实现高效的线性因果发现。
item.description:
混杂因素下奇异线性模型的可微分因果发现

Differentiable Causal Discovery for Singular Linear Models under Confounding

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.01368

该论文基于奇异学习理论提出了一个可微分因果发现框架，验证了WBIC在线性高斯ADMG奇异模型上的一致性，通过ADVI实现其可扩展近似，并利用Gumbel-Softmax松弛实现了在有向与双向邻接结构上的可微分搜索，从而在存在未观测混杂因素时实现高效的线性因果发现。

在存在未观测混杂因素的情况下，基于评分的因果发现方法既需要一致的评分准则，也需要在图结构上进行高效搜索。具有相关误差的线性因果模型自然地可以用有向无环混合图（ADMG）来表示，其诱导的模型族包含奇异统计模型，而对于这些奇异模型，标准的贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）是非一致的。我们基于奇异学习理论，开发了一个针对线性高斯ADMG的基于评分的因果发现框架。我们首先验证了线性因果模型类满足广泛适用贝叶斯信息准则（WBIC）一致性的条件。随后，我们通过自动微分变分推断（ADVI）提出了WBIC的一种可扩展近似方法。最后，我们通过对有向邻接和双向邻接进行Gumbel-Softmax松弛，引入了一种针对ADMG的可微分搜索方法。实验……

arXiv:2601.01368v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Score-based causal discovery in the presence of unobserved confounders requires both a consistent scoring criterion and an efficient search over graph structures. Linear causal models with correlated errors are naturally represented by acyclic directed mixed graphs (ADMGs), whose induced model families include singular statistical models for which the standard Bayesian Information Criterion is inconsistent. We develop a score-based framework for causal discovery over linear Gaussian ADMGs grounded in singular learning theory. We first verify that the conditions for consistency of the Widely Applicable Bayesian Information Criterion (WBIC) are satisfied by the linear causal model class. We then propose a scalable approximation of the WBIC via Automatic Differentiation Variational Inference (ADVI). item.title: Alpha-R1提出了一个强化学习对齐的LLM框架，通过“语义门控”机制将候选因子的经济逻辑与动态构建的市场状态描述进行匹配，实现了情境感知的Alpha因子筛选，突破了传统方法仅依赖数值时间序列、忽视经济语义的局限。
item.description:
Alpha-R1：基于强化学习的LLM推理Alpha筛选

Alpha-R1: Alpha Screening with LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23515

Alpha-R1提出了一个强化学习对齐的LLM框架，通过“语义门控”机制将候选因子的经济逻辑与动态构建的市场状态描述进行匹配，实现了情境感知的Alpha因子筛选，突破了传统方法仅依赖数值时间序列、忽视经济语义的局限。

信号衰减和市场状态转换是非平稳市场中数据驱动投资策略反复面临的挑战，传统时间序列和机器学习方法往往难以超越历史相关性进行泛化。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在处理非结构化信息方面展现出强大能力，但其通过显式经济推理支持量化因子筛选的潜力仍未被充分探索。现有基于因子的方法通常将Alpha简化为数值时间序列，忽视了决定因子何时具有经济相关性的语义逻辑。我们提出了Alpha-R1，一个通过强化学习对齐的LLM框架，用于情境感知的Alpha筛选。其核心机制——语义门控，将每个候选因子的语义特征与动态构建的市场状态描述进行对比评估，从而筛选出经济逻辑与当前市场环境相契合的稀疏因子子集。

arXiv:2512.23515v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Signal decay and regime shifts pose recurring challenges for data-driven investment strategies in non-stationary markets, where conventional time-series and machine learning approaches often struggle to generalize beyond historical correlations. While large language models (LLMs) offer strong capabilities for processing unstructured information, their potential to support quantitative factor screening through explicit economic reasoning remains underexplored. Existing factor-based methods typically reduce alphas to numerical time series, overlooking the semantic rationale that determines when a factor is economically relevant. We present Alpha-R1, an RL-aligned LLM framework for context-aware alpha screening. item.title: SemDAC通过在残差向量量化中引入由HuBERT蒸馏得到的语义条件化机制，使语音编解码器在仅0.95 kbps的比特率下即可达到甚至超越2.5 kbps DAC基线的客观与主观性能。

面向低比特率神经语音压缩的解码端语义条件化方法

Decoder-Side Semantic Conditioning for Low-Bitrate Neural Speech Compression

SemDAC通过在残差向量量化中引入由HuBERT蒸馏得到的语义条件化机制，使语音编解码器在仅0.95 kbps的比特率下即可达到甚至超越2.5 kbps DAC基线的客观与主观性能。

语音编解码器通常以波形保真度为优化目标，将比特分配给那些可以从语言结构中推断出来的声学细节，这导致了压缩效率低下和识别性能下降。我们提出了SemDAC，一种语义感知的神经语音编解码器，它在残差向量量化（RVQ）中引入了层次化的语义条件化机制。第一个RVQ量化器从HuBERT特征蒸馏而来，产生能够捕捉语音内容的语义标记，而后续的量化器则编码残余的声学信息。解码器通过特征级线性调制（FiLM）以语义标记为条件，将重建过程引导至语义抽象未能解释的信息上。在0.95 kbps的比特率下，SemDAC在PESQ、STOI、SI-SNR和Whisper WER指标上达到或超越了2.5 kbps的DAC基线，ViSQOL表现相当，并且其主观MOS高于更高比特率的DAC基线。结果表明，显式的语义条件化……

arXiv:2512.21653v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Speech codecs are usually optimized for waveform fidelity, allocating bits to acoustic detail that can be inferred from linguistic structure. This leads to inefficient compression and degraded recognition performance. We propose SemDAC, a semantic-aware neural speech codec that adds hierarchical semantic conditioning to residual vector quantization (RVQ). The first RVQ quantizer is distilled from HuBERT features to produce semantic tokens capturing phonetic content, while later quantizers encode residual acoustics. At 0.95 kbps, SemDAC matches or surpasses a 2.5 kbps DAC baseline on PESQ, STOI, SI-SNR, and Whisper WER, with comparable ViSQOL, and achieves higher subjective MOS than higher-bitrate DAC baselines. item.title: 提出了一种残差增强的概率算子学习框架，在无限维函数空间中利用流匹配生成建模并借助廉价低保真解算子作为归纳偏置，通过学习刻画低保真与高保真解之间差异的概率残差算子，在数据稀缺条件下实现对偏微分方程系统的高效不确定性量化代理建模。

arXiv:2512.12749v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：在数据稀缺的场景下，为具有潜在不确定性的物理系统学习代理模型仍然充满挑战：确定性神经算子无法刻画不确定性，而生成式方法则需要大量高保真解算子模拟的样本集合，且往往会牺牲分辨率上的泛化能力。在本工作中，我们提出了一种残差增强的概率算子学习框架，该框架将基于流匹配的生成建模置于无限维函数空间中，同时利用廉价的低保真解算子作为归纳偏置。与直接学习完整的高保真随机解算子不同，所提出的框架学习刻画低保真解与高保真解之间差异的概率残差算子。通过使用以已知系统输入和低保真解为条件的神经算子对流匹配中的向量场进行参数化，该框架能够在数据稀缺条件下实现高效且具备不确定性量化的偏微分方程代理建模。

Rather than learning the full high-fidelity stochastic solution operator directly, the proposed framework learns probabilistic residual operators that characterize the discrepancy between low- and high-fidelity solutions. item.title: 提出了一种端到端可微分的模态逻辑神经网络，通过可学习的可达关系和赋值函数实现可微分克里普克语义，统一支持认知、信念、义务和时间等模态解读，并能处理不一致性。
item.description:
模态逻辑神经网络

Modal Logic Neural Networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03491

提出了一种端到端可微分的模态逻辑神经网络，通过可学习的可达关系和赋值函数实现可微分克里普克语义，统一支持认知、信念、义务和时间等模态解读，并能处理不一致性。

神经网络对自然科学与社会而言不可或缺，其影响从公共卫生应用延伸至劳动力生产率。本文提出了模态逻辑神经网络（MLNNs）——模态逻辑的一种端到端可微分的逻辑神经网络实现，它在可能世界语义上评估一个可学习的真值函数。该神经架构通过可学习的世界可达关系和赋值函数来处理次一致性与不一致性。由于模态由关系所满足的框架公理而非算子本身决定，一个可微分引擎即可涵盖认知、信念、义务和时间等多种模态解读，其应用涵盖从反应式和分布式系统的验证到法律话语以及微观经济效用模型。本文提出了可微分克里普克语义的模型，并建立了其可靠性、收敛性和结构性（质）。

arXiv:2512.03491v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Neural Networks are indispensable to natural sciences and society. Their impact extends from applications in public health to workforce productivity. Here, we introduce Modal Logic Neural Networks (MLNNs) -- an end-to-end differentiable logical neural network realisation of modal logic which evaluates a learnable truth function across possible-world semantics. This neural architecture handles para-consistency and inconsistency via a learnable world accessibility relation and valuation function. Because the modality is fixed by which frame axioms the relation satisfies rather than by the operator, one differentiable engine covers the epistemic, doxastic, deontic and temporal readings, with applications from verification of reactive and distributed systems to legal discourse and microeconomic utility models. item.title: 本文提出CoLOR方法，首次在背景分布发生偏移的挑战性条件下为开集识别提供可证明的理论保证，证明其在新类别可分离的良性假设下优于代表性基线方法并具备可扩展性。
item.description:
背景分布偏移下的开集域自适应：挑战与一种可证明高效的解决方案

Open-Set Domain Adaptation Under Background Distribution Shift: Challenges and A Provably Efficient Solution

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.01152

本文提出CoLOR方法，首次在背景分布发生偏移的挑战性条件下为开集识别提供可证明的理论保证，证明其在新类别可分离的良性假设下优于代表性基线方法并具备可扩展性。

随着我们将机器学习系统部署到现实世界中，一个核心挑战是即使在数据发生偏移时也能保持模型的性能。这种偏移可以有多种形式：可能出现训练期间不存在的新类别，这被称为开集识别问题；同时已知类别的分布也可能发生变化。关于开集识别的保证大多是在已知类别的分布（我们称之为背景分布）固定不变的假设下推导出来的。在本文中，我们开发了CoLOR，一种即使在背景分布发生偏移这一具有挑战性的情况下也能保证解决开集识别问题的方法。我们证明了该方法在良性假设下有效，即新类别与非新类别是可分离的，并在简化的过参数化设置中提供了理论保证，证明其优于代表性基线方法。我们还开发了使CoLOR具备可扩展性的技术。

arXiv:2512.01152v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: As we deploy machine learning systems in the real world, a core challenge is to maintain a model that is performant even as the data shifts. Such shifts can take many forms: new classes may emerge that were absent during training, a problem known as open-set recognition, and the distribution of known categories may change. Guarantees on open-set recognition are mostly derived under the assumption that the distribution of known classes, which we call the background distribution, is fixed. In this paper we develop CoLOR, a method that is guaranteed to solve open-set recognition even in the challenging case where the background distribution shifts. We prove that the method works under benign assumptions that the novel class is separable from the non-novel classes, and provide theoretical guarantees that it outperforms a representative baseline in a simplified overparameterized setting. item.title: 该论文提出利用学生问题解决过程的知识追踪方法KT-PSP及配套数据集KT-PSP-25，并构建StatusKT框架，通过教师-学生-教师三阶段大语言模型流水线将学生数学能力作为中间表示进行提取，突破了传统知识追踪仅依赖答题正确性、缺乏可解释性的局限。

通过问题解决过程追踪数学能力

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.00311

该论文提出利用学生问题解决过程的知识追踪方法KT-PSP及配套数据集KT-PSP-25，并构建StatusKT框架，通过教师-学生-教师三阶段大语言模型流水线将学生数学能力作为中间表示进行提取，突破了传统知识追踪仅依赖答题正确性、缺乏可解释性的局限。

知识追踪（Knowledge Tracing, KT）旨在建模学生的知识状态并预测其未来表现，以实现智能辅导系统中的个性化学习。然而，传统的知识追踪方法在可解释性方面存在根本性局限，因为它们仅依赖于答题的正确性，而忽略了学生问题解决过程中蕴含的丰富信息。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了利用问题解决过程的知识追踪方法（KT-PSP），该方法结合学生的问题解决过程来捕捉数学能力的多维度特征。我们还介绍了KT-PSP-25，一个专门为KT-PSP设计的新数据集。在此基础上，我们提出了StatusKT，一个采用教师-学生-教师三阶段大语言模型流水线的知识追踪框架，用于提取学生的数学能力（MP）作为中间表示。在该流水线中，教师大语言模型首先提取特定问题的能力信息……

arXiv:2512.00311v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Knowledge Tracing (KT) aims to model student's knowledge state and predict future performance to enable personalized learning in Intelligent Tutoring Systems. However, traditional KT methods face fundamental limitations in explainability, as they rely solely on the response correctness, neglecting the rich information embedded in students' problem-solving processes. To address this gap, we propose Knowledge Tracing Leveraging Problem-Solving Process (KT-PSP), which incorporates students' problem-solving processes to capture the multidimensional aspects of mathematical proficiency. We also introduce KT-PSP-25, a new dataset specifically designed for KT-PSP. Building on this, we present StatusKT, a KT framework that employs a teacher-student-teacher three-stage LLM pipeline to extract students' Mathematical Proficiency (MP) as intermediate representation. item.title: 该论文揭示了MC-VQA基准测试中存在严重的提示格式敏感性问题——即使消除了选项顺序的影响，仅仅改变选项ID、分隔符等语义无关的格式元素就会导致模型性能排名频繁逆转，这表明当前MC-VQA作为多模态大语言模型评估基准的可靠性存在根本性缺陷。
item.description:
多项选择视觉问答中未被探索的缺陷使基准测试不可靠

Unexplored flaws in multiple-choice VQA make benchmarking unreliable

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.22341

该论文揭示了MC-VQA基准测试中存在严重的提示格式敏感性问题——即使消除了选项顺序的影响，仅仅改变选项ID、分隔符等语义无关的格式元素就会导致模型性能排名频繁逆转，这表明当前MC-VQA作为多模态大语言模型评估基准的可靠性存在根本性缺陷。

先前的研究指出对选项顺序的敏感性是多项选择视觉问答（MC-VQA）评估中的一个关键问题，并提出了一些协议来缓解这种影响。我们证明这种缓解措施不足以确保MC-VQA作为多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）可靠基准的有效性：性能对语义中性的提示格式选择仍然高度敏感，而当前的基准测试并未控制这些格式选择。在一项涵盖七个MLLM和五个MC-VQA数据集的大规模研究中，我们发现即使在顺序不变的评估条件下，排名逆转仍然频繁发生。当我们系统地改变选项ID集合、分隔符和分离符，从而产生48种语义等价的提示格式时，这些排名逆转就会出现。机制分析将这种不稳定性追溯到低层次的语言建模效应：分词器引起的选项ID标记的融合或移除会在输入序列中引入损坏的选项ID标记，而选择……

arXiv:2511.22341v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Previous works identify sensitivity to option order as a key issue in multiple-choice VQA (MC-VQA) evaluation and propose protocols to mitigate this effect. We show that such mitigation is insufficient to ensure the validity of MC-VQA as a reliable benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLMs): performance remains highly sensitive to semantically neutral prompt format choices that are not controlled by current benchmarks. In a large-scale study spanning seven MLLMs and five MC-VQAs datasets, we find frequent rank reversals even under order-invariant evaluation. These reversals arise when we systematically vary option ID sets, delimiters, and separators, yielding 48 semantically equivalent prompt formats. item.description:
迭代GRPO：借助单轮RLHF实现多轮强化学习的批在线策略迭代

Iterative GRPO: Batch-Online Policy Iteration for Multi-Turn RL via Single-Turn RLHF

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.21638

提出Iterative GRPO方法，利用批在线部署模式收集的交互数据，将经典的近似策略迭代算法与单轮RLHF相结合，从而无需在训练循环中接入真实或模拟用户即可实现多轮强化学习。

arXiv:2511.21638v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：实际的LLM智能体通常运行在多轮对话场景中，其成功与否只有在整个交互过程结束后才能确定。大多数多轮RL方法通过同策略 rollout 进行训练，但与单轮RLHF不同，策略无法独自产生完整轨迹，因为在智能体的每一轮之后，外部环境必须做出响应。对于对话式智能体而言，这个环境就是用户，但真实用户通常无法嵌入训练循环中，而忠实地构建模拟用户也十分困难。另一方面，现实世界的部署很少是完全在线或完全离线的。常见的生产模式被称为“批在线”，即先部署当前策略收集一批交互数据，然后在该批数据上重新训练并重新部署。我们证明，这种批在线设置为应用经典的近似策略迭代算法创造了机会。我们的核心观察是，运行标准的token级…

arXiv:2511.21638v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Practical LLM agents often operate over multi-turn conversations where success is determined only after the full interaction ends. Most multi-turn RL methods train via on-policy rollouts, but unlike in single-turn RLHF, the policy cannot produce a trajectory alone, since an external environment must respond after each agent turn. For conversational agents, this environment is a user, but real users are generally unavailable inside the training loop and simulated users are difficult to build faithfully. Separately, real-world deployment is rarely fully online or fully offline. The common production pattern is called "batch online," where the current policy is deployed to collect a batch of interaction data, then retrained on that batch and redeployed. item.title: 提出Pangu-Bayes概率预报框架，将大气状态不确定性与学习模型不确定性作为独立随机变量分开建模，实现了误差来源的可解析归因，并在热带气旋预报中显著降低路径、气压和风速误差。
item.description:
解析AI天气预报中不确定性的来源

Resolving sources of uncertainty in AI weather forecasting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.14218

提出Pangu-Bayes概率预报框架，将大气状态不确定性与学习模型不确定性作为独立随机变量分开建模，实现了误差来源的可解析归因，并在热带气旋预报中显著降低路径、气压和风速误差。

天气预报的不确定性来源于不完美的分析场和预报模式，但仅靠集合离散度无法揭示不同来源与下游预报目标之间的关系。我们提出了Pangu-Bayes，这是一个概率预报层级框架，将大气状态不确定性与学习模型不确定性视为不同的随机变量，将随流演变的状态扰动与贝叶斯参数样本进行交叉组合。这一构造产生了由模式定义的、可区分来源的方差分量以及匹配的路径评估方法。在90个2023年留出的热带气旋上，Pangu-Bayes将路径、气压和风速误差分别降低了54.2%、17.2%和24.9%，同时提高了对快速增强过程的检测能力。在88个支持路径比较的气旋中，大气状态变率与改进的路径预报更为一致地相关，而学习模型变率则更多地与改进的强度预报相关。

arXiv:2511.14218v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Weather forecast uncertainty arises from imperfect analyses and forecast models, but ensemble spread alone does not reveal how distinct sources relate to downstream targets. We introduce Pangu-Bayes, a probabilistic forecasting hierarchy that treats atmospheric-state and learned-model uncertainty as distinct stochastic variables, crossing flow-dependent perturbations of the evolving state with Bayesian parameter samples. This construction yields model-defined source-resolved variance components and matched pathway evaluation. Across 90 held-out 2023 tropical cyclones, Pangu-Bayes reduces track, pressure and wind errors by 54.2%, 17.2% and 24.9%, respectively, while improving rapid-intensification detection. item.title: 提出一种利用专利内部结构（如权利要求、背景等）作为自监督信号的混合dropout-部分正样本策略，有效提升了专利表示学习在多种检索任务中的迁移性。
item.description:
基于自监督的专利表示学习

Patent Representation Learning via Self-supervision

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.10657

提出一种利用专利内部结构（如权利要求、背景等）作为自监督信号的混合dropout-部分正样本策略，有效提升了专利表示学习在多种检索任务中的迁移性。

我们研究了基于对比学习目标的自监督专利表示学习。一个标准基线方法通过对同一文本应用两次独立的dropout掩码来构建正样本，但将这一方法应用于长篇幅、结构化的专利文档时，需要仔细校准。我们证明，通过调节温度和dropout率，仅使用dropout的训练方法可以显著增强，但其最佳配置依赖于评估任务，并且无法从标题-摘要检索统一迁移到权利要求-说明书检索。我们提出混合dropout-部分正样本策略，这是一种专利特定的视图构建方法：锚点为标题-摘要视图，正样本要么来自同一视图的dropout重编码，要么来自同一专利的其他部分（如权利要求、摘要、背景、附图或说明书）。该方法利用专利内部结构作为训练时信号，无需IPC标签。

arXiv:2511.10657v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study self-supervised patent representation learning with contrastive objectives. A standard baseline constructs positives by encoding the same text twice under independent dropout masks, but applying this recipe to long, structured patent documents requires careful calibration. We show that dropout-only training can be substantially strengthened by tuning temperature and dropout rate, yet its best configuration is evaluation-dependent and does not transfer uniformly from title--abstract retrieval to claim-to-disclosure retrieval. We propose mixed dropout--section positives, a patent-specific view construction strategy in which the anchor is the title--abstract view and the positive is sampled either from a dropout re-encoding of the same view or from another section of the same patent, such as claims, summary, background, drawings, or description. 本工作通过纳入广义Bures-Wasserstein（GBW）、Log-Euclidean和Wasserstein距离，扩展了最近提出的用于对称正定（SPD）矩阵的Alpha-Procrustes黎曼度量族。虽然Alpha-Procrustes框架已经在有限维和无限维设置中统一了许多经典度量，但它此前缺乏实现这些广义形式所需的结构组件。我们引入了一种基于单位化Hilbert-Schmidt算子和扩展Mahalanobis范数的形式体系，使得能够构建稳健的GBW和Log-Hilbert-Schmidt距离的无限维推广。我们的方法还纳入了一个可学习的正则化参数，以增强高维比较中的几何稳定性。复现文献中基准测试的初步实验证明了我们广义方法的性能提升。

arXiv:2511.09801v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This work extends the recently introduced Alpha-Procrustes family of Riemannian metrics for symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrices by incorporating generalized versions of the Bures-Wasserstein (GBW), Log-Euclidean, and Wasserstein distances. While the Alpha-Procrustes framework has unified many classical metrics in both finite- and infinite- dimensional settings, it previously lacked the structural components necessary to realize these generalized forms. We introduce a formalism based on unitized Hilbert-Schmidt operators and an extended Mahalanobis norm that allows the construction of robust, infinite-dimensional generalizations of GBW and Log-Hilbert-Schmidt distances. Our approach also incorporates a learnable regularization parameter that enhances geometric stability in high-dimensional comparisons. item.title: 该论文提出了PAN——一个通用、可行动交互且具备长时程一致性的世界模型，旨在突破现有世界模型在开放域行动驱动预测和抽象推理规划方面的局限，推动AI实现超越大语言模型的物理与具身智能。

世界模型是对真实世界环境的认知模拟器，使生物智能体能够推理世界如何演化——无论是自发演化还是在自身行动的响应下演化——并据此进行规划与策略制定。在构建人工智能（AI）系统方面，世界模型代表着超越大语言模型（LLM）的下一个前沿方向，旨在赋予AI智能体物理智能与具身智能，使其能够通过模拟推理进行决策制定，并通过模拟试验进行强化学习。世界建模领域的最新进展在视频生成、三维场景演化、机器人动力学和游戏模拟等方面取得了令人瞩目的成果，但在通用的、开放域的、行动驱动的预测、长时程一致性，以及抽象推理与规划方面仍存在局限。此外，还存在着一些根本性的架构问题，例如状态表示、信息流或训练……

arXiv:2511.09057v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A world model is a cognitive simulator of the real-world environment allowing biological agents to reason about how the world evolves, whether spontaneously or in response to their actions, and accordingly to plan and strategize. Recent advancements in world modeling have yielded impressive progress in video generation, 3-D scene evolution, robotic dynamics, and game simulation, but limitations persist in general, open-domain, action-driven prediction, long-horizon consistency, and abstract reasoning and planning. 本文提出了基于互补条件刻画解稀疏性的新型加速Frank-Wolfe算法，在多面体和矩阵域约束下实现了复杂度仅依赖解稀疏度（而非环境维度）的最优一阶oracle复杂度。

我们为在紧凸集上最小化光滑凸函数的问题开发了Frank-Wolfe（FW）族中新的加速一阶算法，重点关注两类重要的约束集合：（1）多面体和（2）由谱面体（spectrahedron）和核范数球给出的矩阵域。一个关键技术要素是刻画解稀疏性的互补条件——对多面体而言是面的维度，对矩阵而言是秩。我们提出了两种算法：（1）一种针对多面体的纯线性优化oracle（LOO）方法，具有最优的最坏情况一阶（FO）oracle复杂度，除有限的“预热”（burn-in）阶段和至多一个对数因子外，其LOO复杂度随 $r/\sqrt{\epsilon}$ 缩放，其中 $\epsilon$ 是目标精度，$r$ 是解的稀疏度（与环境维度无关）；（2）一种将FW与稀疏投影oracle（例如矩阵域的低秩SVD）相结合的混合方案。

A key technical ingredient is a complementarity condition that captures solution sparsity---face dimension for polytopes and rank for matrices. 本文提出基于循环矩阵与对角矩阵乘积的新型可逆线性层CDFlow，利用快速傅里叶变换在保持表达能力的同时，将参数复杂度降至O(mn)，并将矩阵求逆和对数行列式计算的时间复杂度分别降至O(mn log n)和O(mn)。

标准化流是一类深度生成模型，通过可逆变换实现高效的似然估计和采样。一个关键挑战在于设计既能增强表达能力、又能高效计算雅可比行列式和逆矩阵的线性层。我们提出了一种基于循环矩阵与对角矩阵乘积的新型可逆线性层。这种分解方法使用 m 个对角矩阵和 m-1 个循环矩阵，在仍能逼近一般线性变换的同时，将参数复杂度从 O(n²) 降低到 O(mn)。通过利用快速傅里叶变换，我们的方法将矩阵求逆的时间复杂度从 O(n³) 降低到 O(mn log n)，将对数行列式计算的时间复杂度从 O(n³) 降低到 O(mn)，其中 n 为输入维度。我们基于该层构建了循环-对角流（CDFlow）。

arXiv:2510.25323v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Normalizing flows are deep generative models that enable efficient likelihood estimation and sampling through invertible transformations. A key challenge is to design linear layers that enhance expressiveness while maintaining efficient computation of the Jacobian determinant and inverse. We introduce a novel invertible linear layer based on the product of circulant and diagonal matrices. This decomposition reduces parameter complexity from $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ to $\mathcal{O}(mn)$ using $m$ diagonal matrices and $m-1$ circulant matrices while still approximating general linear transformations. By leveraging the Fast Fourier Transform, our approach reduces the time complexity of matrix inversion from $\mathcal{O}(n^3)$ to $\mathcal{O}(mn\log n)$ and that of computing the log-determinant from $\mathcal{O}(n^3)$ to $\mathcal{O}(mn)$, where $n$ is the input dimension. https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.25183

该论文通过在经典模型与模拟量子模型（包括量子储备池计算）上开展大规模非线性时间序列预测基准测试，从误差、延迟、内存、能耗和碳排放等多个维度全面核算了AI系统的持续性能与能效。

高能效人工智能应当在完整的应用流程中进行评估，而不仅仅以最低误差或最短训练时间为标准。我们通过非线性时间序列预测来研究这一问题，并将模拟量子储备池计算（QRC）作为新兴计算技术的案例研究。我们的评估涵盖33种预测配置以及在NARMA-10、NARMA-20、Mackey-Glass、Lorenz-63和Santa Fe激光数据集上完成的825次运行。核心基准包括775次全程监测的运行，涵盖统计模型、线性模型、储备池模型、神经网络模型、连续变量高斯QRC以及基于门的态矢量QRC模型，另有50次变分量子神经网络（QNN）运行以扩展可训练量子模型的比较。我们测量了NRMSE、RMSE、MAE、实际运行时间、推理延迟、CPU/GPU峰值内存、参数量、运行能耗及碳排放。由于固定的QRC编码器可以为多个读出层生成可复用的特征，我们同时报告了冷启动成本和摊销成本。

arXiv:2510.25183v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Energy-efficient AI should be evaluated across the full application pipeline, not only by lowest error or shortest training time. We study this through nonlinear time-series forecasting using simulated quantum reservoir computing (QRC) as an emerging-computing case study. Our evaluation spans 33 forecasting configurations and 825 completed runs on NARMA-10, NARMA-20, Mackey--Glass, Lorenz-63, and Santa Fe laser data. The core benchmark includes 775 fully instrumented runs across statistical, linear, reservoir, neural, continuous-variable Gaussian QRC, and gate-based statevector QRC models, with 50 additional variational QNN runs extending the trainable-quantum comparison. We measure NRMSE, RMSE, MAE, wall time, inference latency, peak CPU/GPU memory, parameter count, operational energy, and carbon. item.description:
基于扩散策略与多时间尺度世界模型的深度主动推断用于真实世界探索与导航

Deep Active Inference with Diffusion Policy and Multiple Timescale World Model for Real-World Exploration and Navigation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.23258

该论文提出了一个将扩散策略与多时间尺度循环状态空间世界模型相集成的深度主动推断框架，通过最小化期望自由能实现了真实世界机器人探索与目标导向导航的统一。

真实环境中的自主机器人导航既需要通过探索来获取环境信息，也需要目标导向的导航以到达指定目标。基于自由能原理的主动推断通过最小化期望自由能，将认知价值与外在价值相结合，为这些行为提供了一个统一框架。为了在实践中实现这一理念，我们提出了一个深度主动推断框架，该框架集成了扩散策略作为策略模型，以及多时间尺度循环状态空间模型作为世界模型。扩散策略生成多样化的候选动作，而多时间尺度循环状态空间模型通过潜在想象预测这些动作的长期后果，从而实现最小化期望自由能的动作选择。真实世界导航实验，包括基线对比、组件消融和鲁棒性评估，表明我们的框架取得了更高的性能。

arXiv:2510.23258v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Autonomous robotic navigation in real-world environments requires exploration to acquire environmental information as well as goal-directed navigation in order to reach specified targets. Active inference (AIF) based on the free-energy principle provides a unified framework for these behaviors by minimizing the expected free energy (EFE), thereby combining epistemic and extrinsic values. To realize this practically, we propose a deep AIF framework that integrates a diffusion policy as the policy model and a multiple timescale recurrent state-space model (MTRSSM) as the world model. The diffusion policy generates diverse candidate actions while the MTRSSM predicts their long-horizon consequences through latent imagination, enabling action selection that minimizes EFE. arXiv:2510.19251v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Predicting which hypothetical inorganic crystals can be experimentally realized remains a central challenge in accelerating materials discovery. SyntheFormer is a positive-unlabeled framework that learns synthesizability directly from crystal structure, combining Fourier-transformed crystal properties (FTCP) representation with structure-aware feature extraction, Random-Forest feature selection, and a compact deep MLP classifier. The model is trained on historical data from 2011 through 2018 and evaluated prospectively on future years from 2019 to 2025, where the positive class constitutes only 1.02 percent of samples. Under this temporally separated evaluation, SyntheFormer achieves a test AUC of 0.735, AUPRC of 0.099 and 97.6 percent recall at 94.2 percent coverage with dual-threshold calibration. item.description:
RePro：训练语言模型忠实地回收网络数据用于预训练

RePro: Training Language Models to Faithfully Recycle the Web for Pretraining

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.10681

RePro通过强化学习训练仅1B参数的小型语言模型，忠实地改写回收网络数据用于预训练，在22个下游任务上相比仅使用原始数据实现了3.7%-14.5%的相对准确率提升。

高质量数据是大语言模型（LLM）预训练的基石，然而其增长速度未能跟上前沿模型的需求。在本文中，我们提出了RePro，一种新颖的网络数据回收方法，该方法通过强化学习训练一个相对较小的语言模型来生成有效且忠实的预训练数据改写。具体而言，我们设计了一个质量奖励和三个忠实度奖励，优化语言模型改写器将原始数据转换为高质量改写，同时保持其核心语义和结构。在实验中，我们训练了一个仅有1B参数的改写器，从DCLM-RefinedWeb数据集中回收了720亿个token。在400M、1.4B和2.8B模型上的预训练结果表明，RePro在22个下游任务上相比仅使用原始数据的基线实现了3.7%-14.5%的相对准确率提升，是使用提示词驱动70B模型的最先进网络回收方法所获性能提升的两倍。

arXiv:2510.10471v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Environmental perception systems are crucial for high-precision mapping and autonomous navigation, with LiDAR serving as a core sensor providing accurate 3D point cloud data. Efficiently processing unstructured point clouds while extracting structured semantic information remains a significant challenge. In recent years, numerous pseudo-image-based representation methods have emerged to balance efficiency and performance by fusing 3D point clouds with 2D grids. However, the fundamental inconsistency between the pseudo-image representation and the original 3D information critically undermines 2D-3D feature fusion, posing a primary obstacle for coherent information fusion and leading to poor feature discriminability. CogniDir 提出了一种自适应分布学习框架，通过将鲁棒假新闻检测重构为动态数据混合优化问题，并利用信息论评分指导自适应采样，有效对抗大语言模型生成的认知型恶意评论攻击。

大语言模型（LLMs）的扩散催生了一类新的基于心理学原理的恶意评论，使假新闻攻击从表面层面的文本噪声转向深层的认知与逻辑操控。这一转变严重削弱了现有检测器的效能，因为这些检测器通常依赖于静态攻击假设和固定的训练分布。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 CogniDir，一个自适应分布学习框架，它将鲁棒检测重新表述为面向社交媒体内容安全的动态数据混合优化问题。基于认知心理学，我们首先形式化了针对特定机制的认知对抗范式，以系统性暴露检测器深层次的脆弱性。为应对脆弱性的异质性，CogniDir 推导出一个将经验准确率与概率置信度相耦合的信息论评分，该评分随后被映射为自适应采样比例。

arXiv:2510.09712v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has enabled a new class of psychologically grounded malicious comments, shifting fake news attacks from surface-level textual noise to deep cognitive and logical manipulation. This shift severely undermines existing detectors, which conventionally rely on static attack assumptions and fixed training distributions. To bridge this gap, we introduce CogniDir, an adaptive distributional learning framework that reformulates robust detection as a dynamic data mixture optimization problem for social media content safety. Grounded in cognitive psychology, we first formalize mechanism-specific cognitive adversarial paradigms to systematically expose deep-seated detector vulnerabilities. item.title: BaNEL算法仅利用失败尝试（负奖励）对生成模型进行后训练，并最小化奖励评估次数，从而解决了基础模型奖励信号接近零且奖励评估成本高昂这一严峻挑战。
item.description:
BaNEL：仅使用负奖励的生成建模探索后验方法

BaNEL: Exploration Posteriors for Generative Modeling Using Only Negative Rewards

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09596

BaNEL算法仅利用失败尝试（负奖励）对生成模型进行后训练，并最小化奖励评估次数，从而解决了基础模型奖励信号接近零且奖励评估成本高昂这一严峻挑战。

当今的生成模型在大量监督数据和刻画生成质量的信息性奖励函数的支持下蓬勃发展。它们的工作假设是：监督数据为模型预训练提供知识，而奖励函数提供关于如何进一步提高生成质量和正确性的密集信息。然而，在重要问题的最难实例中，出现了两个问题：（1）基础生成模型获得的奖励信号接近于零，（2）调用奖励预言机的成本高昂。这种设置构成了与标准基于奖励的后训练根本不同的学习挑战。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了BaNEL（贝叶斯负证据学习），这是一种仅使用失败尝试来后训练模型的算法，同时最小化奖励评估次数（NREs）。我们的方法基于这样一个核心思想：学习规律的...

arXiv:2510.09596v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Today's generative models thrive with large amounts of supervised data and informative reward functions characterizing the quality of the generation. They work under the assumptions that the supervised data provides knowledge to pre-train the model, and the reward function provides dense information about how to further improve the generation quality and correctness. However, in the hardest instances of important problems, two problems arise: (1) the base generative model attains a near-zero reward signal, and (2) calls to the reward oracle are expensive. This setting poses a fundamentally different learning challenge than standard reward-based post-training. To address this, we propose BaNEL (Bayesian Negative Evidence Learning), an algorithm that post-trains the model using failed attempts only, while minimizing the number of reward evaluations (NREs). item.title: 该论文提出SQS框架，利用贝叶斯变分学习统一权重剪枝与低比特量化——通过尖峰-厚板先验诱导稀疏性、用高斯混合模型建模量化权重，并给出高效近似方法与理论一致性保证，从而在保持模型性能的同时实现比现有方法更高的压缩率。
item.description:
SQS：基于稀疏量化子分布的贝叶斯深度神经网络压缩

SQS: Bayesian DNN Compression through Sparse Quantized Sub-distributions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.08999

该论文提出SQS框架，利用贝叶斯变分学习统一权重剪枝与低比特量化——通过尖峰-厚板先验诱导稀疏性、用高斯混合模型建模量化权重，并给出高效近似方法与理论一致性保证，从而在保持模型性能的同时实现比现有方法更高的压缩率。

压缩大规模神经网络对于在资源受限设备上部署模型至关重要。大多数现有方法单独采用权重剪枝或低比特量化，往往导致为了保持可接受的性能损失而只能获得不理想的压缩率。我们提出了一个统一的框架（\method），通过贝叶斯变分学习同时进行剪枝和低比特量化，在保持相当性能的同时实现了比先前基线更高的压缩率。其核心思想是采用尖峰-厚板（spike-and-slab）先验来诱导稀疏性，并使用高斯混合模型（GMMs）对量化权重进行建模，从而实现低比特精度。由于包含尖峰-厚板先验与高斯混合模型的目标函数难以直接求解，我们推导了一种高效的近似方法，能够在最小精度损失的情况下实现有效压缩。在理论方面，我们为所提出的变分方法提供了一致性结果。

arXiv:2510.08999v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Compressing large-scale neural networks is essential for deploying models on resource-constrained devices. Most existing methods adopt weight pruning or low-bit quantization individually, often resulting in suboptimal compression rates to preserve acceptable performance drops. We introduce a unified framework for simultaneous pruning and low-bit quantization via Bayesian variational learning (\method), which achieves higher compression rates than prior baselines while maintaining comparable performance. The key idea is to employ a spike-and-slab prior to induce sparsity and model quantized weights using Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) to enable low-bit precision. Due to the intractability of the objective involving spike-and-slab priors with GMMs, we derive an efficient approximation that facilitates effective compression with minimal accuracy loss. item.title: 提出了 Agg-SPB 和 CE-SPB 两种“两全其美”的正则化领导者跟随算法，用于带付费观测的线性上下文老虎机，在对抗环境中达到 $T^{2/3}$ 遗憾率，在随机环境中达到对数或多对数级遗憾。
item.description:
付费观测下线性上下文老虎机的两全其美（Best-of-Both-Worlds）

Best-of-Both Worlds for linear contextual bandits with paid observations

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.07424

提出了 Agg-SPB 和 CE-SPB 两种“两全其美”的正则化领导者跟随算法，用于带付费观测的线性上下文老虎机，在对抗环境中达到 $T^{2/3}$ 遗憾率，在随机环境中达到对数或多对数级遗憾。

我们研究带有付费观测的线性上下文老虎机问题，其中在每一轮中，学习者观察一个上下文，选择一个动作，并可以支付固定成本来观察来自部分臂的反馈。我们提出了两种具有“两全其美”保证的正则化领导者跟随算法。第一种是 Agg-SPB，它通过聚合与上下文相关的稳定性项，扩展了 Tsuchiya 和 Ito（2024）的 SPB-matching 框架，在对抗性环境中实现了特征的 $T^{2/3}$ 遗憾率，并在随机环境中实现了对 $T$ 的对数级依赖。第二种是 CE-SPB，它将依赖于臂的观测概率与受 Kuroki 等人（2024）启发的熵自适应学习率相结合，实现了熵自适应的 $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ 对抗性保证和多对数级的随机遗憾，同时避免了 Agg-SPB 随机分析中出现的最小上下文质量依赖。两种算法均进一步扩展到带污染观测的场景。

arXiv:2510.07424v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study linear contextual bandits with paid observations, where at each round the learner observes a context, selects an action, and may pay a fixed cost to observe feedback from a subset of arms. We propose two Follow-the-Regularized-Leader algorithms with Best-of-Both-Worlds guarantees. The first, Agg-SPB, extends the SPB-matching framework of Tsuchiya and Ito (2024) by aggregating context-dependent stability terms, achieving the characteristic $T^{2/3}$ adversarial regret rate and logarithmic dependence on $T$ in stochastic environments. The second, CE-SPB, combines arm-dependent observation probabilities with an entropy-adaptive learning rate inspired by Kuroki et al. (2024). It achieves an entropy-adaptive $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ adversarial guarantee and polylogarithmic stochastic regret, while avoiding the minimum-context-mass dependence arising in the stochastic analysis of Agg-SPB. item.title: 本文提出融合神经网络与核方法的超核岭回归（HKRR）方法，并通过样本复杂度理论证明其能够自适应地学习多指标模型，克服维度灾难。
item.description:
基于超核岭回归的多指标模型学习

Learning Multi-Index Models with Hyper-Kernel Ridge Regression

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.02532

本文提出融合神经网络与核方法的超核岭回归（HKRR）方法，并通过样本复杂度理论证明其能够自适应地学习多指标模型，克服维度灾难。

深度神经网络在高维问题中表现出色，优于核方法等因维度灾难而受限的模型。然而，这一成功背后的理论基础仍知之甚少。我们遵循这样一个观点：学习任务的复合结构是决定深度网络何时优于其他方法的关键因素。为了将这一想法形式化，我们考虑了一个简单的复合模型，即多指标模型（MIM）。在此背景下，我们引入并研究了超核岭回归（HKRR），这是一种融合神经网络与核方法的方法。我们的主要贡献是一个样本复杂度结果，证明HKRR能够自适应地学习多指标模型，从而克服维度灾难。此外，我们利用该估计量的核特性开发了专门的优化方法。实际上，我们对比了交替最小化和交替梯度下降（原文在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2510.02532v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Deep neural networks excel in high-dimensional problems, outperforming models such as kernel methods, which suffer from the curse of dimensionality. However, the theoretical foundations of this success remain poorly understood. We follow the idea that the compositional structure of the learning task is the key factor determining when deep networks outperform other approaches. Taking a step towards formalizing this idea, we consider a simple compositional model, namely the multi-index model (MIM). In this context, we introduce and study hyper-kernel ridge regression (HKRR), an approach blending neural networks and kernel methods. Our main contribution is a sample complexity result demonstrating that HKRR can adaptively learn MIM, overcoming the curse of dimensionality. item.title: 提出了AMR-EnsembleNet集成框架，将轻量级1D CNN学习的序列基序与XGBoost的泛基因组特征相融合，在中等规模数据集上实现了可解释且高效的抗菌素耐药性预测。
item.description:
融合序列基序与泛基因组特征：基于可解释轻量级一维CNN-XGBoost集成模型的抗菌素耐药性预测

Fusing Sequence Motifs and Pan-Genomic Features: Antimicrobial Resistance Prediction using an Explainable Lightweight 1D CNN-XGBoost Ensemble

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23552

提出了AMR-EnsembleNet集成框架，将轻量级1D CNN学习的序列基序与XGBoost的泛基因组特征相融合，在中等规模数据集上实现了可解释且高效的抗菌素耐药性预测。

抗菌素耐药性（AMR）是一场迅速升级的全球健康危机。虽然基因组测序能够快速预测耐药表型，但目前的计算方法存在局限性。标准机器学习模型将基因组视为无序的特征集合，忽略了单核苷酸多态性的序列上下文。而像Transformer这样的最先进序列模型通常需要大量数据且计算成本高昂，不适合该领域中典型的中等规模数据集。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了AMR-EnsembleNet，这是一个协同结合基于序列和基于特征学习的集成框架。我们开发了一个轻量级的定制一维卷积神经网络（CNN），以从高维SNP数据中高效学习预测性序列基序。这个序列感知模型与XGBoost模型（一个强大的梯度提升系统）进行集成……

arXiv:2509.23552v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) is a rapidly escalating global health crisis. While genomic sequencing enables rapid prediction of resistance phenotypes, current computational methods have limitations. Standard machine learning models treat the genome as an unordered collection of features, ignoring the sequential context of Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms (SNPs). State-of-the-art sequence models like Transformers are often too data-hungry and computationally expensive for the moderately sized datasets that are typical in this domain. To address these challenges, we propose AMR-EnsembleNet, an ensemble framework that synergistically combines sequence-based and feature-based learning. We developed a lightweight, custom 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to efficiently learn predictive sequence motifs from high-dimensional SNP data. item.title: AudioFuse提出了一种混合架构，用宽而浅的ViT处理频谱图、浅层1D CNN处理原始波形，同时学习心音图的频域和时域互补特征，在从零训练的条件下达到最先进的分类性能（ROC-AUC 0.8608），并对域偏移展现出优异的鲁棒性。
item.description:
AudioFuse：通过ViT-1D CNN混合架构实现统一的频谱-时域学习，用于鲁棒的心音图分类

AudioFuse: Unified Spectral-Temporal Learning via a Hybrid ViT-1D CNN Architecture for Robust Phonocardiogram Classification

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23454

AudioFuse提出了一种混合架构，用宽而浅的ViT处理频谱图、浅层1D CNN处理原始波形，同时学习心音图的频域和时域互补特征，在从零训练的条件下达到最先进的分类性能（ROC-AUC 0.8608），并对域偏移展现出优异的鲁棒性。

心音图（PCG）等生物医学音频信号本质上具有节律性，其诊断信息同时蕴含在频域和时域中。标准的2D频谱图虽然提供了丰富的频谱特征，但会损失1D波形的相位信息和时间精度。我们提出了AudioFuse，这是一种能够同时从两种互补表示中学习的架构，用于心音图分类。为了降低融合模型中常见的过拟合风险，我们集成了一种定制的宽而浅的视觉Transformer（ViT）来处理频谱图，并结合一个浅层1D CNN来处理原始波形。在PhysioNet 2016数据集上，AudioFuse在从零开始训练的情况下实现了具有竞争力的最先进ROC-AUC 0.8608，优于其频谱图基线（0.8066）和波形基线（0.8223）。此外，它在具有挑战性的PASCAL数据集上展现出对域偏移的卓越鲁棒性，保持ROC-AUC为0.7181

arXiv:2509.23454v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Biomedical audio signals, such as phonocardiograms (PCG), are inherently rhythmic and contain diagnostic information in both their spectral (tonal) and temporal domains. Standard 2D spectrograms provide rich spectral features but compromise the phase information and temporal precision of the 1D waveform. item.description:
S³F-Net：一种通过空间-频谱摘要融合网络实现医学图像分类的多模态方法

S$^3$F-Net: A Multi-Modal Approach to Medical Image Classification via Spatial-Spectral Summarizer Fusion Network

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23442

提出了双分支网络S³F-Net，将深度空间CNN与浅层频谱编码器SpectraNet相融合，其中SpectralFilter层基于卷积定理通过逐元素乘法直接在完整傅里叶频谱上应用可学习滤波器以获得全局感受野，从而同时利用空间与频域表示提升医学图像分类性能。

卷积神经网络因其在学习层次化空间特征方面的出色能力，已成为医学图像分析的基石。然而，这种对单一域的关注在捕获全局、整体模式方面效率低下，且未能显式建模图像的频域特性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了空间-频谱摘要融合网络（S³F-Net），这是一个同时从空间和频谱表示中学习的双分支框架。S³F-Net 将深度空间 CNN 与我们提出的浅层频谱编码器 SpectraNet 进行融合。SpectraNet 的特色在于所提出的 SpectralFilter 层，该层利用卷积定理，通过计算高效的逐元素乘法直接对图像的完整傅里叶频谱应用一组可学习的滤波器。这使得 SpectralFilter 层能够获得全局感受野……

arXiv:2509.23442v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks have become a cornerstone of medical image analysis due to their proficiency in learning hierarchical spatial features. The S$^3$F-Net performs a fusion of a deep spatial CNN with our proposed shallow spectral encoder, SpectraNet. item.title: 提出了SingLEM，一个自监督脑电图基础模型，通过混合卷积-Transformer编码器独立处理每个通道，摆脱了预定义多通道输入和电极布局假设的限制，并在71个公开数据集（约9,200名受试者、357,000小时单通道数据）上训练，显著提升了模型的通用适应性。
item.description:
SingLEM：单通道大型脑电图模型

SingLEM: Single-Channel Large EEG Model

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.17920

提出了SingLEM，一个自监督脑电图基础模型，通过混合卷积-Transformer编码器独立处理每个通道，摆脱了预定义多通道输入和电极布局假设的限制，并在71个公开数据集（约9,200名受试者、357,000小时单通道数据）上训练，显著提升了模型的通用适应性。

当前用于脑电图（EEG）的深度学习模型通常是任务特定的，并依赖大量标注数据，这限制了其适应性。尽管脑电图基础模型试图实现更广泛的适用性，但许多模型仍依赖预定义的多通道输入、电极布局假设或模型特定的通道处理方式。为解决这些局限，我们提出了单通道大型脑电图模型，这是一个自监督基础模型，其混合卷积-Transformer编码器将每个通道独立映射为可复用的表示，从而捕获局部和长程时间结构。这些表示既可以单独使用，也可以通过通道级特征拼接进行组合。我们收集了71个公开脑电图数据集，包含约9,200名受试者和357,000小时的单通道数据。为进行防数据泄漏的评估，下游实验结果是使用在排除了相应数据集后、由68个数据集预训练得到的模型获得的。

arXiv:2509.17920v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Current deep learning models for electroencephalography (EEG) are often task-specific and depend on large labeled datasets, limiting their adaptability. item.title: 本文提出了一种基于随机森林泛化（RF+）的可解释网络辅助模型族，在实现极具竞争力的预测精度的同时，通过直接从模型参数和结构推导出的内在可解释性度量，弥合了网络辅助预测中预测性能与可解释性之间的差距。
item.description:
可解释的网络辅助随机森林+

Interpretable Network-assisted Random Forest+

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.15611

本文提出了一种基于随机森林泛化（RF+）的可解释网络辅助模型族，在实现极具竞争力的预测精度的同时，通过直接从模型参数和结构推导出的内在可解释性度量，弥合了网络辅助预测中预测性能与可解释性之间的差距。

机器学习算法通常假设训练样本是相互独立的。当数据点通过网络相互连接时，样本之间产生的依赖性既是挑战（降低了有效样本量），也是机遇（可以利用网络邻居的信息来改进预测）。目前已有多种利用这一机遇的方法，但其中许多方法（包括图神经网络）不易解释，限制了其在理解模型如何进行预测方面的实用性。其他方法，如网络辅助线性回归，虽然具有可解释性，但预测性能往往较差。我们通过提出一族基于随机森林泛化（RF+）构建的灵活的网络辅助模型来弥合这一差距，该模型实现了极具竞争力的预测精度，并且可以通过直接从模型参数和结构推导出的内在可解释性度量来加以理解。

arXiv:2509.15611v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Machine learning algorithms often assume that training samples are independent. When data points are connected by a network, the induced dependency between samples is both a challenge, reducing effective sample size, and an opportunity to improve prediction by leveraging information from network neighbors. Multiple methods taking advantage of this opportunity are available, but many, including graph neural networks, are not easily interpretable, limiting their usefulness for understanding how models make predictions. Others, such as network-assisted linear regression, are interpretable but often yield worse prediction performance. We bridge this gap by proposing a family of flexible network-assisted models built upon a generalization of random forests (RF+), which achieves highly-competitive prediction accuracy and can be understood through intrinsic interpretability measures, derived directly from the model parameters and stru

item.title: WhisTLE提出了一种深度监督的纯文本领域自适应方法，通过训练VAE从文本建模编码器输出并微调解码器，使预训练语音识别模型无需收集语音数据即可适配新领域，且推理时不产生额外开销。
item.description:
WhisTLE：面向小型预训练语音识别Transformer的深度监督纯文本领域自适应方法

WhisTLE: Deeply Supervised, Text-Only Domain Adaptation for Small Pretrained Speech Recognition Transformers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.10452

WhisTLE提出了一种深度监督的纯文本领域自适应方法，通过训练VAE从文本建模编码器输出并微调解码器，使预训练语音识别模型无需收集语音数据即可适配新领域，且推理时不产生额外开销。

预训练自动语音识别（ASR）模型（如Whisper）表现良好，但仍需要领域自适应来处理未见过的语言表达。在许多实际场景中，收集语音数据并不现实，因此需要进行纯文本自适应。我们提出了WhisTLE，这是一种面向预训练编码器-解码器ASR模型的深度监督纯文本自适应方法。WhisTLE训练一个变分自编码器（VAE）来从文本建模编码器输出，并使用学习到的文本到潜在表示的编码器来微调解码器，还可以选择性地与文本转语音（TTS）自适应相结合。在推理时，恢复原始编码器，因此不会产生额外的运行时开销。在四个数据集和四个ASR模型的实验中，仅使用WhisTLE在32个案例中的28个（88%）中带来改善，平均相对词错误率（WER）下降22%。单独使用WhisTLE或与其他自适应方法结合使用时，在144个案例中的116个（81%）中带来改善，平均额外WER下降15%。

arXiv:2509.10452v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Pretrained automatic speech recognition (ASR) models such as Whisper perform well but still need domain adaptation to handle unseen parlance. In many real-world settings, collecting speech data is impractical, necessitating text-only adaptation. We propose WhisTLE, a deeply supervised, text-only adaptation method for pretrained encoder-decoder ASR models. WhisTLE trains a variational autoencoder (VAE) to model encoder outputs from text and fine-tunes the decoder using the learned text-to-latent encoder, optionally combined with text-to-speech (TTS) adaptation. At inference, the original encoder is restored, incurring no extra runtime cost. Across four datasets and four ASR models, WhisTLE alone helps in 28 of 32 (88%) cases, with an average relative WER drop of 22%. Using WhisTLE alone or in combination with other adaptation approaches helps in 116 of 144 (81%) cases, with an average additional WER drop of 15%. Given all treatm

item.title: 本文确定了在高信噪比区间使用稀疏高斯测量矩阵进行稀疏二元信号支撑恢复所需最小样本量的充分条件，给出了阶为 $s\log(p/s)/\log(ds/p)$ 的信息论阈值，明确量化了测量稀疏性的代价，并指出存在一个测量稀疏导致对数级样本复杂度损失却换来近线性计算增益的区间。
item.description:
稀疏性的代价：使用稀疏与稀疏化测量进行稀疏恢复的充分条件

The Price of Sparsity: Sufficient Conditions for Sparse Recovery using Sparse and Sparsified Measurements

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.01809

本文确定了在高信噪比区间使用稀疏高斯测量矩阵进行稀疏二元信号支撑恢复所需最小样本量的充分条件，给出了阶为 $s\log(p/s)/\log(ds/p)$ 的信息论阈值，明确量化了测量稀疏性的代价，并指出存在一个测量稀疏导致对数级样本复杂度损失却换来近线性计算增益的区间。

我们研究从含噪线性测量中对稀疏二元信号进行支撑恢复的问题。对于稀疏高斯测量矩阵，我们在高信噪比区间 $ds/p \to \infty$ 下确定了最大似然恢复所需最小样本量的充分条件，其中 $p$ 表示信号维度，$s$ 表示信号非零分量的数量，$d$ 表示测量矩阵每行非零分量的期望数量。结合已知的下界，这给出了阶为 $s\log(p/s) / \log(ds/p)$ 的信息论阈值，从而明确揭示了测量稀疏性的代价。特别地，我们强调了一种区间，在该区间中测量稀疏性导致的样本复杂度损失是对数级的，而计算增益接近线性。其次，我们研究了对原始稠密高斯设计进行稀疏化后的恢复问题：观测数据由稠密设计生成，而估计则使用一个独立的（摘要在此处截断）。

arXiv:2509.01809v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We consider the problem of support recovery for sparse binary signals from noisy linear measurements. For sparse Gaussian measurement matrices we identify sufficient conditions on the minimal sample size for maximum-likelihood recovery in the high-SNR regime $ds/p \to \infty$, where $p$ denotes the signal dimension, $s$ the number of non-zero components of the signal, and $d$ the expected number of non-zero components per row of measurement. Combined with known lower bounds, this yields an information-theoretic threshold of order $s\log(p/s) / \log(ds/p)$, making explicit the price of measurement sparsity. In particular, we highlight a regime where the sample-complexity loss from measurement sparsity is logarithmic while the computational gain is nearly linear. item.title: 该论文提出统一策略-价值框架ReST-RL，通过ReST-GRPO重塑轨迹分布以放大奖励信号提升策略训练效率，并结合基于MCTS自收集数据训练价值模型的VM-MCTS解码搜索方法，协同增强大语言模型的推理能力。
item.description:
ReST-RL：通过统一自训练与价值引导搜索强化大语言模型推理

ReST-RL: Reinforcing LLM Reasoning through Unified Self-Training and Value-Guided Search

https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.19576

该论文提出统一策略-价值框架ReST-RL，通过ReST-GRPO重塑轨迹分布以放大奖励信号提升策略训练效率，并结合基于MCTS自收集数据训练价值模型的VM-MCTS解码搜索方法，协同增强大语言模型的推理能力。

在提高大语言模型（LLM）推理准确率方面，代表性的强化学习（RL）方法——组相对策略优化（GRPO）——已取得关键性成功，但其仍存在奖励信号不显著的问题。本文提出了ReST-RL，这是一个统一的强化自训练策略-价值框架，它将策略优化与价值引导搜索重新连接起来，以提升LLM的推理能力。首先，ReST-GRPO采用一种优化的ReST风格算法，通过增加GRPO采样的奖励方差，并让策略接触信息更丰富的部分状态，来重塑策略诱导的轨迹分布，从而提升训练的效率和有效性。随后，我们进一步引入一种解码优化方法VM-MCTS，该方法基于自收集的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）目标训练价值模型（VM），并通过改进的MCTS算法部署该模型以提供[价值引导的搜索]。

arXiv:2508.19576v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: With respect to improving the reasoning accuracy of LLMs, the representative reinforcement learning (RL) method - Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) - has achieved critical success, yet it still suffers from the issue of insignificant reward signals. This paper introduces ReST-RL, a unified Reinforced Self-Training (ReST) policy-value framework that reconnects policy optimization and value-guided search to improve LLM reasoning ability. Firstly, ReST-GRPO adopts an optimized ReST-style algorithm to reshape the policy-induced trajectory distribution by increasing the reward variance of GRPO sampling and exposing the policy to more informative partial states, thereby improving training efficiency and effectiveness. item.title: 本文提出REC框架，通过集成分布奖励模型显式建模每个时间步的奖励不确定性，解决了手工设计奖励函数与人类判断不一致的问题，使智能体能够仅凭人类偏好学会执行高难度的特技飞行动作。
item.description:
从偏好中学习特技飞行

Learning Acrobatic Flight from Preferences

https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.18817

本文提出REC框架，通过集成分布奖励模型显式建模每个时间步的奖励不确定性，解决了手工设计奖励函数与人类判断不一致的问题，使智能体能够仅凭人类偏好学会执行高难度的特技飞行动作。

基于偏好的强化学习使智能体能够在无需人工设计奖励函数的情况下学习控制策略，因此非常适合那些目标难以形式化或本质上具有主观性的任务。特技飞行是一个特别具有挑战性的问题，因为其动力学复杂、运动速度快，且精确执行至关重要。然而，为此类任务人工设计的奖励函数往往无法捕捉真正重要的品质：我们发现手工设计的奖励与人类判断仅有60.7%的一致率，这凸显了基于偏好方法的必要性。在本工作中，我们提出了置信度下的奖励集成，这是一种用于偏好强化学习的概率性奖励学习框架，通过分布奖励模型的集成显式地对每个时间步的奖励不确定性进行建模。该方法将不确定性传播到偏好损失中，并利用模型间的分歧（来指导策略学习）。

arXiv:2508.18817v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) enables agents to learn control policies without requiring manually designed reward functions, making it well-suited for tasks where objectives are difficult to formalize or inherently subjective. Acrobatic flight poses a particularly challenging problem due to its complex dynamics, rapid movements, and the importance of precise execution. However, manually designed reward functions for such tasks often fail to capture the qualities that matter: we find that hand-crafted rewards agree with human judgment only 60.7% of the time, underscoring the need for preference-driven approaches. In this work, we propose Reward Ensemble under Confidence (REC), a probabilistic reward learning framework for PbRL that explicitly models per-timestep reward uncertainty through an ensemble of distributional reward models. By propagating uncertainty into the preference loss and leveraging disagreement

item.title: ComplicitSplat是首个利用3D高斯泼溅中视角特定伪装对下游目标检测器发起黑盒攻击的方法，无需了解模型架构或权重即可成功攻击多种检测器，揭示了自动驾驶等安全关键应用面临的新型风险。
item.description:
ComplicitSplat：下游模型容易受到3D高斯泼溅伪装的黑盒攻击

ComplicitSplat: Downstream Models are Vulnerable to Blackbox Attacks by 3D Gaussian Splat Camouflages

https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.11854

ComplicitSplat是首个利用3D高斯泼溅中视角特定伪装对下游目标检测器发起黑盒攻击的方法，无需了解模型架构或权重即可成功攻击多种检测器，揭示了自动驾驶等安全关键应用面临的新型风险。

随着3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）因能够从静态图像高效合成新视角而在安全关键任务中快速获得应用，攻击者可能如何篡改图像以造成危害？我们提出了ComplicitSplat，这是首个利用标准3DGS着色方法创建视角特定伪装的攻击——即随观察角度变化的颜色和纹理——将对抗性内容嵌入场景物体中，这些内容仅在特定视角下可见，且无需访问模型架构或权重。我们的大量实验表明，ComplicitSplat能够成功泛化并攻击多种流行的检测器——包括单阶段、多阶段和基于Transformer的模型，涵盖真实世界物理物体拍摄和合成场景。据我们所知，这是首个使用3DGS对下游目标检测器发起的黑盒攻击，暴露了自动驾驶等应用中的一种新型安全风险。

arXiv:2508.11854v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: As 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) gains rapid adoption in safety-critical tasks for efficient novel-view synthesis from static images, how might an adversary tamper images to cause harm? We introduce ComplicitSplat, the first attack that exploits standard 3DGS shading methods to create viewpoint-specific camouflage - colors and textures that change with viewing angle - to embed adversarial content in scene objects that are visible only from specific viewpoints and without requiring access to model architecture or weights. Our extensive experiments show that ComplicitSplat generalizes to successfully attack a variety of popular detector - both single-stage, multi-stage, and transformer-based models on both real-world capture of physical objects and synthetic scenes. item.title: 本研究将基于局部谷的采样质量评估方法应用于最新一代D-Wave量子退火机，发现在RBM采样中D-Wave覆盖的局部谷数量略多于Gibbs采样，但两者找到的局部谷差异明显，且在高概率状态上重叠度高、互补性不足。

D-Wave量子退火与Gibbs蒙特卡洛在受限玻尔兹曼机概率分布采样中的比较

Comparison of D-Wave Quantum Annealing and Gibbs Monte Carlo for Sampling from a Probability Distribution of a Restricted Boltzmann Machine

https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.10228

本研究将基于局部谷的采样质量评估方法应用于最新一代D-Wave量子退火机，发现在RBM采样中D-Wave覆盖的局部谷数量略多于Gibbs采样，但两者找到的局部谷差异明显，且在高概率状态上重叠度高、互补性不足。

本研究将一种以局部谷（LV）为中心的受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）采样质量评估方法应用于最新一代的D-Wave量子退火机。在与基于对比散度的RBM学习相关的条件下，从经典训练的RBM中获取了D-Wave和Gibbs采样样本。通过样本所属局部谷的数量以及相应局部极小值的能量对两种采样结果进行了比较。结果表明，减少D-Wave退火时间并未带来局部谷数量的显著（理想的）增加。在每个训练周期中，D-Wave采样的状态所属的局部谷数量略高于Gibbs采样。然而，两种技术找到的许多局部谷并不相同。对于高概率采样状态，两种技术（不利地）表现出较低的互补性和较高的重叠度。尽管如此，许多潜在“重要”的局部极小值……（摘要在此截断）

arXiv:2508.10228v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A local-valley (LV) centered approach to assessing the quality of sampling from Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs) was applied to the latest generation of the D-Wave quantum annealer. D-Wave and Gibbs samples from a classically trained RBM were obtained at conditions relevant to the contrastive-divergence-based RBM learning. The samples were compared for the number of the LVs to which they belonged and the energy of the corresponding local minima. No significant (desirable) increase in the number of the LVs has been achieved by decreasing the D-Wave annealing time. At any training epoch, the states sampled by the D-Wave belonged to a somewhat higher number of LVs than in the Gibbs sampling. However, many of those LVs found by the two techniques differed. item.title: 该论文提出了一种基于Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换的新颖差分隐私化框架，通过降维技术对knockoff矩阵进行隐私化处理，在差分隐私约束下实现了严格的错误发现率（FDR）控制，并从理论上刻画了隐私参数和样本量等因素对变量选择功效的渐近影响。
item.description:
基于Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换的差分隐私Model-X Knockoffs方法

Differentially Private Model-X Knockoffs via Johnson-Lindenstrauss Transform

https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.04800

该论文提出了一种基于Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换的新颖差分隐私化框架，通过降维技术对knockoff矩阵进行隐私化处理，在差分隐私约束下实现了严格的错误发现率（FDR）控制，并从理论上刻画了隐私参数和样本量等因素对变量选择功效的渐近影响。

我们为高维受控变量选择引入了一种新颖的隐私化框架。该框架能够在差分隐私约束下实现严格的错误发现率（FDR）控制。虽然Model-X knockoff程序通过构造可证明可交换的“阴性对照”特征来提供FDR保证，但现有的隐私机制（如高斯噪声注入）会破坏其核心的可交换性条件。在这项工作中，我们考虑通过Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换（JLT）对数据knockoff矩阵进行隐私化处理，JLT是一种降维技术，通过对(ε,δ)-差分隐私的近似等距性，同时保留协变量之间的关系。我们从理论上渐近地刻画了所提出的隐私变量选择程序的FDR和统计功效。我们的理论分析刻画了隐私参数、样本量等不同因素所起的作用。

In this work we consider privatizing the data knockoff matrix through Johnson--Lindenstrauss Transform (JLT), a dimension reduction technique that simultaneously preserves covariate relationships through approximate isometry for $(\epsilon,\delta)$-differential privacy.
